Select BRBM,Sum(ZJE),Sum(jzje) From
(SELECT sum(NVL(ZJJE,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)) zje,sum(NVL(Z	luds_ybsj = Create u_datastore 		String ls_ywlx[], ls_cbrlb 		Integer li_byd = 0 		//门诊/住院
		IF rb_mz.Checked  THEN
			ls_ywlx[1] = 'SF'
			ls_ywlx[2] = 'GH'
		ELSEIF rb_zy.Checked THEN
			ls_ywlx[1] = 'ZY'
		END IF
		//农医保
		IF  rb_yb.Checked THEN
			ls_cbrlb = 'YB'
		ELSEIF rb_nb.Checked THEN
			ls_cbrlb = is_nbcbrlb
		END IF
		//本地异地取不同dataobject
		IF rb_bd.Checked THEN
			li_byd = 0
			IF ldt_begin >= idt_wdqy THEN
				luds_ybsj.DataObject = "d_pyyb_ydsj"
				dw_main.Object.byd_t.Text = '--------本地医保'
			ELSE
				luds_ybsj.DataObject = "d_pyyb_bdsj"
				dw_main.Object.byd_t.Text = '--------本地医保'
			END IF
		ELSE
			li_byd = 1
			luds_ybsj.DataObject = "d_pyyb_ydsj"
			dw_main.Object.byd_t.Text = '--------一卡通医保'
		END IF
		luds_ybsj.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
		luds_ybsj.Retrieve( ldt_begin,ldt_end, ls_ywlx,ls_cbrlb,li_byd,is_cbd)
		IF luds_ybsj.RowCount( ) > 0 THEN
			Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_xjje,ld_bxje,ld_zfje,ld_zlje,ld_zfje2,ld_tcze,ld_gbze,ld_jzze,ld_zhze,ld_zxze,ld_ybfy,ldc_dbbz
			Long ll_jzrc,ll_zzrc,ll_txrc,ll_zyts
			ld_fyze = luds_ybsj.Object.fyze[1]
			ld_xjje = luds_ybsj.Object.xjzf[1]
			ld_bxje = luds_ybsj.Object.bxje[1]
			ld_zfje = luds_ybsj.Object.zfje[1]
			ld_zlje = luds_ybsj.Object.zlje[1]
			ld_zfje2 = luds_ybsj.Object.zfje2[1]
			ld_tcze = luds_ybsj.Object.tcje[1]
			ld_gbze = luds_ybsj.Object.GBje[1]
			ld_jzze = luds_ybsj.Object.JZje[1]
			ld_zhze = luds_ybsj.Object.GRZHJJ[1]
			ld_zxze = luds_ybsj.Object.ZXJJ[1]
			ldc_dbbz = luds_ybsj.Object.DBBZZF[1]
			IF rb_mz.Checked And rb_yb.Checked THEN
				dw_main.Object.FSZFY[1] = ld_fyze
				dw_main.Object.GRFDZFY[1] = ld_xjje
				dw_main.Object.JSJE[1] = ld_bxje
				dw_main.Object.zfje[1] = ld_zfje
				dw_main.Object.zlje[1] = ld_zlje
				dw_main.Object.zfje2[1] = ld_zfje2
				dw_main.Object.jbtcje[1] = ld_tcze
				dw_main.Object.GBje[1] = ld_gbze
				dw_main.Object.JZje[1] = ld_jzze
				dw_main.Object.GRZHJJ[1] = ld_zhze
				dw_main.Object.ZXJJ[1] = ld_zxze + ldc_dbbz
			ELSEIF rb_mz.Checked And rb_nb.Checked THEN
				ld_ybfy = luds_ybsj.Object.YBFY[1]
				dw_main.Object.SBDW[1] = base_info.hospital
				dw_main.Object.ZJE[1] = String(ld_fyze) + '元'
				dw_main.Object.KBJE[1] = String(ld_ybfy) + '元'
				dw_main.Object.bxje[1] = "(大写)" + gu_char.uf_dxzh(ld_bxje) + "    (￥"+String(ld_bxje,'0.00') + ")"
				IF rb_bd.Checked THEN
					IF ldt_begin >= idt_wdqy THEN
						//						SELECT SUM (CASE WHEN ZTBZ = 3 Or ZTBZ = 5 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)  Into :ll_jzrc From JKXT.YB_JSMX
						//					Where ZTBZ > 0 And QRJYLSH Is Not Null And  JSSJ >= :ldt_begin And  JSSJ < :ldt_end And  
						//					      and CBDXZHQ = :is_cbd AND YWLX = 'GH' And CBRLB = 'E00' AND YLFYZE <> 0	Using sqlca_query;

ls_tsxx = "请输入本地有而医保中心的明细中没有的结算交易流水号~n" +&
	"（提示：该功能只进行本地有而中心没有的明细调整，本地没有而医保中心有的明细【门诊校对】双击具体明细。）"
ls_jsjylsh = Trim(gf_inputbox(ls_tsxx, ""))

IF ls_jsjylsh = '-1' Or ls_jsjylsh = "" THEN
	RETURN
END IF

DateTime ldt_begin
ldt_begin = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(idt_begin), -1), Time("00:00:00"))

String ls_brbm, ls_ywlx
Long ll_zyh
DateTime ldt_jysj

String ls_sql
ls_sql = "SELECT brbm, ywlx,zyh,jssj From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= " + gf_dtinsql(ldt_begin) + " And (jslsh = '" + ls_jsjylsh + "' or jylsh = '"+ls_jsjylsh+"') And (ztbz >= 0 or ztbz = -1) Order By jssj Desc "
u_datastore lds_brxx
lds_brxx = Create u_datastore
IF lds_brxx.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
	MessageBox("提示", "创建'病人信息查询'对象失败。")
	RETURN
END IF
lds_brxx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
IF lds_brxx.Retrieve() <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox("提示", "该结算交易流水号没找到对应的病人信息")
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_brbm = lds_brxx.Object.brbm[1]
	ls_ywlx = lds_brxx.Object.ywlx[1]
	ll_zyh = lds_brxx.Object.zyh[1]
	IF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'SF' Or ls_ywlx = '' THEN
		ii_bplx = 4
	ELSEIF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'GH' THEN
		ii_bplx = 5
	ELSEIF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'ZY' THEN
		ii_bplx = 6
	END IF

String ls_fsid,ls_jsid,ls_rybh,ls_yllb,ls_jsbz,ls_srwjcs,ls_jzid,ls_tfbz,ls_filename,ls_path,ls_ywlx
Integer li_ywlx,j
Long   	ll_jybs,ll_rowcount,ll_i,ll_xhcs,ll_snsjbbh,ll_zdbbh,ll_insert,ll_mxrowcount,ll_j,ll_ret,ll_find
Decimal	ld_ylfyze,ld_jjzfze,ld_grzhzfze,ld_xjzfje,ld_ylfyze_sum,ld_jjzfze_sum,ld_grzhzfze_sum

//判断是否统计汇总过，汇总日期是否与显示一致

		//	post event ue_ref()

		RETURN
	ELSE
		ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]

			MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再对账')
			RETURN
		ELSE
			IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
				MessageBox('提示','对账时间'+String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')+'与对账信息汇总中的对账日' + ls_dzr+'不一致,请重新统计汇总')
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	IF  dw_1.RowCount( ) > 0 THEN
		ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]
	ELSE
		ls_dzr = String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')
	END IF
	IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','对账时间'+String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')+'与对账信息汇总中的对账日' + ls_dzr+'不一致,请重新统计汇总')
		RETURN
	END IF
end if
IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_czy_qrqc(Date(gf_server_date()),base_info.UserID,1,ls_err) = -1 THEN
	MessageBox('出错提示','获取操作员签到编号' + ls_err)
	RETURN
END IF
j = 0
ll_rowcount = dw_1.RowCount()
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Reset()
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("")
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter()
IF ddlb_ywlx.getcode() = '1'  THEN //本地明细对账
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',1)
		FOR ll_i = 1 To ll_rowcount
			gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',(ll_i*100/ll_rowcount))
			li_ywlx = dw_1.Object.ywlx[ll_i]
			ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[ll_i]
			ll_jybs = dw_1.Object.jybs[ll_i]
			ls_xz = dw_1.Object.xz[ll_i]
			ls_qslb = dw_1.Object.qslb[ll_i]
			ld_ylfyze = dw_1.Object.ylfze[ll_i]
			ld_jjzfze = dw_1.Object.jjzfze[ll_i]
			ld_grzhzfze = dw_1.Object.grzhzfze[ll_i]
			ld_xjzfje = dw_1.Object.xjzfje[ll_i]
			ls_dzjg = dw_1.Object.dzjg[ll_i]
			if isnull(ll_jybs) then ll_jybs = 1
			if isnull(ld_ylfyze) then ld_ylfyze = 0.00
			if isnull(ld_jjzfze) then ld_jjzfze = 0.00
			if isnull(ld_grzhzfze) then ld_grzhzfze = 0.00
			if isnull(ld_xjzfje) then ld_xjzfje = 0.00
			IF ls_dzjg <> '0' THEN				
				gf_applog("开始组装")
				j++
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_init('3202')
				if ls_qslb ='99994' then
					iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('setl_optins','330000')
				else
					iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('setl_optins',iu_zhyl_his.is_yljgxzqh)
				end if
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('stmt_begndate',Date(idt_begin))
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('stmt_enddate',Date(idt_end))
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('medfee_sumamt',ld_ylfyze)
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('fund_pay_sumamt',ld_jjzfze)
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('cash_payamt',ld_xjzfje)
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('fixmedins_setl_cnt',ll_jybs)
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('clr_type',ls_qslb)
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('refd_setl_flag','')
				//				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('refd_setl_flag','1')
				//				if is_cbdxzhq='3310' then 
				tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("qslb='"+ls_qslb+"'  and (left(cbdxzqh,4) ='"+is_cbdxzhq+"' or isnull(cbdxzqh))")
				tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter()
				//				else
				//					tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("qslb='"+ls_qslb+"'  and xzlx ='"+ls_xz+"'   and (left(cbdxzqh,4) ='"+is_cbdxzhq+"' or isnull(cbdxzqh))")
				//					tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter()
				//				end if
				ll_mxrowcount = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount()
				
				ls_filename = ls_dzr + '-' + ls_qslb + '-' + String(gf_server_date(),'mmddHHmmss')+'.txt'
				gf_applog("导出明细：" + ls_filename)
				IF ll_mxrowcount > 0 THEN
					tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_2.SetTransObject(sqlca)
					IF tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_2.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end,is_cbdxzhq,ls_qslb) <> ll_mxrowcount THEN
						MessageBox('提示','明细数量不一致：原'+String(ll_mxrowcount) + "现" + String(tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_2.RowCount()))
						RETURN
					ELSE
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_2.SaveAs(is_mxxz_lj + "\" + ls_filename,Text!,False)
						gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',-1)
					END IF
//					FOR ll_j = 1  To ll_mxrowcount
//						ls_jsid = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jslsh[ll_j]
//						ls_jzid = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jzid[ll_j]
//						ls_rybh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.grbh[ll_j]
//						ld_ylfyze = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.ylfze[ll_j]
//						ld_jjzfze = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jjzfze[ll_j]
//						ld_grzhzfze = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.grzhzc[ll_j]
//						ls_tfbz = ''
//						IF ll_j = ll_mxrowcount THEN
//							ls_srwjcs = ls_srwjcs + ls_jsid+'~t'+ls_jzid+'~t'+ls_rybh+'~t'+String(ld_ylfyze)+'~t'+String(ld_jjzfze)+'~t'+String(ld_grzhzfze)+'~t'+ls_tfbz
//						ELSE
//							ls_srwjcs = ls_srwjcs + ls_jsid+'~t'+ls_jzid+'~t'+ls_rybh+'~t'+String(ld_ylfyze)+'~t'+String(ld_jjzfze)+'~t'+String(ld_grzhzfze)+'~t'+ls_tfbz+'~r~n'
//						END IF
//					NEXT
				ELSE
					MessageBox('提示','可导出明细为空')
					RETURN	            
				END IF
				gf_applog("导出虳AT* " + ls_filename)
				ls_path = this.wf_replacestr( is_mxxz_lj, "\",'\\')
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('file_qury_no',ls_path)
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('filename',ls_filename)
				iu_zhyl_his.istr_jytsrx.inf_time = gf_server_date()
				gf_applog("开始调用")
				IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_send(ls_err,'') THEN
					gf_applog("开始调用。。。。wf_post ")
					ll_ret = wf_post(iu_zhyl_his.is_send,ls_return)
					
					gf_applog("wf_post返回ret:" + String(ll_ret))
					IF ll_ret = 1 THEN
						gf_applog("开始引入")
						IF tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.ImportFile(ls_return) > 0 THEN
							gf_applog("成功引入")
							EXIT;
						ELSE
							gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',-1)
							MessageBox('提示','下载失败ImportFile错误')
							tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("left(cbdxzqh,4) = '"+is_cbdxzhq+"' or isnull(cbdxzqh)")
							tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter( )
							RETURN
						END IF
					ELSE
						gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',-1)
						MessageBox('提示','下载失败'+ls_return)
						tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("left(cbdxzqh,4) = '"+is_cbdxzhq+"' or isnull(cbdxzqh)")
						tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter( )
						RETURN
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
			
		NEXT
	END IF
	
ELSE //异地明细下载
	ls_jsbz = '0'
	ll_zdbbh = 0
	string ls_jzsj
	dec{0} ldc_stamp
	integer li_stamp_ws
	Select length(round((sysdate - to_date('1970-01-01 08:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'))*60*60*24,0)) into :li_stamp_ws  FROM Dual;
//	ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]
	DO WHILE ls_jsbz = '0'
		gf_waiting('正在下载，请稍后......',1)
		iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_init('1812')
		iu_zhyl_his.istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = '330000' //20220208
		iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('loclDataVer',ll_zdbbh)
		iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('fixmedinsNo',iu_zhyl_his.is_yljgdm) //定点医药机构编码
		iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('begndate',String(Date(idt_begin),'yyyymmdd'))
		iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('enddate',String(Date(idt_end),'yyyymmdd'))
		IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_send(ls_err,'') THEN
			IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
				MessageBox('提示',iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring('err_msg'))
				RETURN
			ELSE
				ll_xhcs = iu_zhyl_his.uf_Getstring_mxnr('data')
				IF ll_xhcs > 0 THEN
					w_sbdz_zhyb.SetRedraw(False)
					FOR ll_i = 1 To ll_xhcs
						j++
						ls_cbdybqh = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('insuplcAdmdvs',ll_i)
						ld_ylfyze = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdecimal_in('medfeeSumamt',ll_i)
						ld_grzhzfze = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdecimal_in('psnCashpay',ll_i)
						ld_jjzfze = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdecimal_in('optinsPaySumamt',ll_i)
						ls_jzsj = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('mdtrtSetlTime',ll_i)
						if isnumber(ls_jzsj) then
							ldc_stamp = dec(mid(ls_jzsj,1,li_stamp_ws))
						end if
						SELECT to_date('1970-01-01 08:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') + :ldc_stamp /60/60/24 into :ld_jzjssj FROM Dual;
//						ld_jzjssj = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdatetime_in('mdtrtSetlTime',ll_i)
						ls_jylx = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('trnsType',ll_i)
						ls_jzsxh = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('mdtrtSeq',ll_i)
						ls_jslsh = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('setlSn',ll_i)
						ll_snsjbbh = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdecimal_in('loclDataVer',ll_i)
						ls_yllb = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('medType',ll_i)
						ls_fsid = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('senderMsgId',ll_i)
						ls_jsid = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('recerMsgId',ll_i)
						ls_rybh = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('psnNo',ll_i)
						IF ll_snsjbbh > ll_zdbbh THEN //获取最大版本号
							ll_zdbbh = ll_snsjbbh
						END IF
						ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.InsertRow(0)
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jsid[ll_insert] = ls_jslsh
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfze[ll_insert] = ld_ylfyze
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.grxjzf[ll_insert] = ld_grzhzfze
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jbjgzfze[ll_insert] = ld_jjzfze
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jylx[ll_insert] = ls_jylx
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jysj[ll_insert] = ld_jzjssj
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdxzqhdm[ll_insert] = ls_cbdybqh
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jzsxh[ll_insert] = ls_jzsxh
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.snsjbbh[ll_insert] = ll_snsjbbh
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.yllb[ll_insert] = ls_yllb
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.fsbwid[ll_insert] = ls_fsid
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jsbwid[ll_insert] = ls_jsid
						tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.rybh[ll_insert] = ls_rybh
					NEXT
				END IF
				IF ll_xhcs = 100 THEN //如果结果数据等于100条，需继续礑AT*
饔茫�第二次调用传入第一次返回数据中的最大数据版本号，循环调用，直到返回数据条数小�
100为止。
				ELSE
					ls_jsbz = '1'
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			gf_waiting('正在下载，请稍后......',-1)
			MessageBox('异地明细下载',ls_err)
			tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("left(cbdxzqh,4) <> '"+is_cbdxzhq+"'")
			tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter( )
			IF ls_err = '无返回数据' THEN //20220401zbq增加一个异地每天对账通过的总对账
				ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Find("dzr = '"+ls_dzr+"'and rybh ='1' ",1,tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.RowCount())
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					IF tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.dzjg[ll_find] = '1' THEN
					ELSE
						tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.dzjg[ll_find] = '1'
						tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.ylfze[ll_find] = 	Dec(dw_1.Describe("EVALUATE('SUM(YLFZE)',1)"))
						tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.jbjgzfze[ll_find] = Dec(dw_1.Describe("EVALUATE('SUM(jbjgzfze)',1)"))
						gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
						IF tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Update( ) = 1 THEN
							gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
						ELSE
							gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
							MessageBox('提示',ls_dzr+"  总对账结果保存失败!")
						END IF
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
			RETURN
		END IF
	LOOP
	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("left(cbdxzqh,4) <> '"+is_cbdxzhq+"'")
	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter( )
END IF
w_sbdz_zhyb.SetRedraw(True)
gf_waiting('正在下载，请稍后......',-1)
IF j > 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','下载成功')
ELSE
	MessageBox('提示','没有对账不平的数据')
END IF

global function integer gf_bcmx (string as_ywlx, string as_fplsh, ref string as_error);String ls_brbm,ls_ksbm,ls_ysbm
Dec{0} ldc_ghlsh
Dec{2} ldc_zjje,ldc_jzje,ldc_yhje,ldc_yhje_t
Integer li_gfje
DateTime ldt_now,ldt_kpsj
ldt_now = gf_server_date()
IF as_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
	ldc_ghlsh = Dec(as_fplsh)
	SELECT BRBM,nvl(ZJJE,0),nvl(ZJJE,0) - nvl(XJJE,0),KSBM,ysbm Into :ls_brbm,:ldc_zjje,:ldc_jzje,:ls_ksbm,:ls_ysbm From MZ_GHXX Where GHLSH = :ldc_ghlsh;
ELSE
	SELECT grbm,GHLSH,CASE when gfje = 1 THEN xmzje - nvl(yhje,0) ELSE xmzje END,jzje Into :ls_brbm,:ldc_ghlsh,:ldc_zjje,:ldc_jzje From mz_fpk Where fplsh = :as_fplsh;
END IF
IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '获取发票信息失败：' + sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
uo_brxx luo_brxx
datastore lds_yb_sfmx
IF IsValid(gu_ybjk_public) = False THEN
	gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
	IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_init(as_error) = False THEN
		as_error = '医保初始化失败：' + as_error
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

str_return lstr_return
luo_brxx = Create uo_brxx
lstr_brxx.BRBM = ls_brbm
lstr_return = luo_brxx.uf_get_brxx('BRBM',lstr_brxx)
IF lstr_return.ai_return < 0 THEN
	as_error = '获取病人信息失败：' + lstr_return.as_error
	GOTO Error
END IF

ldc_smkzf = 0
//SELECT jyjslx,smkzhzf Into :ls_jylx,:ldc_smkzf From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where BRBM = :ls_brbm And ywlx  = :as_ywlx And ywlsh = :as_fplsh And ztbz In (1,2,-1) Using sqlca;

SELECT yllb ,bzbm INTO  :ls_jylx, :ls_bzdm FROM JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX
	Where BRBM = :ls_brbm And ywlx  = :as_ywlx And ywlsh = :as_fplsh  And ztbz In (1,2) Using sqlca;

IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '获取医保结算信息出错:' + sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF ls_jylx = '11' Or ls_jylx = '12' Or ls_jylx = '13' THEN
	ls_jylx = 'PT'
ELSEIF ls_jylx = '140201' THEN
	ls_jylx = 'TSB'
	lstr_brxx.tsbxm = ls_bzdm
ELSEIF ls_jylx = '14' THEN // ls_jylx = '140104' Or
	ls_jylx = 'MXB'
	lstr_brxx.mxbxm = ls_bzdm
ELSEIF ls_jylx = '140401' THEN
	ls_jylx = 'HJB'
ELSEIF ls_jylx = '51' THEN
	ls_jylx = 'SY'
ELSE
	ls_jylx = 'PT'
END IF
Long ll_count ,ll_cur,ll_yyts,ll_spbz
Dec{0} ldc_cflsh,ldc_jzlsh
String ls_ycsl,ls_jl,ls_jsjylsh,ls_firstfplsh,ls_fplshs[],ls_fplsh_temp[]
String ls_ywlsh,ls_zh,ls_spbz
lds_yb_sfmx = Create datastore
IF as_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
	lds_yb_sfmx.DataObject = 'd_gh_bjy'
	lds_yb_sfmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	ll_count = lds_yb_sfmx.Retrieve(ldc_ghlsh )
ELSE
	ls_fplshs[1] = as_fplsh
	lds_yb_sfmx.DataObject = 'd_cwsf_mz_sfmx_bjy'
	lds_yb_sfmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	SELECT firstfplsh Into :ls_firstfplsh From mz_tpxx Where newfplsh = :as_fplsh And tpxh = 0;
	IF ls_firstfplsh > '' THEN
		Dec{2} ldc_tzje,ldc_tjzje
		String ls_newfp = ''
		ls_fplshs[2] = ls_firstfplsh
		SELECT to_char(wm_concat(newfplsh)) Into :ls_newfp  From mz_tpxx Where firstfplsh = :ls_firstfplsh And tpxh = 0 And newfplsh <> :as_fplsh;
		IF ls_newfp > ' ' THEN
			gf_splitparm(ls_newfp,ls_fplsh_temp)
			IF UpperBound(ls_fplsh_temp) > 0 THEN
				FOR ll_cur = 1 To UpperBound(ls_fplsh_temp)
					ls_fplshs[2 + ll_cur] = ls_fplsh_temp[ll_cur]
				NEXT
			END IF
		END IF
		SELECT GHLSH,xmzje,jzje,nvl(yhje,0),gfje,kpsj Into :ldc_ghlsh,:ldc_zjje,:ldc_jzje,:ldc_yhje,:li_gfje,:ldt_kpsj From mz_fpk Where fplsh = :ls_firstfplsh;
		IF li_gfje = 1 THEN
			SELECT sum(nvl(yhje,0)) Into :ldc_yhje_t From mz_fpk Where grbm = :ls_brbm And kpsj >= :ldt_kpsj  And fplsh In (SELECT fplsh From mz_tpxx Where firstfplsh = :ls_firstfplsh And tpxh = 0 );
			IF IsNull(ldc_yhje_t) THEN ldc_yhje_t = 0
		END IF
		SELECT sum(t_zje),sum(t_jzje) Into :ldc_tzje,:ldc_tjzje From mz_tpxx Where firstfplsh = :ls_firstfplsh And tpxh = 0 ;
		IF IsNull(ldc_tzje) THEN ldc_tzje = 0
		IF IsNull(ldc_tjzje) THEN ldc_tjzje = 0
		ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje - ldc_tzje - ldc_yhje_t
		ldc_jzje = ldc_jzje - ldc_tjzje
	END IF
	ll_count = lds_yb_sfmx.Retrieve(ls_fplshs )
	//	获取对应的KSBM,YSBM,GHLSH,JZLSH GH.CBDXZQH
	SELECT GH.YSBM,GH.KSBM, JZ.JZLSH INTO :ls_ysbm,:ls_ksbm,:ldc_jzlsh
		FROM JKXT.ZHYB_MZJZXX JZ,JKXT.ZHYB_GHXX GH
		Where GH.BRBM = JZ.BRBM And GH.JZID = JZ.JZID And GH.BRBM = :ls_brbm And GH.ywlsh = :as_fplsh;
	IF ls_ysbm = '000000' THEN
		ls_ysbm = ''
	ELSE
		SELECT ygdm Into :ls_ysbm From gy_ygdm_kz Where gjybdm = :ls_ysbm;//ls_ksbm = 'YB+' +ls_ksbm
	END IF
	IF ldc_jzlsh >0  THEN		
		SELECT JZKS INTO :ls_ksbm FROM MZ_JZXX WHERE JZLSH = :ldc_jzlsh;
	end if
END IF

IF as_ywlx = 'SF' And ll_count > 0  THEN
	Dec{2} ldc_xmsl
	String ls_ywlx,ls_filter
	Long ll_fyxh,ll_ypcd,ll_find
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		
		ldc_cflsh = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
		ls_ywlsh = String(ldc_cflsh)
		ls_zh  = String(lds_yb_sfmx.Object.mxxh[ll_cur])
		ls_filter = ''
		IF lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur] = 'CF' THEN
			IF (ldc_jzlsh<= 0 or isnull(ldc_jzlsh)) AND ll_cur = 1 then
				select ksbm into :ls_ksbm FROM YPXT.mz_cfk where cflsh = :ldc_cflsh;
			end if
			SELECT ycsl,jl,yyts Into :ls_ycsl,:ls_jl,:ll_yyts From mz_cfmx Where cflsh = :ldc_cflsh And xh = :ls_zh Using sqlca;
			lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ycjl[ll_cur] = ls_ycsl
			lds_yb_sfmx.Object.sypc[ll_cur] = ls_jl
			lds_yb_sfmx.Object.yyts[ll_cur] = ll_yyts
			lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ypzh[ll_cur] = ls_zh
			IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_Get_spbz( 'CF', ls_brbm, ldc_cflsh, Dec(ls_zh), ll_spbz, as_error) < 0 THEN
				as_error = '获取spbz失败：' + as_error
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF (ldc_jzlsh<= 0 or isnull(ldc_jzlsh)) AND ll_cur = 1 then
				select ksbm into :ls_ksbm FROM MZXT.MZ_yjk1 where YJLSH = :ldc_cflsh;
			end if
			IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_Get_spbz( 'YJ', ls_brbm, ldc_cflsh, Dec(ls_zh), ll_spbz, as_error) < 0 THEN
				as_error = '获取spbz失败：' + as_error
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
		IF IsNull(ll_spbz) THEN ll_spbz = 0
		lds_yb_sfmx.Object.spbz[ll_cur] = ll_spbz
		ldc_xmsl = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_cur]
		ll_fyxh = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmlsh[ll_cur]
		ll_ypcd = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.cdlsh[ll_cur]
		ls_ywlx = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur]
		IF ldc_xmsl < 0 THEN
		//数量小于0 的和正的消掉
		   ldc_xmsl = ldc_xmsl * -1
			ls_filter = " ywlx = '"+ls_ywlx+"' and xmlsh = "+String(ll_fyxh)+" and cdlsh = "+String(ll_ypcd) + " and xmdj = " +string(lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmdj[ll_cur])  +" and xmsl >= " + String(ldc_xmsl)
			if ll_spbz = 9 or ll_spbz = 1 then
				ls_filter += " and spbz in (1,9) "
			else
				ls_filter += " and spbz in (0,2,8) "
			end if
			ll_find = lds_yb_sfmx.Find(ls_filter,1,ll_cur - 1)
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_find] = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_find] - ldc_xmsl
				if lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_find] = 0 then
					lds_yb_sfmx.deleterow( ll_find)
					ll_cur --
					ll_count --
				else
					lds_yb_sfmx.Object.zjje[ll_find] = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.zjje[ll_find] + lds_yb_sfmx.Object.zjje[ll_cur]
					lds_yb_sfmx.Object.zfje[ll_find] = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.zfje[ll_find] + lds_yb_sfmx.Object.zfje[ll_cur]
					lds_yb_sfmx.Object.yhje[ll_find] = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.yhje[ll_find] + lds_yb_sfmx.Object.yhje[ll_cur]
				end if
				lds_yb_sfmx.deleterow( ll_cur)
				ll_cur --
				ll_count --
			ELSE
				as_error = String(ll_find) + '找不到大于等于的该正数量的明细' +  string(lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmmc[ll_cur])
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF
IF ll_count <= 0 THEN
	as_error = '无明细' + String(ll_count)
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ldc_jzlsh) Or ldc_jzlsh = 0 THEN
	SELECT Min(JZLSH) Into :ldc_jzlsh From mz_jzxx Where GHLSH = :ldc_ghlsh;
END IF
lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_grjbxx = gu_ybjk_public.istr_yb_grjbxx
//lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_zhxx = gu_ybjk_public.istr_yb_zhxx //病人账户信息
lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx = Create datastore //费用明细
lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.DataObject = lds_yb_sfmx.DataObject
lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Reset()
lds_yb_sfmx.RowsCopy(1, lds_yb_sfmx.RowCount(), Primary!, lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx, 1, Primary!)
lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm = ls_ysbm
IF as_ywlx = 'SF' THEN
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.SetSort('xmsl D')
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Sort( )
END IF

//SetNull(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs)

	messagebox('信息提示','参数错误，未找到交易周期号')
	close(w_dzmxxz )
end if 

dw_1.settransobject( sqlca)

blocks.name: clicked
blocks.text:
event clicked;Long ll_count,ll_row,ll_pos,ll_insert,ll_char,ll_cur
String ls_jyzqh,ls_jylsh,ls_jjzflb,ls_temp,ls_ywlx,ls_date,ls_temp_date
DateTime ldt_jjzfsj
Dec{2} ldc_zfje
ls_ywlx = dw_1.Object.ywlx[1]
IF ls_ywlx <> 'ZY' THEN ls_ywlx = 'MZ'
u_datastore luds_jjlb
IF IsValid(luds_jjlb) = False THEN
	luds_jjlb = Create u_datastore
	luds_jjlb.DataObject = 'd_fymx_kz'
END IF
luds_jjlb.SetTransObject( sqlca)
ll_count = dw_2.RowCount( )
//ll_count = 1
FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
	ls_jyzqh = dw_2.Object.bkc004[ll_row]
	ls_jylsh = dw_2.Object.ckc009[ll_row]
	IF ls_jylsh = '20180102161132782956' THEN DEBUGBREAK()
	select count(1) into :ll_cur  from jkxt.lsyb_jsmx_kz where jylsh = :ls_jylsh;
	if ll_cur > 0 then continue
	ls_jjzflb = dw_2.Object.dke042[ll_row]
	ls_temp_date = mid(string(dw_2.Object.aae070[ll_row]),1,10)
	ll_pos = Pos(ls_jjzflb,ls_temp_date )
	IF ll_pos = 0 then
		ll_pos = Pos(ls_jjzflb,'1900-01-01' )
	end if
	DO WHILE ll_pos > 0
		ls_temp = Mid(ls_jjzflb,1,ll_pos + 18)
		ls_jjzflb = Mid(ls_jjzflb,ll_pos + 19)
		ls_date = Mid(ls_temp,ll_pos,19)
		ldt_jjzfsj = DateTime(date(mid(ls_date,1,10)),time(mid(ls_date,12,8)))
		ll_insert = luds_jjlb.InsertRow( 0)
		luds_jjlb.Object.jyzqh[ll_insert] = ls_jyzqh
		luds_jjlb.Object.jylsh[ll_insert] = ls_jylsh
		luds_jjlb.Object.lblb[ll_insert] = '2'

blocks.text:
event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;
Dec{0} ld_count,ld_cur,ld_find
u_datastore luds_jchy
luds_jchy = Create u_datastore
luds_jchy.DataObject = 'd_jchy'
luds_jchy.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
ld_count = luds_jchy.Retrieve( )
luds_jchy.SetSort( "YF ASC,KSBM ASC,YSBM ASC")
luds_jchy.Sort( )
w_fyhz.SetRedraw ( false )
IF ld_count > 0 THEN
	String ls_yf,ls_ysbm,ls_ksbm,ls_tjmc,ls_mc,ls_ysxm,ls_ksmc
	Long ll_tjm
	Dec{2} ld_fyje
	FOR ld_cur = 1 To ld_count
		gf_waiting('正在导入。。。。',ld_cur /ld_count * 100)
		ls_yf = luds_jchy.Object.yf[ld_cur]
		ls_ysbm = luds_jchy.Object.ysbm[ld_cur]
		ls_ksbm = luds_jchy.Object.ksbm[ld_cur]
		ll_tjm = luds_jchy.Object.tjm[ld_cur]
		ls_tjmc = luds_jchy.Object.tjmmc[ld_cur]
		ld_fyje = luds_jchy.Object.fyje[ld_cur]
		ls_ysxm = luds_jchy.Object.ysxm[ld_cur]
		ls_ksmc = luds_jchy.Object.ksmc[ld_cur]
		IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) THEN
			ld_find = dw_main.Find("yf = '"+ls_yf+"' and ysbm = '"+ls_ysbm+"' and isnull(ksbm) ", 1,dw_main.RowCount())
		ELSE
			ld_find = dw_main.Find("yf = '"+ls_yf+"' and ysbm = '"+ls_ysbm+"' and ksbm = '"+ls_ksbm +"' ", 1,dw_main.RowCount())
		END IF
		ls_mc = wf_gettjm(ll_tjm)
		IF ls_mc = ''  THEN
			gf_applog("tjm:"+String(ll_tjm)+" tjmc :"+ls_tjmc +"获取出错")
			CONTINUE
		END IF
		//----------------------------------------------------------
		IF ld_find > 0 THEN
			IF ls_mc = 'fsf' THEN
				dw_main.Object.fsf[ld_find] = dw_main.Object.fsf[ld_find] + ld_fyje
			ELSE
				dw_main.SetItem(ld_find, ls_mc, ld_fyje)
			END IF
		ELSEIF ld_find = 0 THEN
			ld_find = dw_main.InsertRow( 0)
			dw_main.Object.yf[ld_find] = ls_yf
			dw_main.Object.ysbm[ld_find] = ls_ysbm
			dw_main.Object.ksbm[ld_find] = ls_ksbm
			dw_main.Object.ysxm[ld_find] = ls_ysxm
			dw_main.Object.ksmc[ld_find] = ls_ksmc
			dw_main.SetItem(ld_find, ls_mc, ld_fyje)
		ELSE
			gf_applog("yf = '"+ls_yf+"' and ysbm = '"+ls_ysbm+"' tjm :"+ls_tjmc +"  ：find出错")
		END IF
		IF ld_find > 0 THEN
			IF ll_tjm = 82 Or ll_tjm = 83 THEN
				dw_main.Object.fsf[ld_find] = dw_main.Object.fsf[ld_find] - ld_fyje
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
ELSE
	MessageBox('提示','数据不对：条蔇AT* ' + String(ld_count) + luds_jchy.is_error)
END IF
gf_waiting('导入完成。。。。',-1)

w_fyhz.SetRedraw ( true )
end event

public function integer wf_dzyz ();IF em_1.getdate( ) >= Date(gf_server_date()) THEN
	messagebox('提示','不能对当日账！')
	RETURN 1 //不对当天账
END IF

idt_begin = datetime(em_1.getdate())
idt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(em_1.getdate(),1),Time(00:00:00))

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',1)
//判断预存是否有过正确结转
//=======================核对==============================//
Dec{2} ld_kyc, ld_yck_fp,ldc_yck_gh
Long ll_count,ll_rowcount

ld_kyc = 0
SELECT SUM(JYJE) INTO :ld_kyc FROM H_MZ_ZHJYMX
	Where JYSJ >= :idt_begin And JYSJ < :idt_end And JYLB In (11,12) ;
//And Upper(JYDD) Not In ('GH','ZZGH');
IF IsNull(ld_kyc) THEN ld_kyc = 0

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',10)

//====预存款－－扣款fpk,zffs
ld_yck_fp = 0
SELECT sum(NVL(H_FP_ZFFS.ZFJE,0)) INTO :ld_yck_fp FROM mz_fpk,H_FP_ZFFS
	WHERE mz_fpk.kpsj >= :idt_begin AND mz_fpk.kpsj < :idt_end
	//	AND (H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '5' OR H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '7' OR H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '8' or H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '10')
	AND (H_FP_ZFFS.zffs IN (SELECT to_char(dmsb) FROM xtgl.gy_dmzd WHERE dmlb = 34 AND bzbm2 = 1))
	And NVL(mz_fpk.fpzf,0) <> 9  And mz_fpk.fplsh = H_FP_ZFFS.fplsh;
IF IsNull(ld_yck_fp) THEN ld_yck_fp = 0
//挂号非现金支付
ldc_yck_gh = 0.00
SELECT sum(NVL(xjje,0)) INTO :ldc_yck_gh FROM MZ_GHXX
	WHERE GHRQ >= :idt_begin AND GHRQ < :idt_end
	AND ZFFS IN (SELECT to_char(dmsb) FROM xtgl.gy_dmzd WHERE dmlb = 34 AND bzbm2 = 1)
	And NVL(THBZ,'0') In ('0','s','t','r');
IF IsNull(ldc_yck_gh) THEN ldc_yck_gh = 0

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',20)

IF Abs(ld_kyc + ld_yck_fp + ldc_yck_gh) > 1 THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_yc'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('预存发票未正确结转......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "预存发票未正确结转"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 1 //预存不平
		
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ycgh'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('预存发票未正确结转......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "预存发票未正确结转（挂号）"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 2 //预存挂号不平
		
		RETURN -1
	END IF

	RETURN -1
END IF

//重复的2,3清理
wf_delrep(idt_begin,idt_end)

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',30)
////----验证基金支付总额是否和分基金支付总和一致------- //
//SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :ll_count FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx t
//	WHERE jjzfze <> (tczfs + jzzfs + grdnzhzfs + grlnzhzfs + gbjjzfs + bzjjzfs + lxjjzfs + eyjjzfs + lmjjzfs + jmjjzfs + dxsjjzfs + wcnrjjzfs + xnhjjzfs + qtjjzfs + qtzfs1 + qtzfs2 + qtzfs3)
//	And jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And  jsjylsh Is Not Null  And ZTBZ > 0 ;
//IF ll_count > 0 THEN
//	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jjzf'
//	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
//	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
//	
//	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
//		gf_waiting('基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致......',-1)
//		dw_bpmx.Title = "基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致"
//		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
//		ii_bplx = 3 //基金支付不平
//	END IF
//	
//	//	MessageBox('提示,不能禗AT*
,请与计算中心联系','有'+String(ll_count) + "条记录，验证基金支付总额是否和分基金支付总和一致") //	//	gf_waiting('基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致......',-1) //	SetNull(is_dzr) //	RETURN -1 //END IF

////------验证门诊数据一致性----社保门诊发票记帐金额-------- //, ld_sdjzje, ld_zjece
Dec{2} ld_sbjzje, ld_mzjz, ld_sbzje, ld_jzce, ld_fpzje, ld_ylfyze, ld_jzzfce,ldc_tsje,ldc_gbxjzf
Dec{2} ldc_syd_jz = 0,ldc_syd_zje = 0
Dec{2} ld_cfzje,ld_cfjzje,ld_yjzje,ld_yjjzje
SELECT sum(jzje), sum(xmzje) INTO :ld_sbjzje, :ld_fpzje FROM mz_fpk
	Where kpsj >= :idt_begin And kpsj < :idt_end And NVL(fpzf,0) <> 9 
	And jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1) ;
IF IsNull(ld_sbjzje) THEN ld_sbjzje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_fpzje) THEN ld_fpzje = 0

//select sum(zjje),sum(zjje - zfje) into :ld_cfzje,:ld_cfjzje from   //未结转cfk
//	(select h_mz_ycfp.fplsh,mz_cfk.sfybm,h_mz_ycfp.zjje,h_mz_ycfp.zfje 
//	from mz_cfk,h_mz_ycfp,mz_brda 
//	where mz_cfk.fplsh = h_mz_ycfp.fplsh and mz_cfk.brbm = mz_brda.brbm and mz_brda.jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1)
//		and mz_cfk.sfybm = :as_czybm
//	group by h_mz_ycfp.fplsh,mz_cfk.sfybm,h_mz_ycfp.zjje,h_mz_ycfp.zfje) 
//where fplsh not in (Select JYID From jkxt.sydyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :ldt_today And ywlx = 'SF' and ztbz > 0);
IF IsNull(ld_cfzje) THEN ld_cfzje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_cfjzje) THEN ld_cfjzje = 0

//select sum(zjje),sum(zjje - zfje) into :ld_yjzje,:ld_yjjzje from   //未结转yjk1
//	(select h_mz_ycfp.fplsh,mz_yjk1.sfybm,h_mz_ycfp.zjje,h_mz_ycfp.zfje 
//	from mz_yjk1,h_mz_ycfp,mz_brda 
//	where mz_yjk1.fplsh = h_mz_ycfp.fplsh and mz_yjk1.brbm = mz_brda.brbm and mz_brda.jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1)
//		and mz_yjk1.sfybm = :as_czybm
//	group by h_mz_ycfp.fplsh,mz_yjk1.sfybm,h_mz_ycfp.zjje,h_mz_ycfp.zfje) 
//where fplsh not in (Select JYID From jkxt.sydyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :ldt_today And ywlx = 'SF' and ztbz > 0);
IF IsNull(ld_yjzje) THEN ld_yjzje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_yjjzje) THEN ld_yjjzje = 0

ld_sbjzje = ld_sbjzje + ld_cfjzje + ld_yjjzje
ld_fpzje = ld_fpzje + ld_cfzje + ld_yjzje

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',40)

SELECT sum(nvl(hjbxje,0)), sum(nvl(ylfze,0)) INTO :ld_mzjz, :ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.lsyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jylsh Is NOT NULL And NVL(ywlx,'SF') <> 'ZY' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%';
SELECT SUM(NVL(HJBXJE,0)),sum(nvl(FYZE,0)) INTO :ldc_syd_jz,:ldc_syd_zje FROM jkxt.sydyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND JSLSH Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(JYID,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;

IF IsNull(ld_mzjz) THEN ld_mzjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0
if isnull(ldc_syd_jz) then ldc_syd_jz = 0
if isnull(ldc_syd_zje ) then ldc_syd_zje = 0
ld_sbzje = ld_mzjz  + ldc_syd_jz
ld_ylfyze = ld_ylfyze + ldc_syd_zje

datastore lds_fpk,lds_jsmx
string ls_brbm,ls_ywlsh,ls_ywlx,ls_jyzqh
long ll_i,ll_fpk,ll_jsmx,ll_cur,ll_find,ll_ztbz
lds_fpk = create datastore
lds_jsmx = create datastore
IF ld_sbzje <> ld_sbjzje Or ld_ylfyze <> ld_fpzje THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_sfjz_ls'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		//对账不一致自动调整，ztbz改成-1（改帐）
		lds_fpk.dataobject = 'd_sbdz_fpkdz'
		lds_fpk.settransobject( sqlca)
		lds_jsmx.dataobject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		lds_jsmx.settransobject( sqlca)
		FOR ll_i = 1 to ll_rowcount
			gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',20 + ll_i * 30 / ll_rowcount)
			ls_brbm = dw_bpmx.object.brbm[ll_i]
			ll_fpk = lds_fpk.retrieve( ls_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end)
			ll_jsmx = lds_jsmx.retrieve( ls_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end)

			FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_jsmx
				ls_ywlx = lds_jsmx.object.ywlx[ll_cur]
				ll_ztbz = lds_jsmx.object.ztbz[ll_cur]
				ls_jyzqh = lds_jsmx.object.jyzqh[ll_cur]
				if ls_ywlx <> 'ZY' and ll_ztbz = 1 THEN
					ls_ywlsh = lds_jsmx.object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
					ll_find = lds_fpk.find( "fplsh = '"+ls_ywlsh+"'", 1, ll_fpk)
					if ll_find <= 0 then
						SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_find FROM MZ_FPK WHERE FPLSH = :ls_ywlsh USING SQLCA;
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
							select ztbz into :ll_find from jkxt.lsyb_czy_qrqc where jyzqh = :ls_jyzqh ;
							IF ll_find = 1 THEN
								lds_jsmx.object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -1 
							ELSE
								lds_jsmx.object.bzxx[ll_cur] = '操作员已对账不能改帐'
							END IF
						END IF
					end if
				END IF
			NEXT
			gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
			IF lds_jsmx.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
				gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
				MessageBox("提示", "BRBM:" + ls_brbm + " 改帐保存失败。")
				RETURN -1
			ELSE
				gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			END IF
		NEXT
		
		ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
		if ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
			gf_waiting('门诊交易数据不一致......',-1)
			dw_bpmx.Title = "门诊交易数据不一致"
			dw_bpmx.Visible = True
			ii_bplx = 7 //门诊收费不平
			RETURN -1
		end if
	END IF
END IF

//住院病人结算金额是否一致验证----------------------
Dec{2} ldc_zyjz, ldc_zyjzzf, ldc_zyzje, ldc_zyzjezf, ldc_sbzyjz, ldc_sbzyzje

SELECT sum(NVL(fyhj,0) - NVL(zfhj,0)), sum(NVL(fyhj,0)) INTO :ldc_zyjz, :ldc_zyzje FROM zy_zyjs
	WHERE jsrq >= :idt_begin AND jsrq < :idt_end
	And brxz In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ldc_zyjz) THEN ldc_zyjz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zyzje) THEN ldc_zyzje = 0

SELECT sum(NVL(fyhj,0) - NVL(zfhj,0)), sum(NVL(fyhj,0)) INTO :ldc_zyjzzf, :ldc_zyzjezf FROM zy_zyjs
	WHERE zfrq >= :idt_begin AND zfrq < :idt_end AND zfpb = 1
	And brxz In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ldc_zyjzzf) THEN ldc_zyjzzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zyzjezf) THEN ldc_zyzjezf = 0

ldc_zyjz = ldc_zyjz - ldc_zyjzzf
ldc_zyzje = ldc_zyzje - ldc_zyzjezf

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',60)

SELECT sum(nvl(hjbxje,0)), sum(nvl(ylfze,0)) INTO :ldc_sbzyjz, :ldc_sbzyzje FROM jkxt.lsyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jylsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'ZY' And ZTBZ > 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_sbzyjz) THEN ldc_sbzyjz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_sbzyzje) THEN ldc_sbzyzje = 0
//省异地
ldc_syd_jz = 0
ldc_syd_zje = 0

SELECT SUM(NVL(HJBXJE,0)),sum(nvl(FYZE,0)) INTO :ldc_syd_jz,:ldc_syd_zje FROM jkxt.sydyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND JSLSH Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'ZY' And ZTBZ > 0  ;

IF isnull(ldc_syd_jz) then ldc_syd_jz = 0
IF isnull(ldc_syd_zje) then ldc_syd_zje = 0
IF ldc_zyzje <> ldc_sbzyzje + ldc_syd_zje or ldc_zyjz <> ldc_sbzyjz + ldc_syd_jz THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zy_ls'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('住院病人交易数据不一致......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "住院病人交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 6 //住院不平
	END IF
	RETURN -1
END IF

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',-1)
RETURN 1

end function

public subroutine wf_delrep (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end);u_datastore luds_del
luds_del = Create u_datastore
luds_del.DataObject = 'd_jsjylsh_lsdel'
luds_del.SetTransObject(SQLCA)
luds_del.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end)

Long ll_rowcount,ll_zyh,ll_cur
String ls_brbm,ls_jsjylsh,ls_mxzdh
ll_rowcount = luds_del.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[1]
	ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[1]
	ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[1]
	ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jyzqh[1]
	
	FOR ll_cur = 2 To ll_rowcount
		IF ll_zyh = 0 THEN
			IF ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[ll_cur] THEN
				luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[ll_cur]
				ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jyzqh[ll_cur]
				ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[ll_cur] THEN
				luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[ll_cur]
				ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jyzqh[ll_cur]
				ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF

gf_begin_transaction(SQLCA)
IF luds_del.Update( ) = 1 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(SQLCA)
//	MessageBox('提示','保存成功!')
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(SQLCA)
	MessageBox('提示','del失败')
END IF


end subroutine

blocks.text:
public subroutine wf_get_jjzfzd (string as_lbdm, ref string as_jjzd);//01统筹基金02高额补充03公务员补助04本年个人账户05历年个人账户06记账金额07二乙基金08劳模基金09干部保健0A大病保险
//0B其他补助0C医疗补助
CHOOSE CASE as_lbdm
	CASE '01'
		as_jjzd = 'tczf'
	CASE '02'
		as_jjzd = 'gebc'
	CASE '03'
		as_jjzd = 'gwybz'
	CASE '04','05'
		as_jjzd = 'grzh'
	CASE '06'
		as_jjzd = 'jzje'
	CASE '07'
		as_jjzd = 'eyjjzf'
	CASE '08'
		as_jjzd = 'lmjj'
	CASE '09'
		as_jjzd = 'gbbj'
	CASE '0A'
		as_jjzd = 'dbbx'
	CASE '0B'
		as_jjzd = 'qtbz'
	CASE '0C'
		as_jjzd = 'ylbz'
	CASE '71'
		as_jjzd = 'clbz'
	CASE '0C'
		as_jjzd = 'yljz'
	CASE 'mzgh'
		as_jjzd = 'mzgh'
//0D工伤基金11民政社会救助12民政优抚补助13民政惠民支付61工会互助医疗71残联补助支付
	CASE '0D','11','12','13','61'
		as_jjzd = 'qtjj'
//51支付宝98银行账户99现金
	CASE '98','99' 
		as_jjzd = ''
	CASE '51'
		as_jjzd = 'zfb'
	CASE '53'
		as_jjzd = 'yl'
	CASE ELSE
		as_jjzd = 'qtjj'
END CHOOSE

end subroutine

blocks.name: ue_ref
blocks.text:
event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end
ldt_begin = em_1.getdatetime( 1)
ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(em_2.getdate(),1),Time(00:00:00) )
String ls_ywlx
dw_main.Reset( )
//门诊/住院
IF rb_mz.Checked  THEN
	ls_ywlx = 'MZ'
	dw_main.Object.t_title.Text = '丽水市定点医疗机构肈AT* 耪锓延蒙昵牒瞬Ρ '
ELSEIF rb_zy.Checked THEN
	ls_ywlx = 'ZY'
	dw_main.Object.t_title.Text = '丽水市定点医疗机构住院费用申请核拨表'
END IF
String ls_cbdxzhq,ls_lbdm,ls_lbmc,ls_cbd_old,ls_jjzd,ls_error,ls_cbdmc
Dec{2} ldc_xmzje,ldc_xmje,ldc_jzje
Long ll_row,ll_count,ll_find,ll_ycount
ll_ycount = dw_main.Retrieve( ldt_begin,ldt_end, ls_ywlx)
dw_main.Object.t_rq.Text = "统计时间:" + String(em_1.getdate(),'yyyy年mm月dd日') + " 至 " + String(em_2.getdate(),'yyyy年mm月dd日')
dw_main.Object.t_yymc.Text = "医院名称:"  + base_info.hospital
//	医保基金支付
u_datastore luds_ybsj
luds_ybsj = Create u_datastore
luds_ybsj.DataObject = "d_lsyb_jjzf"

luds_ybsj.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
ll_count = luds_ybsj.Retrieve( ldt_begin,ldt_end, ls_ywlx)
luds_ybsj.SetSort("cbdxzhq ASC,ZFLBDM ASC,LBMC ASC" )
luds_ybsj.Sort( )
ls_cbd_old = ''
ls_error = ''
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ls_cbdxzhq = luds_ybsj.Object.cbdxzhq[ll_row]
		
		ls_lbdm = luds_ybsj.Object.zflbdm[ll_row]
		ls_lbmc = luds_ybsj.Object.lbmc[ll_row]
		ldc_xmje = luds_ybsj.Object.xmje[ll_row]
		IF ls_cbdxzhq <> ls_cbd_old THEN
			IF ls_cbd_old > '' And ll_find > 0 THEN
				IF ldc_jzje <> dw_main.Object.zbxje[ll_find] THEN
					MessageBox('提示',"第" + String(ll_find)+"行" + ls_cbdmc +  "报销金额不一致：总报销" +String(dw_main.Object.zbxje[ll_find]) + '--分基金合计'+ String(ldc_jzje))
				END IF
			END IF
			ldc_jzje = 0.00
			ll_find = dw_main.Find( "cbdxzhq = '" + ls_cbdxzhq +"'",1, ll_ycount)
		END IF
		IF ll_find = 0 THEN
			ll_find = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
			dw_main.Object.cbdxzhq[ll_find] = ls_cbdxzhq
		ELSEIF ll_find < 0 THEN
			ls_cbd_old = ''
			MessageBox('提示','查找参保地' +ls_cbdxzhq +"失败：find" +String(ll_find) )
			CONTINUE
		END IF
		ls_cbdmc = String(dw_main.DESCRIBE("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(cbdxzhq) ', "+ String(ll_find) + ")"))
		IF ls_lbdm = '99' THEN
			IF ldc_xmje <> dw_main.Object.xjzf[ll_find] THEN
				MessageBox('提示',"第" + String(ll_find)+"行" + ls_cbdmc +  "现金金额不一致:" +String(dw_main.Object.xjzf[ll_find]) + '----'+ String(ldc_xmje))
			END IF
			CONTINUE
		ELSE
			wf_Get_jjzfzd(ls_lbdm,ls_jjzd)
			IF ls_jjzd = '' THEN
				MessageBox('提示',ls_cbdmc + "---" +ls_lbdm + '(' +ls_lbmc + ")" + "找不到对应的数据:" + String(ldc_xmje))
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		END IF
		IF ls_jjzd = 'mzgh' THEN DebugBreak()
		IF IsNull(ldc_xmje) THEN ldc_xmje = 0
		
		ldc_xmzje = dw_main.GetItemDecimal( ll_find, ls_jjzd)
		IF IsNull(ldc_xmzje) THEN ldc_xmzje = 0
		ldc_xmzje = ldc_xmzje + ldc_xmje
		ldc_jzje = ldc_jzje +  ldc_xmje
		dw_main.SetItem( ll_find, ls_jjzd, ldc_xmzje)
		IF ls_jjzd <> 'mzgh' THEN
			dw_main.Object.bxje[ll_find] = dw_main.Object.bxje[ll_find] + ldc_xmje
		END IF
		ls_cbd_old = ls_cbdxzhq
	NEXT
	IF ls_error > '' THEN
		MessageBox('提示',ls_error)
	END IF
END IF



end event

ue_tfcl
blocks.text:
event ue_tfcl();IF istr_brxx.brbm > '' THEN
	Long ll_cur,ll_rowcount,ll_count,ll_jscs
	String ls_ywlx,ls_ywlsh,ls_jslsh,ls_jbr,ls_error,ls_brbm
	DateTime ldt_jssj
	Dec{0} ldc_ywh
	Dec{2} ldc_fyze
	str_tzyb_jsxx lstr_tzyb_jsxx
	str_yb_jsxx lstr_yb_jsxx
	ll_rowcount = dw_main.RowCount()
	IF dw_main.Find("xz = 1",1,ll_rowcount) > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
			IF dw_main.Object.xz[ll_cur] <> 1 THEN CONTINUE
			IF istr_brxx.brbm  <> dw_main.Object.brbm[ll_cur] THEN
				CONTINUE
			END IF
			ls_ywlx = dw_main.Object.ywlx[ll_cur]
			ls_ywlsh = dw_main.Object.ywlx[ll_cur]
			ldt_jssj = dw_main.Object.jssj[ll_cur]
			IF ls_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
				ldc_ywh = Dec(ls_ywlsh)
				SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From mz_ghxx Where brbm = :ls_brbm And ghlsh = :ldc_ywh Using sqlca;
			ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'SF' THEN
				SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From mz_fpk Where grbm = :ls_brbm And fplsh = :ls_ywlsh Using sqlca;
			ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
				ldc_ywh = dw_main.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				ll_jscs = dw_main.Object.jscs[ll_cur]
				SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From zy_zyjs Where zyh = :ldc_ywh And jscs = :ll_jscs Using sqlca;
			ELSE
				CONTINUE
			END IF
			IF ll_count > 0 THEN
				IF MessageBox('提示','jslsh:' + ls_jslsh + '有对应的his记录，是否继续执行',question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
					CONTINUE
				END IF
			END IF
			IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzybjk.uf_mz_tfcl( istr_brxx.jzkh,ls_jslsh, ls_jbr, ldc_fyze, 'GZCL', ldt_jssj, lstr_tzyb_jsxx, lstr_yb_jsxx, ls_error ) < 0 THEN
				MessageBox('提示','退费失败jslsh：' + ls_jslsh)
			ELSE
				dw_main.Object.xz[ll_cur] = 0
			END IF
			//			if ls_ywlx
		NEXT
		event ue_ref()
	ELSE
		MessageBox('提示','未选中需要退费的记录')
		RETURN
	END IF
	
ELSE
	MessageBox('提示','请先刷卡或者读卡')
	RETURN
END IF




end event

public subroutine wf_cnsy (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end);//门诊医保
u_datastore luds_ybsj
luds_ybsj = Create u_datastore
String ls_ywlx[]
String ls_cbrlb
//农医保
IF  rb_yb.Checked THEN
	ls_cbrlb = 'YB'
	ls_ywlx[1] = 'ZY'
ELSEIF rb_nb.Checked THEN
	ls_cbrlb = is_nbcbrlb
	//门诊/住院
	IF rb_mz.Checked  THEN
		ls_ywlx[1] = 'SF'
		ls_ywlx[2] = 'GH'
	ELSEIF rb_zy.Checked THEN
		ls_ywlx[1] = 'ZY'
	END IF
END IF
//本地异地取不同dataobject
IF rb_bd.Checked THEN
	luds_ybsj.DataObject = "d_cnsy_bdsj"
	IF  rb_yb.Checked THEN
		dw_main.Object.t_4.Text = '苍南县医疗保险定点医院医疗费用核拨表'
	END IF
ELSE
	luds_ybsj.DataObject = "d_cnyb_ydsj"
	IF rb_yb.Checked THEN
		dw_main.Object.t_4.Text = '苍南县医疗保险定点医院医疗费用核拨表（异地）'
	END IF
	//	dw_main.Object.byd_t.Text = '--------一卡通医保'
END IF
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_xjje,ld_bxje,ld_zfje,ld_zlje,ld_zfje2,ld_tcze,ld_gbze,ld_jzze,ld_zhze,ld_zxze,ld_ybfy,ldc_dbbz,ldc_qtjj
Long ll_jzrc,ll_zzrc,ll_txrc,ll_zyts
dec{2} ll_bzjzrc = 0
MZ:
IF rb_yb.Checked THEN //	ls_ywlx[3] = 'ZY' 医保，住院门诊在一张报表做循环
	luds_ybsj.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
	luds_ybsj.Retrieve( adt_begin,adt_end, ls_ywlx,ls_cbrlb,is_cbd)
	IF luds_ybsj.RowCount( ) > 0 THEN
		ld_fyze = luds_ybsj.Object.fyze[1]
		ld_ybfy = luds_ybsj.Object.YBFY[1]
		ld_zfje = luds_ybsj.Object.zfje[1]
		ld_zlje = luds_ybsj.Object.zlje[1]
		ld_zfje2 = luds_ybsj.Object.zfje2[1]
		ld_xjje = luds_ybsj.Object.xjzf[1]
		ld_bxje = luds_ybsj.Object.bxje[1]
		
		ld_tcze = luds_ybsj.Object.tcje[1]
		ld_gbze = luds_ybsj.Object.GBje[1]
		ld_jzze = luds_ybsj.Object.JZje[1]
		ld_zhze = luds_ybsj.Object.GRZHJJ[1]
		ld_zxze = luds_ybsj.Object.ZXJJ[1]
		ldc_dbbz = luds_ybsj.Object.DBBZZF[1]
		ldc_qtjj = luds_ybsj.Object.QTJJ[1]
		IF ls_ywlx[1] = 'ZY' THEN
			dw_main.Object.ZFSE[1] = ld_fyze
			dw_main.Object.YBFY[1] = ld_ybfy
			dw_main.Object.zfje[1] = ld_zfje
			dw_main.Object.zlje[1] = ld_zlje
			dw_main.Object.zfje2[1] = ld_zfje2
			dw_main.Object.XJJE[1] = ld_xjje
			dw_main.Object.JZje[1] = ld_bxje
			dw_main.Object.GBje[1] = ld_gbze
			
			dw_main.Object.tcje[1] = dw_main.Object.tcje[1] + ld_tcze
			dw_main.Object.JZJE2[1] = dw_main.Object.JZJE2[1] + ld_jzze
			dw_main.Object.GRZHZF[1] = dw_main.Object.GRZHZF[1] + ld_zhze
			dw_main.Object.DBBXZF[1] = dw_main.Object.DBBXZF[1] + ldc_dbbz
			dw_main.Object.TSRQJJZFE[1] = dw_main.Object.TSRQJJZFE[1] + ld_zxze
			dw_main.Object.QTJJ[1] = dw_main.Object.QTJJ[1] + ldc_qtjj
			dw_main.Object.HJFSZE[1] = dw_main.Object.HJFSZE[1] + ld_fyze
			dw_main.Object.HJSBZE[1] = dw_main.Object.HJSBZE[1] + ld_bxje
			IF rb_bd.Checked THEN
				if adt_begin >= idt_wdqy then

event ue_zxdz();String ls_dzr,ls_return,ls_dzjg
Dec{2}  ld_dnzhzfze, ld_lnzhzfze, ld_ybzfxjzfze, ld_tczfze,  ld_gbzfze,  ld_jzzfze,  ld_zyjjzfze,  ld_qtybtcjjzfze, ld_jmybjjzfze
Boolean lb_sbdz
//判断是否统计汇总过，汇总日期是否与显示一致
IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(idt_end) Or dw_1.RowCount( ) <= 0 Or IsNull(dw_1.Object.dzr[1]) THEN
	MessageBox("提示",'请先汇总统计,再对账')
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]
	IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','对账时间'+String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')+'与对账信息汇总中的对账日' + ls_dzr+'不一致,请重新统计汇总')
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]

ld_dnzhzfze = dw_1.Object.dnzhzfze[1]
ld_lnzhzfze = dw_1.Object.lnzhzfze[1]
ld_ybzfxjzfze = dw_1.Object.ybzfxjzfze[1]
ld_tczfze = dw_1.Object.tczfze[1]
ld_gbzfze = dw_1.Object.gbzfze[1]
ld_jzzfze = dw_1.Object.jzzfze[1]
ld_zyjjzfze = dw_1.Object.zyjjzfze[1]
ld_jmybjjzfze = dw_1.Object.jmybjjzfze[1]

IF IsNull(ld_jmybjjzfze) THEN ld_jmybjjzfze = 0
ld_qtybtcjjzfze = ld_jmybjjzfze //待定
IF IsValid (gu_ybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
	gu_ybjk = Create u_ybjk_his
END IF
lb_sbdz = gu_ybjk.uf_sb_dzcl( ls_dzr, ld_dnzhzfze, ld_lnzhzfze, ld_ybzfxjzfze, ld_tczfze,  ld_gbzfze,  ld_jzzfze,  ld_zyjjzfze,  ld_qtybtcjjzfze, ls_return)
IF lb_sbdz THEN
	ls_dzjg = ls_return
	dw_1.Object.flag[1] = ls_dzjg
	gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr)
		tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.retrieve(left(ls_dzr,6))
		MessageBox("提示","对账结果："+ ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(flag)', 1)")) )
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		MessageBox('提示',ls_dzr + '社保对账结果：' + ls_dzjg +",保存失败!")
	END IF
ELSE
	MessageBox('社保对账',ls_return)
END IF






end event

event ue_dcmx();string ls_result,ls_yf
dec {2} ld_zce

if is_dzr='' or isnull(is_dzr) then 
	messagebox('提示','请先统计交易明细')
	return
end if	

if is_dzr <> string(date(idt_begin),'yyyymmdd') then
	messagebox('提示','统计时间与所显示的对账日有出入，请重新汇总统计')
	return

end if

	messagebox('提示','请先与中心对帐')
	return
end if

	messagebox('提示','对帐未通过，你不能导出明细')
	return

	dw_1.object.dcbz[1]=1
	gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	if dw_1.update()=1 then

		messagebox('提示',is_dzr + '导出明细成功')
		tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.retrieve(ls_yf)
	else
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca);
		messagebox('提示',is_dzr + '导出明细失败，请重试')
	end if
else
	messagebox('提示',is_dzr + '导出明细失败，请重试')
end if
end event

event ue_hdjy();Long ll_jymx_count,ll_dzxx_count
Long i,j,ll_find,ll_find2
String ls_errortext = '',ls_error2 = '',ls_error3 = '',ls_error1 = '' ,ls_error4 = ''
String ls_zxlsh,ls_fyze,ls_zddm,ls_brbm,ls_xm,ls_jysj,ls_jylx,ls_jylx2
Dec {2} ld_fyze,ld_sbfyze,ld_ze,ll_lsh,ll_max_lsh
ll_lsh = 900000000

ls_error1 = '中心流水号：'
ls_error3 = '中心流水号：'
ls_error2 = ''
tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = ''

ll_jymx_count = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount() //本地
ll_dzxx_count = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowCount() //导入的社保明细

IF ll_jymx_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计交易明细')
	RETURN
END IF
IF ll_dzxx_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先下载交易明细，并检查是否已正确导入')
	RETURN
END IF

FOR i = 1 To ll_jymx_count
	ls_zxlsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.zxlsh[i]
	ld_fyze = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.fyze[i]
	ls_jylx2 = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jylx[i]
	IF ls_jylx2 = 'RD01' Or ls_jylx2 = 'SD01' or ls_jylx2 = 'sa21' THEN
		ld_fyze = Abs(ld_fyze)
	END IF
	ls_brbm = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.brbm[i]
	ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Find("zxlsh='"+ls_zxlsh+"'",1,ll_dzxx_count)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ls_fyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.sbfyze[ll_find]
		ld_sbfyze = Dec(ls_fyze)
		IF ld_fyze <> ld_sbfyze THEN
			ls_error2 += ls_zxlsh + ':本地费用总额:'+String(ld_fyze,'###.00')+'   中心费用总额：'+String(ld_sbfyze)+'~n'
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_error1 = ls_error1 + "zxlsh='"+ls_zxlsh +"' "+ls_brbm+'~t'
	END IF
NEXT

IF ls_error1 <> '中心流水号：' THEN
	MessageBox('本地没有的中心流水号',ls_error1)
END IF

MessageBox('社保笔数：'+String(ll_dzxx_count),'本地有效笔数：'+String(ll_jymx_count))
FOR i = 1 To ll_dzxx_count
	ls_zxlsh = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zxlsh[i]
	ls_fyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.sbfyze[i]
	ls_zddm = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zddm[i]
	ls_brbm = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.brbm[i]
	ls_xm = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.xm[i]
	ld_ze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ze[i]
	ls_jysj = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jysj[i]
	ls_jylx = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jylx[i]
	
	IF IsNull(ls_jylx) THEN ls_jylx = ''
	IF ls_jylx = 'SD01' THEN
		ll_find = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Find("zxlsh='"+ls_zxlsh+"'",1,ll_jymx_count)
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN 	 ls_error4 = ls_error4 + ls_zxlsh + ',' //判断是不是自动回退的
		CONTINUE
	END IF
	ld_sbfyze = Dec(ls_fyze)
	ll_find = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Find("zxlsh='"+ls_zxlsh+"'",1,ll_jymx_count)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	ELSE
		ll_find2 = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Find("zxlsh='"+ls_zxlsh+"'",1,tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount())
		IF ll_find2 <= 0 THEN
			ll_find2 = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.InsertRow(0)
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.zxlsh[ll_find2] = ls_zxlsh
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.brbm[ll_find2] = ls_brbm
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.xm[ll_find2] = ls_xm
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_find2] = ld_ze
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jssj[ll_find2] = DateTime(Date(Left(ls_jysj,4)+'.'+Mid(ls_jysj,5,2)+'.'+Mid(ls_jysj,7,2)),Time(Mid(ls_jysj,10,2)+":"+Mid(ls_jysj,12,2)+":"+Mid(ls_jysj,14,2)))
			
			ll_max_lsh = 0
			SELECT Max(lsh) Into :ll_max_lsh From sb_jymx_gzxx Where lsh >= :ll_lsh;
			IF ll_max_lsh <= 0 Or IsNull(ll_max_lsh) THEN
				ll_max_lsh = ll_lsh
			ELSE
				ll_max_lsh = ll_max_lsh + 1
			END IF
			
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.lsh[ll_find2] = ll_max_lsh
			gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
			IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Update() = 1  THEN
				gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			ELSE
				gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
				MessageBox('提示','申请改帐申请单有误，请重试')
				RETURN
			END IF
			ls_error3 = ls_error3 + "zxlsh='"+ls_zxlsh+"'" +'~t'
		ELSE
			if ld_sbfyze <> dec(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_find2]) then
				messagebox('总额不一致',ls_zxlsh + ":社保" + ls_fyze + "本地：" + string(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_find2]))
			end if
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT

IF ls_error4 <> '' THEN
	MessageBox('SD01','SD01:zxlsh in ' + ls_error4)
END IF

IF ls_error1 <> '中心流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地有而中心没有的数据' +'~t' +  ls_error1 + '~t'
IF ls_error3 <> '中心流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地没有而中心有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error3 + '~t'
IF ls_error2 <> '' THEN
	ls_errortext += '本地与中心有出入的有：' + '~t' +  ls_error2
	MessageBox('提示',ls_errortext)
END IF
tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = ls_errortext
tab_1.SelectTab(6)
IF tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = '' THEN
	tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = '祝贺你此次对帐顺利通过，哈哈 请客！'
	MessageBox('提示','对帐已通过')
END 
IF








end event

event ue_cxsc();
IF is_dzr = '' Or IsNull(is_dzr) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计汇总!')
	RETURN
END IF

blocks.name: ue_save
ue_zdsc
blocks.text:
event ue_zdsc();datastore lds_zdsc,lds_zdxx

String ls_return,ls_zxlsh, ls_zdxx,ls_knsj,ls_ysbm,ls_jylx,ls_fplsh,ls_ywlx,ls_brbm,ls_jssj
Dec{2} ld_fyze
Dec{0} ld_ghlsh,ld_xmlsh
Long ll_rowcount,ll_cur,ll_count,ll_row,ll_sl
datetime  ldt_jssj
//获取当天社保交易明细以及对应的ghlsh
IF em_1.getdate( ) >= Date(gf_server_date()) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','不能对当日及其之后的时间进行统计!')
	RETURN
END IF
idt_begin = em_1.getdatetime(1)
idt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(em_1.getdate(),1),Time(00:00:00))

IF Not IsValid(lds_zdsc) THEN lds_zdsc = Create datastore
lds_zdsc.DataObject = "d_sb_zdsc"
lds_zdsc.SetTransObject( sqlca)
ll_rowcount = lds_zdsc.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end )
w_sbdz.SetRedraw(False)
gf_waiting("正在上传诊断明细...",0)
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	//根据获取的ghlsh和ysbm获取对应诊断信息
//	ll_rowcount = 10
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
		gf_waiting("正在上传诊断明细...",ll_cur / ll_rowcount * 100)
		ls_zdxx = ''
		ls_knsj = lds_zdsc.Object.cknr[ll_cur]
		ls_zxlsh = lds_zdsc.Object.zxlsh[ll_cur]
		ld_fyze = lds_zdsc.Object.fyze[ll_cur]
		ls_jylx = lds_zdsc.Object.jylx[ll_cur]
		ls_fplsh = lds_zdsc.Object.fplsh[ll_cur]
		ld_xmlsh = lds_zdsc.Object.xmlsh[ll_cur]
		ls_brbm = "SB" + lds_zdsc.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
		ldt_jssj = lds_zdsc.Object.jssj[ll_cur]
		SELECT ywlx,ysbm Into :ls_ywlx,:ls_ysbm From mz_sfmx Where fplsh = :ls_fplsh And ywlsh = :ld_xmlsh And brbm = :ls_brbm And rownum = 1;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			IF ls_ywlx = 'CF' THEN
				SELECT mz_zdxx.zdmc Into :ls_zdxx From mz_cfk,mz_zdxx,mz_jzxx Where mz_cfk.cflsh = :ld_xmlsh And mz_cfk.ghlsh = mz_jzxx.ghlsh And mz_jzxx.jzlsh = mz_zdxx.jzlsh And mz_jzxx.ysbm = :ls_ysbm And mz_zdxx.pxxh = 1 And rownum = 1;
			ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'YJ' THEN
				SELECT mz_zdxx.zdmc Into :ls_zdxx From mz_yjk1,mz_zdxx,mz_jzxx Where mz_yjk1.yjlsh = :ld_xmlsh And mz_yjk1.ghlsh = mz_jzxx.ghlsh And mz_jzxx.jzlsh = mz_zdxx.jzlsh And mz_jzxx.ysbm = :ls_ysbm And mz_zdxx.pxxh = 1 And rownum = 1;
			END IF
			IF sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
				
//				SELECT mz_zdxx.zdmc Into :ls_zdxx From mz_zdxx,mz_jzxx Where mz_jzxx.jzlsh = mz_zdxx.jzlsh And mz_jzxx.brbm = :ls_brbm And mz_zdxx.pxxh = 1 And rownum = 1;
				select mz_zdxx.zdmc Into :ls_zdxx From mz_zdxx,mz_jzxx,sb_jymx where mz_jzxx.jzlsh = mz_zdxx.jzlsh And mz_jzxx.brbm = :ls_brbm And mz_zdxx.pxxh = 1 And rownum = 1 and sb_jymx.zxlsh = :ls_zxlsh
					and round(abs(mz_jzxx.jzsj - sb_jymx.jssj) *24 ) = (select min(round(abs(mz_jzxx.jzsj - sb_jymx.jssj) *24 )) from mz_jzxx b where brbm = :ls_brbm );
				IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
					gf_applog(ls_ywlx + "brbm:" + ls_brbm+"zxlsh:" + ls_zxlsh + "xmlsh: " + String(ld_xmlsh) + "ysbm:" + ls_ysbm + String(sqlca.SQLCode) + '找不到啦' + ls_zdxx )
					ls_zdxx = "健康体检"
				ELSE
					gf_applog(ls_ywlx + "zxlsh:" + ls_zxlsh + "xmlsh: " + String(ld_xmlsh) + "ysbm:" + ls_ysbm +'第二次' + ls_zdxx )
				END IF
			ELSEIF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				ls_zdxx = '健康体检'
				gf_applog(ls_ywlx + "zxlsh:" + ls_zxlsh + "xmlsh: " + String(ld_xmlsh) + "ysbm:" + ls_ysbm + String(sqlca.SQLCode) + '错误啦' + sqlca.SQLErrText )
			END IF
		END IF
		//读取诊断信息
		//		IF Not IsValid(lds_zdxx) THEN lds_zdxx = Create datastore
		//		lds_zdxx.DataObject = "d_zdxx"
		//		lds_zdxx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
		//		ll_count = lds_zdxx.Retrieve(ld_ghlsh,ls_ysbm )
		//		IF ll_count = 0 THEN
		//		ELSEIF ll_count > 1 THEN
		//			FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		//				ls_zdxx += lds_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_row]
		//			NEXT
		//		ELSE
		//			ls_zdxx = lds_zdxx.Object.zdmc[1]
		//		END IF
		
		IF IsNull(ls_zdxx) THEN ls_zdxx = ''
		IF Len(ls_zdxx) > 200 THEN ls_zdxx = gf_midstring(ls_zdxx,200)
		IF IsValid (gu_ybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
			gu_ybjk = Create u_ybjk_his
		END IF
		
		//诊疗信息上传请求 (SH01)
		gu_ybjk.uf_send_init('SH01') //初始对账请求消息类型码
		//添加消息体发送信息内容
		gu_ybjk.uf_send_add('卡内数据',ls_knsj)
		gu_ybjk.uf_send_add('中心流水号',ls_zxlsh)
		gu_ybjk.uf_send_add('社保费用总额',ld_fyze)
		IF ls_jylx = 'RA11' THEN
			gf_applog("特殊病---zxlsh:" + ls_zxlsh  + ls_zdxx)
			gu_ybjk.uf_send_add('诊断信息类型标志','2')
		ELSEIF ls_jylx = 'SD01' Or ls_jylx = 'RD01' THEN
			SELECT count(*) Into :ll_sl From SB_JYMX Where zxlsh Is Not Null And NVL(ZYMZ,'0') = '0' And jylx  = 'RA11' And fplsh = :ls_fplsh ;
			IF ll_sl > 0 THEN
				gf_applog("特殊病---zxlsh:" + ls_zxlsh + ls_zdxx)
				gu_ybjk.uf_send_add('诊断信息类型标志','2')
			ELSE
				gu_ybjk.uf_send_add('诊断信息类型标志','3')
			END IF
		ELSE
			gu_ybjk.uf_send_add('诊断信息类型标志','3')
		END IF
		gu_ybjk.uf_send_add('诊断信息',ls_zdxx)
		//发送消息
		IF gu_ybjk.uf_send(ls_return) THEN
			gf_applog("zxlsh:" + ls_zxlsh + "上传成功")
		ELSE
			gf_applog("zxlsh:" + ls_zxlsh + "上传失败" + ls_return)
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF
w_sbdz.SetRedraw(True)
gf_waiting("正在上传诊断明细...",-1)
MessageBox('提示','成功')
Destroy lds_zdsc
//Destroy lds_zdxx












end event

blocks.name: wf_setghmx
blocks.text:
public function boolean wf_setghmx ();Long ll_rowcount ,ll_cur , ll_find, ll_insert
String ls_brbm,ls_brxm,ls_sfzh,ls_ghdate,ls_zlf,ls_ghf,ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_tsb,ls_mz,ls_brlx,ls_yblx,ls_ztbz,ls_zxlsh,ls_zhbz
Dec{2} ld_zlf,ld_zje,ld_fyze,ld_zlje
DateTime ldt_ghrq
IF is_dzr = '' Or IsNull(is_dzr) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计汇总!')
	RETURN False
END IF
IF is_dzr <> String(idt_begin,'yyyymmdd') THEN
	MessageBox('提示','对账日与实际统计的时间不一致，请重新统计!')
	RETURN False
END IF
//sb_ghmx表中查找到当天记录，则直接检索进行判断
IF tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx.Retrieve( idt_begin,idt_end) > 0 THEN
	ld_zje = tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx.Object.jzje_total[1]
	IF IsNull(ld_zje) THEN ld_zje = 0
	IF dw_1.Object.mzgh[1] <> ld_zje THEN
		dw_1.Object.mzgh[1] = ld_zje
		gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
		IF dw_1.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			RETURN False
		ELSE
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
			RETURN True
		END IF
	ELSE
		RETURN True
	END IF
END IF
//没有挂号明细则生成
IF IsValid(iuds_ghmx) THEN Destroy iuds_ghmx
iuds_ghmx = Create u_datastore
iuds_ghmx.DataObject = 'd_sbghmx'
iuds_ghmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
ll_rowcount = iuds_ghmx.Retrieve( idt_begin,idt_end)
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	gf_waiting("正在生成挂号明细......",0)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
		gf_waiting("正在生成挂号明细......",ll_cur / ll_rowcount * 100)
		ls_brbm = Trim(iuds_ghmx.Object.brbm[ll_cur])
		ls_brxm = Trim(iuds_ghmx.Object.brxm[ll_cur])
		ls_sfzh = Trim(iuds_ghmx.Object.sfzh[ll_cur])
		ldt_ghrq = iuds_ghmx.Object.jssj[ll_cur]
		ls_ghdate = String(ldt_ghrq,'yyyymmdd')
		//誅AT*

		ld_fyze = iuds_ghmx.Object.fyze[ll_cur]
		ld_zlje = iuds_ghmx.Object.zlje[ll_cur]
		IF IsNull(ld_fyze) THEN ld_fyze = 0
		IF IsNull(ld_zlje) THEN ld_zlje = 0
//		ld_zlf = ld_fyze + ld_zlje
		ld_zlf = ld_fyze
		IF ld_zlf < 0 THEN
			ls_zlf = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlf),'#####.00'),9)
		ELSE
			ls_zlf = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlf),'#####.00'),10)
		END IF
		//挂号费
		ls_ghf = Right('00000000000.00',10)
		//社保科室编码
		ls_ksbm = String(iuds_ghmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(ksbm) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
		IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN ls_ksbm = '1'
		//获取对应科室名称
		IF IsValid (gu_ybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
			gu_ybjk = Create u_ybjk_his
		END IF
		IF gu_ybjk.of_get_ybksbm( ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc) < 0 THEN
			ls_ksbm = '1'
			ls_ksmc = '内    科'
		END IF
		
		ls_tsb = iuds_ghmx.Object.tsb[ll_cur]
		ls_mz = iuds_ghmx.Object.mjz[ll_cur]
		ls_brlx = iuds_ghmx.Object.brlx[ll_cur]
		ls_zxlsh = iuds_ghmx.Object.zxlsh[ll_cur]
		ls_zhbz = iuds_ghmx.Object.yblx[ll_cur]
		ls_yblx = Upper(Mid(ls_zhbz,1,1))
		ls_ztbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,2,1)
		IF ls_ztbz = '2' THEN ls_ztbz = '4'
		
		IF IsNull(ls_brbm) Or ls_brbm = '' THEN ls_brbm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_brxm) Or ls_brxm = '' THEN ls_brxm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or ls_sfzh = '' THEN ls_sfzh = '1'
		
		IF Len(ls_ksmc) > 10 THEN ls_ksmc = gf_midstring(ls_ksmc,10)
		IF Len(ls_ksbm) > 5  THEN ls_ksbm = gf_midstring(ls_ksbm, 5)
		IF Len(ls_brxm) > 30 THEN ls_brxm = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,30)
		IF Len(ls_brbm) > 8 THEN ls_brbm = gf_midstring(ls_brbm,8)
		
		ll_insert = tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.InsertRow(0)
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.gh_date[ll_insert] = ls_ghdate
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.ghf[ll_insert] = ls_ghf
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.zlf[ll_insert] = ls_zlf
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = ls_tsb
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = ls_mz
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = ls_brlx
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = ls_yblx
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = ls_zxlsh
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.jssj[ll_insert] = ldt_ghrq
	NEXT
	
	gf_waiting("挂号明细生成完成......",-1)
ELSE
	MessageBox('提示','没有可生成的挂号明细')
	destroy iuds_ghmx
	RETURN False
END IF
destroy iuds_ghmx
//更新
gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
IF tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Update() = 1 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
	IF tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx.Retrieve( idt_begin,idt_end) > 0 THEN
		ld_zje = tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx.Object.jzje_total[1]
		IF IsNull(ld_zje) THEN ld_zje = 0
		IF dw_1.Object.mzgh[1] <> ld_zje THEN
			dw_1.Object.mzgh[1] = ld_zje
			gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
			IF dw_1.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
				gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
				MessageBox('提示','更新对账信息失败，门诊挂号总费用：' + String(ld_zje))
				RETURN False
			ELSE
				gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
				dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
				RETURN True
			END IF
		ELSE
			RETURN True
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
	MessageBox('提示','生成挂号明细失败')
	RETURN False
END IF
RETURN True



end function

blocks.name: wf_setypmx
blocks.text:
public function boolean wf_setypmx ();String ls_brbm,ls_brxm,ls_sfzh,ls_cfdate,ls_fylb,ls_xmbm,ls_xmmc,ls_jx,ls_dw,ls_gg,ls_num,ls_price,ls_jylx
String ls_kbbl,ls_brlx,ls_ztbz,ls_tsb,ls_mzbz,ls_ysgh,ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_zxlsh,ls_fyze,ls_zlje,ls_ybbz,ls_zhbz,ls_fplsh
Long ll_cfs,ll_cur,ll_rowcount,ll_insert,ll_bfrow
Dec{2} ld_szfbl,ld_fyze,ld_zlje,ld_num,ld_ypzje,ld_cyzje,ld_kbbl,ld_szfbl2
Dec{4} ld_price,ld_zjje,ld_zfje
Dec ld_ywlsh,ld_jllsh
DateTime ldt_cfsj
Boolean lb_bf
ld_szfbl2 = -1
IF is_dzr = '' Or IsNull(is_dzr) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计汇总!')
	RETURN False
END IF
IF is_dzr <> String(idt_begin,'yyyymmdd') THEN
	MessageBox('提示','对账日与实际统计的时间不一致，请重新统计!')
	RETURN False
END IF

IF IsValid(iuds_ypmx) THEN
	Destroy iuds_ypmx
END IF
iuds_ypmx = Create u_datastore
iuds_ypmx.DataObject = 'd_sbypmx2'
iuds_ypmx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
iuds_ypmx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)

IF IsValid(iuds_bftp_fp) THEN
	Destroy iuds_bftp_fp
END IF
iuds_bftp_fp = Create u_datastore
iuds_bftp_fp.DataObject = 'dd_fplsh_bf'
iuds_bftp_fp.Reset()

ll_rowcount = iuds_ypmx.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	gf_waiting('正在生成药品明细.....',0)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
		gf_waiting('正在生成药品明细.....', ll_cur / ll_rowcount * 100)
		ls_brbm = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.brbm[ll_cur])
		ls_brxm = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.brxm[ll_cur])
		ls_sfzh = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.sfzh[ll_cur])
		ld_ywlsh = iuds_ypmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
		ld_zjje = iuds_ypmx.Object.zjje[ll_cur]
		ld_zfje = iuds_ypmx.Object.zfje[ll_cur]
		ls_fplsh = iuds_ypmx.Object.fplsh[ll_cur]
		ls_jylx = iuds_ypmx.Object.jylx[ll_cur]
		ls_zxlsh = iuds_ypmx.Object.zxlsh[ll_cur]
		
		//判断是否部分退票
		ll_bfrow = iuds_bftp_fp.Find( "fplsh = '"+ls_fplsh+"' and jylx = '"+ls_jylx+"'", 1, iuds_bftp_fp.RowCount())
		IF ll_bfrow > 0 THEN
			CONTINUE
		ELSE
			//			lb_bf = wf_bftpxx(ls_fplsh,'CF',ls_zxlsh,ll_cur)
			lb_bf = wf_getbftp(ls_fplsh,'CF',ls_zxlsh,ll_cur)
			IF lb_bf THEN
				ll_bfrow = iuds_bftp_fp.InsertRow( 0)
				iuds_bftp_fp.Object.fplsh[ll_bfrow] = ls_fplsh
				iuds_bftp_fp.Object.jylx[ll_bfrow] = ls_jylx
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		END IF
		//--------------------------------
		ldt_cfsj = iuds_ypmx.Object.jssj[ll_cur]
		ls_cfdate = String(ldt_cfsj,'yyyymmdd')
		//药品编码、名称
		ls_xmbm = iuds_ypmx.Object.xmbm[ll_cur]
		ls_xmmc = iuds_ypmx.Object.xmmc[ll_cur]
		//单位、医生工号、自付比例、数量、单价、处方数
		ls_dw = iuds_ypmx.Object.dw[ll_cur]
		ls_jx = iuds_ypmx.Object.ybjx[ll_cur]
		ls_gg = iuds_ypmx.Object.gg[ll_cur]
		ls_ysgh = iuds_ypmx.Object.ysbm[ll_cur]
		ld_num = iuds_ypmx.Object.sl[ll_cur]
		ld_price = iuds_ypmx.Object.dj[ll_cur]
		ll_cfs = iuds_ypmx.Object.cfs[ll_cur]
		//自负比例
		ld_szfbl = iuds_ypmx.Object.szfbl[ll_cur]
		IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 1
		IF ld_szfbl = 1 And ld_zjje = ld_zfje THEN
			ld_jllsh = iuds_ypmx.Object.jllsh[ll_cur]
			IF wf_getzfbl(ld_jllsh,ls_fplsh,ld_ywlsh,'CF',ld_szfbl2) THEN
				IF IsNull(ld_szfbl2) THEN ld_szfbl2 = 0
				ld_szfbl = ld_szfbl2
			END IF
		END IF
		IF ld_szfbl = 1 And ld_zjje <> 0 And ld_zjje <> ld_zfje THEN
			IF Abs(ld_zjje) < Abs(ld_zfje) THEN
				ld_szfbl = 0
			ELSE
				ld_szfbl = ld_zfje / ld_zjje
			END IF
		END IF
		
		// //对于交易类型为RD01,SD01的则成负数
		//		ls_jylx = iuds_ypmx.Object.jylx[ll_cur]
		IF ls_jylx = 'RD01' Or ls_jylx = 'SD01' THEN
			ld_num  = -1 * ld_num
		END IF
		
		IF ld_num < 0 THEN
			ls_num = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),9)
		ELSE
			ls_num = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),10)
		END IF
		
		IF ld_price < 0 THEN
			ls_price = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),11)
		ELSE
			ls_price = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),12)
		END IF
		//对应科室编码和名称
		SELECT SBKS Into :ls_ksbm From mz_ks,mz_cfk Where mz_ks.ksbm = mz_cfk.ksbm And mz_cfk.cflsh = :ld_ywlsh;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
			ls_ksbm = '1'
		END IF
		//		ls_ksbm = String(iuds_ypmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(ksbm) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
		IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN ls_ksbm = '1'
		
		IF IsValid (gu_ybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
			gu_ybjk = Create u_ybjk_his
		END IF
		IF gu_ybjk.of_get_ybksbm( ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc) < 0 THEN
			ls_ksbm = '1'
			ls_ksmc = '内    科'
		END IF
		IF IsNull(ls_ksmc)  THEN ls_ksmc = ''
		
		//费用类别
		ls_fylb = String(iuds_ypmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(fylb) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
		IF IsNull(ls_fylb) THEN ls_fylb = ''
		ls_fylb = Right('00' + ls_fylb,2)
		//特殊病项目、门急诊、病人类型、中心流水号、职退标志、医保标志
		ls_tsb = iuds_ypmx.Object.thb[ll_cur]
		ls_mzbz = iuds_ypmx.Object.mjz[ll_cur]
		ls_brlx = iuds_ypmx.Object.brlx[ll_cur]
		ls_zhbz = iuds_ypmx.Object.yblx[ll_cur]
		ls_ztbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,2,1)
		IF ls_ztbz = '2' THEN ls_ztbz = '4'
		ls_ybbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,1 ,1)
		
		//========报销比例========== //
		ld_kbbl = 1 - ld_szfbl
		ls_kbbl = String(ld_kbbl,'0.00')
		IF ld_kbbl > 0 THEN
			ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
			IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
				ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
			ELSE
				ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
			END IF
			ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
			IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
				ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
			ELSE
				ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
			END IF
		ELSE
			ls_fyze = '0000000.00'
			ls_zlje = '0000000.00'
		END IF
		
		IF IsNull(ls_brbm) Or ls_brbm = '' THEN ls_brbm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_brxm) Or ls_brxm = '' THEN ls_brxm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or Trim(ls_sfzh) = '' THEN ls_sfzh = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_fylb) Or Trim(ls_fylb) = '' THEN ls_fylb = '03'
		IF IsNull(ls_xmbm) Or Trim(ls_xmbm) = '' THEN ls_xmbm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_xmmc) Or Trim(ls_xmmc) = '' THEN ls_xmmc = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_dw) Or Trim(ls_dw) = '' THEN ls_dw = '无'
		IF IsNull(ls_jx) Or Trim(ls_jx) = '' THEN  ls_jx = '无'
		IF IsNull(ls_gg) Or Trim(ls_gg) = '' THEN  ls_gg = '无'
		
		IF IsNull(ls_ysgh) THEN ls_ysgh = ' '
		IF Len(ls_ksmc) > 10 THEN ls_ksmc = gf_midstring(ls_ksmc,10)
		IF Len(ls_ksbm) > 5  THEN ls_ksbm = gf_midstring(ls_ksbm,5)
		IF Len(ls_ysgh) > 6  THEN ls_ysgh = gf_midstring(ls_ysgh,6)
		IF Len(ls_xmmc) > 30 THEN ls_xmmc = gf_midstring(ls_xmmc,30)
		IF Len(ls_brbm) > 8  THEN ls_brbm = gf_midstring(ls_brbm,8)
		IF Len(ls_brxm) > 30 THEN ls_brxm = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,30)
		
		IF ls_fylb = '05' THEN //草药插到诊疗
			ll_insert = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.InsertRow(0)
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_cfdate
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = ls_brlx
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ybbz
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = ls_tsb
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = ls_mzbz
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = ls_zxlsh
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = ll_cfs
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
		ELSE
			ll_insert = tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.InsertRow(0)
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_cfdate
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.mz_frm[ll_insert] = ls_jx
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_std[ll_insert] = ls_gg
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = ls_brlx
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ybbz
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = ls_tsb
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = ls_mzbz
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = ls_zxlsh
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = ll_cfs
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
		END IF
	NEXT
	gf_waiting('药品明细生成完成', -1)
ELSE
	MessageBox('提示','没有可生成的药品明细')
	Destroy iuds_ypmx
	RETURN False
END IF
Destroy iuds_ypmx
IF tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.RowCount() > 0 THEN
	ld_ypzje = tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ypze_total[1]
ELSE
	ld_ypzje = 0

IF IsNull(ld_ypzje) THEN ld_ypzje = 0

//=======草药=================================== //
