	ld_cyzje = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlze_total[1]
ELSE
	ld_cyzje = 0
END IF
IF IsNull(ld_cyzje) THEN ld_cyzje = 0
dw_1.Object.mzyp[1] = ld_ypzje
dw_1.Object.mzzl[1] = ld_cyzje

gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
IF dw_1.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
	gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
	MessageBox('提示','更新对账信息失败，门诊药品总费用：' + String(ld_ypzje) + '草药总金额:' + String(ld_cyzje))
	dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
	RETURN False
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
	dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
	RETURN True
END IF
RETURN True





end function

blocks.name: wf_setzlmx
blocks.text:
public function boolean wf_setzlmx ();String ls_brbm,ls_brxm,ls_sfzh,ls_cfdate,ls_fylb,ls_xmbm,ls_xmmc,ls_jx,ls_dw,ls_gg,ls_num,ls_price,ls_cflb,ls_jylx
String ls_kbbl,ls_brlx,ls_ztbz,ls_tsb,ls_mzbz,ls_ysgh,ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_zxlsh,ls_fyze,ls_zlje,ls_ybbz,ls_zhbz,ls_fplsh
Long ll_cfs,ll_cur,ll_rowcount,ll_insert,ll_bfrow
Dec{2} ld_szfbl,ld_fyze,ld_zlje,ld_num,ld_zlzje,ld_kbbl,ld_szfbl2
Dec{4} ld_price,ld_zjje,ld_zfje
Dec ld_ywlsh,ld_jllsh
DateTime ldt_cfsj
//u_datastore luds_bftp_fp
Boolean lb_bf
ld_szfbl2 = -1
IF is_dzr = '' Or IsNull(is_dzr) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计汇总!')
	RETURN False
END IF
IF is_dzr <> String(idt_begin,'yyyymmdd') THEN
	MessageBox('提示','对账日与实际统计的时间不一致，请重新统计!')
	RETURN False
END IF

IF IsValid(iuds_zlmx) THEN Destroy iuds_zlmx
iuds_zlmx = Create u_datastore
iuds_zlmx.DataObject = 'd_sbzlmx2'
iuds_zlmx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
iuds_zlmx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
ll_rowcount = iuds_zlmx.RowCount()

IF Not IsValid(iuds_bftp_fp) THEN
	iuds_bftp_fp = Create u_datastore
	iuds_bftp_fp.DataObject = 'dd_fplsh_bf'
	iuds_bftp_fp.Reset()
END IF

IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	gf_waiting('正在生成诊疗明细......', 0)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
		gf_waiting('正在生成诊疗明细......', ll_cur / ll_rowcount * 100 )
		ld_szfbl2 = -1
		ls_brbm = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.brbm[ll_cur])
		ls_brxm = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.brxm[ll_cur])
		ls_sfzh = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.sfzh[ll_cur])
		ld_ywlsh = iuds_zlmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
		ld_zjje = iuds_zlmx.Object.zjje[ll_cur]
		ld_zfje = iuds_zlmx.Object.zfje[ll_cur]
		ls_fplsh = iuds_zlmx.Object.fplsh[ll_cur]
		ls_jylx = iuds_zlmx.Object.jylx[ll_cur]
		ls_zxlsh = iuds_zlmx.Object.zxlsh[ll_cur]
		
		//判断是否部分退票
		ll_bfrow = iuds_bftp_fp.Find( "fplsh = '"+ls_fplsh+"' and jylx = '"+ls_jylx+"'", 1, iuds_bftp_fp.RowCount())
		IF ll_bfrow > 0 THEN
			CONTINUE
		ELSE
			//			lb_bf = wf_bftpxx(ls_fplsh,'YJ',ls_zxlsh,ll_cur)
			lb_bf = wf_getbftp(ls_fplsh,'YJ',ls_zxlsh,ll_cur)
			IF lb_bf THEN
				ll_bfrow = iuds_bftp_fp.InsertRow( 0)
				iuds_bftp_fp.Object.fplsh[ll_bfrow] = ls_fplsh
				iuds_bftp_fp.Object.jylx[ll_bfrow] = ls_jylx
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		END IF
		//--------------------------------------
		ldt_cfsj = iuds_zlmx.Object.jssj[ll_cur]
		ls_cfdate = String(ldt_cfsj,'yyyymmdd')
		
		ld_num = iuds_zlmx.Object.sl[ll_cur]
		ld_price = iuds_zlmx.Object.dj[ll_cur]
		//交易类型为RD01的乘-1
		//		ls_jylx = iuds_zlmx.Object.jylx[ll_cur]
		IF ls_jylx = 'RD01' Or ls_jylx = 'SD01' THEN
			ld_num  = -1 * ld_num
		END IF
		IF ld_num < 0 THEN
			ls_num = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),9)
		ELSE
			ls_num = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),10)
		END IF
		
		IF ld_price < 0 THEN
			ls_price = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),11)
		ELSE
			ls_price = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),12)
		END IF
		//科室编码、名称
		SELECT SBKS Into :ls_ksbm From mz_ks,mz_yjk1 Where mz_ks.ksbm = mz_yjk1.ksbm And mz_yjk1.yjlsh = :ld_ywlsh;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
			ls_ksbm = '1'
		END IF
		//		ls_ksbm = String(iuds_zlmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(ksbm) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
		IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN ls_ksbm = '1'
		IF IsValid (gu_ybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
			gu_ybjk = Create u_ybjk_his
		END IF
		IF gu_ybjk.of_get_ybksbm( ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc) < 0 THEN
			ls_ksbm = '1'
			ls_ksmc = '内    科'
		END IF
		IF IsNull(ls_ksmc)  THEN ls_ksmc = ''
		//费用类别
		ls_fylb = String(iuds_zlmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(fylb) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
		IF IsNull(ls_fylb) THEN ls_fylb = ''
		ls_fylb = Right('00' + ls_fylb,2)
		//---------------------------------------------
		ls_dw = iuds_zlmx.Object.dw[ll_cur]
		ls_xmbm = iuds_zlmx.Object.xmbm[ll_cur]
		ls_xmmc = iuds_zlmx.Object.xmmc[ll_cur]
		ls_ysgh = iuds_zlmx.Object.ysbm[ll_cur]
		ll_cfs = iuds_zlmx.Object.cfs[ll_cur]
		ls_tsb = iuds_zlmx.Object.thb[ll_cur]
		ls_mzbz = iuds_zlmx.Object.mjz[ll_cur]
		ls_brlx = iuds_zlmx.Object.brlx[ll_cur]
		ls_zxlsh = iuds_zlmx.Object.zxlsh[ll_cur]
		ls_zhbz = iuds_zlmx.Object.yblx[ll_cur]
		ls_ztbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,2,1)
		IF ls_ztbz = '2' THEN ls_ztbz = '4'
		ls_ybbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,1 ,1)
		
		//========自付比例========== //
		ld_szfbl = iuds_zlmx.Object.szfbl[ll_cur]
		IF ld_szfbl = 1 And (ld_zjje = ld_zfje or ls_xmbm= 'f25031003500') THEN
			ld_jllsh = iuds_zlmx.Object.jllsh[ll_cur]
			IF wf_getzfbl(ld_jllsh,ls_fplsh,ld_ywlsh,'YJ',ld_szfbl2) THEN
				IF IsNull(ld_szfbl2) THEN ld_szfbl2 = 0
				ld_szfbl = ld_szfbl2
			END IF
		END IF
		
		IF ld_szfbl = 1 And ld_zjje <> 0 And ld_zjje <> ld_zfje THEN
			IF Abs(ld_zjje) < Abs(ld_zfje) THEN
				ld_szfbl = 0
			ELSE
				ld_szfbl = ld_zfje / ld_zjje
//				IF ld_szfbl = 0.38 Or  ld_szfbl = 0.6 THEN
//					ld_szfbl = 0
//					ld_szfbl2 = 0
//				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		
		IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 1
		ld_kbbl = 1 - ld_szfbl
		ls_kbbl = String(ld_kbbl,'0.00')
		//		IF ld_kbbl > 0 THEN
		//			ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
		//			IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
		//				ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
		//			ELSE
		//				ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
		//			END IF
		//			ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
		//			IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
		//				ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
		//			ELSE
		//				ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
		//			END IF
		//		ELSE
		//			ls_fyze = '0000000.00'
		//			ls_zlje = '0000000.00'
		//		END IF
		IF ld_kbbl > 0 THEN
			IF ld_szfbl2 = 0 THEN
				ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
				IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
					ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
				ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
				IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
					ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
			ELSE
				ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
				IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
					ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
				ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
				IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
					ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			ls_fyze = '0000000.00'
			ls_zlje = '0000000.00'
		END IF
		
		
		IF IsNull(ls_brbm) Or ls_brbm = '' THEN ls_brbm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_brxm) Or ls_brxm = '' THEN ls_brxm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or Trim(ls_sfzh) = '' THEN ls_sfzh = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_fylb) Or Trim(ls_fylb) = '' THEN ls_fylb = '16'
		IF IsNull(ls_xmbm) Or Trim(ls_xmbm) = '' THEN ls_xmbm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_xmmc) Or Trim(ls_xmmc) = '' THEN ls_xmmc = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_dw) Or Trim(ls_dw) = '' THEN ls_dw = '无'
		
		IF IsNull(ls_ysgh) THEN ls_ysgh = '111111'
		IF Len(ls_ksmc) > 10 THEN ls_ksmc = gf_midstring(ls_ksmc,10)
		IF Len(ls_ksbm) > 5 THEN ls_ksbm = gf_midstring(ls_ksbm,5)
		IF Len(ls_ysgh) > 6 THEN ls_ysgh = gf_midstring(ls_ysgh,6)
		IF Len(ls_xmmc) > 30 THEN ls_xmmc = gf_midstring(ls_xmmc,30)
		IF Len(ls_brbm) > 8  THEN ls_brbm = gf_midstring(ls_brbm,8)
		IF Len(ls_brxm) > 30 THEN ls_brxm = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,30)
		
		ll_insert = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.InsertRow(0)
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_cfdate
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = ls_brlx
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ybbz
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = ls_tsb
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = ls_mzbz
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = ls_zxlsh
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = ll_cfs
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
	NEXT
	gf_waiting('诊疗明细生成完成', -1)
ELSE
	MessageBox('提示','没有可生成的诊疗明细')
	Destroy iuds_zlmx
	Destroy iuds_bftp_fp
	RETURN False
END IF
Destroy iuds_zlmx
Destroy iuds_bftp_fp

IF tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.RowCount() > 0 THEN
	ld_zlzje = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlze_total[1]
ELSE
	ld_zlzje = 0
END IF
IF IsNull(ld_zlzje) THEN ld_zlzje = 0
dw_1.Object.mzzl[1] = ld_zlzje
gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
IF dw_1.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
	gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
	MessageBox('提示','更新对账信息失败，门诊诊疗总费用：' + String(ld_zlzje) )
	dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
	RETURN False
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
	dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
	RETURN True
END IF
RETURN True





end function

blocks.name: wf_auto_jdmz
blocks.text:
public function long wf_auto_jdmz (datetime ld_start, datetime ld_end);datastore ds_sb_fpk,ds_sb_jymx
long ll_fpk_count,ll_jymx_count , i  , ll_find,ll_return ,ll_fplsh_count
string ls_zxlsh,ls_bz,ls_txt,ls_fplsh
dec {0} ll_lsh

ll_return=0

ds_sb_fpk=create datastore 
ds_sb_jymx=create datastore 

ds_sb_fpk.dataobject='d_sb_autodz_fpk'
ds_sb_jymx.dataobject='d_sb_autodz_jymx'

ds_sb_fpk.settransobject(sqlca)
ds_sb_jymx.settransobject(sqlca)


ds_sb_fpk.retrieve(ld_start,ld_end)
ds_sb_jymx.retrieve(ld_start,ld_end)

ll_fpk_count=ds_sb_fpk.rowcount()
ll_jymx_count=ds_sb_jymx.rowcount()
    
	
for i=1 to  ll_fpk_count
	 ls_zxlsh = ds_sb_fpk.object.zxlsh[i]
	 if isnull(ls_zxlsh) then ls_zxlsh=''
	 ll_find=ds_sb_jymx.FIND( "zxlsh='"+ls_zxlsh+"'", 1,  ll_jymx_count  )
	 if isnull(ll_find) then ll_find=0
    if ll_find>0 then 
		  ds_sb_jymx.object.bz[ll_find]='1'
	 else
		  if trim(ls_zxlsh)<='' or isnull(ls_zxlsh) then continue;
         messagebox('提示','zxlsh='+ls_zxlsh+'   需内部调帐' + string(ds_sb_fpk.object.grbm[i]))
			return 100;
	 end if
next

ls_txt=''
for i=1 to  ll_jymx_count
	 ls_bz= ds_sb_jymx.object.bz[i]
	 ll_lsh= ds_sb_jymx.object.lsh[i]
	 ls_fplsh= ds_sb_jymx.object.fplsh[i]
	 
 	 ls_zxlsh= ds_sb_jymx.object.zxlsh[i]
	 if isnull(ls_fplsh) then ls_fplsh=''
    if isnull(ls_bz) or trim(ls_bz)<='' then ls_bz=''
	 if ls_bz='0' then 
		 ll_fplsh_count=0
		 select count(*)  into :ll_fplsh_count from sb_jymx where fplsh=:ls_fplsh  and fplsh is not null;
		 if isnull(ll_fplsh_count) then ll_fplsh_count=0
		 if ll_fplsh_count>=2 then continue;
		 ls_txt=ls_txt+'  '+ls_zxlsh
	 else
		  continue;
	 end if
	 if trim(ls_zxlsh)<='' or isnull(ls_zxlsh) then continue;
	 
	 gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	 insert into sb_jymx_gzxx select * from sb_jymx where zxlsh=:ls_zxlsh   and lsh=:ll_lsh; 
	 if sqlca.sqlcode=0 then 
		 delete from sb_jymx where zxlsh=:ls_zxlsh   and lsh=:ll_lsh; 
		 if sqlca.sqlcode=0 then 
			  gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		else
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			ll_return=101
			exit
		end if
	 else
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			ll_return=101
			exit
	 end if
next

if ls_txt<>'' then 
	messagebox('提示','门诊需改帐的流水号有：'+ls_txt)
end if	

destroy ds_sb_fpk;
destroy ds_sb_jymx;


return ll_return



end function

private function string wf_getfilename (string as_yydm, string as_lb, date ad_dzrq, string as_fybz);string ls_filename
long ll_sbnf,ll_sbyf,ll_sbr
string ls_sbnf,ls_sbyf,ls_sbr,ls_dzrq
ls_dzrq = string(ad_dzrq ,'yyyymmdd')
ll_sbnf = year(ad_dzrq)
ll_sbyf = month(ad_dzrq)
ll_sbr = day(ad_dzrq)
if ll_sbnf > 2009 then
	ls_sbnf = char(asc('A') + ll_sbnf - 2010)
else
	ls_sbnf = string(ll_sbnf - 2000)
end if
if ll_sbyf > 9 then
	ls_sbyf = char(asc('A') + ll_sbyf - 10)
else
	ls_sbyf = string(ll_sbyf)
end if
if ll_sbr > 9 then
	ls_sbr = char(asc('A') + ll_sbr - 10)
else
	ls_sbr = string(ll_sbr)
end if
ls_filename = as_yydm + as_lb + ls_sbnf + ls_sbyf + ls_sbr + trim(as_fybz) + '.txt'
return ls_filename
end function

blocks.text:
public function boolean wf_bftpxx (string as_fplsh, string as_mxlx, string as_zxlsh, long al_cur);//====================================================================
// 事件: w_sbdz.wf_bftpxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:判断窪AT*
梅⑵笔遣皇遣糠滞似

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	      	string	as_fplsh	需做判断的发票号
// 	      	string	as_mxlx 	对应的类型CF:药品，YJ:诊疗
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean 是否是部分退票
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2011.08.03
//====================================================================


Long ll_rowcount,ll_cur,ll_insert,ll_xmlsh
Boolean lb_bf
u_datastore luds_tpxx_bf,luds_bfmx
String ls_first,ls_new,ls_y,ls_brbm,ls_sfzh,ls_brxm,ls_zhbz,ls_jylx,ls_date
String ls_fplshs[]
String ls_dw,ls_gg,ls_jx,ls_xmmc,ls_xmbm,ls_fylb,ls_ztbz,ls_num,ls_price,ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_kbbl,ls_fyze,ls_zlje,ls_ysgh
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_zlje,ld_num,ld_szfbl,ld_kbbl,ld_szfbl2
Dec{4} ld_price,ld_zjje,ld_zfje
DateTime ldt_jssj
Int li_arry
IF IsValid(luds_tpxx_bf) THEN
	Destroy luds_tpxx_bf
END IF
luds_tpxx_bf = Create u_datastore
luds_tpxx_bf.DataObject = 'dd_tpxx_bf'
luds_tpxx_bf.SetTransObject( sqlca)
ll_rowcount = luds_tpxx_bf.Retrieve(as_fplsh)
lb_bf = False
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	lb_bf = True
	ls_fplshs[1] = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]
	ls_fplshs[2] = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.newfplsh[1]
	ls_first = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.firstfplsh[1]
	ls_fplshs[3] = ls_first
	li_arry = 3
	DO WHILE ls_first <> luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]
		IF luds_tpxx_bf.Retrieve(luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]) > 0 THEN
			li_arry ++
			ls_fplshs[li_arry] = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]
		ELSE
			EXIT
		END IF
	LOOP
	
	IF IsValid(luds_bfmx) THEN
		Destroy luds_bfmx
	END IF
	luds_bfmx = Create u_datastore
	IF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
		luds_bfmx.DataObject = 'd_sbypmx_bf'
	ELSEIF as_mxlx = 'YJ' THEN
		luds_bfmx.DataObject = 'd_sbzlmx_bf'
	END IF
	luds_bfmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	ll_rowcount = luds_bfmx.Retrieve(ls_fplshs)
	//对于交易类型为RD01,SD01的则成负数
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		IF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
			ls_brbm = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.brbm[al_cur])
			ls_brxm = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.brxm[al_cur])
			ls_sfzh = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.sfzh[al_cur])
			ls_zhbz = iuds_ypmx.Object.yblx[al_cur]
			ls_jylx = iuds_ypmx.Object.jylx[al_cur]
			ls_ysgh = iuds_ypmx.Object.ysbm[al_cur]
			ld_fyze = iuds_ypmx.Object.fyze[al_cur]
			ld_zlje = iuds_ypmx.Object.zlje[al_cur]
			ldt_jssj = iuds_ypmx.Object.jssj[al_cur]
			ls_date = String(ldt_jssj,'yyyymmdd')
			ls_ztbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,2,1)
			IF ls_ztbz = '2' THEN ls_ztbz = '4'
		ELSEIF as_mxlx = 'YJ' THEN
			ls_brbm = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.brbm[al_cur])
			ls_brxm = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.brxm[al_cur])
			ls_sfzh = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.sfzh[al_cur])
			ls_zhbz = iuds_zlmx.Object.yblx[al_cur]
			ls_jylx = iuds_zlmx.Object.jylx[al_cur]
			ls_ysgh = iuds_zlmx.Object.ysbm[al_cur]
			ld_fyze = iuds_zlmx.Object.fyze[al_cur]
			ld_zlje = iuds_zlmx.Object.zlje[al_cur]
			ldt_jssj = iuds_zlmx.Object.jssj[al_cur]
			ls_date = String(ldt_jssj,'yyyymmdd')
			ls_ztbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,2,1)
			IF ls_ztbz = '2' THEN ls_ztbz = '4'
		END IF
		
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
			ld_num = luds_bfmx.Object.sl[ll_cur]
			ld_price = luds_bfmx.Object.dj[ll_cur]
			ls_xmbm = luds_bfmx.Object.xmbm[ll_cur]
			ls_xmmc = luds_bfmx.Object.xmmc[ll_cur]
			ls_dw = luds_bfmx.Object.dw[ll_cur]
			ld_szfbl = luds_bfmx.Object.szfbl[ll_cur]
			ld_zjje =  luds_bfmx.Object.zjje[ll_cur]
			ld_zfje =  luds_bfmx.Object.zfje[ll_cur]
			IF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
				ls_gg = luds_bfmx.Object.gg[ll_cur]
				ls_jx = luds_bfmx.Object.ybjx[ll_cur]
			END IF
			IF ls_jylx = 'RD01' Or ls_jylx = 'SD01' THEN
				ld_num  = -1 * ld_num
			END IF
			
			IF ld_num < 0 THEN
				ls_num = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),9)
			ELSE
				ls_num = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),10)
			END IF
			
			IF ld_price < 0 THEN
				ls_price = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),11)
			ELSE
				ls_price = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),12)
			END IF
			//对应科室编码和名称
			IF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
				SELECT SBKS Into :ls_ksbm From mz_ks,mz_cfk Where mz_ks.ksbm = mz_cfk.ksbm And mz_cfk.fplsh = :ls_first And rownum = 1;
			ELSEIF as_mxlx = 'YJ' THEN
				SELECT SBKS Into :ls_ksbm From mz_ks,mz_yjk1 Where mz_ks.ksbm = mz_yjk1.ksbm And mz_yjk1.fplsh = :ls_first And rownum = 1;
			END IF
			IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
				ls_ksbm = '1'
			END IF
			IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN ls_ksbm = '1'
			
			IF IsValid (gu_ybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
				gu_ybjk = Create u_ybjk_his
			END IF
			IF gu_ybjk.of_get_ybksbm( ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc) < 0 THEN
				ls_ksbm = '1'
				ls_ksmc = '内    科'
			END IF
			IF IsNull(ls_ksmc)  THEN ls_ksmc = ''
			
			//		
			//费用类别
			ls_fylb = String(luds_bfmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(fylb) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
			IF IsNull(ls_fylb) THEN ls_fylb = ''
			ls_fylb = Right('00' + ls_fylb,2)
			
			//========报销比例========== //
			IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 1
			IF ld_szfbl = 1 And ld_zjje <> 0 And ld_zjje <> ld_zfje THEN
				IF Abs(ld_zjje) < Abs(ld_zfje) THEN
					ld_szfbl = 0
				ELSE
					ld_szfbl = ld_zfje / ld_zjje
					IF ld_szfbl = 0.38 Or  ld_szfbl = 0.6 THEN
						ld_szfbl = 0
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
			
			ld_kbbl = 1 - ld_szfbl
			ls_kbbl = String(ld_kbbl,'0.00')
			IF ld_kbbl > 0 THEN
				ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
				IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
					ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
				ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
				IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
					ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
			ELSE
				ls_fyze = '0000000.00'
				ls_zlje = '0000000.00'
			END IF
			
			IF IsNull(ls_brbm) Or ls_brbm = '' THEN ls_brbm = '1'
			IF IsNull(ls_brxm) Or ls_brxm = '' THEN ls_brxm = '1'
			IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or Trim(ls_sfzh) = '' THEN ls_sfzh = '1'
			IF IsNull(ls_fylb) Or Trim(ls_fylb) = '' THEN ls_fylb = '03'
			IF IsNull(ls_xmbm) Or Trim(ls_xmbm) = '' THEN ls_xmbm = '1'
			IF IsNull(ls_xmmc) Or Trim(ls_xmmc) = '' THEN ls_xmmc = '1'
			IF IsNull(ls_dw) Or Trim(ls_dw) = '' THEN ls_dw = '无'
			IF IsNull(ls_jx) Or Trim(ls_jx) = '' THEN  ls_jx = '无'
			IF IsNull(ls_gg) Or Trim(ls_gg) = '' THEN  ls_gg = '无'
			
			IF IsNull(ls_ysgh) THEN ls_ysgh = ' '
			IF Len(ls_ksmc) > 10 THEN ls_ksmc = gf_midstring(ls_ksmc,10)
			IF Len(ls_ksbm) > 5  THEN ls_ksbm = gf_midstring(ls_ksbm,5)
			IF Len(ls_ysgh) > 6  THEN ls_ysgh = gf_midstring(ls_ysgh,6)
			IF Len(ls_xmmc) > 30 THEN ls_xmmc = gf_midstring(ls_xmmc,30)
			IF Len(ls_brbm) > 8  THEN ls_brbm = gf_midstring(ls_brbm,8)
			IF Len(ls_brxm) > 30 THEN ls_brxm = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,30)
			
			If (as_mxlx = 'CF' And ls_fylb = '05') Or as_mxlx = 'YJ' THEN //草药插到诊疗
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.InsertRow(0)
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_date
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = '0'
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = Mid(ls_zhbz,1 ,1)
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = '0'
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = '1'
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = as_zxlsh
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = 1
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
			ELSEIF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.InsertRow(0)
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_date
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.mz_frm[ll_insert] = ls_jx
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_std[ll_insert] = ls_gg
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = '0'
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = Mid(ls_zhbz,1 ,1)
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = '0'
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = '1'
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = as_zxlsh
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = 1
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
ELSE
	lb_bf = False
END IF
Destroy luds_bfmx
Destroy luds_tpxx_bf
RETURN lb_bf






end function

public function boolean wf_getbftp (string as_fplsh, string as_mxlx, string as_zxlsh, long al_cur);//====================================================================
// 事件: w_sbdz.wf_bftpxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:判断该发票是不是部分退票
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	      	string	as_fplsh	需做判断的发票号
// 	      	string	as_mxlx 	对应的类型CF:药品，YJ:诊疗
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean 是否是部分退票
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2011.08.03
//====================================================================


Long ll_rowcount,ll_cur,ll_insert,ll_yjcount,ll_xmlsh
Boolean lb_bf
u_datastore luds_tpxx_bf,luds_bfcfmx,luds_bfyjmx
String ls_first,ls_new,ls_y,ls_brbm,ls_sfzh,ls_brxm,ls_zhbz,ls_jylx,ls_date
String ls_fplshs[]
String ls_dw,ls_gg,ls_jx,ls_xmmc,ls_xmbm,ls_fylb,ls_ztbz,ls_num,ls_price,ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_kbbl,ls_fyze,ls_zlje,ls_ysgh
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_zlje,ld_num,ld_szfbl,ld_kbbl,ld_szfbl2
Dec{4} ld_price,ld_zjje,ld_zfje
DateTime ldt_jssj
Int li_arry
IF Not IsValid(luds_tpxx_bf) THEN luds_tpxx_bf = Create u_datastore
luds_tpxx_bf.DataObject = 'dd_tpxx_bf'
luds_tpxx_bf.SetTransObject( sqlca)
ll_rowcount = luds_tpxx_bf.Retrieve(as_fplsh)
lb_bf = False
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	lb_bf = True
	ls_fplshs[1] = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]
	ls_fplshs[2] = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.newfplsh[1]
	ls_first = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.firstfplsh[1]
	ls_fplshs[3] = ls_first
	li_arry = 3
	DO WHILE ls_first <> luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]
		IF luds_tpxx_bf.Retrieve(luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]) > 0 THEN
			li_arry ++
			ls_fplshs[li_arry] = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]
		ELSE
			EXIT
		END IF
	LOOP
	
	IF Not IsValid(luds_bfcfmx) THEN luds_bfcfmx = Create u_datastore
	IF Not IsValid(luds_bfyjmx) THEN luds_bfyjmx = Create u_datastore

public function boolean wf_getzfbl (decimal ad_jllsh, string as_fplsh, long al_xmlsh, string as_ywlx, ref decimal ad_zfbl);
//如果ad_jllsh =0, 则找到对应的jllsh,不为0则根据JLLSH来定位
Long ll_count
ad_zfbl = -1
IF ad_jllsh = 0 THEN//根据fplsh和xmlsh,ywlx来判断是否自付比例有变动
	SELECT count(jllsh) Into :ll_count From SB_ZFBL_XG Where fplsh = :as_fplsh And xmlsh = :al_xmlsh And ywlx = :as_ywlx;
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		SELECT X_ZFBL Into :ad_zfbl From SB_ZFBL_XG Where fplsh = :as_fplsh And xmlsh = :al_xmlsh And ywlx = :as_ywlx and rownum = 1;
	ELSE
		ad_zfbl = -1
		RETURN False
	END IF
ELSE
	SELECT X_ZFBL Into :ad_zfbl From SB_ZFBL_XG Where jllsh = :ad_jllsh;
END IF

IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	RETURN True
ELSE
	ad_zfbl = -1
	RETURN False
END IF

end function

event clicked;u_datastore luds_sbzmx
DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end
Long ll_rowcount,ll_cur,ll_find,ll_mxcount

Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_zlje

ll_rowcount = luds_sbzmx.Retrieve( idt_begin,idt_end )
ll_mxcount = tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.RowCount( )
FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
	ls_brbm = luds_sbzmx.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
	ll_find = tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Find( "brbm = '"+ls_brbm+"'", 1, ll_mxcount)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ld_fyze = tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.fyze[ll_find]
		ld_zlje = tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zlje[ll_find]
		If (ld_fyze + ld_zlje) <> Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.zje[ll_cur]) THEN
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.bz[ll_find] = 1
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zje[ll_find] = Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.zje[ll_cur])
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.fyze2[ll_find] = Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.fyze[ll_cur])
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zlje2[ll_find] = Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.zlje[ll_cur])
			gf_applog(string(idt_begin,'yyyymmdd') + "---brbm = '"+ls_brbm+"' 金额不符,相差" + String(ld_fyze + ld_zlje - luds_sbzmx.Object.zje[ll_cur] ))
		ELSE
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zje[ll_find] = Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.zje[ll_cur])
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.fyze2[ll_find] = Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.fyze[ll_cur])
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zlje2[ll_find] = Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.zlje[ll_cur])
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF  luds_sbzmx.Object.zje[ll_cur] <> 0 THEN
			gf_applog(string(idt_begin,'yyyymmdd') + "---找不到对应的brbm = '"+ls_brbm+"' 金额不符,相差" + String(luds_sbzmx.Object.zje[ll_cur]))
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT

u_office_excel uo_excel

end event

event clicked;

	ls_czyzh = dw_1.Object.sptbm[ll_row]

	ls_zdjylsh = '0'
	ls_sfhx = '1'
	DO WHILE ls_sfhx = '1'
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_init ( '9255')
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add( '已下载最大交易流水号',ls_zdjylsh)
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add( '操作员账号',ls_czgh) //008049   3311001000050036
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add( '对帐流水号',ls_dzlsh)
		
		IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send( ls_error,0,'330000' ) THEN
			ls_sfhx = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring( '是否还有需下载的记录')
			ll_xzts = long(gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring( '本次下载记录条数'))

			ls_zdjylsh = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( '交易流水号', ll_xzts)
			ls_suc = ls_czgh
		ELSE
			ls_fail = ls_czgh + "下载失败："+ls_error+"~r~n"
			ls_sfhx = '0'
		END IF
	LOOP
NEXT

MessageBox('信息提示','下载成功!'+ls_suc + ls_fail)



end event

		dw_fpzffs.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_fpzffs.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		st_2.Text = "门诊交易明细(MZXT.MZ_FPK)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_fpkdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
	CASE 2 //预存挂号不平
		dw_ybjsmx.Visible = False
		rb_1.visible = False
		rb_2.visible = False
		rb_3.visible = False
		rb_4.visible = False
		st_1.Text = "门诊账户交易明细(MZXT.H_MZ_ZHJYMX)"
		dw_zhjymx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zhjymx_gh'
		dw_zhjymx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_zhjymx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		st_2.Text = "门诊挂号明细(MZXT.MZ_GHXX)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ghxxdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
	CASE 31 //基金支付不平（门诊）
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pymz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbd_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_mz'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	CASE 32 //基金支付不平（住院）
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pyzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_zy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbdzy'	
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lszy'
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_zy'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( il_zyh )
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	CASE 4,7,41 //门诊收费不平
		
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pymz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbd_mz'	
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_mz'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		st_2.Text = "门诊交易明细(MZXT.MZ_FPK)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_fpkdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		if ii_bplx = 4 or  ii_bplx = 41 then
			dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("YWLX = 'SF'")
			dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
			cb_gzcl.event clicked( )
			cb_save.event clicked( )
			if ii_bplx = 41 then cb_exit.event clicked( )
		end if
		
//			cb_exit.event clicked( )
	CASE 5,8 //门诊挂号不平
		
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pymz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbd_mz'			
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_mz'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )	
			dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		if ii_bplx = 5 then
			dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("YWLX = 'GH'")
			dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
		end if
		st_2.Text = "门诊挂号明细(MZXT.MZ_GHXX)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ghxxdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
	CASE 6,9 //住院不平
		IF il_zyh <= 0 Or IsNull(il_zyh) THEN
			IF IsNull(il_zyh) THEN il_zyh = 0
			as_error = '传入住院号有误ZYH' + String(il_zyh)
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pyzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_zy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lszy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbdzy'			
			
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_zy'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( il_zyh )
		if ii_bplx = 6 then
			dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("YWLX = 'ZY'")
			dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
		end if
		st_2.Text = "住院结算明细(BQXT.ZY_ZYJS)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zyjsdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( il_zyh )
END CHOOSE

RETURN 1



end function

blocks.text:
public subroutine wf_get_sql ();String ls_sql, ls_sql1, ls_sql2, ls_sql3, ls_sql4, ls_sql5
Integer li_pos1, li_pos2, li_pos3

//JKXT.YB_JSMX的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 32 Or ii_bplx = 6 THEN
	ls_sql = dw_ybjsmx.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql, ":an_zyh")
	ls_sql = Replace(ls_sql, li_pos1, 7, String(il_zyh))
ELSEIF ii_bplx = 31 Or ii_bplx = 4 Or ii_bplx = 5 or ii_bplx = 41 THEN
	ls_sql = dw_ybjsmx.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql = Replace(ls_sql, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql = Replace(ls_sql, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql = Replace(ls_sql, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

//MZXT.MZ_FPK的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 1 Or ii_bplx = 4 or ii_bplx = 41 THEN
	ls_sql1 = dw_mxdz.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql1, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql1 = Replace(ls_sql1, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql1, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql1 = Replace(ls_sql1, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql1, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql1 = Replace(ls_sql1, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

//MZXT.MZ_GHXX的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 2 Or ii_bplx = 5 THEN
	ls_sql2 = dw_mxdz.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql2, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql2 = Replace(ls_sql2, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql2, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql2 = Replace(ls_sql2, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql2, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql2 = Replace(ls_sql2, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

//BQXT.ZY_ZYJS的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 6 THEN
	ls_sql3 = dw_mxdz.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql3, ":an_zyh")
	ls_sql3 = Replace(ls_sql3, li_pos1, 7, String(il_zyh))
END IF

//MZXT.H_MZ_ZHJYMX的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 1 Or ii_bplx = 2 THEN
	ls_sql4 = dw_zhjymx.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql4, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql4 = Replace(ls_sql4, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql4, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql4 = Replace(ls_sql4, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql4, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql4 = Replace(ls_sql4, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

//MZXT.H_FP_ZFFS的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 1 Or ii_bplx = 2 THEN
	ls_sql5 = dw_fpzffs.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql5, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql5 = Replace(ls_sql5, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql5, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql5 = Replace(ls_sql5, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql5, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql5 = Replace(ls_sql5, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

IF ls_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql1 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql1) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql1 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql1 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql2 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql2) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql2 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql2 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql3 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql3) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql3 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql3 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql4 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql4) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql4 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql4 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql5 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql5) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql5 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql5 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

event clicked;String ls_yybz
Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_find,ll_fpcount
DEC{0} ll_ywlsh
String ls_ywlsh,ls_ywlx
ls_yybz = gf_getpara(0,'YYBZ'+String(gi_pyyq),'FEY','医院标志')
//2021-07-02zbq台州市本级医保JSMX端，进行98处理，即单边帐，98或99，原来单边帐的，是将ztbz改成-1的
//IF ls_yybz = 'TZFBY' or is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN RETURN 
IF is_ybjk = 'lb'  THEN RETURN
IF ls_yybz = 'TZFBY' And is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
	ll_count = dw_ybjsmx.RowCount( )
	ll_fpcount = dw_mxdz.RowCount( )
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		ls_ywlsh = dw_ybjsmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
		IF dw_ybjsmx.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = 1 THEN
			IF ii_bplx = 4 Or ii_bplx = 7 Or ii_bplx = 41 THEN
				ll_find = dw_mxdz.Find( "fplsh = '"+ls_ywlsh+"'", 1, ll_fpcount)
				IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
					SELECT COUNT(1) Into :ll_find From MZ_FPK Where FPLSH = :ls_ywlsh Using SQLCA;
				END IF
				IF ll_find <= 0 THEN

event ue_zxdz();String ls_dzr,ls_return,ls_dzjg

Boolean lb_sbdz
//判断是否统计汇总过，汇总日期是否与显示一致
IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(is_dzr) Or dw_1.RowCount( ) <= 0  THEN
	//	post event ue_ref()
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再对账')
	RETURN

			RETURN

	END IF
END IF
//修改，直接调用刷新函数，判断是否有对账结果

ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]

ld_zlze = dw_1.Object.fy_zlze[1]

ld_jjzfze = dw_1.Object.jjzfze[1]
ld_dnzhze = dw_1.Object.dnzhze[1]
ld_lnzhze = dw_1.Object.lnzhze[1]
ld_gbze = dw_1.Object.gbze[1]
ld_tcze = dw_1.Object.tcze[1]
ld_jzze = dw_1.Object.jzze[1]
ld_bzze = dw_1.Object.bzze[1]
ld_lxze = dw_1.Object.lxze[1]
ld_eyze = dw_1.Object.eyze[1]
ld_lmze = dw_1.Object.lmze[1]
ld_jmze = dw_1.Object.jmze[1]
ld_dxsze = dw_1.Object.dxsze[1]
ld_wcnze = dw_1.Object.wcnze[1]
ld_xnhze = dw_1.Object.xnhze[1]
ld_qtjjze = dw_1.Object.qtjjze[1]

IF IsValid (gu_ybjk_public) = False THEN //创建医保接口
	gu_ybjk_public = 
Create u_ybjk_public
	IF Not gu_ybjk_public.uf_init( ls_return) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF

lb_sbdz = gu_ybjk_public.iu_ybjk_new.uf_sb_dzcl( li_ywlx, ls_dzr, ll_jybs, ld_ylfyze,ld_zfze,ld_zlze,ld_xjzf,ld_jjzfze, ld_dnzhze,ld_lnzhze, ld_gbze,ld_tcze,ld_jzze,	ld_bzze,ld_lxze,ld_eyze, ld_lmze,ld_jmze,ld_dxsze,ld_wcnze , ld_xnhze,ld_qtjjze,ls_return)

IF lb_sbdz THEN
	ls_dzjg = ls_return
	dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = Integer(ls_dzjg)
	gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr,li_ywlx)

ELSE
	MessageBox('社保对账',ls_return)
END IF

event ue_hdjy();String ls_jsjylsh,ls_ybfyze,ls_error1,ls_error2 ,ls_error3,ls_errortext,ls_error4,ls_jssj,ls_grbh
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_ybfyze
Long ll_jymx_count,ll_dzxx_count,ll_find,i

NEXT

IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN

END IF

MessageBox('社保笔数：'+String(ll_dzxx_count),'本地有效笔数：'+String(ll_jymx_count))

	ls_ybfyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[i]
	ls_jssj =  tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jysj[i]
	ldt_jssj = DateTime(Date(Long(Mid(ls_jssj,1,4)),Long(Mid(ls_jssj,5,2)),Long(Mid(ls_jssj,7,2))),Time(Mid(ls_jssj,8,10)))
	ls_grbh =  tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.kxx[i]
	ls_brbm = ls_grbh
	ls_jylx = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jylx[i]
	ls_cbd = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdxzqhdm[i]
	ls_yxbz = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.yxbz[i]
	ls_cbdxzqhdm = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdxzqhdm[i]
	ld_ybfyze = Dec(ls_ybfyze)
	//	if ld_ybfyze < 0 then continue
	ll_find = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Find("jsjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"' and cbdxzhq = '" +ls_cbdxzqhdm+"'",1,ll_jymx_count)

		//对于交易明细和改帐信息中都没有的中心交易作改帐处理
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
			//			IF ls_yxbz = '1' THEN CONTINUE
//			IF MessageBox('提示',ls_jsjylsh + "该笔记录中心有,本地没有是否进行改帐处理!",Question!,YesNo!,2 ) = 1 THEN
//				gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
//				INSERT Into JKXT.yb_jsmx (brbm,jssj,ywlx,jyjk,jyjslx,jzbh,mxzdh,jsjylsh,ylfyze,ztbz,grbh,cbdxzhq) Values(:ls_brbm,:ldt_jssj,'GZ',:ls_jylx,'0','0','0',:ls_jsjylsh,:ld_ybfyze,-1,:ls_grbh,:ls_cbd) Using sqlca;
//				IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0  THEN
//					gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
//				ELSE
//					ls_errortext = sqlca.SQLErrText + String(sqlca.SQLCode)
//					gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
//					MessageBox('提示','插入改帐申请单有误,请重试:' + ls_errortext)
//					RETURN
//				END IF
//			END IF
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.rowscopy( i, i, Primary!, tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd, 1, Primary!)
			ls_error3 = ls_error3 + "jsjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'" +'~t' + "费用总额:" + ls_ybfyze +'~t'
		ELSE
			IF ld_ybfyze <> Dec(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]) THEN
				MessageBox('总额不一致' , ls_jsjylsh + "社保:" + ls_ybfyze + "本地:" + String(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]))
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT

IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地有而中心没有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error1 + '~t'
IF ls_error3 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地没有而中心有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error3 + '~t'
IF ls_error2 <> '' THEN
	ls_errortext += '本地与中心有出入的有：' + '~t' +  ls_error2
	MessageBox('提示',ls_errortext)
END IF
tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = ls_errortext
tab_1.SelectTab(6)
IF tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = '' THEN
	tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = '祝贺你此次对帐顺利通过，哈哈 请客！'
	MessageBox('提示','对帐已通过')
END IF
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)

event ue_mxxz();String ls_dzr,ls_return,ls_jyxht,ls_jsbz
Long ll_jymxts,ll_cur,ll_insert
Integer li_ywlx
Boolean lb_return
String ls_jsjylshm,ls_cbd,ls_jylx,ls_sfy,ls_jysj,ls_klb,ls_fhkxx,ls_xm,ls_fyze,ls_yxbz
dec{2} ld_fyze = 0.00
IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(idt_end) Or dw_1.RowCount( ) <= 0 Or IsNull(dw_1.Object.dzr[1]) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，在对账')
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]
	li_ywlx = dw_1.Object.ywlx[1]
	IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','对账时间'+String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')+'与对誅AT* 诵畔⒒阕苤械亩哉巳 ' + ls_dzr+'不一致,请重新统计汇总')
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
IF IsValid (gu_ybjk_public) = False THEN //创建医保接口
	gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
	IF Not gu_ybjk_public.uf_init( ls_return) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
//提示
IF tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowCount( ) > 0 THEN
	IF MessageBox('提示','已经下载了明细，是否重新下载?',Question!,YesNo!,2) = 2 THEN
		return
	END IF
END IF
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Reset( )
//添加消息体发送信息内容
ls_jsbz = '0'
ls_jsjylshm = ''
DO WHILE ls_jsbz = '0'
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init('S001')
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('业务类型',li_ywlx)
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('交易日期',ls_dzr)
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('上次查询末笔结算交易流水号',ls_jsjylshm)
	//发送消息
	IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_send(ls_return) THEN 
		w_sbdz_new.SetRedraw(False)
		ls_jsbz = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring("结束标志")
		ll_jymxts = Long(gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring("循环次数"))
		IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_ybjk_new.uf_set_xhcs('S001','YD',ll_jymxts,'循环次数') < 0 THEN
			MessageBox('提示','设置循环体条数失败!')
		END IF
		
		ls_jyxht = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring("循环体")
		gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',0)
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_jymxts
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',ll_cur / ll_jymxts * 100)
			ls_jsjylshm = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring_in( "结算交易流水号",ll_cur)
			ls_cbd = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring_in( "参保地行政区划代码",ll_cur)
			ls_jylx = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring_in( "交易类型",ll_cur)
			ls_sfy = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring_in( "收费人员代码",ll_cur)
			ls_jysj = String(gu_ybjk_public.uf_getdatetime_in( "交易时间",ll_cur),'yyyymmdd-hh:mm:ss')
			//			ls_jysj = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring_in( "交易时间",ll_cur)
			ls_klb = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring_in( "卡类别",ll_cur)
			ls_fhkxx = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring_in( "返回卡信息",ll_cur)
			ls_xm = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring_in( "姓名",ll_cur)
			ls_fyze = String(gu_ybjk_public.uf_getdecimal_in( "医疗费用总额",ll_cur))
			ls_yxbz = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring_in( "有效标志",ll_cur)
			ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.InsertRow( 0)
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jsjylsh[ll_insert] = ls_jsjylshm
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdxzqhdm[ll_insert] = ls_cbd
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jylx[ll_insert] = ls_jylx
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.sfydm[ll_insert] = ls_sfy
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jysj[ll_insert] = ls_jysj
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.klb[ll_insert] = ls_klb
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.kxx[ll_insert] = ls_fhkxx
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_xm
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.yxbz[ll_insert] = ls_yxbz
			ld_fyze = ld_fyze + dec(ls_fyze)
		NEXT
		gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',-1)
	ELSE 
		MessageBox("提示",ls_return)
		RETURN
	END IF
LOOP
w_sbdz_new.SetRedraw(True)
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zfy.text = string(ld_fyze)
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.saveas( "C:\SB\download\"+ls_dzr+string(li_ywlx) + ".txt", text! ,true)
MessageBox("提示",'下载成功!')


end event

event ue_gzsq();String ls_dzr,ls_return,ls_count,ls_cbd,ls_jsjylsh,ls_gzsqh
Integer li_ywlx,li_dzjg,li_ret
Long ll_find,ll_count,ll_cur
Dec{2} ld_ylfyze
IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(is_dzr) Or dw_1.RowCount( ) <= 0 Or IsNull(dw_1.Object.dzr[1]) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计')
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]
	li_ywlx = dw_1.Object.ywlx[1]
	li_dzjg = dw_1.Object.dzjg[1]
	IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','对账时间'+String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')+'与对账信息汇总中的对账日' + ls_dzr+'不一致,请重新统计汇总')
		RETURN
	ELSEIF IsNull(li_dzjg) THEN
		MessageBox('提示',"该日" + ls_dzr + "还未与中心对账，请先对账!")
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
IF li_ywlx = 2 THEN
	Boolean lb_tkjy
	li_ret = wf_ztcx(ls_return,lb_tkjy)
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		IF MessageBox('提示',"是否继续改帐申请？~r~n查询交易状态失败：" +ls_return,question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
	//如果有退款刷新数据，再次对账，再申请改帐 modify by sxl 2016-12-30
	IF lb_tkjy THEN
		Event ue_ref()
		Event ue_zxdz()
	END IF
END IF
DateTime ldt_jssj
li_ret = 0
li_ret = wf_gzcx(ls_dzr,li_ywlx,ls_return)
IF li_ret = 2 Or li_ret = 9 THEN
	IF IsValid (gu_ybjk_public) = False THEN //创建医保接口
		gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
		IF Not gu_ybjk_public.uf_init( ls_return) THEN
			MessageBox('提示','医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
	ll_count = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount()
	ls_count = Right('000000'+String(ll_count),6)
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init( "S002")
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add( "业务类型", li_ywlx)
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add( "交易日期", ls_dzr)
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add( "改账流水循环体条数", ls_count)
	//		gu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add( "改账流水循环体", ll_count)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		//判断改誅AT*
噬昵牒藕徒崴憬灰琢魉�号是否为�

		ldt_jssj = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jssj[ll_cur]
		ls_cbd = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.cbdxzhq[ll_cur]
		ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur]
		ld_ylfyze = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfyze[ll_cur]
		IF Time(ldt_jssj) > Time(23:55:00) THEN
			IF MessageBox('提示',ls_jsjylsh + '的交易时间'+String(ldt_jssj)+'可能存在跨天，是否继续申请改帐！',question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
		gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in( "参保地行政区划代码",ls_cbd,ll_cur)
		gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in( "结算交易流水号",ls_jsjylsh,ll_cur)
		gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in( "医疗费用总额", ld_ylfyze,ll_cur)
	NEXT
	IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_send( ls_return) = False THEN
		MessageBox("提示","改帐出错" +ls_return )
	ELSE
		ls_gzsqh = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring("改账申请号")
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.gzsqh[ll_cur] = ls_gzsqh
		NEXT
		ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Find( "dzr = '"+ls_dzr+"' and ywlx = " + String(li_ywlx) , 1, tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.RowCount())
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.gzjg[ll_find] = '-1'
			tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.gzsqh[ll_find] = ls_gzsqh
		END IF
		gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
		IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Update( ) = 1 And tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Update( ) = 1 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			//			MessageBox('提示','改帐申请成功!' + ls_gzsqh)
			This.Event ue_zxdz( )
		ELSE
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			MessageBox('提示','保存改帐信息错误!')
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	MessageBox('提示','已经申请改帐,结果：'+ls_return)
END IF

end event

event ue_bptz();String ls_jsjylsh, ls_tsxx
ls_tsxx = "请输入本地有而医保中心的明细中没有的结算交易流水号~n" +&
	"（提示：该功能只进行本地有而中心没有的明细调整，本地没有而医保中心有的明细【门诊校对】双击具体明细。）"
ls_jsjylsh = Trim(gf_inputbox(ls_tsxx, ""))

IF ls_jsjylsh = '-1' Or ls_jsjylsh = "" THEN
	RETURN
END IF

DateTime ldt_begin
ldt_begin = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(idt_begin), -1), Time("00:00:00"))

String ls_brbm, ls_ywlx
Long ll_zyh
DateTime ldt_jysj

String ls_sql
ls_sql = "SELECT brbm, ywlx,zyh,jssj From jkxt.yb_jsmx Where jssj >= " + gf_dtinsql(ldt_begin) + " And jsjylsh = '" + ls_jsjylsh + "' And (ztbz > 0 or ztbz = -1) Order By jssj Desc "
u_datastore lds_brxx
lds_brxx = Create u_datastore
IF lds_brxx.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
	MessageBox("提示", "创建'病人信息查询'对象失败。")
	RETURN
END IF
lds_brxx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
IF lds_brxx.Retrieve() <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox("提示", "该结算交易流水号没找到对应的病人信息")
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_brbm = lds_brxx.Object.brbm[1]
	ls_ywlx = lds_brxx.Object.ywlx[1]
	ll_zyh = lds_brxx.Object.zyh[1]
	IF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'SF' Or ls_ywlx = '' THEN
		ii_bplx = 4
	ELSEIF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'GH' THEN
		ii_bplx = 5
	ELSEIF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'ZY' THEN
		ii_bplx = 6
	END IF
	
	s_exchange ls_exchange
	ls_exchange.LongParm[1] = ii_bplx
	ls_exchange.LongParm[2] = ll_zyh
	ls_exchange.StringParm[1] = ls_brbm
	ls_exchange.StringParm[2] = ls_jsjylsh
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[1] = idt_begin
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[2] = idt_end
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[3] = ldt_jysj
	ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'wd'
	
	OpenWithParm(w_sbdz_bptz, ls_exchange)
END IF
destroy lds_brxx
end event

blocks.name: wf_auto_jdmz
blocks.text:
public function long wf_auto_jdmz (datetime ld_start, datetime ld_end);datastore ds_sb_fpk,ds_sb_jymx
long ll_fpk_count,ll_jymx_count , i  , ll_find,ll_return ,ll_fplsh_count
string ls_zxlsh,ls_bz,ls_txt,ls_fplsh
dec {0} ll_lsh

ll_return=0

ds_sb_fpk=create datastore 
ds_sb_jymx=create datastore 

ds_sb_fpk.dataobject='d_sb_autodz_fpk'
ds_sb_jymx.dataobject='d_sb_autodz_jymx'

ds_sb_fpk.settransobject(sqlca)
ds_sb_jymx.settransobject(sqlca)


ds_sb_fpk.retrieve(ld_start,ld_end)
ds_sb_jymx.retrieve(ld_start,ld_end)

ll_fpk_count=ds_sb_fpk.rowcount()
ll_jymx_count=ds_sb_jymx.rowcount()
    
	
for i=1 to  ll_fpk_count
	 ls_zxlsh = ds_sb_fpk.object.zxlsh[i]
	 if isnull(ls_zxlsh) then ls_zxlsh=''
	 ll_find=ds_sb_jymx.FIND( "zxlsh='"+ls_zxlsh+"'", 1,  ll_jymx_count  )
	 if isnull(ll_find) then ll_find=0
    if ll_find>0 then 
		  ds_sb_jymx.object.bz[ll_find]='1'
	 else
		  if trim(ls_zxlsh)<='' or isnull(ls_zxlsh) then continue;
         messagebox('提示','zxlsh='+ls_zxlsh+'   需内部调帐' + string(ds_sb_fpk.object.grbm[i]))
			return 100;
	 end if
next

ls_txt=''
for i=1 to  ll_jymx_count
	 ls_bz= ds_sb_jymx.object.bz[i]
	 ll_lsh= ds_sb_jymx.object.lsh[i]
	 ls_fplsh= ds_sb_jymx.object.fplsh[i]
	 
 	 ls_zxlsh= ds_sb_jymx.object.zxlsh[i]
	 if isnull(ls_fplsh) then ls_fplsh=''
    if isnull(ls_bz) or trim(ls_bz)<='' then ls_bz=''
	 if ls_bz='0' then 
		 ll_fplsh_count=0
		 select count(*)  into :ll_fplsh_count from sb_jymx where fplsh=:ls_fplsh  and fplsh is not null;
		 if isnull(ll_fplsh_count) then ll_fplsh_count=0
		 if ll_fplsh_count>=2 then continue;
		 ls_txt=ls_txt+'  '+ls_zxlsh
	 else
		  continue;
	 end if
	 if trim(ls_zxlsh)<='' or isnull(ls_zxlsh) then continue;
	 
	 gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	 insert into sb_jymx_gzxx select * from sb_jymx where zxlsh=:ls_zxlsh   and lsh=:ll_lsh; 
	 if sqlca.sqlcode=0 then 
		 delete from sb_jymx where zxlsh=:ls_zxlsh   and lsh=:ll_lsh; 
		 if sqlca.sqlcode=0 then 
			  gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		else
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			ll_return=101
			exit
		end if
	 else
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			ll_return=101
			exit
	 end if
next

if ls_txt<>'' then 
	messagebox('提示','门诊需改帐的流水号有：'+ls_txt)
end if	

destroy ds_sb_fpk;
destroy ds_sb_jymx;


return ll_return



end function

blocks.name: wf_dzyz
blocks.text:
public function integer wf_dzyz ();
u_datastore lds_bpmx
lds_bpmx = Create u_datastore

String ls_bpmx
Long ll_rowcount, ll_temp

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',1)
cbx_1.visible =false
//判断预存是否有过正确结转
//=======================核对==============================//
Dec{2} ld_kyc, ld_yck_fp,ldc_yck_gh
Long ll_count

ld_kyc = 0
SELECT SUM(JYJE) INTO :ld_kyc FROM H_MZ_ZHJYMX
	Where JYSJ >= :idt_begin And JYSJ < :idt_end And JYLB In (11,12) ;
//And Upper(JYDD) Not In ('GH','ZZGH');
IF IsNull(ld_kyc) THEN ld_kyc = 0

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',10)

//====预存款－－扣款fpk,zffs
ld_yck_fp = 0
SELECT sum(NVL(H_FP_ZFFS.ZFJE,0)) INTO :ld_yck_fp FROM mz_fpk,H_FP_ZFFS
	WHERE mz_fpk.kpsj >= :idt_begin AND mz_fpk.kpsj < :idt_end
	//	AND (H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '5' OR H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '7' OR H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '8' or H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '10')
	AND (H_FP_ZFFS.zffs IN (SELECT to_char(dmsb) FROM xtgl.gy_dmzd WHERE dmlb = 34 AND bzbm2 = 1))
	And NVL(mz_fpk.fpzf,0) <> 9  And mz_fpk.fplsh = H_FP_ZFFS.fplsh;
IF IsNull(ld_yck_fp) THEN ld_yck_fp = 0
//挂号非现金支付
ldc_yck_gh = 0.00
SELECT sum(NVL(xjje,0)) INTO :ldc_yck_gh FROM MZ_GHXX
	WHERE GHRQ >= :idt_begin AND GHRQ < :idt_end
	AND ZFFS IN (SELECT to_char(dmsb) FROM xtgl.gy_dmzd WHERE dmlb = 34 AND bzbm2 = 1)
	And NVL(THBZ,'0') In ('0','s','t','r');
IF IsNull(ldc_yck_gh) THEN ldc_yck_gh = 0

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',20)

IF Abs(ld_kyc + ld_yck_fp + ldc_yck_gh) > 1 THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_yc'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('预存发票未正确结转......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "预存发票未正确结转"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 1 //预存不平
		
		dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ycgh'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('预存发票未正确结转......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "预存发票未正确结转（挂号）"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 2 //预存挂号不平
		
		dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//重复的2,3清理
wf_delrep(idt_begin,idt_end)

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',30)

//----验证基金支付总额是否和分基金支付总和一致------- //
SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_count FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx t
	WHERE jjzfze <> (tczfs + jzzfs + grdnzhzfs + grlnzhzfs + gbjjzfs + bzjjzfs + lxjjzfs + eyjjzfs + lmjjzfs + jmjjzfs +  	     dxsjjzfs + wcnrjjzfs + xnhjjzfs + qtjjzfs + qtzfs1 + qtzfs2 + qtzfs3 +  		  SYBXZFS + CLJJZFS + DSRNHSYBXZFS + YLJJ1 + YLJJ2 + YLJJ3 + YLJJ4 +  		  YLJJ5 + YLJJ6 + YLJJ7 + YLJJ9 + YLJJ9 + YLJJ10 )
	And jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And  jsjylsh Is Not Null  And ZTBZ > 0 ;
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jjzf'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 3 //基金支付不平
	END IF
	
	//	MessageBox('提示,不能对帐,请与计算中心联系','有'+String(ll_count) + "条记录，验证基金支付总额是否和分基金支付总和一致")
	//	gf_waiting('基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致......',-1)
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

////------验证门诊数据一致性----社保门诊发票记帐金额-------- //, ld_sdjzje, ld_zjece
Dec{2} ld_sbjzje, ld_mzjz, ld_sbzje, ld_jzce, ld_fpzje, ld_ylfyze, ld_jzzfce,ldc_tsje,ldc_gbxjzf
Dec{2} ldc_syd_jz = 0,ldc_syd_zje = 0
SELECT sum(jzje), SUM(CASE when gfje =1 then XMZJE - nvl(yhje,0) else XMZJE end) INTO :ld_sbjzje, :ld_fpzje FROM mz_fpk
	Where kpsj >= :idt_begin And kpsj < :idt_end And NVL(fpzf,0) <> 9 And jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ld_sbjzje) THEN ld_sbjzje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_fpzje) THEN ld_fpzje = 0

SELECT sum(NVL(jzce,0)), SUM(jzce + zfce) INTO :ld_jzce, :ld_jzzfce FROM mzxt.sb_jejd
	Where kpsj >= :idt_begin And kpsj < :idt_end And XMLB = 0;
IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
IF IsNull(ld_jzzfce) THEN ld_jzzfce = 0

ld_sbjzje = ld_sbjzje + ld_jzce
ld_fpzje = ld_fpzje + ld_jzzfce

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',50)

SELECT sum(nvl(jjzfze,0)), sum(nvl(ylfyze,0)) INTO :ld_mzjz, :ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%';
IF Date(idt_begin) > Date(2017,6,1) THEN
	SELECT SUM(NVL(HJBXJE,0)),sum(nvl(FYZE,0)) INTO :ldc_syd_jz,:ldc_syd_zje FROM jkxt.sydyb_jsmx
		WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND JSLSH Is NOT NULL
		And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(JYID,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;
END IF
//干部保健金额
SELECT sum(nvl(xjzfze,0)) INTO :ldc_gbxjzf FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' 
	And (gbbjdx >= '1' OR YWLSH IN (SELECT YWLSH  FROM jkxt.js_tsjl 	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj < :idt_end AND ybywh Is NOT NULL 	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 AND JSFL = 'JRYF'));
SELECT sum(nvl(tszje,0)) INTO :ldc_tsje FROM jkxt.js_tsjl
	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj < :idt_end AND ybywh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;
	
IF IsNull(ld_mzjz) THEN ld_mzjz = 0
//IF IsNull(ld_sdjzje) THEN ld_sdjzje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_gbxjzf) THEN ldc_gbxjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_tsje) THEN ldc_tsje = 0
if isnull(ldc_syd_jz) then ldc_syd_jz = 0
if isnull(ldc_syd_zje ) then ldc_syd_zje = 0
ld_sbzje = ld_mzjz  + (ldc_gbxjzf - ldc_tsje) + ldc_syd_jz//- ld_sdjzje
ld_ylfyze = ld_ylfyze + ldc_syd_zje
//ldc_syd_jz
//ld_zjece = ld_ylfyze - ld_fpzje

IF ld_sbzje <> ld_sbjzje Or ld_ylfyze <> ld_fpzje THEN
	
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_sfjz'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('门诊交易数据不一致......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "门诊交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 4 //门诊收费不平
	END IF
	cbx_1.visible = true
	cbx_1.bringtotop = TRUE
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//挂号记账金额是否一致验证------------------
Dec{2} ld_ghjz, ld_sbghjz, ld_sdghjz, ld_ghzje, ld_zce, ld_ghzjje,ld_ckblf = 0.00

SELECT sum(NVL(ZJJE,0) - NVL(XJJE,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)), sum(NVL(ZJJE,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)) INTO :ld_ghjz, :ld_ghzjje FROM mz_ghxx
	WHERE GHRQ >= :idt_begin AND GHRQ < :idt_end AND (nvl(THBZ,0) NOT IN ('i','3'))
	And jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ld_ghjz) THEN ld_ghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ghzjje) THEN ld_ghzjje = 0

SELECT sum(nvl(ghfy,0)) Into :ld_ckblf From mz_ghxx,mz_ghfyxx 
	Where mz_ghxx.ghlsh = mz_ghfyxx.ghlsh And mz_ghxx.GHRQ >= :idt_begin And mz_ghxx.GHRQ < :idt_end  
	And (nvl(mz_ghxx.THBZ,0) Not In ('i','3')) And mz_ghxx.jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1) 
	And (mz_ghfyxx.fyxh = :il_ckf or mz_ghfyxx.fyxh = :il_blf);

IF IsNull(ld_ckblf) THEN ld_ckblf = 0

SELECT sum(jzce),sum(jzce + zfce) INTO :ld_jzce, :ld_zce FROM mzxt.sb_jejd
	Where kpsj >= :idt_begin And kpsj < :idt_end And XMLB = 1;
	
IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
IF IsNull(ld_zce) THEN ld_zce = 0

ld_ghjz = ld_ghjz + ld_jzce
ld_sdghjz = ld_ghzjje + ld_zce - ld_ckblf

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',70)

SELECT sum(nvl(jjzfze,0)), sum(nvl(ylfyze,0)) INTO :ld_sbghjz, :ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%';
//省异地
ldc_syd_jz = 0
ldc_syd_zje = 0
IF Date(idt_begin) > Date(2017,6,1) THEN
	SELECT SUM(NVL(HJBXJE,0)),sum(nvl(FYZE,0)) INTO :ldc_syd_jz,:ldc_syd_zje FROM jkxt.sydyb_jsmx
		WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND JSLSH Is NOT NULL
		And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(JYID,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;
END IF	
//干部保健
SELECT sum(nvl(xjzfze,0)) INTO :ldc_gbxjzf FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%'
	And (gbbjdx >= '1' OR YWLSH IN (SELECT YWLSH FROM jkxt.js_tsjl 	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj < :idt_end AND ybywh Is NOT NULL 	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 AND JSFL = 'JRYF'));
	
SELECT sum(nvl(tszje,0)) INTO :ldc_tsje FROM jkxt.js_tsjl
	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj < :idt_end AND ybywh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;
	
IF IsNull(ld_ghjz) THEN ld_ghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_sbghjz) THEN ld_sbghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_sdghjz) THEN ld_sdghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_gbxjzf) THEN ldc_gbxjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_tsje) THEN ldc_tsje = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_syd_jz) then ldc_syd_jz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_syd_zje) then ldc_syd_zje = 0

ld_ghzje = ld_sbghjz  + (ldc_gbxjzf - ldc_tsje) + ldc_syd_jz
ld_ylfyze = ld_ylfyze +ldc_syd_zje 
IF ld_ghjz <> ld_ghzje Or ld_sdghjz <> ld_ylfyze THEN
	gf_waiting('门诊挂号交易数据不一致......',-1)
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_gh'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	long ll_ckbl[]
	ll_ckbl[1] = il_ckf
	ll_ckbl[2] = il_blf
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end,ll_ckbl )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		dw_bpmx.Title = "门诊挂号交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 5 //门诊挂号不平
	END IF
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//住院病人结算金额是否一致验证----------------------
Dec{2} ldc_zyjz, ldc_zyjzzf, ldc_zyzje, ldc_zyzjezf, ldc_sbzyjz, ldc_sbzyzje

// 2021.12.17  CJN  27897  (WD)住院总金额计算需要剔除不上传费用NVL(BSCJE,0)
SELECT sum(NVL(fyhj,0) - NVL(zfhj,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)), sum(NVL(fyhj,0)- NVL(YHJE,0)-NVL(BSCJE,0)) INTO :ldc_zyjz, :ldc_zyzje FROM zy_zyjs
	WHERE jsrq >= :idt_begin AND jsrq < :idt_end
	And brxz In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ldc_zyjz) THEN ldc_zyjz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zyzje) THEN ldc_zyzje = 0

SELECT sum(NVL(fyhj,0) - NVL(zfhj,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)), sum(NVL(fyhj,0)- NVL(YHJE,0)-NVL(BSCJE,0)) INTO :ldc_zyjzzf, :ldc_zyzjezf FROM zy_zyjs
	WHERE zfrq >= :idt_begin AND zfrq < :idt_end AND zfpb = 1
	And brxz In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ldc_zyjzzf) THEN ldc_zyjzzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zyzjezf) THEN ldc_zyzjezf = 0

ldc_zyjz = ldc_zyjz - ldc_zyjzzf
ldc_zyzje = ldc_zyzje - ldc_zyzjezf

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',90)

SELECT sum(NVL(jjzfze,0)), sum(NVL(ylfyze,0)) INTO :ldc_sbzyjz, :ldc_sbzyzje FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'ZY' And ZTBZ > 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_sbzyjz) THEN ldc_sbzyjz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_sbzyzje) THEN ldc_sbzyzje = 0
//省异地
ldc_syd_jz = 0
ldc_syd_zje = 0
IF Date(idt_begin) > Date(2017,6,1) THEN
	SELECT SUM(NVL(HJBXJE,0)),sum(nvl(FYZE,0)) INTO :ldc_syd_jz,:ldc_syd_zje FROM jkxt.sydyb_jsmx
		WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND JSLSH Is NOT NULL
		And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'ZY' And ZTBZ > 0  ;
END IF
IF isnull(ldc_syd_zje) then ldc_syd_zje = 0
IF ldc_zyzje <> ldc_sbzyzje + ldc_syd_zje THEN
	gf_waiting('住院病人交易数据不一致......',-1)
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zy'  // 2021.12.17  CJN  27897  (WD)住院明细的总金额计算需要剔除不上传费用NVL(BSCJE,0)
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		dw_bpmx.Title = "住院病人交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 6 //住院不平
	END IF
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',-1)
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer wf_gzcx (string as_dzr, integer ai_ywlx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: w_sbdz_new.wf_gzcx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:改帐查询
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string 	as_dzr  	对账日
// 	value    	integer	ai_ywlx 	业务类型
// 	reference	string 	as_error	返回信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer -1:出错 0:未处理 1:改帐通过 2:改帐未通过 9:没有申请过改帐
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2011.08.31
//====================================================================
String ls_gzsqh,ls_return,ls_gzjg
Long ll_find,ll_count

ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Find( "dzr = '"+as_dzr+"' and ywlx = " + String(ai_ywlx) , 1, tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.RowCount())
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	ls_gzsqh = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.gzsqh[ll_find]
	IF IsNull(ls_gzsqh) THEN
		as_error = as_dzr + '该天没有改帐申请!'
		RETURN 9
	ELSE
		ls_gzjg = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.gzjg[ll_find]
		IF ls_gzjg = '1' THEN
			as_error = '改账已经通过，不需再改帐!' + "改帐申请号：" + ls_gzsqh
			RETURN 1
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	as_error = as_dzr + '没有对账信息，请先对账!'
	RETURN -1
END IF

//除了改帐通过和未申请改帐过的--进行此改帐查询
IF IsValid (gu_ybjk_public) = False THEN //创建医保接口
	gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
	IF Not gu_ybjk_public.uf_init( ls_return) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF

gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init( "S003")
gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add( "业务类型", ai_ywlx)
gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add( "交易日期", as_dzr)
gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add( "改账申请号", ls_gzsqh)

IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_send( ls_return) = False THEN
	as_error = "改帐查询失败:" +ls_return + + "改帐申请号：" + ls_gzsqh
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	ls_return = STRING(LONG(gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring("消息返回码")))
	gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.gzjg[ll_find] = ls_return
	IF tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Update( ) = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		as_error = '保存改誅AT* ,' + "改帐申请号：" + ls_gzsqh
		return -1
	END IF
	IF ls_return = '1' THEN
		as_error = '改账通过,'+ "改帐申请号：" + ls_gzsqh
		RETURN 1
	ELSEIF ls_return = '0' THEN
		as_error = '改帐未处理,'+ "改帐申请号：" + ls_gzsqh
		RETURN 0
	ELSEIF ls_return = '2' THEN
		as_error = '改账未通过,'+ "改帐申请号：" + ls_gzsqh
		RETURN 2
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 9
end function

end And ZTBZ > 0 And JSJYLSH Is Not Null And ( CBDXZHQ = :is_cbdxzhq or CBDXZHQ is null);
	SELECT SUM(NVL(YLFYZE,0)),SUM(NVL(YLFYZFZE,0)),SUM(NVL(YLFYZLZE,0)),SUM(NVL(XJZFZE,0)),SUM(NVL(JJZFZE,0)),SUM(NVL(GRDNZHZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(GRLNZHZFS,0)),

		SUM(NVL(DXSJJZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(WCNRJJZFS,0)) ,SUM(NVL(XNHJJZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(QTJJZFS,0)) // + NVL(QTZFS1,0) + NVL(QTZFS2,0) + NVL(QTZFS3,0)
		INTO :ld_ylfyze,:ld_zfze,:ld_zlze,:ld_xjzf,:ld_jjzfze,:ld_dnzhze,:ld_lnzhze,:ld_gbze,:ld_tcze,:ld_jzze,:ld_bzze,:ld_lxze,:ld_eyze,:ld_dxsze,:ld_wcnze ,:ld_xnhze,:ld_qtjjze

	SELECT SUM(NVL(LMJJZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(JMJJZFS,0))

	SELECT SUM(NVL(LMJJZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(JMJJZFS,0))
		INTO :ld_lmze2,:ld_jmze2
		From JKXT.YB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :ldt_begin And JSSJ < :ldt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And JSJYLSH Is Not Null And BBRQ >= '20110905' And ( CBDXZHQ = :is_cbdxzhq or CBDXZHQ is null);
ELSEIF ai_ywlx = 2 THEN
	SELECT COUNT(*) Into :ll_jybs  From JKXT.YB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :ldt_begin And JSSJ < :ldt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And JSJYLSH Is Not Null And CBDXZHQ <> :is_cbdxzhq;
	SELECT SUM(NVL(YLFYZE,0)),SUM(NVL(YLFYZFZE,0)),SUM(NVL(YLFYZLZE,0)),SUM(NVL(XJZFZE,0)),SUM(NVL(JJZFZE,0)),SUM(NVL(GRDNZHZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(GRLNZHZFS,0)),
		SUM(NVL(GBJJZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(TCZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(JZZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(BZJJZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(LXJJZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(EYJJZFS,0)),
		SUM(NVL(DXSJJZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(WCNRJJZFS,0)) ,SUM(NVL(XNHJJZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(QTJJZFS,0))// + NVL(QTZFS1,0) + NVL(QTZFS2,0) + NVL(QTZFS3,0)
		INTO :ld_ylfyze,:ld_zfze,:ld_zlze,:ld_xjzf,:ld_jjzfze,:ld_dnzhze,:ld_lnzhze,:ld_gbze,:ld_tcze,:ld_jzze,:ld_bzze,:ld_lxze,:ld_eyze,:ld_dxsze,:ld_wcnze ,:ld_xnhze,:ld_qtjjze
		From JKXT.YB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :ldt_begin And JSSJ < :ldt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And JSJYLSH Is Not Null And CBDXZHQ <> :is_cbdxzhq;
	//增加了BBRQ对jmjjzfs和lmjjzfs做的修改(原先jmjjzfs和lmjjzfs插入时互换了)
	SELECT SUM(NVL(LMJJZFS,0)),SUM(NVL(JMJJZFS,0))

IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0

IF IsNull(ld_xjzf) THEN ld_xjzf = 0

IF IsNull(ld_bzze) THEN ld_bzze = 0

IF IsNull(ld_lxze) THEN ld_lxze = 0
IF IsNull(ld_eyze) THEN ld_eyze = 0
IF IsNull(ld_lmze1) THEN ld_lmze1 = 0
IF IsNull(ld_jmze1) THEN ld_jmze1 = 0
IF IsNull(ld_lmze2) THEN ld_lmze2 = 0
IF IsNull(ld_jmze2) THEN ld_jmze2 = 0
IF IsNull(ld_dxsze) THEN ld_dxsze = 0
IF IsNull(ld_wcnze)  THEN ld_wcnze = 0
IF IsNull(ld_xnhze) THEN ld_xnhze = 0
IF IsNull(ld_qtjjze) THEN ld_qtjjze = 0

dw_1.Object.jybs[1] = ll_jybs
dw_1.Object.YLFYZE[1] = ld_ylfyze
dw_1.Object.fy_zfze[1] = ld_zfze
dw_1.Object.fy_zlze[1] = ld_zlze

public subroutine wf_delrep (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end);u_datastore luds_del
luds_del = Create u_datastore
luds_del.DataObject = 'd_jsjylsh_del'
luds_del.SetTransObject(SQLCA)
luds_del.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end)

Long ll_rowcount,ll_zyh,ll_cur
String ls_brbm,ls_jsjylsh,ls_mxzdh
ll_rowcount = luds_del.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[1]
	ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[1]
	ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[1]
	ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.mxzdh[1]
	
	FOR ll_cur = 2 To ll_rowcount
		IF ll_zyh = 0 THEN
			IF ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur] THEN
				luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur]
				ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.mxzdh[ll_cur]
				ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur] THEN
				luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur]
				ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.mxzdh[ll_cur]
				ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF

gf_begin_transaction(SQLCA)
IF luds_del.Update( ) = 1 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(SQLCA)
//	MessageBox('提示','保存成功!')
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(SQLCA)
	MessageBox('提示','del失败')
END IF


end subroutine

public function integer wf_ztcx (ref string as_error, ref boolean ab_tkjy);Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_error = 0
String ls_cbdxzhq,ls_jyzt,ls_jsjylsh,ls_knsj,ls_brbm,ls_error
Dec{2} ld_ylfyze
DateTime ldt_jssj
str_yb_jsxx lstr_yb_jsxx
ll_count = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount()
as_error = ''
ab_tkjy = false
FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
	//判断改帐申请号和结算交易流水号是否为空
	ls_cbdxzhq = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.cbdxzhq[ll_cur]
	ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur]
	ld_ylfyze = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfyze[ll_cur]
	ldt_jssj = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jssj[ll_cur]
	ls_brbm = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init('S022')
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('交易类型','G001')
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('待查询的序号',ls_jsjylsh)
	IF Pos(',330399,330381,330382,330324,330326,330322,330329,330327,330328,',',' + ls_cbdxzhq + ',' ) > 0 THEN CONTINUE
	//交易类型为Y002、Y012、Y023、F002时为请求结算时返回的明细帐单号，交易类型为G001时为原结算交易流水号，交易类型为Y003时为住院编号
	IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_send(ls_cbdxzhq,ls_error) = True THEN
		ls_jyzt = String(gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring('交易状态'))
		IF ls_jyzt = '1' Or ls_jyzt = '01' THEN
			SELECT jzkh Into :ls_knsj From mz_brda Where brbm = :ls_brbm;
			IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_zhcx( ls_knsj, ls_error) < 0 THEN
				ll_error ++
				as_error = as_error + "查询病人账户失败：" + ls_error
				CONTINUE
			END IF
			IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_ybjk_new.uf_tkqr( ls_knsj, ls_jsjylsh,ld_ylfyze, gstr_jqxx.as_jqm, ldt_jssj, lstr_yb_jsxx, ls_error ) < 0 THEN
				ll_error ++
				as_error = as_error + '退交易失败：' + ls_error
				CONTINUE
			ELSE
				ab_tkjy = true
				IF String(lstr_yb_jsxx.tfrq,'yyyymmdd') = String(ldt_jssj,'yyyymmdd') THEN
					MessageBox('提示',ls_jsjylsh +  '该交易省异地有退款,请联系社保局重新生成今日异地对账明细，退款发生时间:'+String(lstr_yb_jsxx.tfrq) )
				ELSE
					MessageBox('提示',ls_jsjylsh +  '省异地有退款,退款发生时间:'+String(lstr_yb_jsxx.tfrq) )
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			CONTINUE
		END IF
	ELSE
		ll_error ++
		as_error = as_error + "查询状态失败：" + ls_error
	END IF
NEXT
IF ll_error > 0 THEN RETURN -1
RETURN 1






end function

blocks.text:
event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;String ls_dzr,ls_mess,ls_yf
Integer li_ywlx
Long ll_rowcount,ll_count
//ll_find,ll_count1,ll_count2,ll_count3,ll_count4,
//Dec {2}  ld_dnzhzfze,ld_lnzhzfze,ld_ybzfxjzfze,ld_tczfze,ld_gbzfze,ld_jzzfze,ld_zyjjzfze,ld_zje,ld_jmybjjzfze
//Dec {2} ld_mztotal,ld_zytotal,ld_total_mzghmx,ld_total_mzypmx,ld_total_mzzlmx,ld_total_zyypmx,ld_total_zyzlmx
//Dec {2} ld_sddnzhzfze,ld_sdlnzhzfze,ld_sdybzfxjzfze,ld_sdtczfze,ld_sdgbzfze,ld_sdjzzfze,ld_sdzyjjzfze,ld_sdjmybjjzfze
//Dec {2} ld_sdmztotal,ld_zzlje

//IF em_1.getdate( ) >= Date(gf_server_date()) THEN
//	MessageBox('提示','不能对当日及其之后的时间进行统计!')
//	RETURN
//END IF
idt_begin = em_1.getdatetime(1)
idt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(em_1.getdate(),1),Time(00:00:00))

//获取统计月份
ls_yf = String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymm')
ls_dzr = String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')
//如果对账日没有变化则不reset对账明细
IF is_dzr <> ls_dzr  THEN
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Reset()
END IF
is_dzr = ls_dzr
li_ywlx = Integer(ddlb_ywlx.getcode( ))
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Reset()
//显示交易明细
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetSort("jssj asc")
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Sort()
//根据异地本地做过滤处理
IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("cbdxzhq = '"+is_cbdxzhq+"' or isnull(cbdxzhq)")
	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter( )
ELSE
	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("cbdxzhq <> '"+is_cbdxzhq+"'")
	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter( )
END IF
IF tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount( ) <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','该天没有社保交易明细!')
END IF
//有社保明细再进行判断计算reset()
dw_1.Reset()
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Reset()
tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Reset()
//显示本月对账信息
tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(ls_yf)
//对对账结果进行判断，有记录则不再判断，无记录则对社保交易明细与fpk等是否保持一致
ll_rowcount = dw_1.Retrieve( is_dzr,li_ywlx)
IF ll_rowcount > 0  THEN
	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
	
IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
		tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.SetFilter("cbdxzhq = '"+is_cbdxzhq+"' or isnull(cbdxzhq)")
		tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Filter( )
	ELSE
		tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.SetFilter("cbdxzhq <> '"+is_cbdxzhq+"'")
		tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Filter( )
	END IF
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	IF dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] <> 0 THEN
		RETURN
	ELSEIF base_info.qxjb < 2 THEN
		RETURN
	END IF
ELSE
	IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
		dw_1.InsertRow(1)
		dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = li_ywlx
		dw_1.Object.dzr[1] = is_dzr
		IF wf_dzyz() < 0 THEN
			RETURN
		END IF
	ELSEIF li_ywlx =  2 THEN
		SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.YB_DZXX   Where YB_DZXX.dzr = :is_dzr And YB_DZXX.ywlx = 1 ;
		IF ll_count > 0 THEN
			dw_1.InsertRow(1)
			dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = li_ywlx
			dw_1.Object.dzr[1] = is_dzr
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.SetFilter("cbdxzhq <> '"+is_cbdxzhq+"'")
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Filter( )
		ELSE
			MessageBox('提示','请先本地对账!')
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
//IF wf_dzyz() < 0 THEN
//	is_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]
//	RETURN
//END IF
//获取对应的总额值,进行中心对账
wf_getdzxx(idt_begin,li_ywlx)
//保存
gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
	dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr,li_ywlx)
	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
	gf_waiting('汇总数据出错，请重试......',-1)
	dw_1.Reset( )
	dw_1.InsertRow(1)
	MessageBox('提示','汇总数据出错，请重试!')
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN
END IF
gf_waiting('统计数据完成......',-1)


end event

blocks.text:
event doubleclicked;call super::doubleclicked;String ls_brbm, ls_jyjk, ls_ywlx, ls_brxm, ls_kxx, ls_jsjylsh, ls_jysj, ls_ylfyze,ls_klb
Long ll_zyh,ll_count
DateTime ldt_jysj
Decimal{2} ldc_ylfyze

DateTime ldt_begin, ldt_end
ldt_begin = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(idt_begin), -1), Time("00:00:00"))
ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(idt_end), 1), Time("00:00:00"))

s_exchange ls_exchange

u_datastore lds_brxx
lds_brxx = Create u_datastore
String ls_sql

IF row > 0 THEN
	il_select = row
	This.SelectRow( 0, False )
	This.SelectRow( il_select, True )
	
	ls_brxm = Trim(This.Object.xm[il_select])
	ls_kxx = Trim(Upper(This.Object.kxx[il_select]))
	ls_klb = Trim(This.Object.klb[il_select])
	ls_ylfyze = This.Object.ylfyze[il_select]
	ldc_ylfyze = Round(Double(ls_ylfyze),2)
	ls_jyjk = Trim(Upper(This.Object.jylx[il_select]))
	ll_count = 0
	if ls_jyjk ='Y023' OR ls_jyjk = 'G001' THEN
		ls_sql = "Select zyh From bqxt.zy_brry Where instr(knxx,'" + ls_kxx + "') > 0 And brxm = '" + ls_brxm + "' " +&
			"And Exists( Select * From jkxt.yb_jsmx b Where zy_brry.zyh = b.zyh " +&
			"And b.jssj >= " + gf_dtinsql(ldt_begin) + " And b.jssj < " + gf_dtinsql(ldt_end) + ")"
		IF lds_brxx.createfromsql( ls_sql ) < 0 THEN
			MessageBox("提示", "创建'住院病人信息'对象失败。")
			RETURN
		END IF
		lds_brxx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		ll_count = lds_brxx.Retrieve( )
	END IF
	IF ll_count <= 0  AND ls_jyjk ='Y023' THEN
		MessageBox("提示", "创建'住院病人信息'失败。")
		RETURN
	END IF
	IF ll_count <= 0 THEN
		IF ls_klb = '16' THEN
			ls_sql = "Select brbm From mzxt.mz_brda Where brxm = '" + ls_brxm + "' And ztbz = 0 and brbm like 'SB%' " +&
				"And Exists ( Select BRBM From jkxt.yb_jsmx b Where mz_brda.brbm = b.brbm " +&
				"And b.jssj >= " + gf_dtinsql(ldt_begin) + " And b.jssj < " + gf_dtinsql(ldt_end) +&
				" AND YLFYZE = "+string(ldc_ylfyze)+")"
		ELSE
			ls_sql = "Select brbm From mzxt.mz_brda Where (instr(jzkh,'" + ls_kxx + "') > 0 or length(jzkh) < 30) And brxm = '" + ls_brxm + "' And ztbz = 0 and brbm like 'SB%' " +&
				"And Exists( Select * From jkxt.yb_jsmx b Where mz_brda.brbm = b.brbm " +&
				"And b.jssj >= " + gf_dtinsql(ldt_begin) + " And b.jssj < " + gf_dtinsql(ldt_end) + ")"
		END IF
		IF lds_brxx.createfromsql( ls_sql ) < 0 THEN
			MessageBox("提示", "创建'门诊病人信息'对象失败。")
			RETURN
		END IF
		lds_brxx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		IF lds_brxx.Retrieve( ) <= 0 THEN
			MessageBox("提示", "该病人信息查询失败。")
			RETURN
		ELSE
			ls_brbm = lds_brxx.Object.brbm[1]
			IF ls_jyjk = 'Y002' THEN
				ii_bplx = 8
			ELSEIF ls_jyjk = 'Y012' THEN
				ii_bplx = 7
			ELSE
				SELECT ywlx Into :ls_ywlx From jkxt.yb_jsmx Where brbm = :ls_brbm And jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And ylfyze = :ldc_ylfyze;
				IF ls_ywlx = "" Or ls_ywlx = "SF" THEN
					ii_bplx = 7
				ELSEIF ls_ywlx = "GH" THEN
					ii_bplx = 8
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSE
		ll_zyh = lds_brxx.Object.zyh[1]
		ii_bplx = 9
	END IF
	
	ls_jsjylsh = Trim(This.Object.jsjylsh[il_select])
	
	ls_jysj = Trim(This.Object.jysj[il_select])
	ls_jysj = Mid(ls_jysj,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_jysj,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_jysj,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_jysj,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_jysj,13,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_jysj,16,2)
	ldt_jysj = DateTime(Date(Left(ls_jysj,10)), Time(Right(ls_jysj,8)))
	
	ls_exchange.LongParm[1] = ii_bplx
	ls_exchange.LongParm[2] = ll_zyh
	ls_exchange.StringParm[1] = ls_brbm
	ls_exchange.StringParm[2] = ls_jsjylsh
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[1] = idt_begin
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[2] = idt_end
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[3] = ldt_jysj
	
	ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'wd'
	OpenWithParm(w_sbdz_bptz, ls_exchange)
END IF

end event
