blocks.name: prototypes
ue_zxdz
blocks.text:
event ue_zxdz();String ls_dzr,ls_return,ls_dzjg
Integer li_ywlx
Long   	ll_jybs
Decimal	ld_ylfyze,ld_zfze,ld_zlze,ld_xjzf,ld_jjzfze,ld_dnzhze,ld_lnzhze,ld_gbze,ld_tcze
Decimal	ld_jzze,	ld_bzze,ld_lxze,ld_eyze,ld_lmze,ld_jmze,ld_dxsze,ld_wcnze ,ld_xnhze,ld_qtjjze
Boolean lb_sbdz
Blob lb_dzxx
//判断是否统计汇总过，汇总日期是否与显示一致
IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
	IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(is_dzr) Or dw_1.RowCount( ) <= 0  THEN
		//	post event ue_ref()
		MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再对账')
		RETURN
	ELSE
		ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]
		IF IsNull(ls_dzr) THEN
			MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再对账')
			RETURN
		ELSE
			IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
				MessageBox('提示','对账时间'+String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')+'与对账信息汇总中的对账日' + ls_dzr+'不一致,请重蠨AT* ')
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	//修改，直接调用刷新函数，判断是否有对账结果
	
	IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN  //增加台州判断 wangyi
		IF IsValid(gu_tzybjk) = False THEN
			gu_tzybjk = Create u_tzybjk_his
			IF Not gu_tzybjk.uf_init( ls_return) THEN
				MessageBox('提示','台州医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF IsValid(gu_pyybjk) = False THEN
			gu_pyybjk = Create u_pyybjk_his
			IF Not gu_pyybjk.uf_init( ls_return) THEN
				MessageBox('提示','平阳医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	//------------------------
	li_ywlx = dw_1.Object.ywlx[1]
	IF li_ywlx = 2 THEN
		IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN  //增加台州判断 wangyi
			IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_yljg_rdz( Date(idt_begin),'2', ls_return) < 0 THEN
				MessageBox('提示',ls_return)
			END IF
			dw_1.Retrieve( ls_dzr )
			RETURN
		END IF
		ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]
		ll_jybs = dw_1.Object.jybs[1]
		ld_ylfyze = dw_1.Object.ylfyze[1]
		ld_zfze = dw_1.Object.fy_zfze[1]
		ld_zlze = dw_1.Object.fy_zlze[1]
		ld_xjzf = dw_1.Object.xjzf[1]
		ld_jjzfze = dw_1.Object.jjzfze[1]
		ld_dnzhze = dw_1.Object.dnzhze[1]
		ld_lnzhze = dw_1.Object.lnzhze[1]
		ld_gbze = dw_1.Object.gbze[1]
		ld_tcze = dw_1.Object.tcze[1]
		ld_jzze = dw_1.Object.jzze[1]
		ld_bzze = dw_1.Object.bzze[1]
		ld_lxze = dw_1.Object.lxze[1]
		ld_eyze = dw_1.Object.eyze[1]
		ld_lmze = dw_1.Object.lmze[1]
		ld_jmze = dw_1.Object.jmze[1]
		ld_dxsze = dw_1.Object.dxsze[1]
		ld_wcnze = dw_1.Object.wcnze[1]
		ld_xnhze = dw_1.Object.xnhze[1]
		ld_qtjjze = dw_1.Object.qtjjze[1]
		//lb_dzxx
		lb_sbdz = gu_pyybjk.uf_sb_dzcl( li_ywlx, ls_dzr, ll_jybs, ld_ylfyze,ld_zfze,ld_zlze,ld_xjzf,ld_jjzfze, ld_dnzhze,ld_lnzhze, ld_gbze,ld_tcze,ld_jzze,	ld_bzze,ld_lxze,ld_eyze, ld_lmze,ld_jmze,ld_dxsze,ld_wcnze , ld_xnhze,ld_qtjjze,lb_dzxx,ls_dzjg,ls_return)
		//	lb_sbdz = gu_ybjk_new.uf_sb_dzcl( li_ywlx, ls_dzr, ll_jybs, ld_ylfyze,ld_zfze,ld_zlze,ld_xjzf,ld_jjzfze, ld_dnzhze,ld_lnzhze, ld_gbze,ld_tcze,ld_jzze,	ld_bzze,ld_lxze,ld_eyze, ld_lmze,ld_jmze,ld_dxsze,ld_wcnze , ld_xnhze,ld_qtjjze,ls_return)
		IF lb_sbdz THEN
			ls_dzjg = ls_return
			dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = Integer(ls_dzjg)
			gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
			IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
				gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
				dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr,li_ywlx)
				tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
				MessageBox("提示","对账结果："+ ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(dzjg)', 1)")) )
			ELSE
				gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
				MessageBox('提示',ls_dzr + '社保对账结果：' + ls_dzjg +",保存失败!")
			END IF
		ELSE
			MessageBox('社保对账',ls_return)
		END IF
	ELSE
		Long ll_rv
		ll_rv = dw_1.GetFullState(lb_dzxx)
		IF ll_rv = -1 THEN
			MessageBox("提示", "SetFullState failed!")
		ELSE
			ls_dzr = dw_1.object.dzr[1]
			IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN  //增加台州判断 wangyi
				// 2021.07.20  CJN  25177  市本地对账
				IF gu_ybjk_public.ii_tzsybxjkqy=1 Then
					IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_yljg_rdz( Date(idt_begin),'2', ls_return) < 0 THEN
						MessageBox('提示',ls_return)
					END IF
					dw_1.Retrieve( ls_dzr )
					RETURN
				ELSE
					lb_sbdz = gu_tzybjk.uf_sb_dzcl( li_ywlx, ls_dzr, ll_jybs,'20', ld_ylfyze,ld_zfze,ld_zlze,ld_xjzf,ld_jjzfze, ld_dnzhze,ld_lnzhze, ld_gbze,ld_tcze,ld_jzze,	ld_bzze,ld_lxze,ld_eyze, ld_lmze,ld_jmze,ld_dxsze,ld_wcnze , ld_xnhze,ld_qtjjze,lb_dzxx,ls_dzjg,ls_return)
				END IF
			ELSE
				lb_sbdz = gu_pyybjk.uf_sb_dzcl( li_ywlx, ls_dzr, ll_jybs, ld_ylfyze,ld_zfze,ld_zlze,ld_xjzf,ld_jjzfze, ld_dnzhze,ld_lnzhze, ld_gbze,ld_tcze,ld_jzze,	ld_bzze,ld_lxze,ld_eyze, ld_lmze,ld_jmze,ld_dxsze,ld_wcnze , ld_xnhze,ld_qtjjze,lb_dzxx,ls_dzjg,ls_return)	
			END IF
			IF lb_sbdz THEN
//				ls_dzjg = ls_return
				dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = Integer(ls_dzjg)
				dw_1.Object.dzjg[2] = Integer(ls_dzjg)
				IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN  //台州对账要对两种(职工、城乡) wangyi 20190107
					lb_sbdz = gu_tzybjk.uf_sb_dzcl( li_ywlx, ls_dzr, ll_jybs,'17', ld_ylfyze,ld_zfze,ld_zlze,ld_xjzf,ld_jjzfze, ld_dnzhze,ld_lnzhze, ld_gbze,ld_tcze,ld_jzze,	ld_bzze,ld_lxze,ld_eyze, ld_lmze,ld_jmze,ld_dxsze,ld_wcnze , ld_xnhze,ld_qtjjze,lb_dzxx,ls_dzjg,ls_return)
					IF lb_sbdz THEN
						dw_1.Object.dzjg[3] = Integer(ls_dzjg)
						dw_1.Object.dzjg[4] = Integer(ls_dzjg)
					ELSE
						MessageBox('社保对账',ls_return)
						RETURN
					END IF
				END IF
				gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
				IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
					gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
					dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr,li_ywlx)
					tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
					MessageBox("提示","对账结果："+ ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(dzjg)', 1)")) )
				ELSE
					gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
					MessageBox('提示',ls_dzr + '社保对账结果：' + ls_dzjg +",保存失败!")
				END IF
			ELSE
				MessageBox('社保对账',ls_return)
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
END IF


end event

event ue_gzsq();
if is_yybz='TZFBY' THEN
	wf_gzcl_tz()
	RETURN
END IF
String ls_dzr,ls_return,ls_count,ls_cbd,ls_jsjylsh,ls_gzsqh,ls_knxx,ls_brbm
Integer li_ywlx,li_dzjg,li_ret
Long ll_find,ll_count,ll_cur
Dec{2} ld_ylfyze
DateTime ldt_gzrq,ldt_jssj
Dec{0} ld_jllsh,ld_zyh
Boolean lb_skzt
IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(is_dzr) Or dw_1.RowCount( ) <= 0 Or IsNull(dw_1.Object.dzr[1]) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计')
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]
	li_ywlx = dw_1.Object.ywlx[1]
	li_dzjg = dw_1.Object.dzjg[1]
	IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','对账时间'+String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')+'与对账信息汇总中的对账日' + ls_dzr+'不一致,请重新统计汇总')
		RETURN
	ELSEIF IsNull(li_dzjg) THEN
		MessageBox('提示',"该日" + ls_dzr + "还未与中心对账，请先对账!")
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
//IF IsValid(gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new) = False THEN
//	gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new = Create u_ybjk_new_his
//	IF gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_init( ls_return) = False THEN
//		MessageBox("提示",'gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new' + ls_return)
//		RETURN
//	END IF
//END IF
IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
	IF IsValid(gu_pyybjk) = False THEN
		gu_pyybjk = Create u_pyybjk_his
		IF gu_pyybjk.uf_init(ls_return) = False THEN
			MessageBox('py社保出错:',ls_return)
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

ll_count = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount()
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
		gu_pyybjk.ib_yd = False
		IF ii_gzqy = 0 THEN
			str_pyyb_jsxx lstr_pyyb_jsxx
			String ls_cardno,ls_cardid,ls_initorgno,ls_oldbrbm
			Dec{0} ld_oldzyh
			FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
				ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.qrjylsh[ll_cur]
				ld_ylfyze = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_cur]
				ldt_jssj = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jssj[ll_cur]
				ld_zyh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				ls_brbm = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				IF ls_brbm <> ls_oldbrbm or ld_oldzyh <> ld_zyh THEN
					ls_return = ''
					lb_skzt = iu_sbiccreader.uf_sbreadcard( ls_cardno,ls_cardid,ls_initorgno,ls_return)
					IF lb_skzt THEN
						ls_knxx = ls_cardid + ls_cardno
					ELSE
						MessageBox('提示','获取病人卡号失败:' + ls_return)
						CONTINUE
					END IF
					IF gu_pyybjk.uf_zhcx( ls_knxx, ls_return) < 0 THEN
						MessageBox('提示','获取病人医保账户失败:' + ls_return)
						CONTINUE
					END IF
				END IF
				IF gu_pyybjk.uf_mz_gzcl( ls_knxx,ls_jsjylsh, base_info.username, 'GZCL',ldt_jssj, lstr_pyyb_jsxx, ls_return) < 0 THEN
					MessageBox('提示',ls_jsjylsh + ':'+ls_return)
					CONTINUE
				END IF
				ls_oldbrbm = ls_brbm
				ld_oldzyh = ld_zyh
			NEXT
		ELSE
			FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
				ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.qrjylsh[ll_cur]
				ld_ylfyze = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_cur]
				ld_jllsh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jllsh[ll_cur]
				gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('87')
				gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
				gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
				gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
				gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
				gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('要作废的结算交易流水号',ls_jsjylsh)
				gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('医疗费用总额',ld_ylfyze)
				gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add( '经办人', base_info.username)
				
				IF gu_pyybjk.uf_send( ls_return) = False THEN
					MessageBox('提示',ls_jsjylsh + ':'+ls_return)
					CONTINUE
				ELSE
					IF gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
						ls_return = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring('错误信息')
						MessageBox('提示',ls_jsjylsh + '该笔改帐失败:' + ls_return)
						CONTINUE
					END IF
					li_ret = Integer(gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring('是否为重复改帐')) //6	是否为重复改帐	int	1	否		0正常改帐，1结算单在医保接口已经被退费过
					IF li_ret = 1 THEN
						MessageBox('提示',ls_jsjylsh + "结算单在医保接口已经被退费过")
						CONTINUE
					END IF
					ls_gzsqh = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring("改帐交易流水号") //7	改帐交易流水号	string	20	否	
					ldt_gzrq = gu_pyybjk.uf_getdatetime( "改帐交易结算日期") //8	改帐交易结算日期	datetime	20	否		yyyyMMdd hh24miss、
					tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.gzsqh[ll_cur] = ls_gzsqh
					tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.gzrq[ll_cur] = ldt_gzrq
					
					UPDATE JKXT.PYYB_JSMX Set gzsqh = :ls_gzsqh,gzrq = :ldt_gzrq,ztbz = -2 Where jllsh = :ld_jllsh;
					IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And sqlca.SQLNRows = 1 THEN
						COMMIT;
					ELSE
						ROLLBACK;
					END IF
				END IF
			NEXT
		END IF
		MessageBox('提示','改帐完成!')
	ELSEIF li_ywlx = 2 THEN
		li_ret = wf_gzcx(ls_dzr,li_ywlx,ls_return)
		IF li_ret = 2 Or li_ret = 9 THEN
			ls_count = Right('000000'+String(ll_count),6)
			gu_pyybjk.ib_yd = True
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('YDJY')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
			//异地接口
			gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_init_py( "S002")
			gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add( "业务类型", li_ywlx)
			gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add( "交易日期", ls_dzr)
			gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add( "改账流水循环体条数", ls_count)
			//		gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add( "改账流水循环体", ll_count)
			FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
				//判断改帐申请号和结算交易流水号是否为空
				ls_cbd = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.cbdxzhq[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur]
				ld_ylfyze = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfyze[ll_cur]
				gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add_in( "参保地行政区划代码",ls_cbd,ll_cur)
				gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add_in( "结算交易流水号",ls_jsjylsh,ll_cur)
				gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add_in( "医疗费用总额", ld_ylfyze,ll_cur)
			NEXT
			IF gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send( ls_return) = False THEN
				MessageBox("提示","改帐出错" +ls_return )
			ELSE
				ls_gzsqh = gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring("改账申请号")
				FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
					tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.gzsqh[ll_cur] = ls_gzsqh
				NEXT
				ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Find( "dzr = '"+ls_dzr+"' and ywlx = " + String(li_ywlx) , 1, tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.RowCount())
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.gzjg[ll_find] = '-1'
					tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.gzsqh[ll_find] = ls_gzsqh
				END IF
				gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
				IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Update( ) = 1 And tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Update( ) = 1 THEN
					gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
					MessageBox('提示','改帐申请成功!' + ls_gzsqh)
				ELSE
					gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
					MessageBox('提示','保存改帐信息错误!')
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			MessageBox('提示','已经申请改帐,结果：'+ls_return)
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

end event

blocks.text:
public function long wf_auto_jdmz (datetime ld_start, datetime ld_end);datastore ds_sb_fpk,ds_sb_jymx
long ll_fpk_count,ll_jymx_count , i  , ll_find,ll_return ,ll_fplsh_count
string ls_zxlsh,ls_bz,ls_txt,ls_fplsh
dec {0} ll_lsh

ll_return=0

ds_sb_fpk=create datastore 
ds_sb_jymx=create datastore 

ds_sb_fpk.dataobject='d_sb_autodz_fpk'
ds_sb_jymx.dataobject='d_sb_autodz_jymx'

ds_sb_fpk.settransobject(sqlca)
ds_sb_jymx.settransobject(sqlca)


ds_sb_fpk.retrieve(ld_start,ld_end)
ds_sb_jymx.retrieve(ld_start,ld_end)

ll_fpk_count=ds_sb_fpk.rowcount()
ll_jymx_count=ds_sb_jymx.rowcount()
    
	
for i=1 to  ll_fpk_count
	 ls_zxlsh = ds_sb_fpk.object.zxlsh[i]
	 if isnull(ls_zxlsh) then ls_zxlsh=''
	 ll_find=ds_sb_jymx.FIND( "zxlsh='"+ls_zxlsh+"'", 1,  ll_jymx_count  )
	 if isnull(ll_find) then ll_find=0
    if ll_find>0 then 
		  ds_sb_jymx.object.bz[ll_find]='1'
	 else
		  if trim(ls_zxlsh)<='' or isnull(ls_zxlsh) then continue;
         messagebox('提示','zxlsh='+ls_zxlsh+'   需内部调帐' + string(ds_sb_fpk.object.grbm[i]))
			return 100;
	 end if
next

ls_txt=''
for i=1 to  ll_jymx_count
	 ls_bz= ds_sb_jymx.object.bz[i]
	 ll_lsh= ds_sb_jymx.object.lsh[i]
	 ls_fplsh= ds_sb_jymx.object.fplsh[i]
	 
 	 ls_zxlsh= ds_sb_jymx.object.zxlsh[i]
	 if isnull(ls_fplsh) then ls_fplsh=''
    if isnull(ls_bz) or trim(ls_bz)<='' then ls_bz=''
	 if ls_bz='0' then 
		 ll_fplsh_count=0
		 select count(*)  into :ll_fplsh_count from sb_jymx where fplsh=:ls_fplsh  and fplsh is not null;
		 if isnull(ll_fplsh_count) then ll_fplsh_count=0
		 if ll_fplsh_count>=2 then continue;
		 ls_txt=ls_txt+'  '+ls_zxlsh
	 else
		  continue;
	 end if
	 if trim(ls_zxlsh)<='' or isnull(ls_zxlsh) then continue;
	 
	 gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	 insert into sb_jymx_gzxx select * from sb_jymx where zxlsh=:ls_zxlsh   and lsh=:ll_lsh; 
	 if sqlca.sqlcode=0 then 
		 delete from sb_jymx where zxlsh=:ls_zxlsh   and lsh=:ll_lsh; 
		 if sqlca.sqlcode=0 then 
			  gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		else
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			ll_return=101
			exit
		end if
	 else
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			ll_return=101
			exit
	 end if
next

if ls_txt<>'' then 
	messagebox('提示','门诊需改帐的流水号有：'+ls_txt)
end if	

destroy ds_sb_fpk;
destroy ds_sb_jymx;


return ll_return



end function

blocks.text:
public function integer wf_dzyz ();//
//u_datastore lds_bpmx
//lds_bpmx = create u_datastore

String ls_bpmx
Long ll_rowcount, ll_temp

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',1)
wf_delrep('1',idt_begin,idt_end)
wf_delrep('2',idt_begin,idt_end)

//判断预存是否有过正确结转
//=======================核对==============================//
Dec{2} ld_kyc, ld_yck_fp,ldc_yck_gh
Long ll_count,ll_count1

ld_kyc = 0
SELECT SUM(JYJE) INTO :ld_kyc FROM H_MZ_ZHJYMX
	Where JYSJ >= :idt_begin And JYSJ < :idt_end And JYLB In (11,12) ;
//And Upper(JYDD) Not In ('GH','ZZGH');
IF IsNull(ld_kyc) THEN ld_kyc = 0

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',20)

//====预存款－－扣款fpk,zffs
ld_yck_fp = 0
SELECT sum(NVL(H_FP_ZFFS.ZFJE,0)) INTO :ld_yck_fp FROM mz_fpk,H_FP_ZFFS
	WHERE mz_fpk.kpsj >= :idt_begin AND mz_fpk.kpsj < :idt_end
	//And (H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '5' OR H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '7') 
	AND (H_FP_ZFFS.zffs IN (SELECT to_char(dmsb) FROM xtgl.gy_dmzd WHERE dmlb = 34 AND bzbm2 = 1))
	And NVL(mz_fpk.fpzf,0) <> 9  And mz_fpk.fplsh = H_FP_ZFFS.fplsh;
IF IsNull(ld_yck_fp) THEN ld_yck_fp = 0

//挂号非现金支付
ldc_yck_gh = 0.00
SELECT sum(NVL(xjje,0)) INTO :ldc_yck_gh FROM MZ_GHXX
	WHERE GHRQ >= :idt_begin AND GHRQ < :idt_end
	AND ZFFS IN (SELECT to_char(dmsb) FROM xtgl.gy_dmzd WHERE dmlb = 34 AND bzbm2 = 1)
	And NVL(THBZ,'0') In ('0','s','t','r');
IF IsNull(ldc_yck_gh) THEN ldc_yck_gh = 0
gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',40)

IF Abs(ld_kyc+ld_yck_fp + ldc_yck_gh) > 1 THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_yc'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('预存发票未正确结转......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "预存发票未正确结转"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 1 //预存不平
		
		dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN -1
		//		for ll_temp = 1 to ll_rowcount
		//			ls_bpmx = ls_bpmx + lds_bpmx.object.#1[ll_temp] + " " + string(lds_bpmx.object.#2[ll_temp]) +&
		//			" " + string(lds_bpmx.object.#3[ll_temp]) + " " + string(lds_bpmx.object.#4[ll_temp]) + "~n"
		//		next
	END IF
	
	gf_waiting('预存发票未正确结转......',-1)
	//	MessageBox('提示','预存发票未正确结转，暂时不能统计汇总' + String(ld_kyc+ld_yck_fp + ldc_yck_gh) + '~n' )
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//----验证基金支付总额是否和分基金支付总和一致------- //
IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN //台州市异地表tzyb_jsmx_syd add by wangyi 20190416
	SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_count FROM jkxt.tzyb_jsmx_syd
		WHERE hjbxje <> (tcjjzf + wnzhzf + dnzhzf + dbjzzf + gwybzzf + eyjjzf + lxjjzf + lmjjzf + mzbzjj + qtzhzf + yl1 + yl2 + yl3 + yl4 + yl5)
		And jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And jslsh Is Not Null And ZTBZ > 0 ;
		
	//	SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :ll_count1 FROM jkxt.pyyb_jsmx  
	//	WHERE HJBXJE <> (LNZHZF + DNZHZF + TCJJZF + DBBZZF + GWYBZZF + LXJJZF  + EYJJZF + LMYLBZZF + JMJJZF + DXSJJZF + WCNRJJZF + XNHJJZF + QTZFS1 + QTZFS2 + QTZFS3 + BZJJZF)
	//		And jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And qrjylsh Is Not Null And ZTBZ > 0 ;
	SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_count1 FROM jkxt.tzyb_jsmx_sbd
		WHERE HJBXJE <> (tcjjzf + wnzhzf + dnzhzf + dbjzzf + gwybzzf + eyjjzf + lxjjzf + lmjjzf + yljzjj + syjjzf+yfbz+sbjjzf)
		And jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And jylsh Is Not Null And ZTBZ > 0 ;
ELSE
	SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_count FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
		WHERE jjzfze <> (tczfs + jzzfs + grdnzhzfs + grlnzhzfs + gbjjzfs + bzjjzfs +lxjjzfs + eyjjzfs + lmjjzfs + jmjjzfs + dxsjjzfs + wcnrjjzfs + xnhjjzfs + qtjjzfs + qtzfs1 + qtzfs2 + qtzfs3)
		And jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And jsjylsh Is Not Null And ZTBZ > 0 ;
		
	SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_count1 FROM jkxt.pyyb_jsmx
		WHERE HJBXJE <> (LNZHZF + DNZHZF + TCJJZF + DBBZZF + GWYBZZF + LXJJZF  + EYJJZF + LMYLBZZF + JMJJZF + DXSJJZF + WCNRJJZF + XNHJJZF + QTJJZF + QTZFS1 + QTZFS2 + QTZFS3 + BZJJZF)
		And jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And qrjylsh Is Not Null And ZTBZ > 0 ;
END IF


IF ll_count + ll_count1 > 0 THEN
	if is_yybz ='TZFBY' AND Date(idt_begin) >= Date(2021,8,9) THEN 
		dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jjzf_tz'
	else
		dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jjzf'
	end if
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	gf_waiting('基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致......',-1)
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		dw_bpmx.Title = "基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 3 //基金支付不平
	END IF
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	//	MessageBox('提示,不能对帐,请与计算中心联系','有' + String(ll_count) + "条记录，验证基金支付总额是否和分基金支付总和一致")
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//平阳医保分和总的验证 //

//------验证门诊数据一致性----社保门诊发票记帐金禗AT*
-------- //
Dec {2} ld_sbjzje, ld_mzjz, ld_sbzje, ld_jzce, ld_fpzje, ld_ylfyze, ld_jzzfce
Dec{2} ldc_syd_jz = 0,ldc_syd_zje = 0
//发票库
SELECT sum(jzje),sum(xmzje) INTO :ld_sbjzje, :ld_fpzje FROM mz_fpk
	WHERE kpsj >= :idt_begin AND kpsj < :idt_end AND NVL(fpzf,0) <> 9
	And jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ld_sbjzje) THEN ld_sbjzje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_fpzje) THEN ld_fpzje = 0
//
//SELECT sum(NVL(jzce,0)), sum(jzce + zfce) INTO :ld_jzce, :ld_jzzfce FROM sb_jejd
//	Where kpsj >= :idt_begin And kpsj < :idt_end And XMLB = 0;
IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
IF IsNull(ld_jzzfce) THEN ld_jzzfce = 0

ld_sbjzje = ld_sbjzje + ld_jzce
ld_fpzje = ld_fpzje + ld_jzzfce

//医保结算
IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN //台州市异地表tzyb_jsmx_syd add by wangyi 20190416
	SELECT sum(nvl(hjbxje,0)),sum(nvl(fyze,0)) INTO :ld_mzjz, :ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.tzyb_jsmx_syd
		WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
		And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 ;
ELSE
	SELECT sum(nvl(jjzfze,0)),sum(nvl(ylfyze,0)) INTO :ld_mzjz, :ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
		WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
		And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And YWLSH Not Like 'A%';
END IF

IF IsNull(ld_mzjz) THEN ld_mzjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0

Dec{2} ld_pymzjz = 0, ld_pyfyze = 0
IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
//		SELECT sum(nvl(hjbxje,0)),sum(nvl(fyze,0)) INTO :ld_pymzjz, :ld_pyfyze FROM jkxt.pyyb_jsmx
//			Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And jsjylsh Is Not Null 
//			And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And ZTBZ <> 4 And ZTBZ <> 5 and ZTBZ <> 99 and ZTBZ<>98 and ZTBZ<>97;  //20210708zbq增加99;
   if is_yybz ='TZFBY' AND Date(idt_begin) >= Date(2021,8,9) THEN		
		SELECT sum(nvl(hjbxje,0)),sum(nvl(fyze,0)) INTO :ld_pymzjz, :ld_pyfyze  FROM jkxt.tzyb_jsmx_sbd
			WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
			And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 ;
	else
		SELECT sum(nvl(hjbxje,0)),sum(nvl(fyze,0)) INTO :ld_pymzjz, :ld_pyfyze FROM jkxt.tzyb_jsmx_sbd
			WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
			And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 ;
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ld_pymzjz) THEN ld_pymzjz = 0.00
	IF IsNull(ld_pyfyze) THEN ld_pyfyze = 0.00
	ld_mzjz = ld_mzjz + ld_pymzjz
	ld_ylfyze = ld_ylfyze + ld_pyfyze
END IF

IF Date(idt_begin) > Date(2017,6,1) And ii_sydsfqy = 1 THEN
	SELECT SUM(NVL(HJBXJE,0)),sum(nvl(FYZE,0)) INTO :ldc_syd_jz,:ldc_syd_zje FROM jkxt.sydyb_jsmx
		WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND JSLSH Is NOT NULL
		And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(JYID,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;
END IF
gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',60)

IF IsNull(ld_sbjzje) THEN ld_sbjzje = 0
//IF IsNull(ld_sdjzje) THEN ld_sdjzje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_fpzje) THEN ld_fpzje = 0

IF IsNull(ldc_syd_jz) THEN ldc_syd_jz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_syd_zje) THEN ldc_syd_zje = 0

ld_sbzje = ld_mzjz   + ldc_syd_jz
ld_ylfyze = ld_ylfyze + ldc_syd_zje
//ld_zjece = ld_ylfyze - ld_fpzje

IF ld_sbzje <> ld_sbjzje Or ld_ylfyze <> ld_fpzje THEN
	IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN // wangyi 20190424
		if Date(idt_begin) >= Date(2021,8,9) THEN 
			dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_sfjz_tzsbd'
		ELSE
			dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_sfjz_tz'
		END IF
	ELSE
		dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_sfjz_py'
	END IF
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		dw_bpmx.Title = "门诊交褼AT* 资�据不一� "
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 4 //门诊收费不平
		//		for ll_temp = 1 to ll_rowcount
		//			ls_bpmx = ls_bpmx + lds_bpmx.object.#1[ll_temp] + " " + string(lds_bpmx.object.#2[ll_temp]) +&
		//			" " + string(lds_bpmx.object.#3[ll_temp]) + "~n"
		//		next
	END IF
	
	gf_waiting('门诊交易数据不一致......',-1)
	//	MessageBox('提示,不能对帐,请与计算中心联系','门诊交易数据不一致:社保理论交易(yb_jsmx) :总金额' + String(ld_ylfyze) + '，记账金额'+String(ld_sbzje)+'  sb实际发生额 (mz_fpk)：总金额'+String(ld_fpzje)+'，记账金额'+String(ld_sbjzje)+'  差值：'+ String(ld_ylfyze - ld_fpzje)+'----'+String(ld_sbzje - ld_sbjzje) + '~n' + ls_bpmx)
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//挂号记账金额是否一致验证------------------
Dec{2} ld_ghjz,ld_sbghjz,ld_sdghjz,ld_zce,ld_ghzjje,ld_ckblf = 0
SELECT sum(NVL(ZJJE,0) - NVL(XJJE,0)),sum(NVL(ZJJE,0)) INTO :ld_ghjz,:ld_ghzjje FROM mz_ghxx
	WHERE GHRQ >= :idt_begin AND GHRQ < :idt_end AND (nvl(THBZ,0) NOT IN ('i','3'))
	And jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
	
//挂号中总额中减去，磁卡，病历费 
IF gi_pyyq = 1 And Date(idt_begin) > Date(2013,8,15) THEN
	SELECT sum(nvl(ghfy,0)) INTO :ld_ckblf FROM mz_ghxx,mz_ghfyxx
		WHERE mz_ghxx.ghlsh = mz_ghfyxx.ghlsh AND mz_ghxx.GHRQ >= :idt_begin AND mz_ghxx.GHRQ < :idt_end
		AND (nvl(mz_ghxx.THBZ,0) NOT IN ('i','3')) AND mz_ghxx.jslb IN (SELECT brxz FROM gy_brxz WHERE ybpb = 1)
		And (mz_ghfyxx.fyxh = :il_ckf Or mz_ghfyxx.fyxh = :il_blf);
END IF
IF IsNull(ld_ckblf) THEN ld_ckblf = 0
//SELECT sum(jzce), sum(jzce + zfce) INTO :ld_jzce,:ld_zce FROM sb_jejd
//	Where kpsj >= :idt_begin And kpsj < :idt_end And XMLB = 1;
IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
IF IsNull(ld_zce) THEN ld_zce = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ghjz) THEN ld_ghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ghzjje) THEN ld_ghzjje = 0
ld_ghjz = ld_ghjz + ld_jzce
ld_ghzjje = ld_ghzjje + ld_zce

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',80)

IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN //台州市异地表tzyb_jsmx_syd add by wangyi 20190416
	SELECT sum(nvl(hjbxje,0)), sum(nvl(fyze,0)) INTO :ld_sbghjz,:ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.tzyb_jsmx_syd
		WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
		And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 ;
ELSE
	SELECT sum(nvl(jjzfze,0)), sum(nvl(ylfyze,0)) INTO :ld_sbghjz,:ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
		WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
		And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And YWLSH Not Like 'A%';
END IF

IF IsNull(ld_sbghjz) THEN ld_sbghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0

Dec{2} ld_pyghjz = 0 ,ld_pyghze = 0
IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
//		SELECT sum(nvl(hjbxje,0)),sum(nvl(fyze,0)) INTO :ld_pyghjz,:ld_pyghze FROM jkxt.pyyb_jsmx
//			Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And qrjylsh Is Not Null  
//			And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And ZTBZ <> 4 And ZTBZ <> 5 and ZTBZ <> 99 and ZTBZ<>98 and ZTBZ<>97;  //20210708zbq增加99;
	if is_yybz ='TZFBY' AND Date(idt_begin) >= Date(2021,8,9) THEN 
		SELECT sum(nvl(hjbxje,0)), sum(nvl(fyze,0)) INTO :ld_pyghjz,:ld_pyghze FROM jkxt.tzyb_jsmx_sbd
			WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
			And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 ;
	else
		SELECT sum(nvl(hjbxje,0)),sum(nvl(fyze,0)) INTO :ld_pyghjz,:ld_pyghze FROM jkxt.tzyb_jsmx_sbd
			WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
			And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And ZTBZ <> 4 And ZTBZ <> 5 ;
	END IF	
	IF IsNull(ld_pyghjz) THEN ld_pymzjz = 0.00
	IF IsNull(ld_pyghze) THEN ld_pyfyze = 0.00
	ld_sbghjz = ld_sbghjz + ld_pyghjz
	ld_ylfyze = ld_ylfyze + ld_pyghze
END IF
IF Date(idt_begin) > Date(2017,6,1) And ii_sydsfqy = 1 THEN
	SELECT SUM(NVL(HJBXJE,0)),sum(nvl(FYZE,0)) INTO :ldc_syd_jz,:ldc_syd_zje FROM jkxt.sydyb_jsmx
		WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND JSLSH Is NOT NULL
		And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(JYID,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;
	IF IsNull(ldc_syd_jz) THEN ldc_syd_jz = 0
	IF IsNull(ldc_syd_zje) THEN ldc_syd_zje = 0
END IF

IF IsNull(ld_ghzjje) THEN ld_ghzjje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ghjz) THEN ld_ghjz = 0
ld_sbghjz = ld_sbghjz + ldc_syd_jz
ld_ylfyze = ld_ylfyze + ldc_syd_zje
IF ld_ghjz <> ld_sbghjz Or (ld_ghzjje - ld_ckblf) <> ld_ylfyze THEN
	IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN // wangyi 20190424
	   if  Date(idt_begin) >= Date(2021,8,9) THEN 
			dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_gh_tzsbd'
		ELSE
			dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_gh_tz'
		END IF
	ELSE
		dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_gh_py'
	END IF
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		//		gf_waiting('门诊挂号交易数据不一致......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "门诊挂号交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 5 //门诊挂号不平
		//		for ll_temp = 1 to ll_rowcount
		//			ls_bpmx = ls_bpmx + lds_bpmx.object.#1[ll_temp] + " " + string(lds_bpmx.object.#2[ll_temp]) +&
		//			" " + string(lds_bpmx.object.#3[ll_temp]) + "~n"
		//		next
	END IF
	
	gf_waiting('肈AT* 耪锕液沤灰资�据不一� ......',-1)
	//	MessageBox('提示,不能对帐，请与计算中心联系','门诊挂号数据不一致：社保理论交易(yb_jsmx) :总金额' + String(ld_ylfyze) + ',记账金额'+String(ld_sbghjz)+'  门诊实际发生额 (MZ_GHXX)：总金额'+String(ld_ghzjje)+',记账金额'+String(ld_ghjz)+'  差值：'+String(ld_ylfyze - ld_ghzjje ) + '----'+String(ld_sbghjz - ld_ghjz) + '~n' + ls_bpmx)
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//住院病人结算金额是否一致验证----------------------
Dec{2} ldc_zyjz, ldc_zyjzzf, ldc_zyzje, ldc_zyzjezf, ldc_sbzyjz, ldc_sbzyzje

// 2021.12.17  CJN  27897  (EPTZ)住院总金额计算需要剔除不上传费用NVL(BSCJE,0)
SELECT sum(NVL(fyhj,0) - NVL(zfhj,0)), sum(NVL(fyhj,0)-NVL(BSCJE,0)) INTO :ldc_zyjz, :ldc_zyzje FROM zy_zyjs
	WHERE jsrq >= :idt_begin AND jsrq < :idt_end
	And brxz In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ldc_zyjz) THEN ldc_zyjz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zyzje) THEN ldc_zyzje = 0

SELECT sum(NVL(fyhj,0) - NVL(zfhj,0)), sum(NVL(fyhj,0)-NVL(BSCJE,0)) INTO :ldc_zyjzzf, :ldc_zyzjezf FROM zy_zyjs
	WHERE zfrq >= :idt_begin AND zfrq < :idt_end AND zfpb = 1
	And brxz In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ldc_zyjzzf) THEN ldc_zyjzzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zyzjezf) THEN ldc_zyzjezf = 0

ldc_zyjz = ldc_zyjz - ldc_zyjzzf
ldc_zyzje = ldc_zyzje - ldc_zyzjezf

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',90)

IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN //台州市异地表tzyb_jsmx_syd add by wangyi 20190416
//	IF ddlb_ywlx.getcode( ) = '1' THEN
//		SELECT sum(NVL(hjbxje,0)), sum(NVL(fyze,0)) INTO :ldc_sbzyjz, :ldc_sbzyzje FROM jkxt.tzyb_jsmx_sbd
//			WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
//			And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'ZY' And ZTBZ > 0;
//	ELSE
		SELECT sum(NVL(hjbxje,0)), sum(NVL(fyze,0)) INTO :ldc_sbzyjz, :ldc_sbzyzje FROM jkxt.tzyb_jsmx_syd
			WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
			And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'ZY' And ZTBZ > 0;
//	END IF
	
ELSE
	SELECT sum(NVL(jjzfze,0)), sum(NVL(ylfyze,0)) INTO :ldc_sbzyjz, :ldc_sbzyzje FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
		WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
		And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'ZY' And ZTBZ > 0;
END IF

IF IsNull(ldc_sbzyjz) THEN ldc_sbzyjz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_sbzyzje) THEN ldc_sbzyzje = 0

Dec{2} ldc_pysbzyjz = 0 ,ldc_pysbzyze = 0
IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
	if is_yybz ='TZFBY' AND Date(idt_begin) >= Date(2021,8,9) THEN 
		SELECT sum(NVL(hjbxje,0)), sum(NVL(fyze,0)) INTO  :ldc_pysbzyjz, :ldc_pysbzyze FROM jkxt.tzyb_jsmx_sbd
				WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
				And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'ZY' And ZTBZ > 0;
	else
		SELECT sum(nvl(hjbxje,0)),sum(nvl(fyze,0)) INTO :ldc_pysbzyjz, :ldc_pysbzyze FROM jkxt.pyyb_jsmx
			WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND qrjylsh Is NOT NULL
			And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'ZY' And ZTBZ > 0 And ZTBZ <> 4 And ZTBZ <> 5;		
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ldc_pysbzyjz) THEN ldc_pysbzyjz = 0.00
	IF IsNull(ldc_pysbzyze) THEN ldc_pysbzyze = 0.00
	ldc_sbzyjz = ldc_sbzyjz + ldc_pysbzyjz
	ldc_sbzyzje = ldc_sbzyzje + ldc_pysbzyze
END IF

//省异地
ldc_syd_jz = 0
ldc_syd_zje = 0
IF Date(idt_begin) > Date(2017,6,1) And ii_sydsfqy = 1 THEN
	SELECT SUM(NVL(HJBXJE,0)),sum(nvl(FYZE,0)) INTO :ldc_syd_jz,:ldc_syd_zje FROM jkxt.sydyb_jsmx
		WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND JSLSH Is NOT NULL
		And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'ZY' And ZTBZ > 0  ;
END IF
IF IsNull(ldc_syd_zje) THEN ldc_syd_zje = 0

IF ldc_zyzje <> ldc_sbzyzje + ldc_syd_zje THEN	
	if is_yybz ='TZFBY' AND Date(idt_begin) >= Date(2021,8,9) THEN  // wangyi 20190424
		dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zy_tz'  // 2021.12.17  CJN  27897  (EPTZ)住院明细的总金额计算需要剔除不上传费用NVL(BSCJE,0)
	ELSE
		dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zy_py'  
	END IF
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('住院病人交易数据不一致......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "住院病人交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 6 //住院不平
		//		FOR ll_temp = 1 To ll_rowcount
		//			ls_bpmx = ls_bpmx + string(lds_bpmx.Object.#1[ll_temp]) + " " + String(lds_bpmx.Object.#2[ll_temp]) +&
		//				" " + String(lds_bpmx.Object.#3[ll_temp]) + "~n"
		//		NEXT
	END IF
	
	//	gf_waiting('住院病人交易数据不一致......',-1)
	//	MessageBox('提示,不能对帐，请与计算中心联系','住院病人交易数据不一致：社保理论交易(YB_JSMX) :总金额'+String(ldc_sbzyzje)+',记账金额'+String(ldc_sbzyjz)+'  住院实际发生额 (ZY_ZYJS)：总金额'+String(ldc_zyzje)+',记账金额'+String(ldc_zyjz)+'  差值：'+String(ldc_sbzyzje - ldc_zyzje) + '----'+String(ldc_sbzyjz - ldc_zyjz) + '~n' + ls_bpmx)
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',-1)
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer wf_gzcx (string as_dzr, integer ai_ywlx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: w_sbdz_new.wf_gzcx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:改帐查询
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string 	as_dzr  	对账日
// 	value    	integer	ai_ywlx 	业务类型
// 	reference	string 	as_error	返回信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer -1:出错 0:未处理 1:改帐通过 2:改帐未通过 9:没有申请过改帐
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2011.08.31
//====================================================================
IF ai_ywlx = 1 THEN
	opensheet(w_pyyb_gzcx, w_mzsf_main, 0, Original!)
//	as_error = '平阳本地没有改帐处理'
	RETURN 0
END IF
String ls_gzsqh,ls_return,ls_gzjg
Long ll_find,ll_count

ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Find( "dzr = '"+as_dzr+"' and ywlx = " + String(ai_ywlx) , 1, tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.RowCount())
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	ls_gzsqh = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.gzsqh[ll_find]
	IF IsNull(ls_gzsqh) THEN
		as_error = as_dzr + '该天没有改帐申请!'
		RETURN 9
	ELSE
		ls_gzjg = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.gzjg[ll_find]
		IF ls_gzjg = '1' THEN
			as_error = '改账已经通过，不需再改帐!' + "改帐申请号：" + ls_gzsqh
			RETURN 1
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	as_error = as_dzr + '没有对账信息，请先对账!'
	RETURN -1
END IF

//除了改帐通过和未申请改帐过的--进行此改帐查询
//IF IsValid (gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new) = False THEN //创建医保接口
//	gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new = Create u_ybjk_new_his
//	IF Not gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_init( ls_return) THEN
//		as_error = '医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return
//		RETURN -1
//	END IF
//END IF

IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN  //增加台州判断 wangyi
	MessageBox('提示','台州无异地对账')
	RETURN -1
END IF
		
IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
	IF IsValid(gu_pyybjk) = False THEN
		gu_pyybjk = Create u_pyybjk_his
		IF gu_pyybjk.uf_init(ls_return) = False THEN
			MessageBox('py社保出错:',ls_return)
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

gu_pyybjk.ib_yd = True
gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('YDJY')
gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
//异地接口
gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_init_py( "S003")
gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add( "业务类型", ai_ywlx)
gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add( "交易日期", as_dzr)
gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add( "改账申请号", ls_gzsqh)

IF gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send( ls_return) = False THEN
	as_error = "改帐查询失败:" +ls_return + + "改帐申请号：" + ls_gzsqh
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	ls_return = STRING(LONG(gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring("消息返回码")))
	gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Object.gzjg[ll_find] = ls_return
	IF tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Update( ) = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		as_error = '保存改帐结果出错,' + "改帐申请号：" + ls_gzsqh
		return -1
	END IF
	IF ls_return = '1' THEN
		as_error = '改账通过,'+ "改帐申请号：" + ls_gzsqh
		RETURN 1
	ELSEIF ls_return = '0' THEN
		as_error = '改帐未处理,'+ "改帐申请号：" + ls_gzsqh
		RETURN 0
	ELSEIF ls_return = '2' THEN
		as_error = '改账未通过,'+ "改帐申请号：" + ls_gzsqh
		RETURN 2
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 9
end function

public function integer wf_mxxz (integer ai_ywlx, string as_dzr, ref string as_error);String ls_jsbz,ls_jsjylshm,ls_jyxht,ls_cbd,ls_jylx,ls_sfy,ls_jysj,ls_klb,ls_fhkxx,ls_xm,ls_fyze,ls_yxbz
String ls_grbh,ls_bxzje
Long ll_jymxts,ll_cur,ll_insert,li_jsq
Dec{2} ld_ze = 0.00,ld_bx = 0.00
//
li_jsq = 0
//台州明细下载
IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN
	IF ai_ywlx = 1 THEN
		// 2021.07.15  CJN  台州市本地医保新接口启用（对账明细下訢AT*

		IF gu_ybjk_public.ii_tzsybxjkqy=1 Then
			RETURN uf_tzyb_mxxz_new(ai_ywlx,as_dzr,as_error)
		ELSE
			RETURN uf_tzyb_mxxz(ai_ywlx,as_dzr,as_error)
		END IF
	ELSEIF ai_ywlx = 2 THEN
		RETURN uf_tzyb_mxxz_syd(as_error)
	END IF
END IF

IF ai_ywlx = 1 THEN
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_zxmx'
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.SetTransObject(sqlca) //无须retrieve
	ls_jsbz = '1'
	ls_jsjylshm = '0'
	DO WHILE ls_jsbz = '1'
		//	3.4.20.	交易明细下载(用户交易55)
		gu_pyybjk.ib_yd = False
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('55')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('下载日期',as_dzr)
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('门诊/住院类别','0')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('开始结算流水号',ls_jsjylshm)
		//1	交易状态
		//2	错误信息
		//3	写医保卡结果
		//4	扣银行卡结果
		//5	更新后IC卡数据
		if ll_insert >= 1400 and mod(ll_insert,200) = 0 then 
			debugbreak()
			sleep(0.1)
		end if
		IF gu_pyybjk.uf_send( as_error) = False THEN
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			IF gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
				as_error = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring('错误信息')
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			ls_jsbz = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring('是否还有需下载的记录') //6	是否还有需下载的记录 1有，0无
			ll_jymxts = Long(gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring("本次下载记录条数")) //7	 本次下载记录条数
			//			IF gu_pyybjk.uf_set_xhcs('S001','YD',ll_jymxts,'循环次数') < 0 THEN //
			//				as_error = '设置循环体条数失败!'
			//				return -1
			//			END IF
			w_sbdz_py.SetRedraw(False)
			//			ls_jyxht = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring("交易明细结构体")8	交易明细结构体
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',0)
			FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_jymxts
				gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',ll_cur / ll_jymxts * 100)
				//				1	结算流水号
				//				2	报销类型
				//				3	个人编码
				//				4	结算时间
				//				5	总费用
				//				6	报销总金额
				//				7	姓名
				ls_jsjylshm = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring_in( "结算流水号",ll_cur)
				ls_jylx = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring_in( "报销类型",ll_cur)
				ls_grbh = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring_in( "个人编码",ll_cur)
				ls_jysj = String(gu_pyybjk.uf_getdatetime_in( "结算时间",ll_cur),'yyyymmdd-hh:mm:ss')
				ls_fyze = String(gu_pyybjk.uf_getdecimal_in( "总费用",ll_cur))
				ls_bxzje = String(gu_pyybjk.uf_getdecimal_in( "报销总金额",ll_cur))
				ls_xm = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring_in( "姓名",ll_cur)
				
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.InsertRow( 0)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jslsh[ll_insert] = ls_jsjylshm
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxlx[ll_insert] = ls_jylx
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.grbh[ll_insert] = ls_grbh
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jssj[ll_insert] = ls_jysj
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zfy[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxzje[ll_insert] = ls_bxzje
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.brxm[ll_insert] = ls_xm
				ld_ze = ld_ze + Dec(ls_fyze)
				ld_bx = ld_bx + Dec(ls_bxzje)
			NEXT
			//			li_jsq ++
			//			gf_applog('jsq:' + string(li_jsq) +"记录数"+ + string(tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.rowcount()))
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',-1)
		END IF
	LOOP
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.z_zfy.Text = String(ld_ze)
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.z_bxzje.Text = String(ld_bx)
	w_sbdz_py.SetRedraw(True)
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.SaveAs( "C:\SB\download\"+ as_dzr+String(ai_ywlx) + ".txt", Text! ,True)
	MessageBox("提示",'下载成功!')
ELSEIF ai_ywlx = 2 THEN
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.DataObject = 'd_yb_zxmx'
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.SetTransObject(sqlca) //无须retrieve
	ls_jsbz = '0'
	ls_jsjylshm = ''
	DO WHILE ls_jsbz = '0'
		gu_pyybjk.ib_yd = True
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('YDJY')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		//异地接口
//		gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_init_py('S001')
		gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_init_py('S001')
		gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add('业务类型',ai_ywlx)
		gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add('交易日期',as_dzr)
		gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add('上次查询末笔结算交易流水号',ls_jsjylshm)
		//发送消息
		IF gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_send(as_error) THEN
			ls_jsbz = gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring("结束标志")
			ll_jymxts = Long(gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring("循环次数"))
			IF gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_set_xhcs('S001','YD',ll_jymxts,'循环次数') < 0 THEN
				as_error = '设置循环体条蔇AT* !'
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			w_sbdz_py.SetRedraw(False)
			ls_jyxht = gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring("循环体")
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',0)
			FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_jymxts
				gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',ll_cur / ll_jymxts * 100)
				ls_jsjylshm = gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring_in( "结算交易流水号",ll_cur)
				ls_cbd = gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring_in( "参保地行政区划代码",ll_cur)
				ls_jylx = gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring_in( "交易类型",ll_cur)
				ls_sfy = gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring_in( "收费人员代码",ll_cur)
				ls_jysj = String(gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getdatetime_in( "交易时间",ll_cur),'yyyymmdd-hh:mm:ss')
				//			ls_jysj = gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring_in( "交易时间",ll_cur)
				ls_klb = gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring_in( "卡类别",ll_cur)
				ls_fhkxx = gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring_in( "返回卡信息",ll_cur)
				ls_xm = gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring_in( "姓名",ll_cur)
				ls_fyze = String(gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getdecimal_in( "医疗费用总额",ll_cur))
				ls_yxbz = gu_pyybjk.iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring_in( "有效标志",ll_cur)
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.InsertRow( 0)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jsjylsh[ll_insert] = ls_jsjylshm
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdxzqhdm[ll_insert] = ls_cbd
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jylx[ll_insert] = ls_jylx
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.sfydm[ll_insert] = ls_sfy
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jysj[ll_insert] = ls_jysj
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.klb[ll_insert] = ls_klb
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.kxx[ll_insert] = ls_fhkxx
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_xm
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.yxbz[ll_insert] = ls_yxbz
				ld_ze = ld_ze + Dec(ls_fyze)
			NEXT
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',-1)
		ELSE
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	LOOP
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zfy.Text = String(ld_ze)
	w_sbdz_py.SetRedraw(True)
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.SaveAs( "C:\SB\download\" + as_dzr+String(ai_ywlx) + ".txt", Text! ,True)
	MessageBox("提示",'下载成功!')
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public subroutine wf_hdjy_bd ();String ls_jsjylsh,ls_ybfyze,ls_error1,ls_error2 ,ls_error3,ls_errortext,ls_error4,ls_jssj,ls_grbh
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_ybfyze,ld_jzje,ld_bxje

ls_error3 = '结算交易流水号：'

		ls_ybfyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zfy[ll_find]
		ls_bxzje = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxzje[ll_find]

		IF ld_fyze <> ld_ybfyze Or  ld_jzje <> ld_bxje THEN
			ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地费用总额:'+String(ld_fyze,'###.00')+'   中心费用总额：'+String(ld_ybfyze,'###.00')+'~n'

END IF

MessageBox('社保笔数：'+String(ll_dzxx_count),'本地有效笔数：'+String(ll_jymx_count))
String ls_brbm,ls_jylx,ls_cbd

	ld_bxje = Dec(ls_bxzje)
	//	if ld_ybfyze < 0 then continue
	ll_find = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Find("qrjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,ll_jymx_count)
	IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
		IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount() > 0 THEN
			ll_find = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Find("qrjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount())
			//对于交易明细和改帐信息中都没有的中心交易作改帐处理
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowsCopy( i, i, Primary!, tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd, 1, Primary!)
				ls_error3 = ls_error3 + "qrjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'" +'~t' + "费用总额:" + ls_ybfyze +'~t'
			ELSE
				IF ld_ybfyze <> Dec(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_find]) Or ld_bxje <>  Dec(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.hjbxje[ll_find]) THEN
					MessageBox('总额不一致' , ls_jsjylsh + "社保:" + ls_ybfyze + "本地:" + String(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_find]) & 						+ "社保:" + String(ld_bxje) +"本地" + String(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.hjbxje[ll_find]))
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowsCopy( i, i, Primary!, tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd, 1, Primary!)
			ls_error3 = ls_error3 + "qrjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'" +'~t' + "费用总额:" + ls_ybfyze +'~t'
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT

IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地有而中心没有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error1 + '~t'
IF ls_error3 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地没有而中心有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error3 + '~t'
IF ls_error2 <> '' THEN
	ls_errortext += '本地与中心有出入的有：' + '~t' +  ls_error2
	MessageBox('提示',ls_errortext)
END IF
tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = ls_errortext
tab_1.SelectTab(6)

	tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = '祝贺你此次对帐顺利通过，哈哈 请客！'
	MessageBox('提示','对帐已通过')
END IF

public subroutine wf_delrep (string as_ywlb, datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end);u_datastore luds_del
luds_del = Create u_datastore
IF as_ywlb = '1' THEN
	luds_del.DataObject = 'd_jsjylsh_pydel'
ELSEIF as_ywlb = '2' THEN
	luds_del.DataObject = 'd_jsjylsh_del'
END IF
luds_del.SetTransObject(SQLCA)
luds_del.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end)

Long ll_rowcount,ll_zyh,ll_cur
String ls_brbm,ls_jsjylsh,ls_mxzdh
ll_rowcount = luds_del.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	IF as_ywlb = '2' THEN
		ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[1]
		ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[1]
		ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[1]
		ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.mxzdh[1]
		
		FOR ll_cur = 2 To ll_rowcount
			IF ll_zyh = 0 THEN
				IF ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur] THEN
					luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
				ELSE
					ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
					ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur]
					ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.mxzdh[ll_cur]
					ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
					CONTINUE
				END IF
			ELSE
				IF ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur] THEN
					luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
				ELSE
					ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
					ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur]
					ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.mxzdh[ll_cur]
					ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
					CONTINUE
				END IF
			END IF
		NEXT
	ELSE
		ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[1]
		ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[1]
		ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.qrjylsh[1]

		FOR ll_cur = 2 To ll_rowcount
			IF ll_zyh = 0 THEN
				IF ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.qrjylsh[ll_cur] THEN
					luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
				ELSE
					ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
					ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.qrjylsh[ll_cur]
					ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
					CONTINUE
				END IF
			ELSE
				IF ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.qrjylsh[ll_cur] THEN
					luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
				ELSE
					ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
					ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.qrjylsh[ll_cur]
//					ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.mxzdh[ll_cur]
					ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
					CONTINUE
				END IF
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
//	luds_del.SetFilter( 'ztbz = -8')
//	luds_del.Filter( )
//	luds_del.SetFilter( '')
//	luds_del.Filter( )
	
	gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	IF luds_del.Update( ) = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
//		MessageBox('提示','保存成功!')
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		MessageBox('提示','del失败')
	END IF
END IF
end subroutine

public function integer uf_tzyb_mxxz (integer ai_ywlx, string as_dzr, ref string as_return);String ls_jsbz ,ls_jsjylshm //as_return
String ls_jylx,ls_grbh,ls_jysj,ls_fyze,ls_bxzje,ls_xm,ls_tcq,ls_rylx
Integer li_return
Long ll_cur,ll_jymxts,ll_insert
Decimal ld_ze,ld_bx
li_return = 1

tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_zxmx'
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.SetTransObject(sqlca) //无须retrieve	
ls_jsbz = '1'
ls_jsjylshm = '0'

DO WHILE ls_jsbz = '1'
	//	3.4.21.交易明细下载（用户交易55）
	gu_tzybjk.uf_send_init('55')
	gu_tzybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
	gu_tzybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
	gu_tzybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	gu_tzybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	gu_tzybjk.uf_send_add('下载日期',as_dzr)
	gu_tzybjk.uf_send_add('门诊/住院类别','0')
	gu_tzybjk.uf_send_add('开始结算流水号',ls_jsjylshm)
	//1	交易状态
	//2	错误信息
	//3	写医保卡结果
	//4	扣银行卡结果
	//5	更新后IC卡数据
	IF gu_tzybjk.uf_send( as_return) = False THEN
		li_return = -1
	ELSE
		IF gu_tzybjk.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_return = gu_tzybjk.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			li_return = -1
		END IF
		ls_jsbz = gu_tzybjk.uf_getstring('是否还有需下载的记录') //6	是否还有需下载的记录 1有，0无
		ll_jymxts = Long(gu_tzybjk.uf_getstring("本次下载记录条数")) //7	 本次下载记录条数
		w_sbdz_py.SetRedraw(False)
		//			ls_jyxht = gu_tzybjk.uf_getstring("交易明细结构体")8	交易明细结构体
		gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',0)
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_jymxts
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',ll_cur / ll_jymxts * 100)
			//				1	结算流水号	string	16	是		
			//				2	报销类型	string	3	是		
			//				3	个人编码	string	20	是		
			//				4	统筹区	string	6	是		
			//				5	结算时间	string	20	是		yyyyMMdd hh24miss
			//				6	总费用	double	12(2)	是		
			//				7	报销总金额	double	12(2)	是		
			//				8	姓名	string	20	是		
			//				9	人员类型	string	20	是		参照7.4.2
			ls_jsjylshm = gu_tzybjk.uf_getstring_in( "结算流水号",ll_cur)
			ls_jylx = gu_tzybjk.uf_getstring_in( "报销类型",ll_cur)
			ls_grbh = gu_tzybjk.uf_getstring_in( "个人编码",ll_cur)
			ls_jysj = String(gu_tzybjk.uf_getdatetime_in( "结算时间",ll_cur),'yyyymmdd-hh:mm:ss')
			ls_fyze = String(gu_tzybjk.uf_getdecimal_in( "总费用",ll_cur))
			ls_bxzje = String(gu_tzybjk.uf_getdecimal_in( "报销总金额",ll_cur))
			ls_xm = gu_tzybjk.uf_getstring_in( "姓名",ll_cur)
			ls_tcq = gu_tzybjk.uf_getstring_in( "统筹区",ll_cur)
			ls_rylx = gu_tzybjk.uf_getstring_in( "人员类型",ll_cur)
			
			ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.InsertRow( 0)
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jslsh[ll_insert] = ls_jsjylshm
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxlx[ll_insert] = ls_jylx
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.grbh[ll_insert] = ls_grbh
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jssj[ll_insert] = ls_jysj
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zfy[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxzje[ll_insert] = ls_bxzje
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.brxm[ll_insert] = ls_xm
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.tcq[ll_insert] = ls_tcq
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.rylx[ll_insert] = ls_rylx
			ld_ze = ld_ze + Dec(ls_fyze)
			ld_bx = ld_bx + Dec(ls_bxzje)
		NEXT
		gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',-1)
	END IF
LOOP
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.z_zfy.Text = String(ld_ze)
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.z_bxzje.Text = String(ld_bx)
w_sbdz_py.SetRedraw(True)
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.SaveAs( "C:\SB\download\"+ as_dzr+String(ai_ywlx) + ".txt", Text! ,True)
MessageBox("提示",'下载成功!')
RETURN li_return

end function

public function integer uf_tzyb_mxxz_syd (ref string as_return);String ls_dzr,ls_jyxht,ls_jsbz
Long ll_jymxts,ll_cur,ll_insert

Dec{2} ld_fyze = 0.00,ldc_bxje = 0.00,ldc_xjje = 0.00

tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.DataObject = 'd_syb_zxmx'
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.SetTransObject(sqlca) //无须retrieve	
//添加消息体发送信息内容
ld_dzr = Date(idt_begin)
ls_dzr = String(ld_dzr,'yyyymmdd')
li_ywlx = 0
ls_jsbz = '1'

Long ll_jymxts_temp

DO WHILE ls_jsbz = '1'
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_send_init('9324')

	gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_send_add('已下载最大交易流水号',ls_jsjylshm)
	//发送消息
	IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_send(as_return) THEN
		w_sbdz_py.SetRedraw(False)
		ls_jsbz = gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_getstring("是否还有需下载的记录") //0：下载完毕1：还需下载
		ll_jymxts_temp = Long(gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_getstring("本次下载记录条数"))

		IF ll_jymxts <> ll_jymxts_temp THEN
			MessageBox('提示','中心下载条数:' +String(ll_jymxts_temp)+'  与本地解析不一致:' + String(ll_jymxts))
		END 
IF
		
		gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',0)
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_jymxts
			//1	交易流水号
			//2	参保地结算流水号
			//3	参保地行政代码
			//4	门诊/住院序列号
			//5	医疗类型
			//6	社会保障卡卡号

event ue_zxdz();String ls_dzr,ls_dzlx
Long ll_count
ll_count = 0
ls_dzr = String(idt_begin,'yyyymmdd')
ls_dzlx = ddlb_ywlx.getcode( )
IF ls_dzlx = '1' THEN
	MessageBox('提示',ddlb_ywlx.Text + '，无需中心对账！')
	RETURN
ELSEIF ls_dzlx = '-1' OR  ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
	MessageBox('提示',ddlb_ywlx.Text + '，仅限下载明细，无需对账！')
	RETURN
END IF
IF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs = 'WD' THEN
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.YB_DZXX   Where YB_DZXX.dzr = :ls_dzr And YB_DZXX.ywlx = 1 ;
ELSEIF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs = 'EP' Or gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs = 'EPTZ' THEN
	IF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs = 'EPTZ' And ls_dzr >= '20210809' THEN
		SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.TZYB_DZXX_SBD  Where to_char(DZRQ,'yyyymmdd') = :ls_dzr and   DZLX = '2'	;
	ELSE
		SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.PYYB_DZXX  Where dzr = :ls_dzr ;
	END IF
ELSEIF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs = 'LB' THEN
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.LSYB_DZXX  Where to_char(dzr,'yyyymmdd') = :ls_dzr ;
END IF
IF ll_count = 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先本地对账!')
	RETURN
END IF

IF tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowCount() < 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先下载明细，再对账')
	RETURN
END IF
String ls_mess
IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_yljg_rdz( Date(idt_begin), ls_dzlx, ls_mess) < 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示',ls_mess)
END IF
//if ls_dzlx = '0' or ls_dzlx = '2' then
//else
	dw_1.Retrieve( Date(idt_begin),-1,ls_dzlx )
//end if


end event

event ue_hdjy();String ls_jsjylsh,ls_error1,ls_error2 ,ls_error3,ls_errortext,ls_error4,ls_jslsh //,ls_jssj,ls_ybfyze
String ls_dzlx
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_ybfyze,ld_bxje,ld_ybbxje,ld_grxjje,ld_ybgrxjje
Long ll_jymx_count,ll_dzxx_count,ll_find,i,ll_insert
//DateTime ldt_jssj
String ls_ztbz
ls_error1 = '结算交易流水号：'
ls_error3 = '结算交易流水号：'
ls_error2 = ''
ls_error4 = ''
ls_errortext = ''
tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = ''
tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.Reset( )
ll_jymx_count = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount() //本地
ll_dzxx_count = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowCount() //导入的社保明细

ls_dzlx = ddlb_ywlx.getcode( )

//IF (ls_dzlx = '-1' OR ls_dzlx = '-2') AND base_info.userid <> '209134' THEN
//	MessageBox('提示','月结算数据无法核对')
//	RETURN
//END IF
IF ll_jymx_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计交易明细')
	RETURN
END IF
IF ll_dzxx_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先下载交易明细，并检查是否已正确导入')
	RETURN
END IF
IF ls_dzlx = '1' THEN
	FOR i = 1 To ll_jymx_count
		ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jsjylsh[i]
		ld_fyze = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.ylfyze[i]
		ld_bxje = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.hjzf[i]
		ld_grxjje = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.grxj[i]
		ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Find("jsjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"' ",1,ll_dzxx_count)
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			ld_ybfyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]
			ld_ybbxje = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxje[ll_find]
			ld_ybgrxjje = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.grxjzf[ll_find]
			//		ld_ybfyze = Dec(ls_ybfyze)
			IF ld_fyze <> ld_ybfyze THEN
				ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地费用总额:'+String(ld_fyze,'###.00')+'   中心费用总额：'+String(ld_ybfyze,'###.00')+'~n'
			END IF
			IF ld_bxje <> ld_ybbxje THEN
				ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地报销金额:'+String(ld_bxje,'###.00')+'   中心报销金额：'+String(ld_ybbxje,'###.00')+'~n'
			END IF
			IF ld_grxjje <> ld_ybgrxjje THEN
				ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地个人现金支付:'+String(ld_grxjje,'###.00')+'   中心个人现金支付：'+String(ld_ybgrxjje,'###.00')+'~n'
			END IF
		ELSE
			//本地有,中心没有的
			ls_error1 = ls_error1 + "jsjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh +"'~t"
		END IF
	NEXT
	
	IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN
		MessageBox('本地有而中心没有的数据',ls_error1)
	END IF
	
	MessageBox('社保笔数：'+String(ll_dzxx_count),'本地有效笔数：'+String(ll_jymx_count))
ELSE
	FOR i = 1 To ll_jymx_count
		ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jylsh[i]
		ld_fyze = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.fyze[i]
		ls_jslsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jslsh[i]
		IF ls_dzlx = '-1' OR ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
			ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Find("cbdjslsh='"+ls_jslsh+"'",1,ll_dzxx_count)
		ELSE
			ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Find("jsjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,ll_dzxx_count)
		END IF
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			ld_ybfyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]
			//		ld_ybfyze = Dec(ls_ybfyze)
			IF ld_fyze <> ld_ybfyze THEN
				ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地费用总额:'+String(ld_fyze,'###.00')+'   中心费用总额：'+String(ld_ybfyze,'###.00')+'~n'
			END IF
			IF ls_jslsh <> tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdjslsh[ll_find] THEN
				ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地jslsh:'+ls_jslsh+'   参保地jslsh：'+String(tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdjslsh[ll_find])+'~n'
			END IF
		ELSE
			//本地有,中心没有的
			IF ls_dzlx = '-1' OR ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
				ls_error1 = ls_error1 + "jsLsh='"+ls_jslsh +"'~t"
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.insertrow( 0)
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.jsjylsh[ll_insert] = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jylsh[i]
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = ld_fyze
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.bxje[ll_insert] = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.hjbxje[i]
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.jysj[ll_insert] = string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jssj[i],'yyyymmdd hh:mm:ss')
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.cbdxzqhdm[ll_insert] = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.cbdxzqh[i]
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.cbdjslsh[ll_insert] = ls_jslsh
				if string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jssj[i],'yyyymm') <> string(idt_begin,'yyyymm')  then
					tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.jylx[ll_insert] = '-1'
				else
					tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.jylx[ll_insert] = '0'
				end if
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.xlh[ll_insert] = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jyid[i]
				
			ELSE
				ls_error1 = ls_error1 + "jsjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh +"'~t"
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT	
	IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN
		MessageBox('本地有而中心没有的数据',ls_error1)
	END IF
	
	MessageBox('社保笔数：'+String(ll_dzxx_count),'本地有效笔数：'+String(ll_jymx_count))
	//String ls_brbm,ls_jylx,ls_cbd
	FOR i = 1 To ll_dzxx_count
		ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jsjylsh[i]
		ld_ybfyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[i]
		ls_jslsh = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdjslsh[i]
		IF ls_dzlx = '-1' OR ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
			ll_find = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Find("jslsh='"+ls_jslsh+"'",1,ll_jymx_count)
		ELSE
			ll_find = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Find("jylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,ll_jymx_count)
		END IF
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
			
			IF ls_dzlx = '-1' OR ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
				ll_find = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Find("jslsh='"+ls_jslsh+"'",1,tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount())
			ELSE
				ll_find = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Find("jylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount())
			END IF
			//对于交易明细和改帐信息中都没有的中心交易作改帐处理
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowsCopy( i, i, Primary!, tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd, 1, Primary!)
				
				if left(string(tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.object.jysj[i]),6) <> string(idt_begin,'yyyymm')  then
					tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.jylx[1] = '-1'
				end if
				ls_error3 = ls_error3 + "jslsh='"+ls_jslsh+"'" +'~t' + "费用总额:" + String(ld_ybfyze) +'~t'
			ELSE
				IF ld_ybfyze <> Dec(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_find]) THEN
					MessageBox('总额不一致' , ls_jslsh + "社保:" + String(ld_ybfyze) + "本地:" + String(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_find]))
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF
IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地有而中心没有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error1 + '~t'
IF ls_error3 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地没有而中心有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error3 + '~t'
IF ls_error2 <> '' THEN
	ls_errortext += '本地与中心有出入的有：' + '~t' +  ls_error2
	MessageBox('提示',ls_errortext)
END IF
tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = ls_errortext
tab_1.SelectTab(6)
IF tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = '' THEN
	tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = '祝贺你此次对帐顺利通过，哈哈 请客！'
	MessageBox('提示','对帐已通过')
END IF
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)

end event

blocks.name: ue_mxxz
blocks.text:
event ue_mxxz();String ls_dzr,ls_return,ls_jyxht,ls_jsbz
Long ll_jymxts,ll_cur,ll_insert
Integer li_ywlx
String ls_jsjylshm,ls_cbd,ls_jylx,ls_sfy,ls_jysj,ls_klb,ls_fhkxx,ls_xm,ls_fyze
Dec{2} ld_fyze = 0.00,ldc_bxje = 0.00,ldc_xjje = 0.00
Date ld_dzr
//Or dw_1.RowCount( ) <= 0 Or IsNull(dw_1.Object.dzrq[1])

String ls_cbdjslsh,ls_dzlx

ls_dzlx = ddlb_ywlx.getcode( )
IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(idt_end)  THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再下载')
	RETURN
ELSE
	ld_dzr = Date(idt_begin)
	ls_dzr = String(ld_dzr,'yyyymmdd')
	//	li_ywlx = integer(dw_1.Object.dzlx[1])
	li_ywlx = 0
	IF ls_dzlx = '-1' Or ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
		if ls_dzlx = '-1'   then
			ld_dzr = Date(idt_end)
   		ls_dzr = String(ld_dzr,'yyyymmdd')
		end if 
		IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymm') <> left(ls_dzr,6) Or  ( ls_dzlx = '-1' and String(idt_end,'yyyymm')  <> String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymm')) or ( ls_dzlx = '-2' and String(idt_begin,'yyyymm')  <> String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymm')) THEN
			MessageBox('提示','对账月份'+String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymm')+'与对账信息汇总中的对账月份' + left(ls_dzr,6)+'不一致,请重新统计汇总')
			RETURN
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
			MessageBox('提示','对账时间'+String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')+'与对账信息汇总中的对账日' + ls_dzr+'不一致,请重新统计汇总')
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
//提示
IF tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowCount( ) > 0 THEN
	IF MessageBox('提示','已经下载了明细，是否重新下载?',Question!,YesNo!,2) = 2 THEN
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
IF ls_dzlx = '1' THEN //移动支付对账
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.DataObject = 'd_sydzf_zxmx'
ELSEIF ls_dzlx = '-1' Or ls_dzlx = '2' THEN //4.2.7.	3105,3106号交易：跨省月结算数据下载
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.DataObject = 'd_syb_yjssj'
	tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.DataObject = 'd_syb_yjssj'
ELSE
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.DataObject = 'd_syb_zxmx'
	tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.DataObject = 'd_syb_zxmx'
END IF
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.SetTransObject(sqlca)
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Reset( )
//添加消息体发送信息内容
ls_jsbz = '1'
ls_jsjylshm = '0'
Long ll_jymxts_temp
IF ls_dzlx = '1' THEN //移动支付对账
	DO WHILE ls_jsbz = '1'
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_init('8033')
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add('结算日期',String(ld_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd'))
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add('平台最大流水号',Integer(ls_jsjylshm))
		//发送消息
		IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send(ls_return) THEN
			w_sbdz_syd.SetRedraw(False)
			ls_jsbz = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getstring("是否还有需下载的记录") //0：下载完毕1：还需下载
			ll_jymxts_temp = Long(gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getstring("本次下载记录条数"))
			ll_jymxts = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getstring_mxnr('对账结果明细列表')
			IF ll_jymxts = -1 THEN EXIT
			IF ll_jymxts <> ll_jymxts_temp THEN
				MessageBox('提示','中心下载条数:' +String(ll_jymxts_temp)+'  与本地解析不一致:' + String(ll_jymxts))
			END IF
			
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',0)
			FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_jymxts
				gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',ll_cur / ll_jymxts * 100)
				ls_jsjylshm = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getstring_in( "平台流水号",ll_cur)
				ls_cbdjslsh = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getstring_in( "参保地结算流水号",ll_cur)
				ls_cbd = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getstring_in( "参保地行政代码",ll_cur)
				ls_jylx = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getstring_in( "第三方支付流水号",ll_cur)
				ls_jysj = String(gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getdatetime_in( "交易时间",ll_cur),'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss')
				ls_fhkxx = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getstring_in( "社会保障卡卡号",ll_cur)
				ls_xm = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getstring_in( "姓名",ll_cur)
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.InsertRow( 0)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jllsh[ll_insert] = ls_jsjylshm
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jsjylsh[ll_insert] = ls_cbdjslsh
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdxzqh[ll_insert] = ls_cbd
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.dsfzfddh[ll_insert] = ls_jylx
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jzh[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getstring_in( "就诊号",ll_cur)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jssj[ll_insert] = ls_jysj
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.shbzkkh[ll_insert] = ls_fhkxx
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.brxm[ll_insert] = ls_xm
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getdecimal_in( "医疗费用总额",ll_cur)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxje[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getdecimal_in( "报销金额",ll_cur) //14	报销金额
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.grxjzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getdecimal_in( "个人现金支付",ll_cur) //15	个人现金支付
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.dzjg[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_getstring_in( "对账结果",ll_cur)
				ld_fyze = ld_fyze + tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_insert] //gu_ybjk_public.gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "医疗费用总额",ll_cur)
				ldc_bxje = ldc_bxje +  tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxje[ll_insert] //gu_ybjk_public.gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "报销金额",ll_cur)
				ldc_xjje = ldc_xjje + tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.grxjzf[ll_insert]
			NEXT
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',-1)
		ELSE
			MessageBox("提示",ls_return)
			RETURN
		END IF
	LOOP
ELSEIF ls_dzlx >= '0' And ls_dzlx <= '5' THEN
	DO WHILE ls_jsbz = '1'
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_init('9224')
		//		IF ls_dzlx = '4' THEN
		//			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add('异地结算类型','5')
		//		ELSE //IF ls_dzlx = '2' THEN
		//			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add('异地结算类型','0')
		//		END IF
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add('异地结算类型',ls_dzlx)
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add('交易日期',String(ld_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd'))
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add('已下载最大交易流水号',ls_jsjylshm)
		//发送消息
		IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send(ls_return) THEN
			w_sbdz_syd.SetRedraw(False)
			ls_jsbz = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring("是否还有需下载的记录") //0：下载完毕1：还需下载
			ll_jymxts_temp = Long(gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring("本次下载记录条数"))
			ll_jymxts = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_mxnr('交易明细列表')
			IF ll_jymxts = -1 THEN EXIT
			IF ll_jymxts <> ll_jymxts_temp THEN
				MessageBox('提示','中心下载条数:' +String(ll_jymxts_temp)+'  与本地解析不一致:' + String(ll_jymxts))
			END IF
			
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',0)
			FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_jymxts
				//			1	交易流水号
				//2	参保地结算流水号
				//3	参保地行政代码
				//4	门诊/住院序列号
				//5	医疗类型
				//6	社会保障卡卡号
				//7	姓名
				//8	交易时间
				//9	医疗费用总额
				//10	自费总额（非医保）
				//11	自理总额（目录内自负比例部分）
				//12	转院自负
				gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',ll_cur / ll_jymxts * 100)
				ls_jsjylshm = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "交易流水号",ll_cur)
				ls_cbdjslsh = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "参保地结算流水号",ll_cur)
				ls_cbd = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "参保地行政代码",ll_cur)
				ls_jylx = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "医疗类型",ll_cur)
				ls_jysj = String(gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdatetime_in( "交易时间",ll_cur),'yyyymmdd hh:mm:ss')
				
				ls_fhkxx = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "社会保障卡卡号",ll_cur)
				ls_xm = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "姓名",ll_cur)
				//			ldc_fyze = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "医疗费用总额",ll_cur)
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.InsertRow( 0)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jsjylsh[ll_insert] = ls_jsjylshm
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdjslsh[ll_insert] = ls_cbdjslsh
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdxzqhdm[ll_insert] = ls_cbd
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jylx[ll_insert] =  ls_jylx
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.xlh[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "门诊/住院序列号",ll_cur)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jysj[ll_insert] = ls_jysj
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.kxx[ll_insert] = ls_fhkxx
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_xm
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "医疗费用总额",ll_cur)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zfze[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "自费总额（非医保）",ll_cur)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zlze[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "自理总额（目录内自负比例部分）",ll_cur)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zyzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "转院自负",ll_cur)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.qfbz[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "起付标准",ll_cur) //13	起付标准
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxje[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "报销金额",ll_cur) //14	报销金额
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.grxjzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "个人现金支付",ll_cur) //15	个人现金支付
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.tcjjzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "统筹基金支付",ll_cur) //16	统筹基金支付
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.wnzhzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "往年帐户支付",ll_cur) //17	往年帐户支付
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.dnzhzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "当年帐户支付",ll_cur) //18	当年帐户支付
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.dbjzzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "大病救助支付",ll_cur) //19	大病救助支付
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.gwybzzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "公务员补助支付",ll_cur) //20	公务员补助支付
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.eyjjzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "二乙基金支付",ll_cur) //21	二乙基金支付
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.lxjjzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "离休基金支付",ll_cur) //22	离休基金支付
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.lmjjzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "劳模基金支付",ll_cur) //23	劳模基金支付
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bzjjzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "补助基金支付",ll_cur) //24	补助基金支付
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.mzbzjjzf[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "民政补助基金支付",ll_cur) //25	民政补助基金支付
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.yl2[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "预留2",ll_cur) //26	原"预留2"修改为"罕见病基金支付"
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.yl3[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "预留3",ll_cur) //27	预留3
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.yl4[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "预留4",ll_cur) //28	预留4
				ld_fyze = ld_fyze + tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_insert] //gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "医疗费用总额",ll_cur)
				ldc_bxje = ldc_bxje +  tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxje[ll_insert] //gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "报销金额",ll_cur)
				ldc_xjje = ldc_xjje + tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.grxjzf[ll_insert]
			NEXT
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',-1)
		ELSE
			MessageBox("提示",ls_return)
			RETURN
		END IF
	LOOP
	
ELSEIF ls_dzlx = '-1'  Or ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
	DO WHILE ls_jsbz = '1'
		IF ls_dzlx = '-1' THEN
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_init('3105')
		ELSEIF ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_init('3106')
		END IF
		//		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add('数据期别',String(ld_dzr,'yyyymm'))
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add('数据期别',String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymm'))
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add('已下载最大交易流水号',ls_jsjylshm)
		//发送消息
		IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send(ls_return) THEN
			w_sbdz_syd.SetRedraw(False)
			ls_jsbz = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring("是否还有需下载的记录") //0：下载完毕1：还需下载
			ll_jymxts_temp = Long(gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring("本次下载记录条数"))
			ll_jymxts = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_mxnr('月结算数据列表')
			IF ll_jymxts = -1 THEN EXIT
			IF ll_jymxts <> ll_jymxts_temp THEN
				MessageBox('提示','中心下载条数:' +String(ll_jymxts_temp)+'  与本地解析不一致:' + String(ll_jymxts))
			END IF
			
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',0)
			FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_jymxts
				//				1	交易流水号2	参保地行政代码 3	费用总额4	报销金额5	就诊结算时间6	就诊序列号7	结算流水号8	退费标志
				gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',ll_cur / ll_jymxts * 100)
				ls_jsjylshm = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "交易流水号",ll_cur)
				ls_cbdjslsh = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "结算流水号",ll_cur)
				ls_cbd = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "参保地行政代码",ll_cur)
				ls_jylx = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "退费标志",ll_cur)
				ls_jysj = String(gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdatetime_in( "就诊结算时间",ll_cur),'yyyymmdd hh:mm:ss')
				//			ldc_fyze = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "医疗费用总额",ll_cur)
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.InsertRow( 0)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jsjylsh[ll_insert] = ls_jsjylshm
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdjslsh[ll_insert] = ls_cbdjslsh
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdxzqhdm[ll_insert] = ls_cbd
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jylx[ll_insert] = ls_jylx
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.xlh[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "就诊序列号",ll_cur)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jysj[ll_insert] = ls_jysj
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "费用总额",ll_cur)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxje[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "报销金额",ll_cur) //14	报销金额
				ld_fyze = ld_fyze + tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_insert] //gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "医疗费用总额",ll_cur)
				ldc_bxje = ldc_bxje +  tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxje[ll_insert] //gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "报销金额",ll_cur)
				ldc_xjje = ldc_xjje + (ld_fyze - ldc_bxje)
			NEXT
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',-1)
		ELSE
			MessageBox("提示",ls_return)
			RETURN
		END IF
	LOOP
END IF
w_sbdz_syd.SetRedraw(True)
IF ls_dzlx <> '-1'  And ls_dzlx <> '-2' THEN
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zxjje.Text = String(ldc_xjje)
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zfy.Text = String(ld_fyze)
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zbxje.Text = String(ldc_bxje)
end if
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.SaveAs( "C:\SB\download\syd"+ls_dzr+String(ddlb_ywlx.Text) + ".txt", Text! ,True)

IF tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowCount()  = 0  THEN
	ls_return = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring("错误信息")
	MessageBox("提示",ls_return)
ELSE
	MessageBox("提示",'下载成功!')
END IF





end event

event ue_bptz();String ls_jsjylsh, ls_tsxx
ls_tsxx = "请输入本地有而医保中心的明细中没有的结算交易流水号~n" +&
	"（提示：该功能只进行本地有而中心没有的明细调整，本地没有而医保中心有的明细【门诊校对】双击具体明细。）"
ls_jsjylsh = Trim(gf_inputbox(ls_tsxx, ""))

IF ls_jsjylsh = '-1' Or ls_jsjylsh = "" THEN
	RETURN
END IF

DateTime ldt_begin
ldt_begin = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(idt_begin), -1), Time("00:00:00"))

String ls_brbm, ls_ywlx
Long ll_zyh
DateTime ldt_jysj

String ls_sql
ls_sql = "SELECT brbm, ywlx,zyh,jssj From jkxt.yb_jsmx Where jssj >= " + gf_dtinsql(ldt_begin) + " And jsjylsh = '" + ls_jsjylsh + "' And ztbz > 0 Order By jssj Desc "
u_datastore lds_brxx
lds_brxx = Create u_datastore
IF lds_brxx.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
	MessageBox("提示", "创建'病人信息查询'对象失败。")
	
RETURN
END IF
lds_brxx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
IF lds_brxx.Retrieve() <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox("提示", "该结算交易流水号没找到对应的病人信息")
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_brbm = lds_brxx.Object.brbm[1]
	ls_ywlx = lds_brxx.Object.ywlx[1]
	ll_zyh = lds_brxx.Object.zyh[1]
	IF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'SF' Or ls_ywlx = '' THEN
		ii_bplx = 4
	ELSEIF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'GH' THEN
		ii_bplx = 5
	ELSEIF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'ZY' THEN
		ii_bplx = 6
	END IF
	
	s_exchange ls_exchange
	ls_exchange.LongParm[1] = ii_bplx
	ls_exchange.LongParm[2] = ll_zyh
	ls_exchange.StringParm[1] = ls_brbm
	ls_exchange.StringParm[2] = ls_jsjylsh
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[1] = idt_begin
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[2] = idt_end
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[3] = ldt_jysj
	ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'wd'
	
	OpenWithParm(w_sbdz_bptz, ls_exchange)
END IF
destroy lds_brxx
end event

blocks.text:
event ue_gzcl();Long ll_row,ll_count
ll_count = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount()
String ls_ywlx,ls_brbm,ls_knxx,ls_mzyh,ls_jylsh,ls_error,ls_kh,ls_sbm,ls_jylx,ls_jyh,ls_cbd,ls_err
Dec{0} ldc_zyh
DateTime ldt_jssj
ls_error = ''
FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
	ls_ywlx = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ywlx[ll_row]
	ldc_zyh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.zyh[ll_row]
	ldt_jssj = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jssj[ll_row]
	ls_mzyh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jyid[ll_row]
	ls_jylsh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jylsh[ll_row]
	ls_cbd = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.cbdxzqh[ll_row]
	
	IF Time(ldt_jssj) > Time(23:55:00) THEN
		IF MessageBox('提示',ls_jylsh + '的交易时间'+String(ldt_jssj)+'可能存在跨天，是否继续作废！',question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
			CONTINUE
		END IF
	END IF
	IF ldc_zyh > 0 THEN
		//	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh )
		//	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm)
		SELECT ybkh,zhbz Into :ls_kh,:ls_sbm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ldc_zyh;
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ls_kh
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = ls_sbm
		IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_row] < 0 THEN
			ls_jylx = 'ZYTF'
			ls_jyh = '9209'
		ELSE
			ls_jylx = 'ZYSF'
			ls_jyh = '9208'
		END IF
	ELSE
		String ls_brxm,ls_sfzh,ls_dkfs,ls_zjlx,ls_lpsj,ls_cbd4
		ls_brbm = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.BRBM[ll_row]
		SELECT JZKH,BRXM,SFZH Into :ls_knxx,:ls_brxm,:ls_sfzh From MZXT.MZ_BRDA Where BRBM = :ls_brbm;
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = ls_knxx
		IF ls_dkfs = '3' THEN
			SELECT BRXM,ZJLX,ZJHM,LPSJ INTO :ls_brxm,:ls_zjlx,:ls_sfzh,:ls_lpsj
				From JKXT.YB_BRJBXXKZ Where (ZJHM = :ls_sfzh And cbdxzqh = :ls_cbd) Or (BRBM = :ls_brbm And cbdxzqh = :ls_cbd );
			IF ls_lpsj > ' ' THEN
			ELSE
				ls_lpsj = ''
				ls_cbd4 = Left(ls_cbd,4)
				SELECT BRXM,zjlx,ZJHM,lpsj INTO :ls_brxm,:ls_zjlx,:ls_sfzh,:ls_lpsj
					From JKXT.YB_BRJBXXKZ Where (ZJHM = :ls_sfzh And substr(cbdxzqh,1,4) = :ls_cbd4) ;
				IF ls_lpsj > ' ' THEN
				ELSE
					ls_zjlx = '01'
					IF Left(ls_knxx,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
						ls_lpsj =  Mid(ls_knxx,7)
					ELSE
						MessageBox('提示','获取医保电子凭证信息失败：' + sqlca.SQLErrText )
						CONTINUE
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		IF Left(ls_knxx,6) = 'YBDZPZ' Or ls_dkfs = '3' THEN
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = ls_brxm + "|" +ls_zjlx+ "|" +ls_sfzh+'|' + ls_lpsj
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ''
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = ""
		ELSE
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = Right(ls_knxx,9)
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = Mid(ls_knxx,1,Len(ls_knxx) -9)
		END IF
		IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_row] < 0 THEN
			ls_jylx = 'MZTF'
			ls_jyh = '9204'
		ELSE
			ls_jylx = 'MZSF'
			ls_jyh = '9203'
		END IF
	END IF
	String ls_jyjg
	str_yb_jsxx_syb lstr_yb_jsxx
	
	//9203【门诊结算】，9204【门诊退费】，9205【住院登记】，9208【住院结算】，9209【住院退费】
	IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_jycx( ls_jyh, ls_mzyh, ls_cbd, ls_jyjg,lstr_yb_jsxx, ls_error) >= 0 THEN
		IF ls_jyjg <> '1' THEN
			ls_error  = '查询失败:jyjg' + ls_jyjg
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF MessageBox('提示','查询状态异常' + ls_error + ",是否继续作废？",question!,yesno! ,2) = 2 THEN RETURN
	END IF
	IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_jyzf( ldt_jssj, ls_jylFRE* sh, ls_jyh, ls_cbd, ls_err) <= 0 THEN
		ls_error += ls_mzyh +'作废失败：' + ls_err +'~r~n'
	END IF
NEXT
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	IF  ls_error = '' THEN
		MessageBox('提示','作废成功'  )
	ELSE
		MessageBox('提示','作废失败：' + ls_error)
	END IF
END IF



end event

event ue_mxsc();//省移动支付才需要上传
if ddlb_ywlx.getcode( ) <> '1' then return
long ll_row
string ls_dzr,ls_return
date ld_dzr
IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(idt_end)  THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再上传')
	RETURN
ELSE
	ld_dzr = Date(idt_begin)
	ls_dzr = String(ld_dzr,'yyyymmdd')
	IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','对账时间'+String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')+'与对账信息汇总中的对账日' + ls_dzr+'不一致,请重新统计汇总')
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_init('8032')
gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add('结算日期',String(ld_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd'))
gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add('总记录条数',integer(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount()))
gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add('本次上传的明细条数',integer(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount()))
gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( '交易明细列表')
for ll_row = 1 to tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount()
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '第三方支付订单号', string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.dsfzfddh[ll_row]), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '参保地结算流水号', string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.jsjylsh[ll_row]), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '参保地行政代码', string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.cbdxzqh[ll_row]), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '门诊序列号', string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.brbm[ll_row]), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '社会保障卡卡号', string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.shbzkkh[ll_row]), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '姓名', string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.brxm[ll_row]), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '交易时间', string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.jssj[ll_row],'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '医疗费用总额', Round(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.ylfyze[ll_row],2), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '报销金额', Round(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.hjzf[ll_row],2), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '个人现金支付', Round(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.grxj[ll_row],2), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '交易类型', 1, ll_row)
