public subroutine wf_delrep (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end);u_datastore luds_del
luds_del = Create u_datastore
luds_del.DataObject = 'd_jsjylsh_syddel'
luds_del.SetTransObject(SQLCA)
luds_del.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end)

Long ll_rowcount,ll_zyh,ll_cur
String ls_brbm,ls_jsjylsh,ls_mxzdh
ll_rowcount = luds_del.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[1]
	ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[1]
	ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[1]
	ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[1]
	
	FOR ll_cur = 2 To ll_rowcount
		IF ll_zyh = 0 THEN
			IF ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur] THEN
				luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur]
				ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[ll_cur]
				ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur] THEN
				luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur]
				ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[ll_cur]
				ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT

END IF

gf_begin_transaction(SQLCA)
IF luds_del.Update( ) = 1 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(SQLCA)
//	MessageBox('提示','保存成功!')
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(SQLCA)
	MessageBox('提示','del失败')
END IF


end subroutine

blocks.text:
public function integer wf_update_zjk (string ls_brbm, string ls_fplsh, string ls_fplsh_new);
UPDATE h_mz_ycfp Set fplsh = :ls_fplsh_new Where brbm = :ls_brbm And fplsh = :ls_fplsh ;
IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	UPDATE h_mz_ycfp_zffs Set fplsh = :ls_fplsh_new Where brbm = :ls_brbm And fplsh = :ls_fplsh ;
	IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		UPDATE mz_yjk1 Set fplsh = :ls_fplsh_new Where brbm = :ls_brbm And fplsh = :ls_fplsh ;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			gf_applog(ls_fplsh +":"+ sqlca.SQLErrText)
			GOTO Error
		ELSE
			UPDATE zjk.yj_lisjk Set fplsh = :ls_fplsh_new  Where brbm = :ls_brbm And fplsh = :ls_fplsh ;
			IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
				UPDATE zjk.yj_tjjk Set fplsh = :ls_fplsh_new  Where brbm = :ls_brbm And fplsh = :ls_fplsh ;
				IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
					UPDATE jkxt.yb_jsmx Set YWlsh = :ls_fplsh_new Where brbm = :ls_brbm And YWlsh = :ls_fplsh and ywlx ='SF' ;
					IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
						gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
					ELSE
						gf_applog(ls_fplsh +":"+ 'yb_jsmx:'+sqlca.SQLErrText)
						GOTO Error
					END IF
				ELSE
					gf_applog(ls_fplsh +":"+ 'yj_tjjk更新失败:'+sqlca.SQLErrText)
					GOTO Error
				END IF
			ELSE
				gf_applog(ls_fplsh +":"+ 'yj_lisjk更新失败:'+sqlca.SQLErrText)
				GOTO Error
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSE
		gf_applog(ls_fplsh +":"+ 'h_mz_ycfp_zffs更新失败:'+sqlca.SQLErrText)
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_applog(ls_fplsh +":"+ 'h_mz_ycfp更新失败:'+sqlca.SQLErrText)
	GOTO Error
END IF
RETURN 1
Error:
gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
RETURN -1




end function

event clicked;String ls_brbm,ls_fplsh,ls_brxm
Long ll_rowcount,ll_cur,li_yjkrowcount,ll_row,li_index,ll_bh,ll_sfxm2,ll_tjm2,ll_sfxm ,ll_tjxm ,k,ll_yybz,ll_yhms,li_cfkrowcount,ll_cfmxcount,j
DateTime ldt_kpsj
u_datastore ds_sfmx,ds_fpk,ds_yjk,ds_yjk2_sfxm,ds_cfk,ds_cfmx
ll_yhms = 1
ll_rowcount = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_2.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	Dec{2} ldc_ce,ldc_zje,ldc_yhje,ld_jzje = 0.00,ld_zfje = 0.00,ld_sumjzje,ld_sumzfje,ld_sum_xmzje,ld_sl,ld_szfbl,ldc_yhje_sum,ldc_bscje,ld_mx_jzje,ld_mx_zfje
	Dec{4} ld_xmdj
	Dec{0} ldc_yjlsh,ldc_cflsh,ld_lsh //,ll_ghlsh,ll_yjlshgl,
	String ls_czybm,ls_ysbm,ls_sfxm,ls_tjm,ls_czbz,ls_xmmc
	Boolean lb_qtbz = False
	Long ll_ypxh,ll_ypcd
	//sfmx
	ds_sfmx = Create u_datastore
	ds_sfmx.DataObject = 'd_cwsf_mz_sfmx'
	ds_sfmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	//fpk
	ds_fpk = Create u_datastore
	ds_fpk.DataObject = 'd_cwsf_mz_sf'
	ds_fpk.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	//yjk
	ds_yjk = Create u_datastore
	ds_yjk.DataObject = 'd_ycrj_yjk' //医技库
	ds_yjk.SetTransObject(sqlca)
	ds_yjk2_sfxm = Create u_datastore
	ds_yjk2_sfxm.DataObject = 'd_ycrj_yjk2'
	ds_yjk2_sfxm.SetTransObject(sqlca)
	//cfk	
	ds_cfk = Create u_datastore
	ds_cfk.DataObject = 'd_ycrj_cfk' //处方库
	ds_cfk.SetTransObject(sqlca)
	ds_cfmx = Create u_datastore
	ds_cfmx.DataObject = 'd_ycrj_cfmx'
	ds_cfmx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
		ldc_zje = 0.00
		ldc_yhje = 0.00
		ld_sumjzje = 0.00
		ld_sumzfje = 0.00
		ld_sum_xmzje = 0.00
		ldc_ce = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_2.Object.ce[ll_cur] * -1
		IF ldc_ce = 0 Or IsNull(ldc_ce) THEN CONTINUE
		ls_brbm =  tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_2.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
		ls_fplsh =  tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_2.Object.fplsh[ll_cur]
		ds_fpk.Retrieve(ls_fplsh )
		IF ds_fpk.RowCount( ) <= 0 THEN
			gf_applog(ls_fplsh + 'fpk找不到记录')
			CONTINUE
		ELSE
			ls_brxm = ds_fpk.Object.brxm[1]
			ldt_kpsj = ds_fpk.Object.kpsj[1]
			ll_yybz = Long(ds_fpk.Object.yybz[1])
		END IF
		ds_sfmx.Retrieve(ls_fplsh )
		li_yjkrowcount = ds_yjk.Retrieve(ls_fplsh,ls_brbm)
		IF li_yjkrowcount > 0 THEN
			FOR ll_row = 1 To li_yjkrowcount
				ldc_yjlsh = ds_yjk.Object.yjlsh[ll_row]
				IF ds_sfmx.Find("ywlx = 'YJ' AND YWLSH = "+String(ldc_yjlsh),1,ds_sfmx.RowCount()) > 0 THEN CONTINUE
				ls_czybm = ds_yjk.Object.czybm[ll_row]
				ldc_yjlsh = ds_yjk.Object.yjlsh[ll_row]
				ls_ysbm = ds_yjk.Object.ysbm[ll_row]
				ls_sfxm = ds_yjk.Object.sfxm[ll_row]
				ls_tjm = ds_yjk.Object.tjm[ll_row]
				//======对yj中的明细按收费项目汇总======== //
				IF IsNull(ls_sfxm)  THEN ls_sfxm = ''
				IF IsNull(ls_tjm)  THEN ls_tjm = ''
				IF ls_sfxm = '' Or ls_tjm = '' THEN
					ll_bh = ds_yjk.Object.bh[ll_row]
					SELECT nvl(fygb,0),nvl(wyey_tjm,0) Into :ll_sfxm2,:ll_tjm2 From gy_ylsf  Where fyxh = :ll_bh Using sqlca;
					IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
						IF ls_sfxm = '' THEN
							ls_sfxm = String(ll_sfxm2)
						END IF
						IF ls_tjm = '' THEN
							ls_tjm = String(ll_tjm2)
						END IF
					ELSE
						IF ls_sfxm = '' THEN
							ls_sfxm = '0'
						END IF
						IF ls_tjm = '' THEN
							ls_tjm = '0'
						END IF
						gf_applog(String(ll_bh) +"  获取sfxm和tjm失败null" + sqlca.SQLErrText)
					END IF
				END IF
				ll_sfxm = Long(ls_sfxm)
				ll_tjxm = Long(ls_tjm)
				ls_czbz = Lower(ds_yjk.Object.czbz[ll_row])
				//czbz为z的(全退)发票结转的时候均为0
				IF ls_czbz = 'z' THEN
					ld_jzje = 0
					ld_zfje = 0
				ELSE
					lb_qtbz = False
					ld_jzje = ds_yjk.Object.jzje[ll_row]
					ld_zfje = ds_yjk.Object.zfje[ll_row]
				END IF
				
				ld_sumjzje += ld_jzje
				ld_sumzfje += ld_zfje
				ld_sum_xmzje = ld_sumjzje + ld_sumzfje
				ds_yjk2_sfxm.Reset()
				IF ls_czybm = '11' Or ls_czybm = '5'  Or ls_czybm = '12' THEN //有yjk2
					ds_yjk2_sfxm.Retrieve(ldc_yjlsh)
					IF ds_yjk2_sfxm.RowCount() > 0 THEN
						FOR k = 1 To  ds_yjk2_sfxm.RowCount()
							ll_bh = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.bh[k]
							ld_xmdj = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.dj[k]
							ld_szfbl = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.szfbl[k]
							IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 1
							ls_xmmc = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.pm[k]
							IF IsNull(ls_xmmc) THEN ls_xmmc = ''
							IF ls_czbz = 'z' THEN
								ld_sl = 0
								ld_mx_jzje = 0
								ld_mx_zfje = 0
								ldc_yhje = 0
							ELSE
								lb_qtbz = False
								ld_sl = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.sl[k]
								ld_mx_jzje = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.jzje[k]
								ld_mx_zfje = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.zfje[k]
								ldc_yhje = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.yhje[k]
								ld_lsh = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.lsh[k]
								IF IsNull(ld_mx_jzje) THEN ld_mx_jzje = 0
								IF IsNull(ld_mx_zfje) THEN ld_mx_zfje = 0
							END IF
							IF IsNull(ldc_yhje) THEN ldc_yhje = 0
							ldc_yhje_sum += ldc_yhje
							//由于mz_yjk1所对应的sfxm和tjm和mz_yjk2中的项目会不一致，所以mz_yjk2的sfxm和tjm都重新获取
							SELECT fygb,wyey_tjm INTO :ll_sfxm2,:ll_tjm2 FROM gy_ylsf
								Where fyxh = :ll_bh Using sqlca;
							IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
								ll_sfxm2 = ll_sfxm
								ll_tjm2 = ll_tjxm
								gf_applog(String(ll_bh) +"  获取sfxm和tjm失败：(yjlsh2 = '"+String(ldc_yjlsh)+"')" + sqlca.SQLErrText)
							END IF
							//ll_sfxm2,ll_tjm2
							//插入发票明细
							li_index = ds_sfmx.InsertRow(0)
							ds_sfmx.Object.fplsh[li_index] = ls_fplsh
							ds_sfmx.Object.brbm[li_index] = ls_brbm
							ds_sfmx.Object.brxm[li_index] = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,20)
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmlsh[li_index] = ll_bh
							ds_sfmx.Object.cdlsh[li_index] = 0
							ds_sfmx.Object.sfxm[li_index] = ll_sfxm2
							ds_sfmx.Object.tjxm[li_index] = ll_tjm2
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmmc[li_index] = ls_xmmc
							ds_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[li_index] = ldc_yjlsh
							ds_sfmx.Object.ywlx[li_index] = 'YJ'
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmdj[li_index] = ld_xmdj
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmsl[li_index] = ld_sl
							ds_sfmx.Object.zjje[li_index] = Round(ld_xmdj * ld_sl,2)
							ds_sfmx.Object.zfje[li_index] = ld_mx_zfje
							ds_sfmx.Object.yhje[li_index] = ldc_yhje
							ds_sfmx.Object.zfbl[li_index] = ld_szfbl
							ds_sfmx.Object.ysbm[li_index] = ls_ysbm
							ds_sfmx.Object.yqbm[li_index] = ll_yybz
							ds_sfmx.Object.ztbz[li_index] = 0
							ds_sfmx.Object.sfybm[li_index] = '9999'
							ds_sfmx.Object.sfsj[li_index] = ldt_kpsj
							ds_sfmx.Object.sjpjh[li_index] = '0'
							ds_sfmx.Object.mxxh[li_index] = ld_lsh
							ds_sfmx.Object.czybm[li_index] = ls_czybm
						NEXT
					END IF
					//======对yj中的明细按收费项目汇总======== //
				ELSE
					//插入发票明细
					ll_bh = ds_yjk.Object.bh[ll_row]
					ld_xmdj = ds_yjk.Object.dj[ll_row]
					IF ls_czbz = 'z' THEN
						ld_sl = 0
						ldc_yhje = 0
					ELSE
						lb_qtbz = False
						ld_sl = ds_yjk.Object.sl[ll_row]
						ldc_yhje = ds_yjk.Object.yhje[ll_row]
					END IF
					IF IsNull(ldc_yhje) THEN ldc_yhje = 0
					ldc_yhje_sum += ldc_yhje
					//					ld_sl = ds_yjk.Object.sl[ll_row]
					ld_szfbl = ds_yjk.Object.szfbl[ll_row]
					IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 1
					SELECT fymc Into :ls_xmmc From gy_ylsf Where fyxh = :ll_bh Using sqlca;
					IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
						SELECT fymc INTO :ls_xmmc FROM gy_ylsf
							Where fyxh = :ll_bh Using sqlca;
						IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
							ls_xmmc = ''
							gf_applog(String(ll_bh) +"  获取收费项目名称失败：(yjlsh = '"+String(ldc_yjlsh)+"')" + sqlca.SQLErrText)
						END IF
					END IF
					IF IsNull(ls_xmmc) THEN ls_xmmc = ''
					li_index = ds_sfmx.InsertRow(0)
					ds_sfmx.Object.fplsh[li_index] = ls_fplsh
					ds_sfmx.Object.brbm[li_index] = ls_brbm
					ds_sfmx.Object.brxm[li_index] = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,20)
					ds_sfmx.Object.xmlsh[li_index] = ll_bh
					ds_sfmx.Object.cdlsh[li_index] = 0
					ds_sfmx.Object.sfxm[li_index] = ll_sfxm
					ds_sfmx.Object.tjxm[li_index] = ll_tjxm
					ds_sfmx.Object.xmmc[li_index] = ls_xmmc
					ds_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[li_index] = ldc_yjlsh
					ds_sfmx.Object.ywlx[li_index] = 'YJ'
					ds_sfmx.Object.xmdj[li_index] = ld_xmdj
					ds_sfmx.Object.xmsl[li_index] = ld_sl
					ds_sfmx.Object.zjje[li_index] = Round(ld_xmdj * ld_sl,2 ) //ld_jzje + ld_zfje
					ds_sfmx.Object.zfje[li_index] = ld_zfje
					ds_sfmx.Object.yhje[li_index] = ldc_yhje
					ds_sfmx.Object.zfbl[li_index] = ld_szfbl
					ds_sfmx.Object.ysbm[li_index] = ls_ysbm
					ds_sfmx.Object.yqbm[li_index] = ll_yybz
					ds_sfmx.Object.ztbz[li_index] = 0
					ds_sfmx.Object.sfybm[li_index] = '9999'
					ds_sfmx.Object.sfsj[li_index] = ldt_kpsj
					ds_sfmx.Object.sjpjh[li_index] = '0'
					ds_sfmx.Object.mxxh[li_index] = 0
					ds_sfmx.Object.czybm[li_index] = ls_czybm
				END IF
			NEXT
			
			//将取出来的流水号在处方库里检索一遍,如果有则生成发票明细和发票
			li_cfkrowcount = ds_cfk.Retrieve(ls_fplsh,ls_brbm)
			IF li_cfkrowcount > 0 THEN
				FOR ll_row = 1 To li_cfkrowcount
					ldc_cflsh = ds_cfk.Object.cflsh[ll_row]
					IF ds_sfmx.Find("ywlx = 'CF' AND YWLSH = "+String(ldc_cflsh),1,ds_sfmx.RowCount()) > 0 THEN CONTINUE
					ls_ysbm = ds_cfk.Object.ysbm[ll_row]
					ls_czbz = Lower(ds_cfk.Object.fybz[ll_row])
					
					//----------------------------
					CHOOSE CASE Upper(ds_cfk.Object.cflb[ll_row])
						CASE '1','M','J','J2','J1','D' //cflb,小写变大写
							ls_sfxm = '1' //sfxm由01->1
							ll_sfxm = 1
						CASE 'K' //颗粒
							ls_sfxm = '3'
							ll_sfxm = 3
						CASE ELSE
							ls_sfxm = Upper(ds_cfk.Object.cflb[ll_row])
							ll_sfxm  = Long(ls_sfxm)
							IF ll_sfxm = 0 THEN ll_sfxm = 1
					END CHOOSE
					ls_tjm = ls_sfxm
					ll_tjxm = ll_sfxm
					IF ls_czbz = 'z' THEN
						ld_jzje = 0
						ld_zfje = 0
						ldc_yhje = 0
					ELSE
						lb_qtbz = False
						ld_jzje = ds_cfk.Object.jzje[ll_row]
						ld_zfje = ds_cfk.Object.zfje[ll_row]
						ldc_yhje = ds_cfk.Object.yhje[ll_row]
						IF IsNull(ld_jzje) THEN
							ld_jzje = 0
						END IF
						IF IsNull(ld_zfje) THEN
							ld_zfje = 0
						END IF
						IF IsNull(ldc_yhje) THEN ldc_yhje = 0
					END IF
					ld_sumjzje += ld_jzje
					ld_sumzfje += ld_zfje
					//				ldc_yhje_sum += ldc_yhje
					ld_sum_xmzje = ld_sumjzje + ld_sumzfje
					ll_cfmxcount = ds_cfmx.Retrieve(ldc_cflsh)
					//生成发票明细,插入发票明细库中
					IF ll_cfmxcount > 0 THEN
						IF ds_cfmx.Find( 'yhms = 1', 1, 9999) > 0 THEN ll_yhms = 1
						FOR j = 1 To ll_cfmxcount
							ll_ypxh = ds_cfmx.Object.ypxh[j]
							ll_ypcd = ds_cfmx.Object.ypcd[j]
							ld_lsh = ds_cfmx.Object.xh[j]
							ld_xmdj = ds_cfmx.Object.dj[j]
							IF ls_czbz = 'z' THEN
								ld_mx_jzje = 0
								ld_mx_zfje = 0
								ldc_yhje = 0
								ld_sl = 0
							ELSE
								lb_qtbz = False
								ld_mx_jzje = ds_cfmx.Object.jzje[j]
								ld_mx_zfje = ds_cfmx.Object.zfje[j]
								ldc_yhje = ds_cfmx.Object.yhje[j]
								ld_sl = ds_cfmx.Object.fs[j] * ds_cfmx.Object.sl[j]
								IF IsNull(ld_mx_jzje) THEN
									ld_mx_jzje = 0
								END IF
								IF IsNull(ld_mx_zfje) THEN
									ld_mx_zfje = 0
								END IF
							END IF
							IF IsNull(ldc_yhje) THEN ldc_yhje = 0
							ldc_yhje_sum = ldc_yhje_sum + ldc_yhje
							ld_szfbl = ds_cfmx.Object.szfbl[j]
							IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 0
							SELECT ypmc Into :ls_xmmc From yk_typk Where ypxh = :ll_ypxh Using sqlca;
							IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
								gf_applog(String(ll_ypxh) +"  获取褼AT* ┢访�称失败� (cflsh = '"+String(ldc_cflsh)+"')" + sqlca.SQLErrText)
								ls_xmmc = ''
							END IF
							li_index = ds_sfmx.InsertRow(0)
							ds_sfmx.Object.fplsh[li_index] = ls_fplsh
							ds_sfmx.Object.brbm[li_index] = ls_brbm
							ds_sfmx.Object.brxm[li_index] = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,20)
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmlsh[li_index] = ll_ypxh
							ds_sfmx.Object.cdlsh[li_index] = ll_ypcd
							ds_sfmx.Object.sfxm[li_index] = ll_sfxm
							ds_sfmx.Object.tjxm[li_index] = ll_tjxm
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmmc[li_index] = ls_xmmc
							ds_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[li_index] = ldc_cflsh
							ds_sfmx.Object.ywlx[li_index] = 'CF'
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmdj[li_index] = ld_xmdj
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmsl[li_index] = ld_sl
							ds_sfmx.Object.zjje[li_index] = Round(ld_xmdj * ld_sl,2) //ld_mx_jzje + ld_mx_zfje
							ds_sfmx.Object.zfje[li_index] = ld_mx_zfje
							ds_sfmx.Object.yhje[li_index] = ldc_yhje
							ds_sfmx.Object.zfbl[li_index] = ld_szfbl
							ds_sfmx.Object.ysbm[li_index] = ls_ysbm
							ds_sfmx.Object.yqbm[li_index] = ll_yybz
							ds_sfmx.Object.ztbz[li_index] = 0
							ds_sfmx.Object.sfybm[li_index] = '9999'
							ds_sfmx.Object.sfsj[li_index] = ldt_kpsj
							ds_sfmx.Object.sjpjh[li_index] = '0'
							ds_sfmx.Object.mxxh[li_index] = ld_lsh
							ds_sfmx.Object.czybm[li_index] = '0'
						NEXT
					END IF
				NEXT
			END IF
			
			
			
			IF ds_fpk.RowCount() = 0 Or  ds_sfmx.RowCount( ) = 0 THEN
				gf_applog("fpk，sfmx结转后明细为空" + ls_fplsh)
				CONTINUE
			ELSE
				IF ldc_ce <> ld_sum_xmzje THEN
					gf_applog("差额和新增明细总额不一致：" +String(ldc_ce) +'--' + String(ld_sum_xmzje)+ + 'fplsh:'+ ls_fplsh)
					CONTINUE
				END IF
				IF ll_yhms = 1  THEN
					ds_fpk.Object.xmzje[1] = ds_fpk.Object.xmzje[1] + ld_sum_xmzje + ldc_yhje_sum
				ELSE
					ds_fpk.Object.xmzje[1] = ds_fpk.Object.xmzje[1] + ld_sum_xmzje
				END IF
				ds_fpk.Object.xjje[1] = ds_fpk.Object.xjje[1] + ld_sum_xmzje
				ds_fpk.Object.yhje[1] = ds_fpk.Object.yhje[1] + ldc_yhje_sum
			END IF
			gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
			IF ds_sfmx.Update() <> 1 THEN
				gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
				gf_applog("ds_sfmx,更新失败：" + ds_sfmx.is_error+ ls_fplsh)
				CONTINUE
			END IF
			
			IF  ds_fpk.Update() <> 1   THEN
				gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
				gf_applog("ds_fpk更新失败：" + ds_fpk.is_error+ ls_fplsh)
				CONTINUE
			END IF
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			gf_applog("更新成功：" + ls_fplsh)
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF

IF IsValid(ds_sfmx) THEN Destroy ds_sfmx
IF IsValid(ds_fpk) THEN Destroy ds_fpk

event doubleclicked;call super::doubleclicked;IF row <= 0 Or row > This.RowCount( ) THEN RETURN
IF tab_1.tabpage_4.dw_8.DataObject = 'd_zypj_cl' THEN
	
	
	String ls_zsm,ls_xm,ls_pjlx,ls_error
	DateTime ldt_rq
	Long ll_kcbc
	ls_zsm = This.Object.zsm[row]
	ldt_rq = This.Object.rq[row]
	ls_xm = This.Object.xm[row]
	ls_pjlx = This.Object.pjlx[row]
	IF This.Object.bqkcs[row] < 0 THEN
		ll_kcbc = This.Object.bqkcs[row] * -1
		UPDATE gy_pjsfc SET bqkcs = 0, sys = sys - :ll_kcbc,dqsjkcs = 0
			Where zsm = :ls_zsm And pjlx = :ls_pjlx  And rq = :ldt_rq ;
			
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			ls_error = sqlca.SQLErrText
			ROLLBACK Using sqlca;
			MessageBox('1','sb'  + ls_error)
			RETURN
		END IF
		ldt_rq = This.Object.rq[row + 1]
		UPDATE gy_pjsfc SET sqkcs = 0, sys = sys + :ll_kcbc
			Where zsm = :ls_zsm And pjlx = :ls_pjlx  And rq = :ldt_rq ;
			
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			COMMIT Using sqlca;
			MessageBox('1','cg')
		ELSE
			ls_error = sqlca.SQLErrText
			ROLLBACK Using sqlca;
			MessageBox('2','sb'  + ls_error)
		END IF
		ldt_rq = This.Object.rq[row]
		em_3.setdate(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_rq),-1))
	ELSE
		ll_kcbc = Long(gf_inputbox('请输入需要补差的差','0'))
		em_3.setdate(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_rq),-1))
		UPDATE gy_pjsfc SET bqkcs = bqkcs  - :ll_kcbc, sys = sys + :ll_kcbc
			Where zsm = :ls_zsm And pjlx = :ls_pjlx  And rq = :ldt_rq ;
			
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			ls_error = sqlca.SQLErrText
			ROLLBACK Using sqlca;
			MessageBox('1','sb'  + ls_error)
			RETURN
		END IF
		UPDATE gy_pjsfc SET bqkcs = bqkcs  - :ll_kcbc, sqkcs = sqkcs - :ll_kcbc
			Where zsm = :ls_zsm And pjlx = :ls_pjlx  And rq > :ldt_rq ;
			
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			COMMIT Using sqlca;
			MessageBox('1','cg')
		ELSE
			ls_error = sqlca.SQLErrText
			ROLLBACK Using sqlca;
			MessageBox('2','sb'  + ls_error)
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

wf_filter
blocks.text:
public subroutine wf_filter ();String ls_bz,ls_filter,ls_title
ls_bz = ddlb_zhlb.getcode( )

ls_filter = ''
ls_title = ''
IF Lower(ls_bz) = 'z' THEN
	ls_filter = ''
ELSEIF Lower(ls_bz) = 'y' THEN
	ls_filter = "cbrlb <> 'E00'"
	ls_title = "(" + ddlb_zhlb.text + ")"
ELSE
	ls_filter = "cbrlb = '"+ls_bz+"'"
	ls_title = "(" + ddlb_zhlb.text + ")"
END IF

IF rb_yd.Checked THEN
	IF ls_filter > ''  then
		ls_filter += " AND "
	END IF
	ls_filter += " lx = 'YD'"
	ls_title += "-----异地"
ELSEIF rb_bd.Checked THEN
	IF ls_filter > ''  then
		ls_filter += " AND "
	END IF
	ls_filter += "lx = 'BD'"
	ls_title += "-----本地"
END IF

dw_main.SetFilter( ls_filter)
dw_main.Filter( )

dw_main.Object.Title.Text = Base_info.Hospital + '门诊医疗保险病人费用结算明细表' + ls_title
end subroutine

event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;DateTime ldt_start,ldt_end
Long ll_count
String ls_ywlx,ls_title
Integer li_byd = 0
dw_main.Reset()

ldt_start = DateTime(em_begin.getdate(),Time('00:00:00'))
ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(em_end.getdate(),1),Time('00:00:00'))
IF rb_mz.Checked THEN
	ls_title = '医保公费门诊记账计算总表'
ELSEIF rb_zy.Checked THEN
	ls_title = '医保公费住院记账计算总表'
END IF
IF is_yqpd = 'CNSY' THEN
	IF rb_qb.Checked THEN
		li_byd = 0
		ls_title = ls_title
	ELSEIF rb_bd.Checked THEN
		li_byd = 1
		ls_title = ls_title + '（本地）'
	ELSEIF rb_yd.Checked THEN
		li_byd = 2
		ls_title = ls_title + '（异地）'
	END IF
	dw_main.Retrieve(ldt_start,ldt_end,li_byd)
	dw_main.Object.t_yymc.Text = base_info.hospital
	dw_main.Object.title.Text = String(ldt_start,'yyyy年mm月dd日')+ ' 至 '+String(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_end),-1),'yyyy年mm月dd日') + ls_title
ELSE
	dw_main.Retrieve(ldt_start,ldt_end)
	//过滤
	wf_filter()
	//dw_main.Object.Title.Text = Base_info.Hospital + '门诊医疗保险病人费用结算明细表'
END IF
//-------------------------------
dw_main.Object.tjrq.Text = '统计日期：'+String(ldt_start,'yyyy.mm.dd')+ ' 至 '+String(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_end),-1),'yyyy.mm.dd')
dw_main.Object.zbr.Text = Base_info.username
ll_count = dw_main.RowCount()
IF ll_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','该时间段没有当前类别病人的交易数据')
END IF

blocks.text:
event ue_find;call super::ue_find;Int i,li_count,li_row
Long ll_find
DateTime ldt_start,ldt_end
datastore lds_sbjymx
String ls_jymx_yblx,ls_tgdw_yblx,ls_yblx,ls_zbrxm,ls_zbrbm,ls_dwmc
Dec ldc_sjzs,ldc_jzrc,ldc_sjzs_t
Dec {2} ldc_fpjzje,ld_jzce
ls_zbrxm = base_info.username
ls_zbrbm = base_info.UserID
ls_dwmc = ddlb_yblb.Text
ldt_start = DateTime(Date(em_1.Text),Time('00:00:00'))
ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(em_2.Text),1),Time('00:00:00'))

if date(ldt_start) > date(2011,9,2) or  date(ldt_end) > date(2011,9,3) then
	messagebox('提示','20110903之前和以后的数据请分开统计，20110903之后的数据请在新医保月汇总报表中统计!')
	return
end if
dw_main.Reset( )
ls_yblx = ddlb_yblb.getcode()
lds_sbjymx = Create datastore
lds_sbjymx.DataObject = 'd_sbjymx'
lds_sbjymx.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
lds_sbjymx.Retrieve(ldt_start, ldt_end)
dw_main.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
dw_main.Retrieve(ls_yblx)
li_count = lds_sbjymx.RowCount( )
li_row = dw_main.RowCount( )
gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',1)
IF li_count > 0 THEN
	IF li_row > 0 THEN
		FOR i = 1 To li_row
			gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',(i*100/li_row))
			ll_find = 0
			ldc_sjzs = 0
			ldc_fpjzje = 0.00
			ls_tgdw_yblx = dw_main.Object.yblx[i]
			ll_find = lds_sbjymx.Find( "yblx='"+String(ls_tgdw_yblx)+"'", 1, li_count)
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				SELECT  nvl(count(Distinct(fplsh)),0) Into :ldc_sjzs From sb_jymx Where xmlb Not In ('GH') And substr(zhbz,1,1) = :ls_tgdw_yblx And jssj >= :ldt_start And jssj < :ldt_end And nvl(zymz,'0') = '0' And zxlsh Is Not Null And jylx In ('RA11','RA01') using sqlca_query;
				SELECT  nvl(count(Distinct(fplsh)),0) Into :ldc_sjzs_t From sb_jymx Where xmlb Not In ('GH') And substr(zhbz,1,1) = :ls_tgdw_yblx And jssj >= :ldt_start And jssj < :ldt_end And nvl(zymz,'0') = '0' And zxlsh Is Not Null And jylx In ('SD01','RD01') using sqlca_query;
				
				SELECT  sum(NVL(dnzfs,0) + NVL(qfddnzhzfs,0) + NVL(lnzfs,0) + NVL(tcdtczfs,0) + NVL(qfdgbzfs,0) + NVL(tcdgbzfs,0) + NVL(jzdgbzfs,0) + NVL(jzdsgbzfs,0) + NVL(gbzfs,0)   + NVL(jzdjzzfs,0) + NVL(zyjjzfs,0) + NVL(jmjjzf,0) + NVL(tcdjjzfs,0) + NVL(jzzfs,0) + NVL(qfdlnzhzfs,0) + NVL(jzdslnzhzfs,0) + NVL(tcdlnzhzfs,0)) As jzje INTO :ldc_fpjzje FROM sb_jymx
					Where substr(zhbz,1,1) = :ls_tgdw_yblx And zxlsh Is Not Null And xmlb <> 'GH' And nvl(zymz,'0') = '0' And jssj >= :ldt_start And jssj < :ldt_end using sqlca_query;
				//				SELECT  nvl(Sum(mz_fpk.jzje),0) into :ldc_fpjzje From mz_fpk,gy_brxz,gy_tgdw Where mz_fpk.jslb=gy_brxz.brxz and gy_brxz.ybpb=1 And gy_brxz.brxz=gy_tgdw.brxz And gy_tgdw.tgdw=mz_fpk.jsdw And  gy_tgdw.yblx=:ls_tgdw_yblx;
				SELECT  nvl(Count(jzlsh),0) INTO :ldc_jzrc FROM mz_jzxx,gy_brxz,gy_tgdw,mz_ghxx
					WHERE mz_ghxx.jslb = gy_brxz.brxz AND gy_brxz.ybpb = 1 AND gy_brxz.brxz = gy_tgdw.brxz AND
					gy_tgdw.tgdw = mz_ghxx.jsdw And mz_ghxx.ghlsh = mz_jzxx.ghlsh  And gy_tgdw.yblx = :ls_tgdw_yblx  And mz_ghxx.ghrq >= :ldt_start And mz_ghxx.ghrq < :ldt_end using sqlca_query;
				IF IsNull(ldc_sjzs) THEN ldc_sjzs = 0
				IF IsNull(ldc_sjzs_t) THEN ldc_sjzs_t = 0
				dw_main.Object.jzje[i] = lds_sbjymx.Object.jzje[ll_find]
				dw_main.Object.zfje[i] = lds_sbjymx.Object.xjje[ll_find]
				dw_main.Object.sjzs[i] = ldc_sjzs - ldc_sjzs_t
				dw_main.Object.fpjzje[i] = ldc_fpjzje
				dw_main.Object.jzrc[i] = ldc_jzrc
			END IF
		NEXT
	ELSE
		gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',-1)
		Destroy lds_sbjymx
		MessageBox('提示','检索社保类型失败，请退出程序重试！')
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
Long ll_count,ll_cur
ll_count = dw_main.RowCount( )
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		IF dw_main.Object.compute_hjje[ll_cur] = 0 THEN
			dw_main.DeleteRow(ll_cur)
			ll_cur --
			ll_count --
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF
SELECT sum(jzce) Into :ld_jzce From sb_jejd Where kpsj >= :ldt_start And kpsj < :ldt_end using sqlca_query;
IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
//9月份存在-132.07的交易补差额
IF ld_jzce <> 0 THEN
	st_text.Text = em_1.Text+"至"+em_2.Text+",记账共计差：" +String(ld_jzce)
ELSEIF ld_jzce = 0  THEN
	st_text.Text = ''
END IF
dw_main.Object.t_dwmc.Text = '温州市社会保障局'+'['+ls_dwmc+']'
dw_main.Object.zbr.Text = '制表人:'+ls_zbrxm+'['+ls_zbrbm+']'
dw_main.Object.st_tjrq.Text = em_1.Text+' '+'至'+' '+em_2.Text
dw_main.Object.zbsj.Text = String(gf_server_date(),'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss')
Destroy lds_sbjymx
gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',-1)






end event

event ue_zxdz();String ls_dzr, ls_return, ls_dzjg
Long ll_jyzbs, ll_zcxfbs, ll_tkjybs
Decimal{2} ldc_zfzje, ldc_zcxfje, ldc_tkjyje

Boolean lb_smkdz

//判断是否统计汇总过，汇总日期是否与显示一致
IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(idt_end) Or dw_1.RowCount( ) <= 0 Or IsNull(dw_1.Object.qsrq[1]) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再对账')
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.qsrq[1]
	IF IsNull(ls_dzr) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再对账')
		RETURN
	ELSE
		IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
			MessageBox('提示','对账时间' + String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') + '与对账信息汇总中的对账菵AT* ' + ls_dzr + '不一致,请重新统计汇总')
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.qsrq[1]
ll_jyzbs = dw_1.Object.jyzbs[1]
ldc_zfzje = dw_1.Object.zhzfzje[1]
ll_zcxfbs = dw_1.Object.zcxfbs[1]
ldc_zcxfje = dw_1.Object.zhzcxfje[1]
ll_tkjybs = dw_1.Object.tkjybs[1]
ldc_tkjyje = dw_1.Object.tkjyje[1]

IF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs ='EP'  THEN
	IF IsValid (gu_pyybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
		gu_pyybjk = Create u_pyybjk_his
		IF Not gu_pyybjk.uf_init(ls_return) THEN
			MessageBox('提示', '医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('110')
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('交易总笔数',Right('000000' + String(ll_jyzbs),6))
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('账户支付总金额',ldc_zfzje)
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('正常消费笔数',Right('000000' + String(ll_zcxfbs),6))
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('账户正常消费金额',ldc_zcxfje)
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('退款交易笔数',Right('000000' + String(ll_tkjybs),6))
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('退款交易金额',ldc_tkjyje)
	lb_smkdz = gu_pyybjk.uf_send(ls_return)
	IF lb_smkdz THEN
		ls_dzjg = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring("对帐结果")
		dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = ls_dzjg
		IF ls_dzjg = '1' THEN
			dw_1.Object.sctgsj[1] = gf_server_date()
		END IF
		gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
		IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr)
			tab_1.tabpage_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
			MessageBox("提示", "对账结果：" + ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(dzjg)', 1)")) )
		ELSE
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			MessageBox("提示", ls_dzr + '对账结果：' + ls_dzjg + ",保存失败!")
		END IF
	ELSE
		MessageBox("提示", '市民卡对账失败。' + ls_return)
	END IF
ELSE
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init('K011')
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('交易总笔数',Right('000000' + String(ll_jyzbs),6))
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('账户支付总金额',ldc_zfzje)
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('正常消费笔数',Right('000000' + String(ll_zcxfbs),6))
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('账户正常消费金额',ldc_zcxfje)
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('退款交易笔数',Right('000000' + String(ll_tkjybs),6))
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('退款交易金额',ldc_tkjyje)
	
	lb_smkdz = gu_ybjk_public.uf_send(ls_return)
	
	IF lb_smkdz THEN
		ls_dzjg = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring("对帐结果")
		dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = ls_dzjg
		IF ls_dzjg = '1' THEN
			dw_1.Object.sctgsj[1] = gf_server_date()
		END IF
		gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
		IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr)
			tab_1.tabpage_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
			MessageBox("提示", "对账结果：" + ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(dzjg)', 1)")) )
		ELSE
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			MessageBox("提示", ls_dzr + '对账结果：' + ls_dzjg + ",保存失败!")
		END IF
	ELSE
		MessageBox("提示", '市民卡对账失败。' + ls_return)
	END IF
END IF


end event

event ue_mxsc();String ls_dzr, ls_dzjg, ls_return, ls_jsbz
Long ll_row, ll_rowcount, ll_mxtop, ll_i, ll_cur
Integer li_xhcs, li_jymxts

Boolean lb_return

String ls_cbd, ls_mxzdh, ls_jsjylsh
Dec{2} ldc_zhzfje = 0.00

IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(idt_end) Or dw_1.RowCount( ) <= 0 Or IsNull(dw_1.Object.qsrq[1]) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再对账')
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.qsrq[1]
	IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','对账时间' + String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') + '与对账信息汇总中的对账日' + ls_dzr + '不一致,请重新统计汇总')
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF

IF IsNull(dw_1.Object.dzjg[1]) Or dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = '' THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先对账，再确定是否要上传不平明细。')
	RETURN
END IF

IF dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] <> '0' THEN
	MessageBox('提示','市民卡对账已完成，无需上传市民卡账户不平明细。')
	RETURN
END IF

ll_rowcount = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount( )
li_xhcs = Ceiling( ll_rowcount / ii_mxts )
IF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs ='EP' THEN //gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
	IF IsValid(gu_pyybjk) = False THEN
		gu_pyybjk = Create u_pyybjk_his
		IF gu_pyybjk.uf_init(ls_return) = False THEN
			MessageBox("提示", '医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
	
	FOR ll_i = 1 To li_xhcs
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('111')	
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
		IF ll_i * ii_mxts >= ll_rowcount THEN
			ll_mxtop = ll_rowcount
			li_jymxts = ll_rowcount - (ll_i - 1) * ii_mxts
			ls_jsbz = '1'
		ELSE
			ll_mxtop = ll_i * ii_mxts
			li_jymxts = ii_mxts
			ls_jsbz = '0'
		END IF
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体条数', Right('000000' +String(li_jymxts),6))
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否上传结束', ls_jsbz)
		ll_cur = 0
		FOR ll_row = (ll_i - 1) * ii_mxts + 1 To ll_mxtop
			ls_cbd = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.cbdxzqh[ll_row]
			ls_mxzdh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.mxzdh[ll_row]
			ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jylsh[ll_row]
			ldc_zhzfje = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.zhzfje[ll_row]
			IF ldc_zhzfje < 0 THEN
				ldc_zhzfje = -ldc_zhzfje
			END IF
			ll_cur ++
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add_in('参保地行政区划代码', ls_cbd, ll_cur)
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add_in('明细账单号', ls_mxzdh, ll_cur)
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add_in('市民卡交易流水号', ls_jsjylsh, ll_cur)
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add_in('账户支付金额', ldc_zhzfje, ll_cur)
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add_in('清算日期', ls_dzr, ll_cur)
		NEXT
		lb_return = gu_pyybjk.uf_send(ls_return)
		IF Not lb_return THEN
			MessageBox('提示','市民卡账户明细上传失败，请重新上传。' + ls_return)
			
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('111')	
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体条数', '000000')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否上传结束', '1')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体','')
			lb_return = gu_pyybjk.uf_send(ls_return)
			IF Not lb_return THEN
				MessageBox('提示', '市民卡账户明细上传失败处理异常，请用明细上传异常处理重试。')
			END IF
			RETURN
		END IF
		IF ls_jsbz = '1' THEN
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('112')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
			
			lb_return = gu_pyybjk.uf_send(ls_return)
			
			IF Not lb_return THEN
				MessageBox('提示','市民卡对账结果查询失败，请重试。' + ls_return )
				RETURN
			ELSE
				ls_dzjg = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring("对帐结果")
				dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = ls_dzjg
				gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
				IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
					gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
					dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr)
					tab_1.tabpage_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
					MessageBox("提示", "对账结果：" + ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(dzjg)', 1)")) )
				ELSE
					gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
					MessageBox("提示", ls_dzr + '对账结果：' + ls_dzjg + ",保存失败!")
				END IF
			END IF
			//	MessageBox('提示','市民卡账户明细上传成功。')
		END IF
	NEXT
ELSE
//	IF IsValid(gu_ybjk_public) = False THEN
//		gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
//		IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_init(ls_return) = False THEN
//			MessageBox("提示", '医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
//			RETURN
//		END IF
//	END IF
	//w_smkdz.SetRedraw(False)
	FOR ll_i = 1 To li_xhcs
		gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init('K012')
		gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
		IF ll_i * ii_mxts >= ll_rowcount THEN
			ll_mxtop = ll_rowcount
			li_jymxts = ll_rowcount - (ll_i - 1) * ii_mxts
			ls_jsbz = '1'
		ELSE
			ll_mxtop = ll_i * ii_mxts
			li_jymxts = ii_mxts
			ls_jsbz = '0'
		END IF
		gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体条数', Right('000000' +String(li_jymxts),6))
		gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('是否上传结束', ls_jsbz)
		//	gu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体','')
		ll_cur = 0
		FOR ll_row = (ll_i - 1) * ii_mxts + 1 To ll_mxtop
			ls_cbd = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.cbdxzqh[ll_row]
			ls_mxzdh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.mxzdh[ll_row]
			ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jylsh[ll_row]
			ldc_zhzfje = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.zhzfje[ll_row]
			IF ldc_zhzfje < 0 THEN
				ldc_zhzfje = -ldc_zhzfje
			END IF
			ll_cur ++
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in('参保地行政区划代码', ls_cbd, ll_cur)
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in('明细账单号', ls_mxzdh, ll_cur)
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in('市民卡交易流水号', ls_jsjylsh, ll_cur)
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in('账户支付金额', ldc_zhzfje, ll_cur)
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in('清算日期', ls_dzr, ll_cur)
		NEXT
		lb_return = gu_ybjk_public.uf_send(ls_return)
		IF Not lb_return THEN
			MessageBox('提示','市民卡账户明细上传失败，请重新上传。' + ls_return)
			
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init('K012')
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体条数', '000000')
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('蔇AT* 欠裆洗�结� ', '1')
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体','')
			lb_return = gu_ybjk_public.uf_send(ls_return)
			IF Not lb_return THEN
				MessageBox('提示', '市民卡账户明细上传失败处理异常，请用明细上传异常处理重试。')
			END IF
			//	w_smkdz.SetRedraw(true)
			RETURN
		END IF
		//END IF	
		IF ls_jsbz = '1' THEN
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init('K013')
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
			
			lb_return = gu_ybjk_public.uf_send(ls_return)
			
			IF Not lb_return THEN
				MessageBox('提示','市民卡对账结果查询失败，请重试。' + ls_return )
				RETURN
			ELSE
				ls_dzjg = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring("对帐结果")
				dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = ls_dzjg
				gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
				IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
					gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
					dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr)
					tab_1.tabpage_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
					MessageBox("提示", "对账结果：" + ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(dzjg)', 1)")) )
				ELSE
					gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
					MessageBox("提示", ls_dzr + '对账结果：' + ls_dzjg + ",保存失败!")
				END IF
			END IF
			//	MessageBox('提示','市民卡账户明细上传成功。')
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF
//w_smkdz.SetRedraw(true)



end event

	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计并对账。')
	RETURN
END IF

	IF IsValid(gu_pyybjk) = False THEN

		dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = ls_dzjg
		IF ls_dzjg = '3' And IsNull(dw_1.Object.sctgsj[1]) THEN
			dw_1.Object.sctgsj[1] = gf_server_date()
		END IF
		gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
		IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr)
			tab_1.tabpage_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
			MessageBox("提示", "对账结果：" + ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(dzjg)', 1)")) )
		ELSE
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			MessageBox("提示", ls_dzr + '对账结果：' + ls_dzjg + ",保存失败!")
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
//	IF IsValid (gu_ybjk_public) = False THEN //创建褼AT*

//		gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
//		IF Not gu_ybjk_public.uf_init(ls_return) THEN
//			MessageBox('提示', '医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
//			RETURN
//		END IF
//	END IF
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init('K013')
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
	
	lb_return = gu_ybjk_public.uf_send(ls_return)
	
	IF Not lb_return THEN
		MessageBox('提示','市民卡对账结果查询失败，请重试。' + ls_return )
		RETURN
	ELSE
		ls_dzjg = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring("对帐结果")
		dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = ls_dzjg
		IF ls_dzjg = '3' And IsNull(dw_1.Object.sctgsj[1]) THEN
			dw_1.Object.sctgsj[1] = gf_server_date()
		END IF
		gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
		IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr)
			tab_1.tabpage_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
			MessageBox("提示", "对账结果：" + ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(dzjg)', 1)")) )
		ELSE
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			MessageBox("提示", ls_dzr + '对账结果：' + ls_dzjg + ",保存失败!")
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

blocks.text:
public function integer wf_dzyz ();
u_datastore lds_bpmx
lds_bpmx = Create u_datastore

String ls_bpmx, ls_sql
Long ll_rowcount, ll_temp

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',1)

//校验市民卡账户支付金额（医保）
//=======================核对==============================//
Dec{2} ldc_zhzfje, ldc_smkzhzf,ldc_smkzhzf_py

SELECT SUM(nvl(zhzfje,0)) INTO :ldc_zhzfje FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	Where qsrq >= :idt_begin And qsrq < :idt_end And (jslb = 'XF' Or jslb = 'TK') And ztbz > 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_zhzfje) THEN ldc_zhzfje = 0.00

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',30)

SELECT SUM(nvl(smkzhzf,0)) INTO :ldc_smkzhzf FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
	Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And ztbz > 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_smkzhzf) THEN ldc_smkzhzf = 0.00
// add by sxl 平阳市民卡诊间结算
IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
	SELECT SUM(nvl(smkzhzf,0)) INTO :ldc_smkzhzf_py FROM jkxt.pyyb_jsmx
		Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And ztbz > 0;
END IF
IF IsNull(ldc_smkzhzf_py) THEN ldc_smkzhzf_py = 0.00
gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',60)

IF ldc_zhzfje <> (ldc_smkzhzf + ldc_smkzhzf_py) THEN
	IF ldc_smkzhzf_py > 0 THEN
		ls_sql = "SELECT brbm, Sum(je) From " +&
			"(SELECT sum(nvl(zhzfje,0)) je, brbm From jkxt.yb_zjjs " +&
			"Where qsrq >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
			"And qsrq < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0 " +&
			"And (jslb = 'XF' Or jslb = 'TK') And jylsh Is Not Null And ztbz > 0 Group By brbm " +&
			"Union All " +&
			"SELECT sum(nvl(smkzhzf,0)) * -1 je, brbm FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx " +&
			"Where jssj >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
			"And jssj < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(smkzhzf,0) <> 0 " +&
			"And ztbz > 0 Group By brbm " +&
			"Union All " +&
			"SELECT sum(nvl(smkzhzf,0)) * -1 je, brbm FROM jkxt.pyyb_jsmx " +&
			"Where jssj >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
			"And jssj < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(smkzhzf,0) <> 0 " +&
			"And ztbz > 0 Group By brbm) " +&
			"Group By brbm " +&
			"Having Sum(je) <> 0"
	ELSE
		ls_sql = "SELECT brbm, Sum(je) From " +&
			"(SELECT sum(nvl(zhzfje,0)) je, brbm From jkxt.yb_zjjs " +&
			"Where qsrq >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
			"And qsrq < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0 " +&
			"And (jslb = 'XF' Or jslb = 'TK') And jylsh Is Not Null And ztbz > 0 Group By brbm " +&
			"Union All " +&
			"SELECT sum(nvl(smkzhzf,0)) * -1 je, brbm FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx " +&
			"Where jssj >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
			"And jssj < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(smkzhzf,0) <> 0 " +&
			"And ztbz > 0 Group By brbm) " +&
			"Group By brbm " +&
			"Having Sum(je) <> 0"
	END IF
	IF lds_bpmx.createfromsql( ls_sql ) < 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('医保病人市民卡账户支付金额不一致......',-1)
		MessageBox('提示','医保病人市民卡对账不平明细生成失败。')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	lds_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = lds_bpmx.Retrieve( )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_temp = 1 To ll_rowcount
			ls_bpmx = ls_bpmx + lds_bpmx.Object.#1[ll_temp] + " " + String(lds_bpmx.Object.#2[ll_temp]) + "~n"
		NEXT
	END IF
	gf_waiting('医保病人市民卡账户支付金额不一致......',-1)
	
	MessageBox('【提示】不能对帐，请与计算中心联系','医保病人市民卡账户支付数据不一致。理论交易额(YB_ZJJS)：'+String(ldc_zhzfje)+', 实际发生额(YB_JSMX)：'+String(ldc_smkzhzf)+', 差值：'+String(ldc_zhzfje - ldc_smkzhzf) + '~n' + ls_bpmx)
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	//	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//校验市民卡账户支付金额（医保&自费）
//=======================核对==============================//
Dec{2} ldc_zhjyje, ldc_smkzfje

SELECT SUM(nvl(zhzfje,0)) INTO :ldc_smkzfje FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	Where qsrq >= :idt_begin And qsrq < :idt_end And (jslb = 'XF' Or jslb = 'TK' Or jslb = 'ZFXF' Or jslb = 'ZFTK') And ztbz > 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_smkzfje) THEN ldc_smkzfje = 0.00

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',20)

SELECT SUM(nvl(jyje,0)) INTO :ldc_zhjyje FROM H_MZ_ZHJYMX
	Where jysj >= :idt_begin And jysj < :idt_end And jkfs = 8;
IF IsNull(ldc_zhjyje) THEN ldc_zhjyje = 0.00

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',40)

IF ldc_smkzfje <> - ldc_zhjyje THEN
	ls_sql = "SELECT brbm, Sum(je) From " +&
		"(SELECT sum(nvl(zhzfje,0)) je, brbm From jkxt.yb_zjjs " +&
		"Where qsrq >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
		"And qsrq < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0 " +&
		"And (jslb = 'XF' Or jslb = 'TK' Or jslb = 'ZFXF' Or jslb = 'ZFTK') And ztbz > 0 Group By brbm " +&
		"Union All " +&
		"SELECT sum(nvl(jyje,0)) je, brbm FROM H_MZ_ZHJYMX " +&
		"Where jysj >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
		"And jysj < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(jyje,0) <> 0 " +&
		"And jkfs = 8 Group By brbm) " +&
		"Group By brbm " +&
		"Having Sum(je) <> 0"
	
	IF lds_bpmx.createfromsql( ls_sql ) < 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('市民卡账户支付总金额不一致......',-1)
		MessageBox('提示','市民卡对账不平明细生成失败。')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	lds_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = lds_bpmx.Retrieve( )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_temp = 1 To ll_rowcount
			ls_bpmx = ls_bpmx + lds_bpmx.Object.#1[ll_temp] + " " + String(lds_bpmx.Object.#2[ll_temp]) + "~n"
		NEXT
	END IF
	gf_waiting('市民卡账户支付总金额不一致......',-1)
	
	MessageBox('【提示】不能对帐，请与计算中心联系','市民卡账户支付数据不一致：社保理论交易(YB_ZJJS)：'+String(ldc_smkzfje)+', 实际发生额(H_MZ_ZHJYMX)：'+String(-ldc_zhjyje)+', 差值：'+String(ldc_smkzfje+ldc_zhjyje) + '~n' + ls_bpmx)
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	//	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',-1)
RETURN 1



end function

blocks.text:
public subroutine wf_getdzxx (datetime adt_dzrq);DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end
String ls_dzr ,ls_error
Long ll_jyzbs, ll_zcxfbs, ll_tkjybs
Decimal{2} ldc_zfzje, ldc_zcxfje, ldc_tkjyje

ldt_begin = DateTime(Date(adt_dzrq),Time(00:00:00))
ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_dzrq),1),Time(00:00:00))
ls_dzr = String(adt_dzrq,'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT count(*) INTO :ll_jyzbs FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	WHERE qsrq >= :ldt_begin AND qsrq < :ldt_end AND ztbz > 0
	And jylsh Is Not Null And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0;
IF IsNull(ll_jyzbs) THEN ll_jyzbs = 0
//SELECT sum(nvl(zhzfje,0)) INTO :ldc_zfzje FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
//	WHERE qsrq >= :ldt_begin AND qsrq < :ldt_end AND ztbz > 0
//	And jsjylsh Is Not Null And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0;
//IF IsNull(ldc_zfzje) THEN ldc_zfzje = 0.00

SELECT count(*) INTO :ll_zcxfbs FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	WHERE qsrq >= :ldt_begin AND qsrq < :ldt_end AND ztbz > 0 AND (jslb = 'XF' OR jslb = 'ZFXF')
	And jylsh Is Not Null And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0;
IF IsNull(ll_zcxfbs) THEN ll_zcxfbs = 0

SELECT sum(nvl(zhzfje,0)) INTO :ldc_zcxfje FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	WHERE qsrq >= :ldt_begin AND qsrq < :ldt_end AND ztbz > 0 AND (jslb = 'XF' OR jslb = 'ZFXF')
	And jylsh Is Not Null And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_zcxfje) THEN ldc_zcxfje = 0.00

SELECT count(*) INTO :ll_tkjybs FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	WHERE qsrq >= :ldt_begin AND qsrq < :ldt_end AND ztbz > 0 AND (jslb = 'TK' OR jslb = 'ZFTK')
	And jylsh Is Not Null And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0;
IF IsNull(ll_tkjybs) THEN ll_tkjybs = 0

SELECT sum(nvl(zhzfje,0)) INTO :ldc_tkjyje FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	WHERE qsrq >= :ldt_begin AND qsrq < :ldt_end AND ztbz > 0 AND (jslb = 'TK' OR jslb = 'ZFTK')
	And jylsh Is Not Null And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_tkjyje) THEN ldc_tkjyje = 0.00

ldc_zfzje = ldc_zcxfje - ldc_tkjyje

dw_1.object.qsrq[1] = ls_dzr
dw_1.Object.jyzbs[1] = ll_jyzbs
dw_1.Object.zhzfzje[1] = ldc_zfzje
dw_1.Object.zcxfbs[1] = ll_zcxfbs
dw_1.Object.zhzcxfje[1] = ldc_zcxfje
dw_1.Object.tkjybs[1] = ll_tkjybs
dw_1.Object.tkjyje[1] = - ldc_tkjyje

end subroutine

blocks.name: ue_ref
blocks.text:
event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;String ls_dzr, ls_yf
Long ll_rowcount, ll_count

//IF em_1.getdate( ) >= Date(gf_server_date()) THEN
//	MessageBox('提示','不能对当日及其之后的时间进行统计!')
//	RETURN
//END IF
idt_begin = em_1.getdatetime(1)
idt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(em_1.getdate(),1),Time(00:00:00))

//获取统计月份
ls_yf = String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymm')
ls_dzr = String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')

//显示本月对账信息
tab_1.tabpage_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(ls_yf)

//is_dzr = ls_dzr

Long ll_find
IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_find From jkxt.pyyb_dzxx Where dzr = :ls_dzr And dzjg Is Not Null;
	IF ll_find = 0 THEN
		SELECT count(1) Into :ll_find From jkxt.yb_dzxx Where dzr = :ls_dzr And dzjg Is Not Null;
	END IF
ELSE
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_find From jkxt.yb_dzxx Where dzr = :ls_dzr And dzjg Is Not Null;
END IF
IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示', '未进行医保对账，不能进行市民卡对账。')
	dw_1.Reset()
	dw_1.InsertRow(1)
	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Reset()
	tab_1.tabpage_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Reset()
	RETURN
END IF

tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Reset()
//显示交易明细
ll_count = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetSort("jssj asc")
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Sort()

IF ll_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','该天没有社保交易明细!')
END IF

//对对账结果进行判断，有记录则不再判断，无记录则验证yb_jsmx和yb_zjjs
ll_rowcount = dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr)

IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	IF dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] <> '0' THEN
		RETURN
	ELSEIF base_info.qxjb < 2 THEN
		RETURN
	END IF
ELSE
	dw_1.InsertRow(1)
	dw_1.Object.qsrq[1] = ls_dzr
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		IF wf_dzyz() < 0 THEN
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

//获取对应的总额值,用于进行中心对账
wf_getdzxx(idt_begin)

//保存
gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)

	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)

public function integer wf_import (ref datastore ads_ysj);String ls_syd_hbbfl,ls_zhyb_hbbfl
String ls_rylb[],ls_zhybrylb[]

ls_syd_hbbfl = gf_getpara(0,'SYDHBBFL',',14,15,16,27,24,25,26,91,|,11,12,13,20,30,90,|,0,|,31,32,33,34,35,39,','省异地核拨表')
//ls_zhyb_hbbfl = gf_getpara(0,'ZHYBHBBFL',',11,12,|,14,15,16,|,99,|,13,33,34,5588,','省异地核拨表')
IF ls_syd_hbbfl = '0' THEN
	MessageBox('信息提示','省异地人员分类未归类，请设置后重新统计（SYDHBBFL）')
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF gf_splitparm_zdy(ls_syd_hbbfl,ls_rylb,'|') < 0 THEN
	MessageBox('信息提示','省异地人员分类错误，核对后重新设置（SYDHBBFL）')
	RETURN -1
END IF

//IF gf_splitparm_zdy(ls_zhyb_hbbfl,ls_zhybrylb,'|') < 0 THEN
//	MessageBox('信息提示','智慧医保人员分类错误，核对后重新设置（ZHYBHBBFL）')
//	RETURN -1
//END IF
this.SetRedraw(False)
Long ll_rowcnt,ll_index,ll_find
String ls_temp,ls_ybjk,ls_ylrylb,ls_wglrylb
ll_rowcnt = ads_ysj.RowCount()
FOR ll_index = 1 To ll_rowcnt
	gf_waiting('正在进行数据归并，请耐心等。。。',ll_index /ll_rowcnt * 100 )
	ls_temp = ''
	ls_temp = ads_ysj.Object.cbdxzqh[ll_index ]
	ls_ybjk = ads_ysj.Object.ybjk[ll_index ]
	ll_find = dw_main.Find("xzqh2 ='" +ls_temp +"'", 1,999999)
	IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
		ll_find = dw_main.InsertRow( 0)
		dw_main.Object.xzqh[ll_find ] = ads_ysj.Object.cbdmc[ll_index ]
		dw_main.Object.xzqh2[ll_find ] = ls_temp
	END IF
	ls_temp = ''
	ls_temp = ',' + ads_ysj.Object.ylrylb[ll_index ]  + ','
	ls_ylrylb = ads_ysj.Object.ylrylb[ll_index ]
	If (ls_ybjk = 'SYD' And Pos(ls_rylb[1] ,ls_temp) > 0) Or (ls_ybjk = 'ZHYB' And (Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '11' Or Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '12')) THEN
		ads_ysj.Object.fl[ll_index ] = 'ZG' //职工
		dw_main.Object.zg[ll_find ] =  ads_ysj.Object.bfje[ll_index ] + dw_main.Object.zg[ll_find ]
	ElseIf (ls_ybjk = 'SYD' And Pos(ls_rylb[2] ,ls_temp) > 0) Or (ls_ybjk = 'ZHYB' And (Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '14' Or Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '15' Or Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '16'))  THEN
		ads_ysj.Object.fl[ll_index ] = 'CZJM' //城镇居民
		dw_main.Object.CZJM[ll_find ] = ads_ysj.Object.bfje[ll_index ] + dw_main.Object.CZJM[ll_find ]
	ElseIf (ls_ybjk = 'SYD' And Pos(ls_rylb[3] ,ls_temp) > 0)  THEN
		ads_ysj.Object.fl[ll_index ] = 'XXNC' //新型农村
		dw_main.Object.XXNC[ll_find ] = ads_ysj.Object.bfje[ll_index ] + dw_main.Object.XXNC[ll_find ]
	ElseIf (ls_ybjk = 'SYD' And Pos(ls_rylb[4] ,ls_temp) > 0) Or (ls_ybjk = 'ZHYB' And (Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '13' Or Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '33' Or Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '34' Or ls_ylrylb = '5088'))  THEN
		ads_ysj.Object.fl[ll_index ] = 'LX' //离休
		dw_main.Object.LX[ll_find ] = ads_ysj.Object.bfje[ll_index ] + dw_main.Object.LX[ll_find ]
	ELSE
		IF ls_wglrylb > ' ' THEN
			IF Pos(',' + ls_wglrylb+',',',' + ls_ylrylb+',') = 0 THEN
				ls_wglrylb = ls_wglrylb+','+ls_ylrylb
			END IF
		ELSE
			ls_wglrylb = ls_ylrylb
		END IF
		ads_ysj.Object.fl[ll_index ] = 'XXNC' //新型农村
		dw_main.Object.XXNC[ll_find ] = ads_ysj.Object.bfje[ll_index ] + dw_main.Object.XXNC[ll_find ]
	END IF
NEXT
this.SetRedraw(true)
gf_waiting('正在进行数据归并，请耐心等。。。',-1 )
if ls_wglrylb > ' ' then MessageBox('信息提示','人员分类（'+ls_wglrylb+'）未归类，暂时计入【新型农村合作医疗/其他】')
RETURN 1



end function

ELSEIF dw_main.DataObject <> 'd_ybhbb_2019'  THEN

dw_main.Reset( )
Long ll_mzcount,li_syd,ll_cur,ll_find,ll_insert,li_mzy = 0
String ls_cbds,ls_cbrlb,ls_ybjk,ls_temp = '',ls_jslsh
ls_cbds = is_yljgxzqh //'330399'
IF dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_2019' THEN
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //1

	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //2

	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	//救助

	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '职工医疗救助'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //4
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'cxjmyljz'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '城乡居民医疗救助'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	//优抚
	//ZHYB	610200	优抚对象医疗补助基金		2	
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //5
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'zgyljz'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '职工优抚'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //6
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'cxjmyljz'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '城居优抚'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	//益康保
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //7
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'zgykb'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '职工益康保'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //8
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'cxykb'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '城居益康保'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //9
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'lxry'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '离休人员医疗保障'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 00.00
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //10
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'lxpo'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '离休人员配偶医疗保障'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //11
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'qt'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '其他'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00

	gf_waiting("开始统计...",10)

	END IF
	Dec{2} ld_fyje,ldc_jzzfze,ldc_yfje,ldc_ykb
	gf_waiting("开始统计...",60)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_mzcount
		gf_waiting("正在汇总数据...",ll_cur /(ll_mzcount) * 100 )

				//	if ls_cbrlb = '100' or ls_cbrlb = '101' or ls_cbrlb = '200' or ls_cbrlb = '201' or ls_cbrlb = '320' or ls_cbrlb = '321' or ls_cbrlb = 'C00' then
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[1] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[1] + (ld_fyje - ldc_jzzfze - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykb)

				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[5] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[5] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[7] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[7] + ldc_ykb
				//B00 居民医保  D00 未成年 E00 新农合 G00 大学生
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = 'B00' Or ls_cbrlb = 'D00' Or ls_cbrlb = 'E00' Or ls_cbrlb = 'G00'  THEN
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[2] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[2] + (ld_fyje - ldc_jzzfze - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykb)
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[4] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[4] + ldc_jzzfze
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[6] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[6] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[8] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[8] + ldc_ykb
				//	ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = "F00" THEN //F00 子女统筹 算到其他
				//		dw_main.Object.sqbfje[3] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[3] + ld_fyje
			ELSE
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[11] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[11] + ld_fyje
				MessageBox('提示',ls_cbrlb + '归入其他')
			END IF
		ELSEIF ls_ybjk = 'ZHYB' THEN
			IF Left(ls_cbrlb,2) = '11' Or Left(ls_cbrlb,2) = '12' THEN //职工
				//	if ls_cbrlb = '100' or ls_cbrlb = '101' or ls_cbrlb = '200' or ls_cbrlb = '201' or ls_cbrlb = '320' or ls_cbrlb = '321' or ls_cbrlb = 'C00' then
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[1] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[1] + (ld_fyje - ldc_jzzfze - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykb)
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[3] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[3] + ldc_jzzfze
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[5] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[5] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[7] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[7] + ldc_ykb
				//B00 居民医保  D00 未成年 E00 新农合 G00 大学生
			ELSEIF Left(ls_cbrlb,2) = '14' Or Left(ls_cbrlb,2) = '15' Or Left(ls_cbrlb,2) = '16' THEN //城乡
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[2] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[2] + (ld_fyje - ldc_jzzfze - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykb)
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[4] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[4] + ldc_jzzfze
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[6] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[6] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[8] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[8] + ldc_ykb
			ELSEIF Left(ls_cbrlb,2) = '13' THEN //13 离休			
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[9] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[9] + ld_fyje
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = '5088' THEN //离休配偶	
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[10] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[10] + ld_fyje
			ELSE
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[11] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[11] + ld_fyje
				MessageBox('提示',ls_cbrlb + '归入其他')
			END IF
		ELSE
			MessageBox('提示',ls_ybjk + '找不到归类')
		END IF
	NEXT
	dw_main.Object.t_jsny.Text = String(adt_begin,'yyyy年 mm月')
	IF ai_ywlx = 8 Or ai_ywlx = 12 THEN
		dw_main.Object.byd_t.Text = '(本地)'
	ELSEIF ai_ywlx = 11 THEN
		dw_main.Object.byd_t.Text = '(异地)'
	END IF
ELSEIF dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_zhyb2' Or dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_zhyb' THEN
	ls_jslsh = ''
	SELECT jslsh Into :ls_jslsh From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :adt_begin And jssj <= :adt_end And ztbz > 0 Group By jslsh Having count(1) > 1;
	IF ls_jslsh > ' ' THEN
		MessageBox('提示','存在多余数据，请联系信息科处理')
		RETURN
	END IF
	IF rb_qb.Checked THEN
		li_mzy = 0
		ls_temp = ''
	ELSEIF rb_mz.Checked THEN
		li_mzy = 1
		ls_temp = '(门诊)'
	ELSEIF rb_zy.Checked THEN
		li_mzy = 2
		ls_temp = '(住院)'
	END IF
	ll_mzcount = dw_main.Retrieve(adt_begin,adt_end,ls_cbds,0 ,li_mzy)
	IF ll_mzcount > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_mzcount
			IF dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_zhyb2' THEN
				dw_main.Object.qsjbjg[ll_cur] = is_yljgxzqh
				dw_main.Object.jgbm[ll_cur] = is_yljldm
				dw_main.Object.jgmc[ll_cur] = base_info.hospital
			ELSEIF dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_zhyb' THEN
				dw_main.Object.sqbffy[ll_cur] = Round(dw_main.Object.jjzfze[ll_cur] * 0.9,2)
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
	dw_main.Object.t_1.Text = '浙江省定点医疗费用申请核拨表（两定机构）' + ls_temp
	//	dw_main.Object.t_date.Text = '统计月份： ' + String(adt_begin,'yyyy年 mm月份')
END IF
IF dw_main.DataObject <> 'd_ybhbb_zhyb2' THEN
	IF ii_sfby = 0 THEN
		dw_main.Object.t_dddw.Text = '定点医疗机构名称(盖章)：' + base_info.hospital
	ELSE
		dw_main.Object.t_dddw.Text = '定点医疗机构名称(盖章)：' + base_info.hospital1
	END IF
	dw_main.Object.t_yljgbh.Text = '定点医药机构编号：' + is_yljldm
END IF
gf_waiting("结束统计...",-1 )






end subroutine

	ls_cbds[8] = '330382'

		330322	洞头县	330324	永嘉县	330326	平阳县	330327	苍南县	330328	文成县	330329	泰顺县

槟庑姓�区划，一卡通平台发起交易时的就医地行政区�

	*/

	IF Pos(base_info.hospital,'台州' ) > 0 THEN
		dw_main.DataObject = 'd_sydfy_tzhbb'
	ELSE
		dw_main.DataObject = 'd_sydfy_hbb'
	END IF
	dw_main.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	//	lds_syd_hbb.Retrieve( )
	IF li_ywlx = 5  Or li_ywlx = 51 Or li_ywlx = 52 THEN
		//		li_syd = 2		
		IF String(ldt_begin,'yyyymm') >= '202012' THEN
			li_syd = 2
		ELSE
			li_syd = 4
		END IF
		IF dw_main.DataObject = 'd_sydfy_tzhbb' THEN
			dw_main.Object.t_1.Text = '浙江省两定单位医疗费用申请核拨表'
		ELSE
			dw_main.Object.t_1.Text = '浙江省异地就医联网结算定点单位医疗费用申请核拨表'
			dw_main.Object.t_2.Text = '（跨省异地就医）'
		END IF
		IF li_ywlx = 51 THEN
			dw_main.Object.t_1.Text = dw_main.Object.t_1.Text + '(门诊)'
		ELSEIF li_ywlx = 52 THEN
			dw_main.Object.t_1.Text = dw_main.Object.t_1.Text + '(住院)'
		END IF
	ELSEIF li_ywlx = 9 THEN
		IF String(ldt_begin,'yyyymm') >= '202012' THEN
			MessageBox('提示','2020年12月之后长三角纳入跨省异地报表（跨省异地包含长三角的数据）')
		END IF
		li_syd = 3
		dw_main.Object.t_1.Text = '浙江省异地就医联网结算定点单位医疗费用申请核拨表'
		dw_main.Object.t_2.Text = '（长江三角区就医）'
	END IF
	IF li_ywlx = 51 Or li_ywlx = 52 THEN
		lds_syd_hbb.DataObject = 'd_syd_hbb_mzy'
		lds_syd_hbb.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
		IF lds_syd_hbb.Retrieve(ldt_begin,ldt_end,li_syd,li_ywlx,Left(is_yljgxzqh,4)) < 0 THEN
			MessageBox('信息提示',lds_syd_hbb.is_error )
			RETURN
		END IF
	ELSE
		lds_syd_hbb.DataObject = 'd_syd_hbb_ysj'
		lds_syd_hbb.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
		IF lds_syd_hbb.Retrieve(ldt_begin,ldt_end,li_syd,Left(is_yljgxzqh,4)) < 0 THEN
			MessageBox('信息提示',lds_syd_hbb.is_error )
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
	IF String(ldt_begin,'yyyymm') >= '202012' And dw_main.DataObject <> 'd_sydfy_tzhbb' THEN
		dw_main.Object.t_date.Text = String(ldt_now,'yyyy年mm月') + '(制表年月)'
		dw_main.Object.t_bz.Visible = True
		dw_main.Object.t_bz.Text = '备注：申请拨付金额为上月及之前未拨付金额'
	ELSE
		dw_main.Object.t_date.Text = String(ldt_begin,'yyyy年mm月')
		dw_main.Object.t_bz.Visible = False
	END IF
	IF  dw_main.DataObject = 'd_sydfy_tzhbb' THEN
		dw_main.Object.t_date.Text = '日期：' + String(ldt_begin,'yyyy年mm月dd日') + '至' +String(ldt_end,'yyyy年mm月dd日')
		dw_main.Object.t_3.Text = '医疗机构名称(盖章)：'+ base_info.hospital
		dw_main.Object.t_4.Text = '医疗机构代码： '+  gf_getpara_Eas(sqlca_query,0,"SYB_YYDM_NEW","","省医保医院代码")
	ELSE
		dw_main.Object.t_3.Text = '定点医疗机构盖章：'+ base_info.hospital
		dw_main.Object.t_4.Text = '定点医疗机构编号：'+  gf_getpara_Eas(sqlca_query,0,"SYB_YYDM_NEW","","省医保医院代码")
	END IF
	dw_main.Object.t_13.Text = '制表日期：'+ String(ldt_now,'yyyy年mm月dd日')
	//填充数据
	//	this.SetRedraw(False)
	wf_import(lds_syd_hbb)
	//	this.SetRedraw(true)
	RETURN
	
ELSEIF li_ywlx = 6 Or li_ywlx = 7 Or li_ywlx = 10 THEN //add by SXL 20171012 省异地
	dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhzb_syd'
	//	ls_title = '温州市异地就医医保费用汇总表（'+ddlb_ywlx.Text+'）'
	IF Pos(ls_sydtitle,'汇总表') > 0 THEN
		ls_title = ls_sydtitle + '（'+ddlb_ywlx.Text+'）'
	ELSE
		ls_title = ls_sydtitle + '费用申请核拨表' + '（'+ddlb_ywlx.Text+'）'
	END IF
	IF li_ywlx = 6  THEN
		li_syd = 1
	ELSEIF li_ywlx = 7 THEN
		IF String(ldt_begin,'yyyymm') >= '202012' THEN
			li_syd = 2
		ELSE
			li_syd = 4
		END IF
	ELSEIF li_ywlx = 10 THEN
		li_syd = 3
		IF String(ldt_begin,'yyyymm') >= '202012' THEN
			MessageBox('提示','2020年12月之后长三角纳入跨省异地报表（跨省异地包含长三角的数据）')
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN
END IF
dw_main.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
IF li_ywlx <> 6 And li_ywlx <> 7 And li_ywlx <> 10 THEN
		//门诊医保病人
	IF li_ywlx = 3 THEN li_syd = 99
	IF IsValid(luds_mzcbr) = False THEN luds_mzcbr = Create u_datastore
	luds_mzcbr.DataObject = "dd_ybhzxx_mz"
	luds_mzcbr.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
	ll_mzcount = luds_mzcbr.Retrieve(ldt_begin,ldt_end,ls_cbds,li_syd )
	//住院医保病人
	IF IsValid(luds_zycbr) = False THEN luds_zycbr = Create u_datastore
	luds_zycbr.DataObject = "dd_ybhzxx_zy"
	luds_zycbr.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
	ll_zycount = luds_zycbr.Retrieve(ldt_begin,ldt_end,ls_cbds,li_syd )
	//门诊交易
	gf_waiting("开始统计...",0)
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
	dw_main.Object.xm[ll_insert - 3] = "门诊"
	dw_main.Object.xm[ll_insert - 2] = "门诊救助"
	dw_main.Object.xm[ll_insert - 1] = "门诊优抚"
	dw_main.Object.xm[ll_insert] = "门诊益康保"
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_mzcount
		gf_waiting("正在统计门诊数据...",ll_cur /(ll_mzcount + ll_zycount)*100 )
		ls_cbrlb = luds_mzcbr.Object.cbrlb[ll_cur]
		ld_fyje = luds_mzcbr.Object.jjzfze[ll_cur]
		ldc_jzje = luds_mzcbr.Object.jzzfze[ll_cur]
		ldc_yfje = luds_mzcbr.Object.yfje[ll_cur]
		ldc_ykbzf = luds_mzcbr.Object.ykbzf[ll_cur]
		IF IsNull(ldc_yfje) THEN ldc_yfje = 0.00
		IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
			IF ls_cbrlb = "B00" Or Left(ls_cbrlb,6) = 'ZHYB15' Or Left(ls_cbrlb,6) = 'ZHYB16' THEN //B00 居民医保 
				dw_main.Object.czjm[ll_insert - 3] = dw_main.Object.czjm[ll_insert - 3] + ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf
				dw_main.Object.czjm[ll_insert - 2] = dw_main.Object.czjm[ll_insert - 2] + ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.czjm[ll_insert - 1] = dw_main.Object.czjm[ll_insert - 1] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.czjm[ll_insert] = dw_main.Object.czjm[ll_insert]  + ldc_ykbzf
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = "D00" Or Left(ls_cbrlb,6) = 'ZHYB14' THEN //D00 未成年 
				dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert - 3] = dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert - 3] + ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf
				dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert - 2] = dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert - 2] + ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert - 1] = dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert - 1] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert] = dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert] + ldc_ykbzf
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = "E00" THEN //E00 新农合 
				dw_main.Object.xnh[ll_insert - 3] = ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf
				dw_main.Object.xnh[ll_insert - 2] = ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.xnh[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.xnh[ll_insert] = ldc_ykbzf
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = "G00" THEN //G00 大学生 
				dw_main.Object.dxs[ll_insert - 3] = ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf
				dw_main.Object.dxs[ll_insert - 2] = ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.dxs[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.dxs[ll_insert] = ldc_ykbzf
			END IF
		ELSEIF li_ywlx = 2 THEN
			IF Pos ( is_cbrlb_snjbyl, ls_cbrlb) > 0 THEN
				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 3] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 3] + (ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf)
				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 2] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 2] + ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 1] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 1] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert] + ldc_ykbzf
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = "F00" THEN //F00 子女统筹 
				dw_main.Object.zntc[ll_insert - 3] = ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.zntc[ll_insert - 2] = ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.zntc[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.zntc[ll_insert] = ldc_ykbzf
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = "C00" THEN //C00 农民工 
				dw_main.Object.nmg[ll_insert - 3] = ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.nmg[ll_insert - 2] = ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.nmg[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.nmg[ll_insert] = ldc_ykbzf
				//智慧医保都归入基本医疗
			ELSEIF Left(ls_cbrlb,6) <> 'ZHYB14' And Left(ls_cbrlb,6) <> 'ZHYB15' And Left(ls_cbrlb,6) <> 'ZHYB16' And Left(ls_cbrlb,4) = 'ZHYB' THEN
				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 3] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 3] + (ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf)
				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 2] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 2] + ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 1] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 1] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert] + ldc_ykbzf
			END IF
		ELSEIF li_ywlx = 3 Or li_ywlx = 4 THEN
			IF Pos ( is_cbrlb_jbyl, ls_cbrlb) > 0 Or ( Left(ls_cbrlb,6) <> 'ZHYB14' And Left(ls_cbrlb,6) <> 'ZHYB15' And Left(ls_cbrlb,6) <> 'ZHYB16' And Left(ls_cbrlb,4) = 'ZHYB')  THEN
				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 3] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 3] + (ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf)
				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 2] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 2] + ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 1] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert - 1] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert] + ldc_ykbzf
			ELSEIF  ls_cbrlb = "B00" Or Left(ls_cbrlb,6) = 'ZHYB15' Or Left(ls_cbrlb,6) = 'ZHYB16' THEN //B00 居民医保 
				dw_main.Object.jmyb[ll_insert - 3] = ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf
				dw_main.Object.jmyb[ll_insert - 2] = ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.jmyb[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.jmyb[ll_insert] = ldc_ykbzf
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = "C00" THEN //C00 农民工 
				dw_main.Object.nmg[ll_insert - 3] = ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf
				dw_main.Object.nmg[ll_insert - 2] = ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.nmg[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.nmg[ll_insert] = ldc_ykbzf
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = "D00" Or Left(ls_cbrlb,6) = 'ZHYB14' THEN //D00 未成年 
				dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert - 3] = ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf
				dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert - 2] = ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert] = ldc_ykbzf
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = "F00" THEN //F00 子女统筹 
				dw_main.Object.zntc[ll_insert - 3] = ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf
				dw_main.Object.zntc[ll_insert - 2] = ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.zntc[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.zntc[ll_insert] = ldc_ykbzf
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = "G00" THEN //G00 大学生 
				dw_main.Object.dxs[ll_insert - 3] = ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf
				dw_main.Object.dxs[ll_insert - 2] = ldc_jzje
				dw_main.Object.dxs[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.dxs[ll_insert] = ldc_ykbzf
			ELSE
				MessageBox(ls_cbrlb,is_cbrlb_jbyl)
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
	//住院交易
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
	dw_main.Object.xm[ll_insert - 3] = "住院"
	dw_main.Object.xm[ll_insert - 2] = "住院救助"
	dw_main.Object.xm[ll_insert - 1] = "住院优抚"
	dw_main.Object.xm[ll_insert] = "住院益康保"
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_zycount
		gf_waiting("正在统计住院数据...",(ll_cur + ll_mzcount) /(ll_mzcount + ll_zycount)*100 )
		ls_cbrlb = luds_zycbr.Object.cbrlb[ll_cur]
		ld_fyje = luds_zycbr.Object.jjzfze[ll_cur]
		ldc_jzje = luds_zycbr.Object.jzzfze[ll_cent doubleclicked;call super::doubleclicked;string ls_jylsh,ls_jyzqh

ls_jylsh = this.object.jylsh[row]
ls_jyzqh = this.object.jyzqh[row]

tab_1.tabpage_2.dw_2.retrieve(ls_jyzqh,ls_jylsh)

blocks.name: uf_tzyb_mxxz_new
blocks.text:
public function integer uf_tzyb_mxxz_new (integer ai_ywlx, string as_dzr, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 事件: w_sbdz_py.uf_tzyb_mxxz_new()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 台州市本地医保新接口（对账明细下载）
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	integer	ai_ywlx  	
// 	value    	string 	as_dzr   	
// 	reference	string 	as_return	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2021.07.15     25177
//====================================================================
String ls_jsbz ,ls_jsjylshm 
Integer li_return
Long ll_cur, ll_jymxts_temp, ll_jymxts, ll_insert
Date ld_dzr
li_return = 1


tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_zxmx_new'
tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.dataObject = 'd_pyyb_zxmx_new'
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.SetTransObject(sqlca) 
tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.setTransObject(sqlca)
ls_jsbz = '1'
ls_jsjylshm = '0'
ld_dzr = Date(idt_begin)


DO WHILE ls_jsbz = '1'
	//	3.3.6.	8106号交易：定点机构日结算交易明细下载
	// A.传出参数
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_send_init('8106')
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_send_add('已下载最大平台流水号', ls_jsjylshm)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_send_add('交易日期', String(ld_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd'))
	
	// B.发送报文
	IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_send( as_return) = False THEN
		li_return = -1
	ELSE
		w_sbdz_py.SetRedraw(False)
		
		// C.传入参数
		IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_getstring('交易处理结果') <> '0' THEN  // 0-成功；＞0-成功但是有警告；＜0-失败
			as_return = gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			li_return = -1
		END IF
		ls_jsbz = gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_getstring('是否还有需下载的记录')     // 0-下载完毕，1-还需下载
		ll_jymxts_temp = Long(gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_getstring("本次下载记录条数"))
		ll_jymxts = gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_getString_mxnr("交易明细列表")
		IF ll_jymxts = -1 Then 
			li_return = -1
			as_return = '交易明细列表明细数量＜0'
			Exit
		END IF
		IF ll_jymxts <> ll_jymxts_temp Then
			Messagebox("提示", '中心下载条数:' +String(ll_jymxts_temp)+'  与本地解析不一致:' + String(ll_jymxts))
		END IF
		
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_jymxts
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',ll_cur / ll_jymxts * 100)
			
			ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.InsertRow( 0)
			                                                                                                                                           //     (接口返回参数) → (数据库字段)
			ls_jsjylshm = gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_getstring_in( "参保地结算流水号",ll_cur)
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.CBDJSLSH[ll_insert] = ls_jsjylshm                                                                            // 1.参保地结算流水号 → CBDJSLSH
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.CBDXZQHDM[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_getstring_in( "参保地行政代码",ll_cur)                // 2.参保地行政代码 → CBDXZQH
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.MZZYXLH[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_getstring_in( "门诊/住院序列号",ll_cur)               // 3.门诊/住院序列号 → MZZYXLH

event ue_bptz();DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end
ldt_begin = em_1.getdatetime(1)
ldt_end = em_2.getdatetime( 2)
Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_row,ll_i
u_datastore luds_jd,luds_mxzdh
luds_jd = Create u_datastore
luds_jd.DataObject = 'd_mxsc_jd'
luds_jd.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)

ll_count = luds_jd.Retrieve(ldt_begin ,ldt_end)

String ls_brbm,ls_mxzdh,ls_ywlx,ls_error = ''
Dec{0} ldc_zyh,ldc_ywlsh,ldc_mxlsh
Dec{2} ldc_je,ldc_zjje
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	luds_mxzdh = Create u_datastore
	luds_mxzdh.DataObject = 'd_mxzdh_mx'
	luds_mxzdh.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		ls_brbm = luds_jd.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
		ldc_zyh = luds_jd.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
		ls_mxzdh = luds_jd.Object.mxzdh[ll_cur]
		ll_row = luds_mxzdh.Retrieve(ldc_zyh,ls_brbm,ls_mxzdh )
		FOR ll_i = 1 To ll_row
			ls_ywlx = luds_mxzdh.Object.ywlx[ll_i]
			ldc_ywlsh = luds_mxzdh.Object.ywlsh[ll_i]
			ldc_mxlsh = luds_mxzdh.Object.ywmxlsh[ll_i]
			IF ls_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
				CONTINUE
			ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'YJ' Or ls_ywlx = 'CF' THEN
				IF IsNull(ldc_mxlsh) THEN ldc_mxlsh = 0
				SELECT zjje Into :ldc_zjje From mz_sfmx Where brbm = :ls_brbm And ywlsh = :ldc_ywlsh And mxxh = :ldc_mxlsh;
			ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
				SELECT zjje Into :ldc_zjje From BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where JLXH = :ldc_ywlsh;
			END IF
			luds_mxzdh.Object.ylfyje[ll_i] = ldc_zjje
		NEXT
		gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
		IF luds_mxzdh.Update( ) = 1 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		ELSE
			ls_error += luds_mxzdh.is_error
			gf_Rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		END IF
	NEXT
	Destroy luds_mxzdh
	IF ls_error > '' THEN
		MessageBox('失败', ls_error)
	ELSE
		MessageBox('成功', 'YEAH!YEAH!YEAH!')
	END IF
END IF
Destroy luds_jd




end event

public function integer wf_getsyd (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, string as_ywlx, long al_tsmxbz, decimal adc_jcfy);Dec{2} ldc_fyze,ldc_xjzf,ldc_jjzf,ldc_zfze,ldc_zlze,ldc_fhybfy,ldc_fpjz
long ll_insert,ll_ljrc,ll_jzrc,ll_sjzs
datetime ldt_ljrc1 
if date(adt_end) < date(2017,6,1)  then return 1
ldt_ljrc1 = DateTime(Date(Year(Date(adt_begin)),1,1),Time(00:00:00))
IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	SELECT  SUM(FYZE) YLFYZE,
			  SUM(GRXJZF) XJZFZE,
			  SUM(HJBXJE) JJZFZE,
			  sum(CASE WHEN YWLX = 'SF' THEN HJBXJE ELSE 0 END) AS FPJZ,
			  SUM(CASE WHEN YWLX = 'GH' THEN 0  		         WHEN YWLX = 'SF' AND ZTBZ = 3 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) SJZS ,
		     SUM(ZFZE) YLFYZFZE,
			  SUM(ZLZE) YLFYZLZE,
		     SUM(FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE) FHYBFY
		INTO :ldc_fyze,:ldc_xjzf,:ldc_jjzf,:ldc_fpjz,:ll_sjzs,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_fhybfy
		FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND
				( JSLSH is NOT NULL ) AND
				( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND
				( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND
				( YWLX In ('SF','GH')) and
				( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
				(FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
	if dw_main.rowcount( ) > 0 then
		ll_insert = dw_main.find( "cbrlb = 'SYD' and ywlx = '"+as_ywlx+"'", 1, dw_main.rowcount( ) )
		if ll_insert <= 0 then  ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	else
		ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	end if
	dw_main.object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'SYD'
	dw_main.object.lbmc[ll_insert] = '省异地'
	dw_main.object.ywlx[ll_insert] = as_ywlx
	dw_main.object.sjzs[ll_insert] = ll_sjzs
	dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ylfyzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_zfze
	dw_main.object.ylfyzlze[ll_insert] = ldc_zlze
	dw_main.object.jjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_jjzf
	dw_main.object.xjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_xjzf
	dw_main.object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = ldc_fyze
	dw_main.object.fpjz[ll_insert] = ldc_fpjz
	dw_main.object.fhybfy[ll_insert] = ldc_fhybfy
	SELECT count(DISTINCT to_char(jssj,'yyyymmdd') || brbm) INTO :ll_jzrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX In ('SF','GH')) and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
  dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = ll_jzrc
   SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT GRBH||cbdxzqh) INTO :ll_ljrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :ldt_ljrc1) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX In ('SF','GH')) and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;

	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = ll_ljrc
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	SELECT  SUM(FYZE) YLFYZE,
			  SUM(GRXJZF) XJZFZE,
			  SUM(HJBXJE) JJZFZE,
		     SUM(ZFZE) YLFYZFZE,
			  SUM(ZLZE) YLFYZLZE,
		     SUM(FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE) FHYBFY,
			  SUM(CASE WHEN  ZTBZ = 3 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) SJZS 
		INTO :ldc_fyze,:ldc_xjzf,:ldc_jjzf,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_fhybfy,:ll_sjzs
		FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND
				( JSLSH is NOT NULL ) AND
				( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND
				( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND
				( YWLX In ('ZY')) and
				( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
				( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
	if dw_main.rowcount( ) > 0 then
		ll_insert = dw_main.find( "cbrlb = 'SYD' and ywlx = '"+as_ywlx+"'", 1, dw_main.rowcount( ) )
		if ll_insert <= 0 then  ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	else
		ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	end if
	ldc_fpjz = ldc_jjzf
	dw_main.object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'SYD'
	dw_main.object.lbmc[ll_insert] = '省异地'
	dw_main.object.ywlx[ll_insert] = as_ywlx
	dw_main.object.sjzs[ll_insert] = ll_sjzs
	dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ylfyzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_zfze
	dw_main.object.ylfyzlze[ll_insert] = ldc_zlze
	dw_main.object.jjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_jjzf
	dw_main.object.xjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_xjzf
	dw_main.object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = ldc_fyze
	dw_main.object.fpjz[ll_insert] = ldc_fpjz
	dw_main.object.fhybfy[ll_insert] = ldc_fhybfy
  
    SELECT count(DISTINCT JYID) INTO :ll_jzrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX = 'ZY') and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
  dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = ll_jzrc
   SELECT count(DISTINCT GRBH||cbdxzqh) INTO :ll_ljrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :ldt_ljrc1) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX = 'ZY') and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = ll_ljrc
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer wf_get_jcfy (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, string as_ywlx, string as_ywlxs[], string as_byd, string as_jyjslxs[], string as_cbrlbs[]);//1：均次药品费，2：均次药品费占均次费用的盌AT*
嚷剩�即均次药占比�
3：均次材料费，4：均次材料费占均次费用的比率，即均次材料占比；
Long ll_count,ll_row,ll_find
String ls_ywlx
dec{2} ldc_zfy = 0.00
u_datastore luds_jcfy
luds_jcfy = Create u_datastore
IF as_ywlx = 'JBYL' Or as_ywlx = 'CXJM' Or as_ywlx = 'CXJMBHWCN' THEN
	luds_jcfy.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhzb_jc'//20210719zbq
	luds_jcfy.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	ll_count = luds_jcfy.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,as_ywlxs,as_byd,as_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,as_cbrlbs)
	IF ll_count > 0 and dw_main.rowcount( ) > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row =  1 To ll_count
			ldc_zfy = ldc_zfy + luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row]
			dw_main.Object.ypf[1] = luds_jcfy.Object.ypf[ll_row]
			dw_main.Object.clf[1] = luds_jcfy.Object.clf[ll_row]
			IF dw_main.Object.ylfyze[1]  <>  ldc_zfy THEN
				gf_applog( '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[1]) + "--jc"+String(ldc_zfy)+"）")
				MessageBox('提示', '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[1]) + "--jc"+String(ldc_zfy)+"）")
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
ELSE
	String ls_cbrlb
	luds_jcfy.DataObject = 'd_sbyhzbb_jc'//20210719zbq
	luds_jcfy.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	ll_count = luds_jcfy.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,il_byd,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row =  1 To ll_count
			ls_cbrlb = luds_jcfy.Object.cbrlb[ll_row]
			ls_ywlx = luds_jcfy.Object.ywlx[ll_row]
			ll_find = dw_main.Find("cbrlb = '"+ls_cbrlb+"' and ywlx = '" + ls_ywlx +"'",1,dw_main.RowCount())
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				IF dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]  <> luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row] THEN
					gf_applog('参保人类别：' + ls_cbrlb + '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]) + "--jc"+String(luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row])+"）")
					MessageBox('提示','参保人类别：' + ls_cbrlb + '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]) + "--jc"+String(luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row])+"）")
				END IF
				dw_main.Object.ypf[ll_find] = luds_jcfy.Object.ypf[ll_row]
				dw_main.Object.clf[ll_find] = luds_jcfy.Object.clf[ll_row]
			ELSE
				MessageBox('提示','找不到参保人类别：' + ls_cbrlb + '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'的汇总信息')
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
END IF
Destroy luds_jcfy
RETURN 1
end function
