public function integer wf_ylfyhz (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, datetime adt_ndks, string as_yblx, string as_ywlx, string as_byd, boolean ab_jcfy, ref string as_error);String ls_title,ls_error,ls_lx
String ls_ywlxs[],ls_cbrlbs[],ls_jyjslxs[]
gf_waiting('正在准备数据..........',1)
dw_main.DataObject  = 'd_ylfyhzb'//20210719zbq
dw_main.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)

IF as_yblx = 'JBYL' THEN
	ls_cbrlbs[1] = '100'
	ls_cbrlbs[2] = '101'
	ls_cbrlbs[3] = '200'
	ls_cbrlbs[4] = '201'
	ls_cbrlbs[5] = 'C00' //20210719zbq增加农民工
ELSEIF as_yblx = 'CXJM' THEN //'B00','D00','G00','E00'
	ls_cbrlbs[1] = 'B00'
	ls_cbrlbs[2] = 'D00'
	ls_cbrlbs[3] = 'G00'
	ls_cbrlbs[4] = 'E00'
ELSEIF as_yblx = 'CXJMBHWCN' THEN //'B00','G00','E00'
	ls_cbrlbs[1] = 'B00'
	ls_cbrlbs[2] = 'G00'
	ls_cbrlbs[3] = 'E00'
END IF

//"1本地;2异地;3全部" as_byd
IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	ls_lx = '（门诊）'
	ls_ywlxs[1] = 'SF'
	ls_ywlxs[2] = 'GH'
	ls_jyjslxs[1] = '001'
	ls_jyjslxs[2] = '002'
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	ls_lx = '（住院）'
	ls_ywlxs[1] = 'ZY'
	ls_jyjslxs[1] = '011'
END IF
//	温州市基本医疗保险医疗费用汇总表（门诊）
//	温州市城乡居民保险医疗费用汇总表（住院）
dw_main.Object.title_t.Text = '温州市'+ ddlb_yblb.Text + '保险医疗费用汇总表' + ls_lx
dw_main.SetRedraw( False)

gf_waiting('正在统计基本数据..........',20)
dw_main.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
// 人次数
u_datastore luds_rcs,luds_rts
gf_waiting('正在统计人次数.........',50)
IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	luds_rcs = Create u_datastore
	luds_rcs.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhz_rc' //20210719zbq
	luds_rcs.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	luds_rcs.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	luds_rcs = Create u_datastore
	luds_rcs.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhz_zyrc' //20210719zbq
	luds_rcs.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	luds_rcs.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
END IF
//人头数
gf_waiting('正在统计人头数.........',70)
luds_rts = Create u_datastore
luds_rts.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhz_rt' //20210719zbq
luds_rts.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
luds_rts.Retrieve(adt_ndks, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
dw_main.Object.rcs[1] = luds_rcs.Object.rczs[1]
dw_main.Object.rts[1] = luds_rts.Object.rtzs[1]
IF String(adt_begin,'yyyy.mm') <> left(em_2.text,7) THEN
	dw_main.Object.st_tjrq.Text = String(adt_begin,'yyyymm') +"-" +String(em_2.getdate(),'yyyymm')
ELSE
	dw_main.Object.st_tjrq.Text = String(adt_begin,'yyyymm')
END IF
gf_waiting('正在计算均次费用..........',80)
if ab_jcfy then this.wf_get_jcfy( adt_begin, adt_end, as_yblx, ls_ywlxs, as_byd, ls_jyjslxs, ls_cbrlbs)
gf_waiting('数据完成..........',-1)
dw_main.SetRedraw( True)
RETURN 1
end function

blocks.text:
event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;Long ll_find,ll_rowcount,ll_count,ll_row,ll_sjzs,ll_ljrc
DateTime ldt_start,ldt_end,ldt_ljrc1,ldt_ljrc2
u_datastore luds_jzrc,luds_sjzs,luds_ljrc
String ls_yblx,ls_zbrxm,ls_zbrbm,ls_dwmc,ls_cbrlb,ls_error,ls_filter
Dec{2} ld_jzce
Boolean lb_jcfy
lb_jcfy = cbx_jcfy.Checked
st_text.Text = ''
ls_zbrxm = base_info.username
ls_zbrbm = base_info.UserID
ls_dwmc = ddlb_yblb.Text
 
ldt_start = em_1.getdatetime(1)
ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(em_2.getdate(),1))
ls_yblx = Upper(ddlb_yblb.getcode())
//用于确定年度开始时间，统计人头数，城乡居民（1月1）和基本医疗（4月1）年度开始时间不同
//ls_cbrlbs[1] = 'B00'
//	ls_cbrlbs[2] = 'D00'
//	ls_cbrlbs[3] = 'G00'
//	ls_cbrlbs[4] = 'E00'
IF ls_yblx = 'CXJM' Or ls_yblx = 'CXJMBHWCN' Or ls_yblx = 'B00' Or ls_yblx = 'D00' Or ls_yblx = 'G00' Or ls_yblx = 'E00' OR LS_YBLX='15' THEN
	ldt_ljrc1 = DateTime(Date(Year(Date(ldt_start)),1,1))
	ldt_ljrc2 = ldt_end
ELSE
	IF Month(Date(em_1.getdate())) < 7 THEN
		ldt_ljrc1 = DateTime(Date(Year(Date(ldt_start)) - 1,7,1),Time(00:00:00))
		ldt_ljrc2 = ldt_end //modify by sxl 3月或3月以前年度开始为上1年的4月1日，但是结束日期为当前结束日期
		//	ldt_ljrc2 = DateTime(Date(Year(Date(ldt_end)),Month(2014-04-01),Day(2014-04-01)),Time(00:00:00))
	ELSE
		ldt_ljrc1 = DateTime(Date(Year(Date(ldt_start)),7,1),Time(00:00:00))
		ldt_ljrc2 = ldt_end
	END IF
END IF
IF Date(ldt_start) <= Date(2011,9,2) Or  Date(ldt_end) <= Date(2011,9,3) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','20110903之前和以后的数据请分开统计,20110903之前的数据请在老的医保月汇总报表中统计!')
	RETURN
END IF
IF ls_yblx = 'JBYL' Or ls_yblx = 'CXJM' Or ls_yblx = 'CXJMBHWCN' THEN
	
	dw_main.SetFilter( "")
	dw_main.Filter( )
	//医疗费用汇总
	IF	wf_ylfyhz(ldt_start, ldt_end,ldt_ljrc1,ls_yblx,is_ywlx,String(il_byd),lb_jcfy,ls_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN
	END IF
	idc_jcje = 0
ELSE
	dw_main.DataObject  = 'd_sbyhzbb_new' //20210719zbq
	dw_main.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	dw_main.SetRedraw( False)
	IF ls_yblx = 'SYD' THEN
		wf_getsyd(ldt_start, ldt_end,is_ywlx,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
		dw_main.SetRedraw( True)
		//		RETURN
	ELSE
		dw_main.Retrieve(ldt_start, ldt_end,il_byd,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
		dw_main.SetFilter( "ywlx='"+is_ywlx+"'")
		dw_main.Filter( )
	END IF
	ll_rowcount = dw_main.RowCount( )
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		//获取就诊人次
		IF IsValid(luds_jzrc) = False THEN luds_jzrc = Create u_datastore
		IF ls_yblx = 'SYD' THEN
			IF is_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
				dw_main.Object.title_t.Text = "医保月汇总报表（门诊）"
			ELSE
				dw_main.Object.title_t.Text = "医保月汇总报表（住院）"
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF is_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
				dw_main.Object.title_t.Text = "医保月汇总报表（门诊）"
				luds_jzrc.DataObject = 'd_jzrc_cbrlb' //20210719zbq
			ELSE
				dw_main.Object.title_t.Text = "医保月汇总报表（住院）"
				luds_jzrc.DataObject = 'd_jzrc_cbrlb_zy' //20210719zbq
			END IF
			
			luds_jzrc.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
			ll_count = luds_jzrc.Retrieve(ldt_start, ldt_end,il_byd,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
			IF ll_count > 0 THEN
				gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',1)
				FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
					gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',(ll_row / ll_count * 100))
					ls_cbrlb = luds_jzrc.Object.cbrlb[ll_row]
					//判断参保人类别是否为空
					IF IsNull(ls_cbrlb) THEN
						ll_find = dw_main.Find(" isnull(cbrlb) ",1, ll_rowcount)
					ELSE
						ll_find = dw_main.Find("cbrlb = '"+ls_cbrlb+"'",1, ll_rowcount)
					END IF
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN
						IF IsNull(dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find]) THEN dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find] = 0
						dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find] = dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find] + luds_jzrc.Object.jzrc[ll_row]
					ELSEIF ll_find = 0 THEN
						ll_find = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
						dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_find] = ls_cbrlb
						dw_main.Object.lbmc[ll_find] = ls_cbrlb
						dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find] = luds_jzrc.Object.jzrc[ll_row]
						dw_main.Object.sjzs[ll_find] = 0
						dw_main.Object.jjzfze[ll_find] = 0.00
						dw_main.Object.xjzfze[ll_find] = 0.00
						dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find] = 0.00
						dw_main.Object.fpjz[ll_find] = 0.00
						dw_main.Object.ywlx[ll_find] = is_ywlx
					END IF
				NEXT
				Destroy luds_jzrc
				//获取累计人次
				IF IsValid(luds_ljrc) = False THEN luds_ljrc = Create u_datastore
				
				IF is_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
					luds_ljrc.DataObject = 'd_ljrc_cbrlb' //20210719zbq
				ELSE
					luds_ljrc.DataObject = 'd_ljrc_cbrlb_zy'//20210719zbq
				END IF
				
				luds_ljrc.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
				ll_count = luds_ljrc.Retrieve(ldt_ljrc1, ldt_ljrc2,il_byd,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
				IF ll_count > 0 THEN
					gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',1)
					FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
						gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',(ll_row / ll_count * 100))
						ls_cbrlb = luds_ljrc.Object.cbrlb[ll_row]
						ll_ljrc = luds_ljrc.Object.ljrc[ll_row]
						IF IsNull(ls_cbrlb) THEN
							ll_find = dw_main.Find(" isnull(cbrlb) ",1, ll_rowcount)
						ELSE
							ll_find = dw_main.Find("cbrlb = '"+ls_cbrlb+"'",1, ll_rowcount)
						END IF
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							IF IsNull(dw_main.Object.ljrc[ll_find]) THEN dw_main.Object.ljrc[ll_find] = 0
							dw_main.Object.ljrc[ll_find] = dw_main.Object.ljrc[ll_find] + ll_ljrc
						ELSEIF ll_find = 0 THEN
							ll_find = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
							dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_find] = ls_cbrlb
							dw_main.Object.lbmc[ll_find] = ls_cbrlb
							dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find] = 0
							dw_main.Object.ljrc[ll_find] = ll_ljrc
							dw_main.Object.jjzfze[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.xjzfze[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.fpjz[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.ywlx[ll_find] = is_ywlx
						END IF
					NEXT
					Destroy luds_ljrc
				END IF
				//获取收据张数
				IF IsValid(luds_sjzs) = False THEN luds_sjzs = Create u_datastore
				luds_sjzs.DataObject = 'd_sjzs_cbrlb'//20210719zbq
				luds_sjzs.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
				luds_sjzs.Retrieve(ldt_start, ldt_end,il_byd,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
				//		luds_sjzs.setfilter( "")
				//		luds_sjzs.filter( ) 
				//		if is_ywlx='MZ' THEN
				luds_sjzs.SetFilter( "ywlx='"+is_ywlx+"'")
				luds_sjzs.Filter( )
				//		ELSE
				//			luds_sjzs.setfilter( "ywlx='ZY'")
				//			luds_sjzs.filter( ) 			 
				//		END IF
				ll_count = 	luds_sjzs.RowCount( )
				IF ll_count > 0 THEN
					gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',1)
					FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
						gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',(ll_row / ll_count * 100))
						ls_cbrlb = luds_sjzs.Object.cbrlb[ll_row]
						ll_sjzs = luds_sjzs.Object.sjzs[ll_row]
						IF IsNull(ls_cbrlb) THEN
							ll_find = dw_main.Find(" isnull(cbrlb) ",1, ll_rowcount)
						ELSE
							ll_find = dw_main.Find("cbrlb = '"+ls_cbrlb+"'",1, ll_rowcount)
						END IF
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							IF IsNull(dw_main.Object.sjzs[ll_find]) THEN dw_main.Object.sjzs[ll_find] = 0
							dw_main.Object.sjzs[ll_find] = dw_main.Object.sjzs[ll_find] + ll_sjzs
						ELSEIF ll_find = 0 THEN
							ll_find = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
							dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_find] = ls_cbrlb
							dw_main.Object.lbmc[ll_find] = ls_cbrlb
							dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find] = 0
							dw_main.Object.sjzs[ll_find] = ll_sjzs
							dw_main.Object.jjzfze[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.xjzfze[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.fpjz[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.ywlx[ll_find] = is_ywlx
						END IF
					NEXT
					Destroy luds_sjzs
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	//根据对应的参保人类别做过滤
	IF ls_yblx = 'ALL' THEN
		dw_main.SetFilter( '')
		dw_main.Filter( )
		//wf_getsyd(ldt_start, ldt_end,is_ywlx,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
		dw_main.SetRedraw( True)
		ls_filter = ''
	ELSE
		ls_filter = "cbrlb = '"+ls_yblx+"'"
		dw_main.SetFilter( "cbrlb = '"+ls_yblx+"' ")
		dw_main.Filter( )
	END IF
	SELECT sum(jzce) Into :ld_jzce From sb_jejd Where kpsj >= :ldt_start And kpsj < :ldt_end Using sqlca_query;
	IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
	Dec{2} ld_pyjzce
	IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
		SELECT sum(NVL(HJBXJE,0)) Into :ld_pyjzce From JKXT.PYYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :ldt_start And JSSJ < :ldt_end And ZTBZ In (4,5) And QRJYLSH Is Not Null And ywlx In ('SF','GH') Using sqlca_query;
		IF IsNull(ld_pyjzce) THEN ld_pyjzce = 0
		ld_jzce = ld_jzce + ld_pyjzce
	END IF
	//9月份存在-132.07的交易补差额
	IF ld_jzce <> 0 THEN
		IF String(ldt_start,'yyyymm') = '201109' THEN
			ld_jzce = ld_jzce - 132.07
			st_text.Text = em_1.Text+"至"+em_2.Text+",记账共计差：" +String(ld_jzce) +"(201109存在-132.07的补交易差额,实际的总差额以全月的差额为准)"
		ELSE
			st_text.Text = em_1.Text+"至"+em_2.Text+",记账共计差：" +String(ld_jzce)
		END IF
	ELSEIF ld_jzce = 0  THEN
		st_text.Text = ''
	END IF
	dw_main.Object.t_dwmc.Text = '温州市社会保障局'+'['+ls_dwmc+']'
	dw_main.Object.zbr.Text = '制表人:'+ls_zbrxm+'['+ls_zbrbm+']'
	dw_main.Object.st_tjrq.Text = em_1.Text+' '+'至'+' '+em_2.Text
	dw_main.Object.zbsj.Text = String(gf_server_date(),'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss')
	gf_waiting('正在统计均次费用,请稍候......',80)
	String ls_null[]
	IF lb_jcfy THEN This.wf_get_jcfy( ldt_start, ldt_end, ls_yblx,ls_null, '', ls_null, ls_null)
	//	wf_get_jcfy( ldt_start, ldt_end, ls_yblx)
	gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',-1)
	idc_jcje = 0
	IF ls_filter > ' ' THEN
		ls_filter = ls_filter + " and ywlx='"+is_ywlx+"'"
	ELSE
		ls_filter =  "ywlx='"+is_ywlx+"'"
	END IF
	dw_main.SetFilter(ls_filter)
	dw_main.Filter( )
END IF
dw_main.SetRedraw( True)
IF idc_jcje <> 0.00 THEN
	st_text.Text = '当前设置的三倍均次费用为:' + String(idc_jcje) + st_text.Text
ELSE
	st_text.Text = '' + st_text.Text
END IF




end event

blocks.text:
event clicked;//符合医保费用fhybfy=hjje-zfje-zlje
//医保均次费用=fhybfy/jzrc(zy:sjzs)
//三倍均次费用=3*医保均次费用  //自己输
//企业在职101企业退休100公务员在职201公务员退休200

String ls_mess,ls_default
String ls_je
Dec{2} ldc_jczje,ldc_jcfy
ldc_jczje = 0.00
 

If (Upper(ddlb_yblb.getcode( )) = 'JBYL' Or Upper(ddlb_yblb.getcode( )) = 'CXJM' Or Upper(ddlb_yblb.getcode( )) = 'CXJMBHWCN')  THEN
	IF dw_main.RowCount( ) > 0 And Lower(dw_main.DataObject) = 'd_ylfyhzb' THEN
		ldc_jczje = dw_main.Object.jcylf[1]
		ls_mess = String(em_1.getdatetime( 1))+'-'+String(em_2.getdatetime( 2))+"的医保均次费用为:"+String(ldc_jczje)
	ELSE
		ls_mess = String(em_1.getdatetime( 1))+'-'+String(em_2.getdatetime( 2))
	END IF
ELSE
	Int i,j
	Long ll_jzrc,ll_sjzs
	ldc_jczje = 0
	ll_jzrc = 0
	ll_sjzs = 0
	ldc_jcfy = 0
	FOR i = 1 To dw_main.RowCount( )
		IF dw_main.Object.cbrlb[i] = '100' Or dw_main.Object.cbrlb[i] = '101' Or dw_main.Object.cbrlb[i] = '200' Or dw_main.Object.cbrlb[i] = '201' THEN
			ldc_jczje = ldc_jczje+dw_main.Object.fhybfy[i]
			ll_jzrc = ll_jzrc+dw_main.Object.jzrc[i]
			ll_sjzs = ll_sjzs+dw_main.Object.sjzs[i]
		END IF
	NEXT
	
	IF ll_jzrc > 0 THEN
		IF is_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
			ldc_jcfy = ldc_jczje/ll_jzrc
		ELSE
			//ldc_jcfy=ldc_jczje/ll_sjzs
			ldc_jcfy = ldc_jczje/ll_jzrc
		END IF
	ELSE
		ldc_jcfy = 0
	END IF
	
	ls_mess = String(em_1.getdatetime( 1))+'-'+String(em_2.getdatetime( 2))+"公务员在职、退休，企业在职退休总共的医保均次费用为:"+String(ldc_jcfy)
END IF
ls_default = "请输入金额(三倍均次费用):"
ls_je = gf_inputbox(ls_mess,ls_default)
idc_jcje = Dec(ls_je)
IF IsNull(idc_jcje) Or idc_jcje < 0 THEN idc_jcje = 0.00
IF idc_jcje = 0.00 THEN
	st_text.Text = ''
ELSE
	st_text.Text = '当前设置的三倍均次费用为:' + String(idc_jcje)
END IF
 
//Event ue_ref()





end event

blocks.text:
public subroutine wf_hdjy_bd_new ();String ls_jsjylsh,ls_ybfyze,ls_error1,ls_error2 ,ls_error3,ls_errortext,ls_error4,ls_jssj,ls_grbh
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_ybfyze,ld_jzje,ld_bxje
Long ll_jymx_count,ll_dzxx_count,ll_find,i,ll_jdrow
DateTime ldt_jssj
String ls_ztbz,ls_yxbz,ls_bxzje
ls_error1 = '结算交易流水号：'
ls_error3 = '结算交易流水号：'
ls_error2 = ''
ls_error4 = ''
ls_errortext = ''
tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = ''


//==========================
ll_jymx_count = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount() //本地
ll_dzxx_count = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowCount() //导入的社保明细

IF ll_jymx_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计交易明细')
	RETURN
END IF
IF ll_dzxx_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先下载交易明细，并检查是否已正确导入')
	RETURN
END IF
tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.dataobject = 'd_pyyb_zxmx_new' 
tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.settransobject( sqlca)
FOR i = 1 To ll_jymx_count
	ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jslsh[i]
	ld_fyze = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.fyze[i]
	ld_jzje = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.hjbxje[i]
	ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Find("cbdjslsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,ll_dzxx_count)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ld_ybfyze = Dec(tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_find])
		ld_bxje = Dec(tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxje[ll_find])
//		ld_bxje = Dec(ls_bxzje)
//		ld_ybfyze = Dec(ls_ybfyze)
		IF ld_fyze <> ld_ybfyze Or  ld_jzje <> ld_bxje THEN
			ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地费用总额:'+String(ld_fyze,'###.00')+'   中心费用总额：'+String(ld_ybfyze,'###.00')+'~n'
			ls_error2 += ':本地报销总额:'+String(ld_jzje,'###.00')+'   中心报销总额：'+String(ld_bxje,'###.00')+'~n'
		END IF
	ELSE

event doubleclicked;call super::doubleclicked;String ls_brbm, ls_jsjylsh
Long ll_zyh
DateTime ldt_jysj
String ls_jzkh
s_exchange ls_exchange

IF row > 0 THEN
	il_select = row
	This.SelectRow( 0, False )
	This.SelectRow( il_select, True )
	
	IF ii_bplx = 6 THEN //住院
		ll_zyh = This.Object.zyh[il_select]
	ELSEIF ii_bplx = 3 THEN //基金支付不平
		IF IsNull(This.Object.brbm0[il_select]) Or This.Object.brbm0[il_select] = "" THEN
			ll_zyh = Long(This.Object.brbm[il_select])
			ii_bplx = 32 //基金支付不平（住院）
		ELSE
			ls_brbm = This.Object.brbm[il_select]
			ii_bplx = 31 //基金支付不平（门诊）
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_brbm = This.Object.brbm[il_select]
	END IF
	ls_exchange.LongParm[1] = ii_bplx
	ls_exchange.LongParm[2] = ll_zyh
	ls_exchange.StringParm[1] = ls_brbm
	ls_exchange.StringParm[2] = ls_jsjylsh
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[1] = idt_begin
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[2] = idt_end
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[3] = ldt_jysj
	IF ll_zyh > 0 THEN
		SELECT knxx Into :ls_jzkh From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ll_zyh Using sqlca;
	ELSE
		SELECT jzkh Into :ls_jzkh From mzxt.mz_brda Where brbm = :ls_brbm Using sqlca;
	END IF
	IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		IF Left(ls_jzkh,4) = '3311' Or Len(ls_jzkh) <  30 THEN
			ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'lb'
		ELSE
			ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'syd'
		END IF
	END IF
	OpenWithParm(w_sbdz_bptz, ls_exchange)
END IF
end event

String ls_error = '',ls_fail = '',ls_sfhx

Long ll_row ,ll_rowcount,ll_xzts

	ls_czgh = ''
	ls_dzlsh = ''
	IF dw_1.Object.xz[ll_row] = 0  THEN CONTINUE
	ls_czgh = dw_1.Object.ygdm[ll_row]
	ls_czyzh = dw_1.Object.sptbm[ll_row]
	ls_dzlsh = dw_1.Object.jyzqh[ll_row]
	ls_zdjylsh = '0'

		gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_send_init ( '9355')
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_send_add( '已下载最大交易流水号',ls_zdjylsh)

			RETURN
		END IF
	LOOP
NEXT

		FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
			ls_ywlx = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ywlx[ll_row]
			ldc_zyh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.zyh[ll_row]
			ldt_jssj = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jssj[ll_row]
			ls_mzyh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jyid[ll_row]
			ls_jylsh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jslsh[ll_row]
			ls_cbd = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.cbdxzqh[ll_row]
			IF ldc_zyh > 0 THEN
				SELECT ybkh,zhbz,knxx Into :ls_kh,:ls_sbm,:ls_knxx From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ldc_zyh;
				gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = ls_knxx
				gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ls_kh
				gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = ls_sbm
				IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfyze[ll_row] < 0 THEN
					ls_jylx = 'ZYTF'
					ls_jyh = '9209'
				ELSE
					ls_jylx = 'ZYSF'
					ls_jyh = '9208'
				END IF
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.BRBM[ll_row]
				
				SELECT JZKH,BRXM,SFZH Into :ls_knxx,:ls_brxm,:ls_sfzh From MZXT.MZ_BRDA Where BRBM = :ls_brbm;
				IF Left(ls_knxx,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
					SELECT ZJLX,LPSJ Into :ls_zjlx,:ls_zflp From  JKXT.YB_BRJBXXKZ Where ZJHM = :ls_sfzh And cbdxzqh = :ls_cbd;
					IF ls_zjlx > '' THEN
					ELSE
						ls_zflp = Mid(ls_knxx,7)
						ls_zjlx = '01'
					END IF
				END IF
				IF Left(ls_knxx,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
					gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = ls_brxm + "|" +ls_zjlx + "|" +ls_sfzh+'|' + ls_zflp + '|' + ls_cbd + '|||ZJA06B07C36D70|'+ String(base_info.syscode)
					gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ''
					gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = ""
				ELSE
					gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = ls_knxx
					gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = Right(ls_knxx,9)
					gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = Mid(ls_knxx,1,Len(ls_knxx) -9)
				END IF
				IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfyze[ll_row] < 0 THEN
					ls_jylx = 'MZTF'
					ls_jyh = '9204'
				ELSE
					ls_jylx = 'MZSF'
					ls_jyh = '9203'
				END IF
			END IF
			
			IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_jyzf( ldt_jssj, ls_jylsh, ls_jyh, ls_cbd, ls_return) <= 0 THEN
				ls_error = ls_error + ls_return
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
	IF ll_row >= ll_count THEN
		IF  ls_error > '' THEN
			MessageBox('提示','作废出错：' + ls_error)
		ELSE
			MessageBox('提示','作废成功')
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

blocks.text:
event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;String ls_dzr,ls_mess,ls_yf
Integer li_ywlx
Long ll_rowcount,ll_count

IF em_1.getdate( ) >= Date(gf_server_date()) THEN
	IF base_info.hospitalcode = '9' THEN //add by wangyi 台州不控制对账日期
		IF em_1.getdate( ) > Date(gf_server_date()) THEN
			MessageBox('提示','选择日期大于当前日期!')
			RETURN
		END IF
	ELSE
		MessageBox('提示','不能对当日及其之后的时间进行统计!')
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
idt_begin = em_1.getdatetime(1)
idt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(em_1.getdate(),1),Time(00:00:00))

//获取统计月份
ls_yf = String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymm')
ls_dzr = String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')
//如果对账日没有变化则不reset对账明细
IF is_dzr <> ls_dzr  THEN
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Reset()
END IF
is_dzr = ls_dzr
li_ywlx = Integer(ddlb_ywlx.getcode( ))
//本地异地datawindow初始化
wf_ini(li_ywlx)

//tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Reset()
//显示交易明细
//IF gu_ybjk_public.ii_tzsybxjkqy=1 and li_ywlx=1 THen
//	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.dataObject = 'd_tzyb_jsmx_sbd_dz'
//	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.dataobject = 'd_tzyb_gzxx_sbd'
//ELSE
//	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.dataObject = 'd_pyyb_jsmx'
//	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.dataobject = 'd_pyyb_gzxx'
//END IF
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.setTransOBject( sqlca)
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.setTransOBject( sqlca)
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetSort("jssj asc")
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Sort()
//根据异地本地做过滤处理
//IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
//	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("cbdxzhq = '"+is_cbdxzhq+"' or isnull(cbdxzhq)")
//	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter( )
//ELSE
//	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("cbdxzhq <> '"+is_cbdxzhq+"'")
//	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter( )
//END IF
IF tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount( ) <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','该天没有社保交易明细!')
END IF
//有社保明细再进行判断计算reset()
dw_1.Reset()
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Reset()
tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Reset()
//显示本月对账信息
tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(ls_yf)
//对对账结果进行判断，有记录则不再判断，无记录则对社保交易明细与fpk等是否保持一致
ll_rowcount = dw_1.Retrieve( is_dzr,li_ywlx)
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
		IF gu_ybjk_public.ii_tzsybxjkqy=1 Then
			IF dw_1.Object.dzjgbz[1] = '0' THEN
				RETURN
			ELSEIF base_info.qxjb < 2 THEN
				RETURN
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = 0 THEN
				RETURN
			ELSEIF base_info.qxjb < 2 THEN
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF base_info.hospitalcode = '9' THEN //台州市异地
			dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = li_ywlx
			RETURN
		ELSE
			IF dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] <> 0 THEN
				RETURN
			ELSEIF base_info.qxjb < 2 THEN
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
		dw_1.InsertRow(1)
		dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = li_ywlx
		dw_1.Object.dzr[1] = is_dzr
		IF wf_dzyz() < 0 THEN
			RETURN
		END IF
	ELSEIF li_ywlx =  2 THEN
		IF base_info.hospitalcode = '9' THEN //台州市异地
			dw_1.Object.dzlx[1] = string(li_ywlx)
			dw_1.Object.dzrq[1] = em_1.getdate( )	
			dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = li_ywlx
			dw_1.Object.dzr[1] = is_dzr	
			RETURN
		END IF	
		
		SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.PYYB_DZXX   Where PYYB_DZXX.dzr = :is_dzr ;
		IF ll_count > 0 THEN
			dw_1.InsertRow(1)
			dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = li_ywlx
			dw_1.Object.dzr[1] = is_dzr	
		ELSE
			MessageBox('提示','请先本地对账!')
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

IF ddlb_ywlx.getCode()='1' and gu_ybjk_public.ii_tzsybxjkqy=1 THen
	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
//	dw_1.InsertRow(1)
//	dw_1.Object.dzlx[1] = ls_dzlx
//	dw_1.Object.dzrq[1] =  Date(idt_begin)
ELSE
	//获取对应的总额值,进行中心对账
	wf_getdzxx(idt_begin,li_ywlx)
	//保存
	gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr,li_ywlx)
		tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		gf_waiting('汇总数据出错，请重试......',-1)
		dw_1.Reset( )
		dw_1.InsertRow(1)
		MessageBox('提示','汇总数据出错，请重试!')
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
gf_waiting('统计数据完成......',-1)

end event

blocks.text:
event doubleclicked;call super::doubleclicked;String ls_brbm,ls_jzkh,ls_sfzh,ls_cbd
Long ll_zyh
DateTime ldt_jysj

s_exchange ls_exchange

IF row > 0 THEN
	il_select = row
	nextrow:
	This.SelectRow( 0, False )
	This.SelectRow( il_select, True )
	
	IF ii_bplx = 6 THEN //住院
		ll_zyh = This.Object.zyh[il_select]
	ELSEIF ii_bplx = 3 THEN //基金支付不平
		IF IsNull(This.Object.brbm0[il_select]) Or This.Object.brbm0[il_select] = "" THEN
			ll_zyh = Long(This.Object.brbm[il_select])
			ii_bplx = 32 //基金支付不平（住院）
		ELSE
			ls_brbm = This.Object.brbm[il_select]
			ii_bplx = 31 //基金支窪AT*
恫黄剑�门诊�

		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_brbm = This.Object.brbm[il_select]
	END IF
	IF ii_bplx = 4 Or ii_bplx = 41 THEN
		IF tab_1.tabpage_1.cbx_1.Checked  THEN
			ii_bplx = 41
		ELSE
			ii_bplx = 4
		END IF
	END IF
	ls_exchange.LongParm[1] = ii_bplx
	ls_exchange.LongParm[2] = ll_zyh
	ls_exchange.StringParm[1] = ls_brbm
	ls_exchange.StringParm[2] = ''
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[1] = idt_begin
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[2] = idt_end
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[3] = ldt_jysj
	IF ll_zyh > 0 THEN
		SELECT knxx,sfzh,sbhm Into :ls_jzkh,:ls_sfzh,:ls_cbd From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ll_zyh Using sqlca;
		if len(ls_jzkh) <  30  and posw(ls_jzkh,'|') = 0 then
			ls_cbd = gu_pyybjk.is_yljgxzqh
		else
			if isnull(ls_cbd) or ls_cbd = '' then
				ls_cbd = Left(ls_jzkh,6)
			end if
		end if
	ELSE
		SELECT jzkh,sfzh Into :ls_jzkh,:ls_sfzh From mzxt.mz_brda Where brbm = :ls_brbm Using sqlca;
		if left(ls_jzkh,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
			SELECT CBDXZQH INTO :ls_cbd FROM JKXT.YB_BRJBXXKZ WHERE ZJHM = :ls_sfzh ORDER BY GXSJ DESC;
			IF ls_cbd > '0' THEN
			ELSE
				ls_cbd = gu_pyybjk.is_yljgxzqh
			END IF
		ELSE
			ls_cbd = Left(ls_jzkh,6)
		END IF
	END IF
	
	//IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	IF ls_cbd > '' THEN
		IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN //wangyi 20190424			
			//IF Left(ls_jzkh,6) = gu_tzybjk.is_yljgxzqh THEN
        IF Pos(is_tzsbj , ls_cbd) > 0 THEN
				ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'tzsbd'		
			ELSEIF Left(ls_cbd,4) = '3310' THEN
				ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'tzsyd'

event ue_keyenter;String ls_zxbb, ls_mess
SELECT ZXBB Into :ls_zxbb From SS_ZXBB Where XTSB = :base_info.syscode;
IF  ls_zxbb > gs_zxbb THEN
	MessageBox('提示','您当前使用的门诊收费程序并不是最新版本，请马上退出程序重新登录!!!')
	mzsf_main.af_close()
	Close(Parent)
	HALT CLOSE;
	RETURN
END IF

str_brxx lstr_brxx
lstr_brxx.jzkh = This.Text
boolean lb_ybjk = true

	ls_mess = "就诊卡号为空，请重新刷卡！"
	Messagebox('提示', ls_mess)
	st_mess.Text = ls_mess
	return
END IF
	
	
str_return lstr_return
IF Mid( This.Text,1,4) = 'BRBM' THEN
	lstr_brxx.brbm = Mid(This.Text,5)
	lstr_return = uf_get_brxx(lb_ybjk, 'BRBM',lstr_brxx)
ELSE
	lstr_return = uf_get_brxx(lb_ybjk,lstr_brxx) //获取病人信息

IF lstr_return.ai_return < 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','无效病人信息!' + lstr_return.as_error)
	st_mess.Text = '无效病人信息!' + lstr_return.as_error
	sle_jzkh.SetFocus( )
	RETURN

	sle_xb.Text = '男'

	sle_xb.Text = '女'
ELSE
	sle_xb.Text = ''
END IF
sle_yddh.Text = String(istr_brxx.yddh)
sle_csny.Text = String(istr_brxx.csny, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
Select xzmc into :sle_jslb.Text From xtgl.gy_brxz Where brxz=:istr_brxx.jslb Using sqlca;
IF isnull(sle_jslb.Text) or Len(Trim(sle_jslb.Text))<=0 Then sle_jslb.Text = String(istr_brxx.jslb)
Select dwmc into :sle_jsdw.Text From xtgl.gy_tgdw Where brxz=:istr_brxx.jslb and tgdw=:istr_brxx.jsdw Using sqlca;

IF istr_brxx.ztbz < 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示',istr_brxx.brxm+' 的病人档案已经作废或者锁定，无法在门诊进行操作!'+lstr_return.as_error)
	RETURN
END IF
IF istr_brxx.ybpb = 1 THEN
	IF gu_ybjk_public.istr_yb_grjbxx.zydjbz = 1 THEN
		IF MessageBox('提示','该病人已经进行过住院登记，无法在门诊进行，是否继续?',Question!,YesNo!,2) = 1 THEN
		ELSE
			sle_jzkh.SetFocus( )

		END IF
	END IF
END IF

			ld_ylfyze = dw_1.Object.ylfze[ll_i]
			ld_jjzfze = dw_1.Object.jjzfze[ll_i]
			ld_grzhzfze = dw_1.Object.grzhzfze[ll_i]
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_init('3201')
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('insutype',ls_xz)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('clr_type',ls_qslb)
			if ls_qslb ='99994' then
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('setl_optins','330000')
			else
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('setl_optins',iu_zhyl_his.is_yljgxzqh)
			end if
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('stmt_begndate',Date(idt_begin))
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('stmt_enddate',Date(idt_end))
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('medfee_sumamt',ld_ylfyze)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('fund_pay_sumamt',ld_jjzfze)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('acct_pay',ld_grzhzfze)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('fixmedins_setl_cnt',ll_jybs)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('refd_setl_flag','')
			IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_send(ls_err,'') THEN
				IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
					MessageBox('提示',iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring('err_msg'))
					RETURN
				ELSE
					iu_zhyl_his.uf_Getstring_mxnr('stmtinfo')
					ls_dzjg = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('stmt_rslt',1)
					ls_dzjgsm = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('stmt_rslt_dscr',1)
					dw_1.Object.dzjg[ll_i] = ls_dzjg
					dw_1.Object.dzjgsm[ll_i] = ls_dzjgsm
					
				END IF
			ELSE
				gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',-1)
				MessageBox('提示','险种:'+ls_xz+',类别:'+ls_qslb+'对账失败'+ls_err+',请程序退出重试！')
				RETURN
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
	
ELSE //异地对账
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',1)
		FOR ll_i = 1 To ll_rowcount
			gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',(ll_i*100/ll_rowcount))
			if dw_1.Object.dzjg[ll_i] = '1' then continue
			ls_cbdybqh = dw_1.Object.cbdybqh[ll_i]
			ls_rybh = dw_1.Object.rybh[ll_i]
			ld_ylfyze = dw_1.Object.ylfze[ll_i]
			ld_jjzfze = dw_1.Object.jbjgzfze[ll_i]
			ldt_jssj = dw_1.Object.jzjssj[ll_i]
			ls_jslsh = dw_1.Object.jslsh[ll_i]
			ls_jzid = dw_1.Object.jzid[ll_i]
			li_ywlx = dw_1.Object.ywlx[ll_i]
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_init('1505')
			iu_zhyl_his.istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = '330000' //20220208
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in_mxnr('data')
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('mdtrtareaAdmdvs',iu_zhyl_his.is_yljgxzqh,1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('insuplcAdmdvs',ls_cbdybqh,1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('fixmedinsNo',iu_zhyl_his.is_yljgdm,1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('psnNo',ls_rybh,1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('medfeeSumamt',ld_ylfyze,1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('optinsPaySumamt',ld_jjzfze,1)
			IF ld_ylfyze >= 0 THEN
				li_jylx = 1 //正交易
			ELSE
				li_jylx = 0 //负交易
			END IF
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('mdtrtSetlTime',String(ldt_jssj,'yyyymmddhhmmss'),1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('trnsType',li_jylx,1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('mdtrtSeq',ls_jzid,1) //就诊id
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('setlSn',ls_jslsh,1)
			JX:
			IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_send(ls_err,'') THEN
				IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
					MessageBox('提示',iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring('err_msg'))
					RETURN
				ELSE
					//	ll_cwts = iu_zhyl_his.uf_Getstring_mxnr('data')
					//for ll_rec = 1 to ll_cwts
					ls_dzjg = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('succFlag',1)
					ls_dzjgsm = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('prmmsg',1)
					dw_1.Object.dzjg[ll_i] = ls_dzjg
					dw_1.Object.dzjgsm[ll_i] = ls_dzjgsm
					//	next 
				END IF
			ELSE
				IF Pos(ls_err,'timeout') > 0 Or (ls_err = '' Or IsNull(ls_err)) THEN
					GOTO JX
				END IF
				gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',-1)
				MessageBox('提示',ls_rybh+'对账失败'+ls_err+',请程序退出重试！')
				RETURN
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
END IF

gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)	
	dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr,li_ywlx)
	tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
	MessageBox('提示','对账完成')
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
	MessageBox('提示','险种:'+ls_xz+',类别:'+ls_qslb+'社保对账结果：' + ls_dzjg +",保存失败!")
END IF

end event

	MessageBox('社保笔数：'+String(ll_dzxx_count),'本地有效笔数：'+String(ll_jymx_count))
else //异地
	
	ll_jymx_count = dw_1.RowCount() 
	FOR i = 1 To ll_jymx_count
		ls_jsjylsh = dw_1.Object.jslsh[i]
		ld_fyze = dw_1.Object.ylfze[i]
		ls_cbdxzqhdm = dw_1.Object.cbdybqh[i]
		ls_dzjg	=	dw_1.Object.dzjg[i]
		if ls_dzjg='0' then
			ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Find("jsid='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,ll_dzxx_count)
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ld_ybfyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfze[ll_find]
				//ld_ybfyze = Dec(ls_ybfyze)
				IF ld_fyze <> ld_ybfyze THEN
					ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地费用总额:'+String(ld_fyze,'###.00')+'   中心费用总额：'+String(ld_ybfyze,'###.00')+'~n'
				END IF
			ELSE
				//本地有,中心没有的
				ls_error1 = ls_error1 + "jslsh='"+ls_jsjylsh +"'~t"
			END IF
		end if
	NEXT
	
	IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN
		MessageBox('本地有而中心没有的数据',ls_error1)
	END IF
	
	MessageBox('社保笔数：'+String(ll_dzxx_count),'本地有效笔数：'+String(ll_jymx_count))
end if

String ls_brbm,ls_jylx,ls_cbd
FOR i = 1 To ll_dzxx_count
	ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jsid[i]
	ld_ybfyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfze[i]
	ls_grbh =  tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.rybh[i]
	ls_brbm = ls_grbh
	if  ddlb_ywlx.getcode() = '1' then
		ls_fsfid = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.fsfid[i]
	else
		ls_fsfid = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.fsbwid[i]
	end if

	ls_ybfyze = String(ld_ybfyze)
	//ld_ybfyze = Dec(ls_ybfyze)
	//	if ld_ybfyze < 0 then continue
	ll_find = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Find("jslsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"' and grbh = '" +ls_grbh+"'",1,ll_jymx_count)
	IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
		ll_find = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Find("jslsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"' and grbh = '"+ls_grbh+"'",1,tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount())//还没写
		//对于交易明细和改帐信息中都没有的中心交易作改帐处理
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.rowscopy( i, i, Primary!, tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd, 1, Primary!)
			ls_error3 = ls_error3 + "jylsh='"+ls_fsfid+"'" +'~t' + "费用总额:" + ls_ybfyze +'~t'
		ELSE
			IF ld_ybfyze <> Dec(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfze[ll_find]) THEN
				MessageBox('总额不一致' , ls_fsfid + "社保:" + ls_ybfyze + "本地:" + String(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfze[ll_find]))
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT

IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地有而中心没有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error1 + '~t'
IF ls_error3 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地没有而中心有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error3 + '~t'
IF ls_error2 <> '' THEN
	ls_errortext += '本地与中心有出入的有：' + '~t' +  ls_error2
	MessageBox('提示',ls_errortext)
END IF
tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = ls_errortext
tab_1.SelectTab(6)
IF tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = '' THEN
	tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = '祝贺你此次对帐顺利通过，哈哈 请客！'
	MessageBox('提示','对帐已通过')
END IF
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
end event

blocks.text:
event ue_cancel();//
Int li_sbbz
Long ll_i,ll_row,j
String ls_err,ls_sqid
//dw_ysb.SetFilter( "sbbz=1")
//dw_ysb.Filter( )
ll_row = dw_ysb.RowCount( )
//ll_row = dw_ysb.GetRow()
j = 0
IF ll_row <= 0 THEN RETURN

IF Not IsValid(iu_zhyl_his) THEN
	iu_zhyl_his = Create u_zhyl_his
	IF Not iu_zhyl_his.uf_init(ls_err) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','初始化医保接口对象失败!'+ls_err)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF

IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_czy_qrqc(Date(gf_server_date()),base_info.UserID,1,ls_err) = -1 THEN
	MessageBox('出错提示','获取操作员签到编号' + ls_err)
	RETURN
END IF

gf_waiting('正在取消上报，请稍后......',1)
//FOR ll_i = 1 To ll_row
	ll_i = dw_ysb.getrow()
	gf_waiting('正在取消上报，请稍后......',(ll_i*100/ll_row))
//	li_sbbz = dw_ysb.Object.sbbz[ll_i]
//	IF li_sbbz = 1 THEN
		ls_sqid = dw_ysb.Object.clr_appy_evt_id[ll_i]
		iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_init('3204')
		iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('clr_appy_evt_id',ls_sqid)
		IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_send(ls_err,'') THEN
			IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
				MessageBox('提示',iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring('err_msg'))
				RETURN
			ELSE
				dw_ysb.Object.ZFPB[ll_row] = 1
				dw_ysb.Object.CZSJ[ll_row] = gf_server_date()
				j++
			END IF
		ELSE
			gf_waiting('正在取消上报，请稍后......',-1)
			MessageBox('提示','第'+String(ll_i)+'行清算撤销失败:'+ls_err+',请程序退出重试！')
			RETURN
		END IF
	//END IF
//NEXT
IF dw_ysb.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
	gf_ROLLBACK_transaction(sqlca);
	gf_waiting('正在取消上报，请稍后......',-1)
	MessageBox('出错提示','清算撤销上报失败，请重试' + sqlca.SQLErrText)
	RETURN
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca);
	gf_waiting('正在撤销上报，请稍后......',-1)
	PostEvent("ue_ref")
	PostEvent("ue_filter")
	MessageBox('提示','撤销上报成功！')
END IF




end event

blocks.name: ue_qssq
blocks.text:
event ue_qssq();
Long ll_row,i,j,ll_insertrow,ll_find,li_ypcd,ll_ypxh
String ls_error,ls_ypmc,ls_qsny,ls_gjbm,ls_mlbm,ls_pydm,ls_qsid
Int li_sbbz,li_type
String ls_czgh,ls_err,ls_fyly
DateTime ldt_czsj
Dec ld_fyxh
string ls_qslb,ls_qsfs

decimal ll_rc,ll_ylfze,ll_ybrkze,ll_jjsbze,ll_xjzfje,ll_grzhzc
Date ld_start,ld_end


ldt_czsj = gf_server_date()
ls_czgh = base_info.UserID
gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)


IF Not IsValid(iu_zhyl_his) THEN
	iu_zhyl_his = Create u_zhyl_his
	IF Not iu_zhyl_his.uf_init(ls_error) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','初始化医保接口对象失败!'+ls_error)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_czy_qrqc(Date(gf_server_date()),base_info.UserID,1,ls_err) = -1 THEN
	MessageBox('出错提示','获取操作员签到编号' + ls_err)
	RETURN
END IF

ll_row = dw_qssq.RowCount()
IF ll_row > 0 THEN
 	ls_qslb = dw_qssq.Object.qslb[1]
	ls_qsfs = dw_qssq.Object.qsfs[1]  
	ls_qsny = dw_qssq.Object.qsny[1] 
	ll_rc = dw_qssq.Object.qsrc[1] 
	ll_ylfze = dw_qssq.Object.ylfze[1] 
	ll_ybrkze = dw_qssq.Object.ybrkfyze[1] 
	ll_jjsbze = dw_qssq.Object.jjsbze[1] 
	ll_xjzfje = dw_qssq.Object.xjzfje[1] 
	ll_grzhzc = dw_qssq.Object.grzhzc[1]
	ld_start = dw_qssq.Object.kssj[1] 
	ld_end = dw_qssq.Object.jssj[1] 

	
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_init('3203')
	//	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in_mxnr('data')
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('clr_type',ls_qslb)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('clr_way',ls_qsfs)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('setlym',ls_qsny)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('psntime',ll_rc)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('medfee_sumamt',ll_ylfze)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('med_sumfee',ll_ybrkze)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('fund_appy_sum',ll_jjsbze)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('cash_payamt',ll_xjzfje)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('acct_pay',ll_grzhzc)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('begndate',ld_start)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('enddate',ld_end)
	IF iu_zhyl_his .uf_send(ls_error,'') = True THEN
		IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
			MessageBox('提示',iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring('err_msg'))
			RETURN
		ELSE
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_Getstring_mxnr('result')
			ls_qsid = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('clr_appy_evt_id',1)
			ll_insertrow = dw_ysb.InsertRow(0)
			dw_ysb.Object.clr_type[ll_insertrow] = ls_qslb
			dw_ysb.Object.clr_way[ll_insertrow] = ls_qsfs
			dw_ysb.Object.setlym[ll_insertrow] = ls_qsny
			dw_ysb.Object.psntime[ll_insertrow] = ll_rc
			dw_ysb.Object.medfee_sumamt[ll_insertrow] = ll_ylfze
			dw_ysb.Object.med_sumfee[ll_insertrow] =  ll_ybrkze
			dw_ysb.Object.fund_appy_sum[ll_insertrow] =  ll_jjsbze
			dw_ysb.Object.cash_payamt[ll_insertrow] = ll_xjzfje
			dw_ysb.Object.acct_pay[ll_insertrow] = ll_grzhzc
			dw_ysb.Object.begndate[ll_insertrow] = ld_start
			dw_ysb.Object.enddate[ll_insertrow] = ld_end
			dw_ysb.Object.CZSJ[ll_insertrow] = gf_server_date()
			dw_ysb.Object.ZFPB[ll_insertrow] = 0
			dw_ysb.Object.clr_appy_evt_id[ll_insertrow] = ls_qsid
		END IF
	ELSE
		MessageBox('提示',ls_error)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF


IF dw_ysb.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
	gf_ROLLBACK_transaction(sqlca);
	Destroy iu_zhyl_his
	gf_waiting('正在上报，请稍后......',-1)
	MessageBox('出错提示','更新ZHYB_QSSQ出错，请重试' + sqlca.SQLErrText)
	RETURN
ELSE
	gf_waiting('正在上报，请稍后......',-1)
	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca);
	MessageBox('提示','上报成功！')
	PostEvent("ue_ref")
END IF



























end event

event ue_tj();string ls_qslb,ls_qsfs

decimal ll_rc,ll_ylfze,ll_ybrkze,ll_jjsbze,ll_xjzfje,ll_grzhzc
DateTime ldt_start,ldt_end

ldt_start = em_4.getdatetime(1)
ldt_end = em_5.getdatetime(2)
dw_qssq.reset()
dw_qssq.Object.t_jsny.Text = "申请年月:"  +  String(ldt_start,'yyyymm')
IF String(ldt_start,'yyyymm') <> String(ldt_end,'yyyymm') THEN
	MessageBox('错误提示','清算时间要在同一个自然月内')
	RETURN
END IF
ls_qslb = ddlb_qslb.getcode()
ls_qsfs = ddlb_qsfs.getcode()
SELECT Count(1) ,Sum(ylfze),Sum(jjzfze+grfdzje),Sum(jjzfze),Sum(grxjzc),sum(grzhzc) INTO:ll_rc,:ll_ylfze,
	:ll_ybrkze,:ll_jjsbze,:ll_xjzfje,:ll_grzhzc FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx WHERE qslb = :ls_qslb //AND (qsfs = :is_qsfs or qsfs='')
	And (jssj >= :ldt_start And jssj <= :ldt_end)  and substr(cbdxzqh,1,4)=:is_cbdxzhq and ztbz<>0 and(grzhzc+jjzfze)<>0; 
IF ll_rc> 0 THEN
	dw_qssq.insertrow(0)
	dw_qssq.Object.qslb[1] = ls_qslb
	dw_qssq.Object.qsfs[1] = ls_qsfs
	dw_qssq.Object.qsny[1] = String(ldt_start,'yyyymm')
	dw_qssq.Object.qsrc[1] = ll_rc
	dw_qssq.Object.ylfze[1] = ll_ylfze
	dw_qssq.Object.ybrkfyze[1] = ll_ybrkze
	dw_qssq.Object.jjsbze[1] = ll_jjsbze+ll_grzhzc
	dw_qssq.Object.xjzfje[1] = ll_xjzfje
	dw_qssq.Object.grzhzc[1] = ll_grzhzc
	dw_qssq.Object.kssj[1] = date(ldt_start)
	dw_qssq.Object.jssj[1] = date(ldt_end)
	dw_toolbar.of_setenabled('ue_qssq',true)
ELSE
	MessageBox('错误提示','清算时间内没有数据')
	RETURN
END IF





end event

public function integer wf_getsyd (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, string as_ywlx, long al_tsmxbz, decimal adc_jcfy);Dec{2} ldc_fyze,ldc_xjzf,ldc_jjzf,ldc_zfze,ldc_zlze,ldc_fhybfy,ldc_fpjz
long ll_insert,ll_ljrc,ll_jzrc,ll_sjzs
datetime ldt_ljrc1 
if date(adt_end) < date(2017,6,1)  then return 1
ldt_ljrc1 = DateTime(Date(Year(Date(adt_begin)),1,1),Time(00:00:00))
IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	SELECT  SUM(FYZE) YLFYZE,
			  SUM(GRXJZF) XJZFZE,
			  SUM(HJBXJE) JJZFZE,
			  sum(CASE WHEN YWLX = 'SF' THEN HJBXJE ELSE 0 END) AS FPJZ,
			  SUM(CASE WHEN YWLX = 'GH' THEN 0  		         WHEN YWLX = 'SF' AND ZTBZ = 3 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) SJZS ,
		     SUM(ZFZE) YLFYZFZE,
			  SUM(ZLZE) YLFYZLZE,
		     SUM(FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE) FHYBFY
		INTO :ldc_fyze,:ldc_xjzf,:ldc_jjzf,:ldc_fpjz,:ll_sjzs,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_fhybfy
		FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND
				( JSLSH is NOT NULL ) AND
				( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND
				( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND
				( YWLX In ('SF','GH')) and
				( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
				(FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
	if dw_main.rowcount( ) > 0 then
		ll_insert = dw_main.find( "cbrlb = 'SYD' and ywlx = '"+as_ywlx+"'", 1, dw_main.rowcount( ) )
		if ll_insert <= 0 then  ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	else
		ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	end if
	dw_main.object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'SYD'
	dw_main.object.lbmc[ll_insert] = '省异地'
	dw_main.object.ywlx[ll_insert] = as_ywlx
	dw_main.object.sjzs[ll_insert] = ll_sjzs
	dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ylfyzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_zfze
	dw_main.object.ylfyzlze[ll_insert] = ldc_zlze
	dw_main.object.jjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_jjzf
	dw_main.object.xjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_xjzf
	dw_main.object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = ldc_fyze
	dw_main.object.fpjz[ll_insert] = ldc_fpjz
	dw_main.object.fhybfy[ll_insert] = ldc_fhybfy
	SELECT count(DISTINCT to_char(jssj,'yyyymmdd') || brbm) INTO :ll_jzrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX In ('SF','GH')) and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
  dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = ll_jzrc
   SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT GRBH||cbdxzqh) INTO :ll_ljrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :ldt_ljrc1) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX In ('SF','GH')) and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;

	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = ll_ljrc
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	SELECT  SUM(FYZE) YLFYZE,
			  SUM(GRXJZF) XJZFZE,
			  SUM(HJBXJE) JJZFZE,
		     SUM(ZFZE) YLFYZFZE,
			  SUM(ZLZE) YLFYZLZE,
		     SUM(FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE) FHYBFY,
			  SUM(CASE WHEN  ZTBZ = 3 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) SJZS 
		INTO :ldc_fyze,:ldc_xjzf,:ldc_jjzf,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_fhybfy,:ll_sjzs
		FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND
				( JSLSH is NOT NULL ) AND
				( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND
				( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND
				( YWLX In ('ZY')) and
				( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
				( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
	if dw_main.rowcount( ) > 0 then
		ll_insert = dw_main.find( "cbrlb = 'SYD' and ywlx = '"+as_ywlx+"'", 1, dw_main.rowcount( ) )
		if ll_insert <= 0 then  ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	else
		ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	end if
	ldc_fpjz = ldc_jjzf
	dw_main.object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'SYD'
	dw_main.object.lbmc[ll_insert] = '省异地'
	dw_main.object.ywlx[ll_insert] = as_ywlx
	dw_main.object.sjzs[ll_insert] = ll_sjzs
	dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ylfyzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_zfze
	dw_main.object.ylfyzlze[ll_insert] = ldc_zlze
	dw_main.object.jjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_jjzf
	dw_main.object.xjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_xjzf
	dw_main.object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = ldc_fyze
	dw_main.object.fpjz[ll_insert] = ldc_fpjz
	dw_main.object.fhybfy[ll_insert] = ldc_fhybfy
  
    SELECT count(DISTINCT JYID) INTO :ll_jzrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX = 'ZY') and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
  dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = ll_jzrc
   SELECT count(DISTINCT GRBH||cbdxzqh) INTO :ll_ljrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :ldt_ljrc1) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX = 'ZY') and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = ll_ljrc
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer wf_get_jcfy (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, string as_ywlx, string as_ywlxs[], string as_byd, string as_jyjslxs[], string as_cbrlbs[]);//1：均次药品费，2：均次药品费占均次费用的比率，即均次药占比；3：均次材料费，4：均次材料费占均次费用的比率，即均次材料占比；
Long ll_count,ll_row,ll_find
String ls_ywlx
dec{2} ldc_zfy = 0.00
u_datastore luds_jcfy
luds_jcfy = Create u_datastore
IF as_ywlx = 'JBYL' Or as_ywlx = 'CXJM' Or as_ywlx = 'CXJMBHWCN' THEN
	luds_jcfy.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhzb_jc'//20210719zbq
	luds_jcfy.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	ll_count = luds_jcfy.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,as_ywlxs,as_byd,as_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,as_cbrlbs)
	IF ll_count > 0 and dw_main.rowcount( ) > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row =  1 To ll_count
			ldc_zfy = ldc_zfy + luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row]
			dw_main.Object.ypf[1] = luds_jcfy.Object.ypf[ll_row]
			dw_main.Object.clf[1] = luds_jcfy.Object.clf[ll_row]
			IF dw_main.Object.ylfyze[1]  <>  ldc_zfy THEN
				gf_applog( '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[1]) + "--jc"+String(ldc_zfy)+"）")
				MessageBox('提示', '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[1]) + "--jc"+String(ldc_zfy)+"）")
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
ELSE
	String ls_cbrlb
	luds_jcfy.DataObject = 'd_sbyhzbb_jc'//20210719zbq
	luds_jcfy.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	ll_count = luds_jcfy.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,il_byd,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row =  1 To ll_count
			ls_cbrlb = luds_jcfy.Object.cbrlb[ll_row]
			ls_ywlx = luds_jcfy.Object.ywlx[ll_row]
			ll_find = dw_main.Find("cbrlb = '"+ls_cbrlb+"' and ywlx = '" + ls_ywlx +"'",1,dw_main.RowCount())
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				IF dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]  <> luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row] THEN
					gf_applog('参保人类别：' + ls_cbrlb + '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]) + "--jc"+String(luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row])+"）")
					MessageBox('提示','参保人类别：' + ls_cbrlb + '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]) + "--jc"+String(luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row])+"）")
				END IF
				dw_main.Object.ypf[ll_find] = luds_jcfy.Object.ypf[ll_row]
				dw_main.Object.clf[ll_find] = luds_jcfy.Object.clf[ll_row]
			ELSE
				MessageBox('提示','找不到参保人类别：' + ls_cbrlb + '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'的汇总信息')
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
END IF
Destroy luds_jcfy
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer wf_ylfyhz (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, datetime adt_ndks, string as_yblx, string as_ywlx, string as_byd, boolean ab_jcfy, ref string as_error);String ls_title,ls_error,ls_lx
String ls_ywlxs[],ls_cbrlbs[],ls_jyjslxs[]
gf_waiting('正在准备数据..........',1)
dw_main.DataObject  = 'd_ylfyhzb'//20210719zbq
dw_main.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)



//"1本地;2异地;3全部" as_byd
IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	ls_lx = '（门诊）'
	ls_ywlxs[1] = 'SF'
	ls_ywlxs[2] = 'GH'
	ls_jyjslxs[1] = '001'
	ls_jyjslxs[2] = '002'
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	ls_lx = '（住院）'
	ls_ywlxs[1] = 'ZY'
	ls_jyjslxs[1] = '011'
END IF
//	温州市基本医疗保险医疗费用汇总表（门诊）
//	温州市城乡居民保险医疗费用汇总表（住院）
dw_main.Object.title_t.Text = '温州市'+ ddlb_qslb.Text + '保险医疗费用汇总表' + ls_lx
dw_main.SetRedraw( False)

gf_waiting('正在统计基本数据..........',20)
dw_main.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
// 人次数
u_datastore luds_rcs,luds_rts
gf_waiting('正在统计人次数.........',50)
IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	luds_rcs = Create u_datastore
	luds_rcs.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhz_rc' //20210719zbq
	luds_rcs.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	luds_rcs.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	luds_rcs = Create u_datastore
	luds_rcs.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhz_zyrc' //20210719zbq
	luds_rcs.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	luds_rcs.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
END IF
//人头数
gf_waiting('正在统计人头数.........',70)
luds_rts = Create u_datastore
luds_rts.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhz_rt' //20210719zbq
luds_rts.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
luds_rts.Retrieve(adt_ndks, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
dw_main.Object.rcs[1] = luds_rcs.Object.rczs[1]
dw_main.Object.rts[1] = luds_rts.Object.rtzs[1]
IF String(adt_begin,'yyyy.mm') <> left(em_2.text,7) THEN
	dw_main.Object.st_tjrq.Text = String(adt_begin,'yyyymm') +"-" +String(em_2.getdate(),'yyyymm')
ELSE
	dw_main.Object.st_tjrq.Text = String(adt_begin,'yyyymm')
END IF
gf_waiting('正在计算均次费用..........',80)
if ab_jcfy then this.wf_get_jcfy( adt_begin, adt_end, as_yblx, ls_ywlxs, as_byd, ls_jyjslxs, ls_cbrlbs)
gf_waiting('数据完成..........',-1)
dw_main.SetRedraw( True)
RETURN 1
end function

public function long wf_auto_jdmz (datetime ld_start, datetime ld_end);datastore ds_sb_fpk,ds_sb_jymx
Long ll_fpk_count,ll_jymx_count , i  , ll_find,ll_return ,ll_fplsh_count
String ls_zxlsh,ls_bz,ls_txt,ls_fplsh
Dec {0} ll_lsh

ll_return = 0

ds_sb_fpk = Create datastore
ds_sb_jymx = Create datastore

ds_sb_fpk.DataObject = 'd_sb_autodz_fpk'
ds_sb_jymx.DataObject = 'd_sb_autodz_jymx'

ds_sb_fpk.SetTransObject(sqlca)
ds_sb_jymx.SetTransObject(sqlca)


ds_sb_fpk.Retrieve(ld_start,ld_end)
ds_sb_jymx.Retrieve(ld_start,ld_end)

ll_fpk_count = ds_sb_fpk.RowCount()
ll_jymx_count = ds_sb_jymx.RowCount()


FOR i = 1 To  ll_fpk_count
	ls_zxlsh = ds_sb_fpk.Object.zxlsh[i]
	IF IsNull(ls_zxlsh) THEN ls_zxlsh = ''
	ll_find = ds_sb_jymx.Find( "zxlsh='"+ls_zxlsh+"'", 1,  ll_jymx_count  )
	IF IsNull(ll_find) THEN ll_find = 0
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ds_sb_jymx.Object.bz[ll_find] = '1'
	ELSE
		IF Trim(ls_zxlsh) <= '' Or IsNull(ls_zxlsh) THEN CONTINUE;
		MessageBox('提示','zxlsh='+ls_zxlsh+'   需内部调帐' + String(ds_sb_fpk.Object.grbm[i]))
		RETURN 100;
	END IF
NEXT

ls_txt = ''
FOR i = 1 To ll_jymx_count
	ls_bz = ds_sb_jymx.Object.bz[i]
	ll_lsh = ds_sb_jymx.Object.lsh[i]
	ls_fplsh = ds_sb_jymx.Object.fplsh[i]
	
	ls_zxlsh = ds_sb_jymx.Object.zxlsh[i]
	IF IsNull(ls_fplsh) THEN ls_fplsh = ''
	IF IsNull(ls_bz) Or Trim(ls_bz) <= '' THEN ls_bz = ''
	IF ls_bz = '0' THEN
		ll_fplsh_count = 0
		SELECT count(*)  Into :ll_fplsh_count From sb_jymx Where fplsh = :ls_fplsh  And fplsh Is Not Null;
		IF IsNull(ll_fplsh_count) THEN ll_fplsh_count = 0
		IF ll_fplsh_count >= 2 THEN CONTINUE;
		ls_txt = ls_txt+'  '+ls_zxlsh
	ELSE
		CONTINUE;
	END IF
	IF Trim(ls_zxlsh) <= '' Or IsNull(ls_zxlsh) THEN CONTINUE;
	
	gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	INSERT Into sb_jymx_gzxx SELECT * From sb_jymx Where zxlsh = :ls_zxlsh   And lsh = :ll_lsh;
	IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		DELETE From sb_jymx Where zxlsh = :ls_zxlsh   And lsh = :ll_lsh;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		ELSE
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			ll_return = 101
			EXIT
		END IF
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		ll_return = 101
		EXIT
	END IF
NEXT

IF ls_txt <> '' THEN
	MessageBox('提示','门诊需改帐的流水号有：'+ls_txt)
END IF

Destroy ds_sb_fpk;
Destroy ds_sb_jymx;


RETURN ll_return




end function

public function integer wf_dzyz ();
u_datastore lds_bpmx
lds_bpmx = Create u_datastore

String ls_bpmx
Long ll_rowcount, ll_temp

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',1)
cbx_1.visible =false
//判断预存是否有过正确结转
//=======================核对==============================//
Dec{2} ld_kyc, ld_yck_fp,ldc_yck_gh
Long ll_count

ld_kyc = 0
SELECT SUM(JYJE) INTO :ld_kyc FROM H_MZ_ZHJYMX
	Where JYSJ >= :idt_begin And JYSJ <= :idt_end And JYLB In (11,12) ;
//And Upper(JYDD) Not In ('GH','ZZGH');
IF IsNull(ld_kyc) THEN ld_kyc = 0

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',10)

//====预存款－－扣款fpk,zffs
ld_yck_fp = 0
SELECT sum(NVL(H_FP_ZFFS.ZFJE,0)) INTO :ld_yck_fp FROM mz_fpk,H_FP_ZFFS
	WHERE mz_fpk.kpsj >= :idt_begin AND mz_fpk.kpsj <= :idt_end 
	//	AND (H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '5' OR H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '7' OR H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '8' or H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '10')
	AND (H_FP_ZFFS.zffs IN (SELECT to_char(dmsb) FROM xtgl.gy_dmzd WHERE dmlb = 34 AND bzbm2 = 1))
	And NVL(mz_fpk.fpzf,0) <> 9  And mz_fpk.fplsh = H_FP_ZFFS.fplsh;
IF IsNull(ld_yck_fp) THEN ld_yck_fp = 0
//挂号非现金支付
ldc_yck_gh = 0.00
SELECT sum(NVL(xjje,0)) INTO :ldc_yck_gh FROM MZ_GHXX
	WHERE GHRQ >= :idt_begin AND GHRQ <= :idt_end 
	AND ZFFS IN (SELECT to_char(dmsb) FROM xtgl.gy_dmzd WHERE dmlb = 34 AND bzbm2 = 1)
	And NVL(THBZ,'0') In ('0','s','t','r');
IF IsNull(ldc_yck_gh) THEN ldc_yck_gh = 0

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',20)

IF Abs(ld_kyc + ld_yck_fp + ldc_yck_gh) > 1 THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_yc'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('预存发票未正确结转......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "预存发票未正确结转"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 1 //预存不平
		
		dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ycgh'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('预存发票未正确结转......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "预存发票未正确结转（挂号）"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 2 //预存挂号不平
		
		dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//重复的2,3清理
wf_delrep(idt_begin,idt_end)

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',30)

//----验证基金支付总额是否和分基金支付总和一致------- //
SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_count FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx t
	WHERE jjzfze <> (JBYLBXTCJJZC + GWYYLBZZJZC + QYBCYLBXJJZC + JMDBBXZJZC + ZGDEYLFYBZJJZC + YLJZJJZC + QTZC + nvl(SCRYYLBZJJZC,0))
	And jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj <= :idt_end  And  jslsh Is Not Null  And ZTBZ > 0 ;
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jjzf'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 3 //基金支付不平
	END IF
	
	//	MessageBox('提示,不能对帐,请与计算中心联系','有'+String(ll_count) + "条记录，验证基金支付总额是否和稤AT*
只�金支付总和一�
") 	//	gf_waiting('基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致......',-1) 	SetNull(is_dzr) 	RETURN -1
END IF

//------验证门诊数据一致性----社保门诊发票记帐金额-------- //
Dec {2} ld_sbjzje, ld_mzjz, ld_sbzje, ld_jzce, ld_fpzje, ld_ylfyze,ldc_gbxjzf,ldc_tsje,ld_zce
//发票库
SELECT sum(jzje),SUM(CASE when gfje =1 then XMZJE - nvl(yhje,0) else XMZJE end)  INTO :ld_sbjzje, :ld_fpzje FROM mz_fpk
	WHERE kpsj >= :idt_begin AND kpsj <= :idt_end  AND NVL(fpzf,0) <> 9
	And jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ld_sbjzje) THEN ld_sbjzje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_fpzje) THEN ld_fpzje = 0

SELECT sum(jzce),sum(jzce + zfce) INTO :ld_jzce, :ld_zce FROM mzxt.sb_jejd
	Where kpsj >= :idt_begin And kpsj <= :idt_end  And XMLB = 0;
	IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
IF IsNull(ld_zce) THEN ld_zce = 0

ld_sbjzje = ld_sbjzje + ld_jzce
ld_fpzje = ld_fpzje + ld_zce

//医保结算
SELECT sum(nvl(JJZFZE,0)+nvl(grzhzc,0)),sum(nvl(YLFZE,0) + nvl(bscje,0)) INTO :ld_mzjz, :ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj <= :idt_end  AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;

SELECT sum(nvl(grxjzc,0) + nvl(bscje,0)) INTO :ldc_gbxjzf FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj <= :idt_end  AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' 
	And (gbbjdx >= '1' OR YWLSH IN (SELECT YWLSH  FROM jkxt.js_tsjl 	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj <= :idt_end  AND ybywh Is NOT NULL 	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 AND JSFL = 'JRYF'));
SELECT sum(nvl(tszje,0)) INTO :ldc_tsje FROM jkxt.js_tsjl
	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj <= :idt_end  AND ybywh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;
	
IF IsNull(ld_mzjz) THEN ld_mzjz = 0
//IF IsNull(ld_sdjzje) THEN ld_sdjzje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_gbxjzf) THEN ldc_gbxjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_tsje) THEN ldc_tsje = 0

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',60)

ld_sbzje = ld_mzjz  + (ldc_gbxjzf - ldc_tsje) 

IF ld_sbzje <> ld_sbjzje Or ld_ylfyze <> ld_fpzje THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_sfjz'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		dw_bpmx.Title = "门诊交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 4 //门诊收费不平
		//		for ll_temp = 1 to ll_rowcount
		//			ls_bpmx = ls_bpmx + lds_bpmx.object.#1[ll_temp] + " " + string(lds_bpmx.object.#2[ll_temp]) +&
		//			" " + string(lds_bpmx.object.#3[ll_temp]) + "~n"
		//		next
	END IF
	
	gf_waiting('门诊交易数据不一致......',-1)	
	cbx_1.visible = true
	cbx_1.bringtotop = TRUE
	//	MessageBox('提示,不能对帐,请与计算中心联系','门诊交易数据不一致:社保理论交易(yb_jsmx) :总金额' + String(ld_ylfyze) + '，记账金额'+String(ld_sbzje)+'  sb实际发生额 (mz_fpk)：总金额'+String(ld_fpzje)+'，记账金额'+String(ld_sbjzje)+'  差值：'+ String(ld_ylfyze - ld_fpzje)+'----'+String(ld_sbzje - ld_sbjzje) + '~n' + ls_bpmx)
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//挂号记账金额是否一致验证------------------
Dec{2} ld_ghjz, ld_sbghjz, ld_sdghjz, ld_ghzje,  ld_ghzjje,ld_ckblf = 0.00

SELECT sum(NVL(ZJJE,0) - NVL(XJJE,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)), sum(NVL(ZJJE,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)) INTO :ld_ghjz, :ld_ghzjje FROM mz_ghxx
	WHERE GHRQ >= :idt_begin AND GHRQ <= :idt_end  AND (nvl(THBZ,0) NOT IN ('i','3'))
	And jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);


SELECT sum(nvl(ghfy,0)) Into :ld_ckblf From mz_ghxx,mz_ghfyxx 
	Where mz_ghxx.ghlsh = mz_ghfyxx.ghlsh And mz_ghxx.GHRQ >= :idt_begin And mz_ghxx.GHRQ <= :idt_end   
	And (nvl(mz_ghxx.THBZ,0) Not In ('i','3')) And mz_ghxx.jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1) 
	And (mz_ghfyxx.fyxh = :il_ckf or mz_ghfyxx.fyxh = :il_blf);

IF IsNull(ld_ckblf) THEN ld_ckblf = 0
ld_jzce = 0
ld_zce = 0
SELECT sum(jzce),sum(jzce + zfce) INTO :ld_jzce, :ld_zce FROM mzxt.sb_jejd
	Where kpsj >= :idt_begin And kpsj <= :idt_end  And XMLB = 1;
	
IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
IF IsNull(ld_zce) THEN ld_zce = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ghjz) THEN ld_ghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ghzjje) THEN ld_ghzjje = 0 
ld_ghjz = ld_ghjz + ld_jzce
ld_ghzjje = ld_ghzjje + ld_zce - ld_ckblf
gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',70)
ldc_tsje  = 0
SELECT sum(nvl(jjzfze,0)+nvl(grzhzc,0)), sum(nvl(ylfze,0) + nvl(bscje,0)) INTO :ld_sbghjz, :ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj <= :idt_end  AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' ; 

SELECT sum(nvl(grxjzc,0) + nvl(bscje,0)) INTO :ldc_gbxjzf FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj <= :idt_end  AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' 
	And (gbbjdx >= '1' OR YWLSH IN (SELECT YWLSH  FROM jkxt.js_tsjl 	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj <= :idt_end  AND ybywh Is NOT NULL 	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 AND JSFL = 'JRYF'));
	
SELECT sum(nvl(tszje,0)) INTO :ldc_tsje FROM jkxt.js_tsjl
	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj <= :idt_end  AND ybywh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;
	
IF IsNull(ld_sbghjz) THEN ld_sbghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_gbxjzf) THEN ldc_gbxjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_tsje) THEN ldc_tsje = 0
ld_sbghjz = ld_sbghjz + (ldc_gbxjzf - ldc_tsje) //+干保托收和优抚优惠的金额

IF ld_ghjz <> ld_sbghjz Or ld_ghzjje <> ld_ylfyze THEN
	gf_waiting('门诊挂号交易数据不一致......',-1)
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_gh'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	long ll_ckbl[]
	ll_ckbl[1] = il_ckf
	ll_ckbl[2] = il_blf
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end,ll_ckbl )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		dw_bpmx.Title = "门诊挂号交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 5 //门诊挂号不平
	END IF
	cbx_1.visible = true
	cbx_1.bringtotop = TRUE
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//住院病人结算金额是否一致验证----------------------
Dec{2} ldc_zyjz, ldc_zyjzzf, ldc_zyzje, ldc_zyzjezf, ldc_sbzyjz, ldc_sbzyzje

// 2021.12.17  CJN  27897  (WD)住院总金额计算需要剔除不上传费用NVL(BSCJE,0)
SELECT sum(NVL(fyhj,0) - NVL(zfhj,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)), sum(NVL(fyhj,0)- NVL(YHJE,0) -NVL(BSCJE,0)) INTO :ldc_zyjz, :ldc_zyzje FROM zy_zyjs
	WHERE jsrq >= :idt_begin AND jsrq <= :idt_end 
	And brxz In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ldc_zyjz) THEN ldc_zyjz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zyzje) THEN ldc_zyzje = 0

SELECT sum(NVL(fyhj,0) - NVL(zfhj,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)), sum(NVL(fyhj,0)- NVL(YHJE,0)-NVL(BSCJE,0)) INTO :ldc_zyjzzf, :ldc_zyzjezf FROM zy_zyjs
	WHERE zfrq >= :idt_begin AND zfrq <= :idt_end  AND zfpb = 1
	And brxz In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ldc_zyjzzf) THEN ldc_zyjzzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zyzjezf) THEN ldc_zyzjezf = 0

ldc_zyjz = ldc_zyjz - ldc_zyjzzf
ldc_zyzje = ldc_zyzje - ldc_zyzjezf

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',90)

SELECT sum(NVL(jjzfze,0)+NVL(grzhzc,0)), sum(NVL(ylfze,0)) INTO :ldc_sbzyjz, :ldc_sbzyzje FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj <= :idt_end  AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') in ('ZY','ZYMZ') And ZTBZ > 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_sbzyjz) THEN ldc_sbzyjz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_sbzyzje) THEN ldc_sbzyzje = 0
IF ldc_zyzje <> ldc_sbzyzje  THEN  //or ldc_zyjz <> ldc_sbzyjz
	gf_waiting('住院病人交易数据不一致......',-1)
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zy' 
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		dw_bpmx.Title = "住院病人交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 6 //住院不平
	END IF
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF
update  jkxt.zhyb_jsmx set dzzt = 1	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj <= :idt_end  AND jslsh Is NOT NULL and ZTBZ > 0 and (dzzt = 0 or dzzt is null );
commit;
gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',-1)
RETURN 1

end function

public subroutine wf_getdzxx (datetime adt_dzrq, integer ai_ywlx);DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end,ldt_jssj[]
String ls_dzr ,ls_error,ls_xz[],ls_qslb[],ls_cbdxzqh[],ls_rybh[],ls_jslsh[],ls_jzid[]
Long   	ll_jybs[],ll_insertrow,ll_find,ll_jlxh[]
Decimal	ld_ylfze[],ld_jjzfze[],ld_grzhzfze[],ld_xjzfje[],ld_GRXJZC[]
Int li_i,i
ldt_begin = DateTime(Date(adt_dzrq),Time(00:00:00))
ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_dzrq),1),Time(00:00:00))
ls_dzr = String(adt_dzrq,'YYYYMMDD')
IF ai_ywlx = 1 THEN
	// 2.声明游标
	DECLARE cur_bddzxx CURSOR FOR //本地对账
		SELECT xzlx,qslb,SUM(NVL(YLFZE,0)),SUM(NVL(jjzfze,0)),SUM(NVL(GRZHZC,0)),SUM(NVL(GRXJZC,0))
		From JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :ldt_begin And JSSJ < :ldt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And JSLSH Is Not Null And substr(CBDXZQH,1,4) = :is_cbdxzhq   Group By xzlx,qslb;
	// 3.打开游标
	OPEN cur_bddzxx;
	IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		CLOSE cur_bddzxx;
		RETURN
	END IF
	// 4.移动游标，获取数据。
	li_i = 1
	FETCH cur_bddzxx Into :ls_xz[li_i], :ls_qslb[li_i],:ld_ylfze[li_i],:ld_jjzfze[li_i],:ld_grzhzfze[li_i],:ld_xjzfje[li_i];
	DO WHILE sqlca.SQLCode = 0
		SELECT COUNT(*) Into :ll_jybs[li_i]  From JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :ldt_begin And JSSJ < :ldt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And JSLSH Is Not Null And substr(CBDXZQH,1,4) = :is_cbdxzhq And xzlx = :ls_xz[li_i] And qslb = :ls_qslb[li_i];
		li_i++
		FETCH cur_bddzxx Into :ls_xz[li_i], :ls_qslb[li_i],:ld_ylfze[li_i],:ld_jjzfze[li_i],:ld_grzhzfze[li_i],:ld_xjzfje[li_i];
	LOOP
	// 5.关闭游标
	CLOSE cur_bddzxx;
	li_i = li_i -1
	FOR i = 1 To li_i
		IF IsNull(ld_ylfze[i]) THEN ld_ylfze[i] = 0
		IF IsNull(ld_jjzfze[i]) THEN ld_jjzfze[i] = 0
		IF IsNull(ld_grzhzfze[i]) THEN ld_grzhzfze[i] = 0
		IF IsNull(ld_xjzfje[i]) THEN ld_xjzfje[i] = 0
		ll_find = dw_1.Find("dzr ='"+ls_dzr+"' AND XZ='"+ls_xz[i]+ "' AND QSLB='"+ls_qslb[i]+"' and ywlx="+String(ai_ywlx),1,dw_1.RowCount())
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			dw_1.Object.YLFZE[ll_find] = ld_ylfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.jjzfze[ll_find] = ld_jjzfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.grzhzfze[ll_find] = ld_grzhzfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.xjzfje[ll_find] = ld_xjzfje[i]
			dw_1.Object.jybs[ll_find] = ll_jybs[i]
		ELSE
			ll_insertrow = dw_1.InsertRow(0)
			dw_1.Object.ywlx[ll_insertrow] = ai_ywlx
			dw_1.Object.dzr[ll_insertrow] = ls_dzr
			dw_1.Object.jybs[ll_insertrow] = ll_jybs[i]
			dw_1.Object.xz[ll_insertrow] = ls_xz[i]
			dw_1.Object.qslb[ll_insertrow] = ls_qslb[i]
			dw_1.Object.YLFZE[ll_insertrow] = ld_ylfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.jjzfze[ll_insertrow] = ld_jjzfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.grzhzfze[ll_insertrow] = ld_grzhzfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.xjzfje[ll_insertrow] = ld_xjzfje[i]
		END IF
		
	NEXT
ELSEIF ai_ywlx = 2 THEN
	DECLARE cur_yddzxx CURSOR FOR //异地对账
		SELECT jlxh,cbdxzqh,GRBH,NVL(YLFZE,0),NVL(jjzfze,0),JSSJ,jslsh,jzid,NVL(GRXJZC,0)
		From JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :ldt_begin And JSSJ < :ldt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And JSLSH Is Not Null And substr(CBDXZQH,1,4) <> :is_cbdxzhq;
	// 3.打开游标
	OPEN cur_yddzxx;
	IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		CLOSE cur_yddzxx;
		RETURN
	END IF
	// 4.移动游标，获取数据。
	li_i = 1
	FETCH cur_yddzxx Into :ll_jlxh[li_i],:ls_cbdxzqh[li_i], :ls_rybh[li_i],:ld_ylfze[li_i],:ld_jjzfze[li_i],:ldt_jssj[li_i],:ls_jslsh[li_i],:ls_jzid[li_i],:ld_GRXJZC[li_i];
	DO WHILE sqlca.SQLCode = 0
		li_i++
		FETCH cur_yddzxx Into :ll_jlxh[li_i],:ls_cbdxzqh[li_i], :ls_rybh[li_i],:ld_ylfze[li_i],:ld_jjzfze[li_i],:ldt_jssj[li_i],:ls_jslsh[li_i],:ls_jzid[li_i],:ld_GRXJZC[li_i];
	LOOP
	// 5.关闭游标
	CLOSE cur_yddzxx;
	li_i = li_i -1
	FOR i = 1 To li_i
		IF IsNull(ld_ylfze[i]) THEN ld_ylfze[i] = 0
		IF IsNull(ld_jjzfze[i]) THEN ld_jjzfze[i] = 0
		ll_find = dw_1.Find("dzr ='"+ls_dzr+"' AND cbdybqh='"+ls_cbdxzqh[i]+ "' AND rybh='"+ls_rybh[i]+"' and jslsh = '"+ls_jslsh[i]+"'",1,dw_1.RowCount())
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			
		ELSE
			ll_insertrow = dw_1.InsertRow(0)
			dw_1.Object.dzr[ll_insertrow] = ls_dzr
			dw_1.Object.cbdybqh[ll_insertrow] = ls_cbdxzqh[i]
			dw_1.Object.rybh[ll_insertrow] = ls_rybh[i]
			dw_1.Object.jzjssj[ll_insertrow] = ldt_jssj[i]
			dw_1.Object.YLFZE[ll_insertrow] = ld_ylfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.jbjgzfze[ll_insertrow] = ld_ylfze[i]-ld_GRXJZC[i]
			dw_1.Object.JSLSH[ll_insertrow] = ls_jslsh[i]
			dw_1.Object.jlxh[ll_insertrow] = ll_jlxh[i]
			dw_1.Object.jzid[ll_insertrow] = ls_jzid[i]
			dw_1.Object.ywlx[ll_insertrow] = 2
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF




end subroutine

public subroutine wf_delrep (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end);u_datastore luds_del
luds_del = Create u_datastore
luds_del.DataObject = 'd_jslsh_zhdel'
luds_del.SetTransObject(SQLCA)
luds_del.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end)

Long ll_rowcount,ll_zyh,ll_cur
String ls_brbm,ls_jsjylsh,ls_mxzdh,ls_jylsh
ll_rowcount = luds_del.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[1]
	ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[1]
	ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[1]
	ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jzid[1]
	
	FOR ll_cur = 2 To ll_rowcount
		IF ll_zyh = 0 THEN
			IF ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur] THEN
				luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur]
				ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jzid[ll_cur]
				ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur] THEN
				luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur]
				ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jzid[ll_cur]
				ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF

gf_begin_transaction(SQLCA)
IF luds_del.Update( ) = 1 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(SQLCA)
	luds_del.SetFilter( "ztbz = -8")
	luds_del.Filter( )
	ll_rowcount = luds_del.RowCount()
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
		ls_jylsh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[ll_cur]
		ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur]
		ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jzid[ll_cur]
		UPDATE jkxt.zhyb_jsmx_kz Set ztbz = -8 Where jslsh = :ls_jsjylsh and jzid = :ls_mxzdh And jylsh = :ls_jylsh;
		COMMIT Using SQLCA;
	NEXT
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(SQLCA)
	MessageBox('提示','del失败')
END IF

IF IsValid(luds_del) THEN Destroy luds_del

end subroutine

public function string wf_replacestr (string as_str, string as_find, string as_replace);/*******************************************************************************
[功能] 对as_str 用as_replace 替换所有的as_find
将一个字符串指定字符串替换为另一个字符串
*******************************************************************************/

Long		ll_pos ,ll_len

IF as_str = '' Or IsNull(as_str)Or	as_find = as_replace THEN RETURN as_str

ll_len = Lenw(as_replace)
ll_pos = 0
DO
	IF ll_pos + ll_len = 0 Or ll_pos = 0 THEN
		ll_pos = Posw(as_str , as_find, 1 )
	ELSE
		ll_pos = Posw(as_str , as_find, ll_pos + ll_len )
	END IF
	IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
		as_str = Replacew(as_str,ll_pos,Lenw(as_find),as_replace)
	END IF
	
LOOP WHILE ll_pos > 0
RETURN as_str


end function

public function integer wf_ybtk ();String ls_return,ls_cbd,ls_jsjylsh,ls_grbh,ls_ywlx,ls_brbm,ls_knxx

//Dec{2} ld_ylfyze

str_zhyl_jsxx Lstr_zhyl_jsxx,Lstr_zhyl_jsxx_N
li_ret = 0
ll_count = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount()
//ll_count = 2
gf_waiting('正在退款，请稍后......',1)
FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
	//判断改誅AT*
噬昵牒藕徒崴憬灰琢魉�号是否为�

	gf_waiting('退款进行时......',(ll_cur*100/ll_count))
	ls_grbh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.grbh[ll_cur]
	ldt_jssj = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jssj[ll_cur]

	ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jslsh[ll_cur]
//	ld_ylfyze = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfze[ll_cur]
	ls_ywlx = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur]
	ls_brbm= tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
	ldc_zyh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
//	ls_cbdybqh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
//	ls_jzid = astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID
//	ls_grbh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.GRBH
	iu_zhyl_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm = ls_cbd
	IF Time(ldt_jssj) > Time(23:55:00) THEN
		IF MessageBox('提示',ls_jsjylsh + '的交易时间'+String(ldt_jssj)+'可能存在跨天，是否继续退款操作！',question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
	ls_knxx = ''
	iu_zhyl_his.ii_zymz = 0
	IF ls_ywlx = 'ZY' OR ls_ywlx = 'ZYMZ'  THEN
		IF ls_ywlx = 'ZYMZ' THEN

	   END IF

	ELSE		
		ls_ywlx = 'MZ'
		select jzkh into :ls_knxx from mzxt.mz_brda where brbm = :ls_brbm;
	END IF
	if ls_knxx > ' ' then
		if iu_zhyl_his.uf_zhcx( ls_knxx, ls_return) < 0 then			
			MessageBox('提示','第'+string(ll_cur)+'zhcx失败:kh' + ls_knxx + '  错误：' + ls_return  )
			continue
		end if
	end if
	Lstr_zhyl_jsxx = Lstr_zhyl_jsxx_N
	li_ret = iu_zhyl_his.uf_tfcl( ls_ywlx, ls_jsjylsh, 'YBDZTK', ldt_jssj, Lstr_zhyl_jsxx,ls_return)
	//	li_ret = iu_zhyl_his.uf_jyzf(ldt_jssj,ls_ywlx,ls_grbh,ls_jsjylsh,ls_return)
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		MessageBox('提示','退款失败'+ls_return)
		gf_waiting('退款失败',-1)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
NEXT
MessageBox('提示','退款成功')
gf_waiting('退款成功......',-1)
return 1

event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;String ls_dzr,ls_mess,ls_yf
Integer li_ywlx
Long ll_rowcount,ll_count,i,j,ll_find,ll_insert
//ll_find,ll_count1,ll_count2,ll_count3,ll_count4,
//Dec {2}  ld_dnzhzfze,ld_lnzhzfze,ld_ybzfxjzfze,ld_tczfze,ld_gbzfze,ld_jzzfze,ld_zyjjzfze,ld_zje,ld_jmybjjzfze
//Dec {2} ld_mztotal,ld_zytotal,ld_total_mzghmx,ld_total_mzypmx,ld_total_mzzlmx,ld_total_zyypmx,ld_total_zyzlmx
//Dec {2} ld_sddnzhzfze,ld_sdlnzhzfze,ld_sdybzfxjzfze,ld_sdtczfze,ld_sdgbzfze,ld_sdjzzfze,ld_sdzyjjzfze,ld_sdjmybjjzfze
//Dec {2} ld_sdmztotal,ld_zzlje

//IF em_1.getdate( ) >= Date(gf_server_date()) THEN
//	MessageBox('提示','不能对当日及其之后的时间进行统计!')
//	RETURN
//END IF
idt_begin = em_1.getdatetime(1)
idt_end = DateTime((em_1.getdate()),Time(23:59:59))

//获取统计月份
ls_yf = String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymm')
ls_dzr = String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')
//如果对账日没有变化则不reset对账明细
IF is_dzr <> ls_dzr  THEN
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Reset()
END IF
is_dzr = ls_dzr
li_ywlx = Integer(ddlb_ywlx.getcode( ))
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Reset()
//显示交易明细
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetSort("jssj asc")
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Sort()
//根据异地本地做过滤处理
IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("left(cbdxzqh,4) = '"+is_cbdxzhq+"' or isnull(cbdxzqh)")
	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter( )
ELSE
	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("left(cbdxzqh,4) <> '"+is_cbdxzhq+"'")
	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter( )
END IF
IF tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount( ) <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','该天没有社保交易明细!')
END IF
//有社保明细再进行判断计算reset()
dw_1.Reset()
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Reset()
tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Reset()
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.SetFilter("left(cbdxzqh,4) = '"+is_cbdxzhq+"' or isnull(cbdxzqh)")
	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Filter( )
ELSE
	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.SetFilter("left(cbdxzqh,4) <> '"+is_cbdxzhq+"'")
	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Filter( )
END IF 
//显示本月对账信息
tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(ls_yf)

ll_rowcount = dw_1.Retrieve( is_dzr,li_ywlx)
IF ll_rowcount > 0  THEN
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	j = 0
	FOR i = 1 To ll_rowcount
		IF dw_1.Object.dzjg[i] = '0' THEN
			j++
		ELSEIF base_info.qxjb < 2 THEN
			RETURN
		END IF
	NEXT
	IF j = ll_rowcount THEN
		RETURN
	END IF
ELSE
	
IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
		dw_1.InsertRow(1)
		dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = li_ywlx
		dw_1.Object.dzr[1] = is_dzr
		dw_1.Object.jybs[1] = 0
		dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = 1
		dw_1.Object.xz[1]='310'
		dw_1.Object.qslb[1]='11'
		IF wf_dzyz() < 0 THEN //测试先注释zbq20220127
			RETURN
		END IF
	ELSEIF li_ywlx =  2 THEN
		SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.ZHYB_DZXX   Where ZHYB_DZXX.dzr = :is_dzr And ZHYB_DZXX.ywlx = 1 ;
		IF ll_count > 0 THEN
			//			dw_1.InsertRow(1)
			//			dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = li_ywlx
			//			dw_1.Object.dzr[1] = is_dzr
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.SetFilter("left(cbdxzqh,4) <> '"+is_cbdxzhq+"'")
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Filter( )
		ELSE
			MessageBox('提示','请先本地对账!')
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
//IF wf_dzyz() < 0 THEN
//	is_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]
//	RETURN
//END IF
//获取对应的总额值,进行中心对账
wf_getdzxx(idt_begin,li_ywlx)
//保存
gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
	//gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
	dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr,li_ywlx)
	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
	//---------------------
	if ddlb_ywlx.getcode() = '2' then //异地插入总对账20220407ZBQ
		ll_count = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
		if ll_count>0 then
			ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.find("dzr = '"+Left(ls_dzr,8)+"'and rybh = '1' ",1,ll_count)
			if ll_find>0 then 
			else
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.insertrow(0)
				tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.object.dzr[ll_insert]=Left(ls_dzr,8)
				tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.object.rybh[ll_insert]='1'
				tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.object.JZJSSJ[ll_insert]=gf_server_date()
			end if
		else
			ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.insertrow(0)
			tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.object.dzr[ll_insert]=Left(ls_dzr,8)
			tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.object.rybh[ll_insert]='1'
			tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.object.JZJSSJ[ll_insert]=gf_server_date()
		end if
	end if
	IF tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Update( ) = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
	else
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		gf_waiting('汇总数据出错，请重试......',-1)
		dw_1.Reset( )
		dw_1.InsertRow(1)
		MessageBox('提示','汇总数据出错，请重试!')
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN
	end if
	//---------------------
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
	gf_waiting('汇总数据出错，请重试......',-1)
	dw_1.Reset( )
	dw_1.InsertRow(1)
	MessageBox('提示','汇总数据出错，请重试!')
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN
END IF
gf_waiting('统计数据完成......',-1)





end event
