public function integer wf_load_jdmx (ref string as_error);IF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.PYYB_JSMX)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'wd' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.YB_JSMX)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SYD)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.LSYB_JSMX)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SBD)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'zhyb' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX)'	
END IF
dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("")
dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
CHOOSE CASE ii_bplx
	CASE 1 //预存不平
		dw_ybjsmx.Visible = False
		rb_1.visible = False
		rb_2.visible = False
		rb_3.visible = False
		rb_4.visible = False
		st_1.Text = "门诊账户交易明细(MZXT.H_MZ_ZHJYMX)"
		dw_zhjymx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zhjymx'
		dw_zhjymx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_zhjymx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		dw_fpzffs.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_fpzffs.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		st_2.Text = "门诊交易明细(MZXT.MZ_FPK)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_fpkdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
	CASE 2 //预存挂号不平
		dw_ybjsmx.Visible = False
		rb_1.visible = False
		rb_2.visible = False
		rb_3.visible = False
		rb_4.visible = False
		st_1.Text = "门诊账户交易明细(MZXT.H_MZ_ZHJYMX)"
		dw_zhjymx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zhjymx_gh'
		dw_zhjymx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_zhjymx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		st_2.Text = "门诊挂号明细(MZXT.MZ_GHXX)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ghxxdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
	CASE 31 //基金支付不平（门诊）
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pymz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbd_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'zhyb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_jsmx_mz'
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_mz'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	CASE 32 //基金支付不平（住院）
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pyzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_zy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbdzy'	
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lszy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'zhyb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_jsmx_zy'	
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_zy'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( il_zyh )
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	CASE 4,7,41 //门诊收稤AT*

		
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pymz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbd_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'zhyb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_jsmx_mz'	
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_mz'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		st_2.Text = "门诊交易明细(MZXT.MZ_FPK)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_fpkdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		if ii_bplx = 4 or  ii_bplx = 41 then
			dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("YWLX = 'SF'")
			dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
			cb_gzcl.event clicked( )
			cb_save.event clicked( )
			if ii_bplx = 41 then cb_exit.event clicked( )
		end if
	CASE 5,8,51 //门诊挂号不平
		
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pymz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbd_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'zhyb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_jsmx_mz'	
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_mz'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )	
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		st_2.Text = "门诊挂号明细(MZXT.MZ_GHXX)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ghxxdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		if ii_bplx = 5 or  ii_bplx = 51 then
			dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("YWLX = 'GH'")
			dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
			cb_gzcl.event clicked( )
			cb_save.event clicked( )
			if ii_bplx = 51 then cb_exit.event clicked( )
		end if
	CASE 6,9 //住院不平
		IF il_zyh <= 0 Or IsNull(il_zyh) THEN
			IF IsNull(il_zyh) THEN il_zyh = 0
			as_error = '传入住院号有误ZYH' + String(il_zyh)
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pyzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_zy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lszy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbdzy'			
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'zhyb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_jsmx_zy'		
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_zy'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( il_zyh )
		if ii_bplx = 6 then
			dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("YWLX = 'ZY'")
			dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
		end if
		st_2.Text = "住院结算明细(BQXT.ZY_ZYJS)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zyjsdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( il_zyh )
END CHOOSE

RETURN 1



end function

public subroutine wf_get_sql ();String ls_sql, ls_sql1, ls_sql2, ls_sql3, ls_sql4, ls_sql5
Integer li_pos1, li_pos2, li_pos3

//JKXT.YB_JSMX的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 32 Or ii_bplx = 6 THEN
	ls_sql = dw_ybjsmx.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql, ":an_zyh")

	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql1, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql1 = Replace(ls_sql1, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql1, ":adt_begin")

	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql1, ":adt_end")

	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql2, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql2 = Replace(ls_sql2, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))

//BQXT.ZY_ZYJS的SQL语句

	ls_sql3 = dw_mxdz.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT

//MZXT.H_MZ_ZHJYMX的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 1 Or ii_bplx = 2 THEN
	ls_sql4 = dw_zhjymx.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql4, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql4 = Replace(ls_sql4, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql4, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql4 = Replace(ls_sql4, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))

	ls_sql4 = Replace(ls_sql4, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))

//MZXT.H_FP_ZFFS的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 1 Or ii_bplx = 2 THEN
	ls_sql5 = dw_fpzffs.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql5, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql5 = Replace(ls_sql5, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql5, ":adt_begin")

blocks.text:
public function integer wf_bjy (ref string as_error);String ls_brbm,ls_ksbm,ls_ysbm,ls_ywlx_y,ls_fplsh
Dec{0} ldc_ghlsh
Dec{2} ldc_zjje,ldc_jzje,ldc_yhje,ldc_yhje_t
Integer li_gfje,li_count,li_row
DateTime ldt_now,ldt_kpsj
u_datastore uds_bjy_temp
uds_bjy_temp = Create u_datastore
uds_bjy_temp.DataObject = 'd_zhybbjy_temp'
uds_bjy_temp.SetTransObject(sqlca)
li_count = uds_bjy_temp.Retrieve()
IF li_count <= 0 THEN
	IF IsValid(uds_bjy_temp) THEN Destroy uds_bjy_temp
	RETURN 0
END IF
ldt_now = gf_server_date()
ls_brbm = uds_bjy_temp.Object.brbm[1]

uo_brxx luo_brxx
u_datastore lds_yb_sfmx
IF IsValid(gu_ybjk_public) = False THEN
	gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
	IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_init(as_error) = False THEN
		as_error = '医保初始化失败：' + as_error
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
str_brxx lstr_brxx
str_return lstr_return
luo_brxx = Create uo_brxx
string ls_jzkh
ls_jzkh = gf_inputbox('请刷卡','')
lstr_brxx.jzkh = ls_jzkh
lstr_return = luo_brxx.uf_get_brxx(lstr_brxx)
IF lstr_return.ai_return < 0 THEN
	as_error = '获取病人信息失败：' + lstr_return.as_error
	GOTO Error
END IF 

//lstr_brxx.BRBM = ls_brbm //
if ls_brbm <> lstr_brxx.BRBM then
	as_error = '病人编码不一致:' + ls_brbm + '----' + lstr_brxx.BRBM
	GOTO Error
end if
str_yb_mzsfqq_public lstr_yb_mzsfqq,lstr_yb_mzsfqq_null
Dec{2} ldc_smkzf
String ls_jylx,ls_bzdm
ldc_smkzf = 0
Dec{2} ldc_xmsl
String ls_ywlx,ls_filter
Long ll_fyxh,ll_ypcd,ll_find
Long ll_count ,ll_cur,ll_yyts,ll_spbz
Dec{0} ldc_cflsh,ldc_jzlsh
String ls_ycsl,ls_jl,ls_jsjylsh,ls_firstfplsh,ls_fplshs[],ls_fplsh_temp[],ls_fplsh_null[]
String ls_ywlsh,ls_zh,ls_spbz
Boolean lb_isyz = False
Int li_ret
Dec{2} ldc_tzje,ldc_tjzje
String ls_newfp = ''
str_yb_mzghqq_new lstr_yb_mzghqq
lds_yb_sfmx = Create u_datastore
FOR li_row = 1 To li_count
	ls_ywlx_y = uds_bjy_temp.Object.ywlx[li_row]
	ls_fplsh = uds_bjy_temp.Object.ywlsh[li_row]
	ls_jylx = uds_bjy_temp.Object.yllb[li_row]
	ls_bzdm = uds_bjy_temp.Object.bzbm[li_row]
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'GH' THEN
		ldc_ghlsh = Dec(ls_fplsh)
		SELECT BRBM,nvl(ZJJE,0),nvl(ZJJE,0) - nvl(XJJE,0),KSBM,ysbm Into :ls_brbm,:ldc_zjje,:ldc_jzje,:ls_ksbm,:ls_ysbm From MZ_GHXX Where GHLSH = :ldc_ghlsh;
	ELSE
		SELECT grbm,GHLSH,(CASE when gfje = 1 THEN xmzje - nvl(yhje,0) ELSE xmzje END) ,jzje Into :ls_brbm,:ldc_ghlsh,:ldc_zjje,:ldc_jzje From mz_fpk Where fplsh = :ls_fplsh;
	END IF
	IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '获取发票信息失败：' + sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	//SELECT jyjslx,smkzhzf Into :ls_jylx,:ldc_smkzf From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where BRBM = :ls_brbm And ywlx  = :as_ywlx And ywlsh = :as_fplsh And ztbz In (1,2,-1) Using sqlca;
	
	//SELECT yllb ,bzbm INTO  :ls_jylx, :ls_bzdm FROM JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX
	//	Where BRBM = :ls_brbm And ywlx  = :ls_ywlx And ywlsh = :ls_ywlsh  And ztbz In (1,2) Using sqlca;
	
	IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '获取医保结算信息出错:' + sqlca.SQLErrText
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	IF ls_jylx = '11' Or ls_jylx = '12' Or ls_jylx = '13' THEN
		ls_jylx = 'PT'
	ELSEIF ls_jylx = '140201' THEN
		ls_jylx = 'TSB'
		lstr_brxx.tsbxm = ls_bzdm
	ELSEIF ls_jylx = '14' THEN // ls_jylx = '140104' Or
		ls_jylx = 'MXB'
		lstr_brxx.mxbxm = ls_bzdm
	ELSEIF ls_jylx = '140401' THEN
		ls_jylx = 'HJB'
	ELSEIF ls_jylx = '51' THEN
		ls_jylx = 'SY'
	ELSE
		ls_jylx = 'PT'
	END IF
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'GH' THEN
		lds_yb_sfmx.DataObject = 'd_gh_bjy'
		lds_yb_sfmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
		ll_count = lds_yb_sfmx.Retrieve(ldc_ghlsh )
	ELSE
		ls_firstfplsh = ''
		ls_newfp = ''
		ls_fplshs = ls_fplsh_null
		ls_fplsh_temp = ls_fplsh_null
		ls_fplshs[1] = ls_fplsh
		ldc_tzje = 0.00
		ldc_tjzje = 0.00
		ldc_yhje_t = 0.00
		ldc_zjje = 0.00
		ldc_jzje = 0.00
		ldc_yhje = 0.00
		li_gfje = 0.00
		setnull(ldt_kpsj)
		lds_yb_sfmx.DataObject = 'd_cwsf_mz_sfmx_bjy'
		lds_yb_sfmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
		SELECT firstfplsh Into :ls_firstfplsh From mz_tpxx Where newfplsh = :ls_fplsh And tpxh = 0;
		IF ls_firstfplsh > '' THEN			
			ls_fplshs[2] = ls_firstfplsh
			SELECT to_char(wm_concat(newfplsh)) Into :ls_newfp  From mz_tpxx Where firstfplsh = :ls_firstfplsh And tpxh = 0 And newfplsh <> :ls_fplsh;
			IF ls_newfp > ' ' THEN
				gf_splitparm(ls_newfp,ls_fplsh_temp)
				IF UpperBound(ls_fplsh_temp) > 0 THEN
					FOR ll_cur = 1 To UpperBound(ls_fplsh_temp)
						ls_fplshs[2 + ll_cur] = ls_fplsh_temp[ll_cur]
					NEXT
				END IF
			END IF
			SELECT GHLSH,xmzje,jzje,nvl(yhje,0),gfje,kpsj Into :ldc_ghlsh,:ldc_zjje,:ldc_jzje,:ldc_yhje,:li_gfje,:ldt_kpsj From mz_fpk Where fplsh = :ls_firstfplsh;
			IF li_gfje = 1 THEN
				SELECT sum(nvl(yhje,0)) Into :ldc_yhje_t From mz_fpk Where grbm = :ls_brbm And kpsj >= :ldt_kpsj  And fplsh In (SELECT fplsh From mz_tpxx Where firstfplsh = :ls_firstfplsh And tpxh = 0 );
				IF IsNull(ldc_yhje_t) THEN ldc_yhje_t = 0
			END IF
			SELECT sum(t_zje),sum(t_jzje) Into :ldc_tzje,:ldc_tjzje From mz_tpxx Where firstfplsh = :ls_firstfplsh And tpxh = 0 ;
			IF IsNull(ldc_tzje) THEN ldc_tzje = 0
			IF IsNull(ldc_tjzje) THEN ldc_tjzje = 0
			ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje - ldc_tzje - ldc_yhje_t
			ldc_jzje = ldc_jzje - ldc_tjzje
		END IF
		ldc_jzlsh = 0
		ls_ysbm = ''
		ls_ksbm = ''
		ll_count = lds_yb_sfmx.Retrieve(ls_fplshs )
		if ll_count <= 0 then 
			as_error ='明细出错' +  lds_yb_sfmx.is_error
			return -1
		end if
		//	获取对应的KSBM,YSBM,GHLSH,JZLSH GH.CBDXZQH
		SELECT GH.YSBM,GH.KSBM, JZ.JZLSH INTO :ls_ysbm,:ls_ksbm,:ldc_jzlsh
			FROM JKXT.ZHYB_MZJZXX JZ,JKXT.ZHYB_GHXX GH
			Where GH.BRBM = JZ.BRBM And GH.JZID = JZ.JZID And GH.BRBM = :ls_brbm And GH.ywlsh = :ls_fplsh;
		IF ls_ysbm = '000000' THEN
			ls_ysbm = ''
		ELSE
			SELECT ygdm Into :ls_ysbm From gy_ygdm_kz Where gjybdm = :ls_ysbm;
			//ls_ksbm = 'YB+' +ls_ksbm
		END IF
		IF ldc_jzlsh > 0  THEN
			SELECT JZKS Into :ls_ksbm From MZ_JZXX Where JZLSH = :ldc_jzlsh;
		END IF
	END IF
	
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'SF' And ll_count > 0  THEN
		
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
			ldc_cflsh = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
			ls_ywlsh = String(ldc_cflsh)
			ls_zh  = String(lds_yb_sfmx.Object.mxxh[ll_cur])
			ls_filter = ''
			IF lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur] = 'CF' THEN
				If (ldc_jzlsh <= 0 Or IsNull(ldc_jzlsh)) And ll_cur = 1 THEN
					SELECT KSBM Into :ls_ksbm From YPXT.mz_cfk Where cflsh = :ldc_cflsh;
				END IF
				SELECT ycsl,jl,yyts Into :ls_ycsl,:ls_jl,:ll_yyts From mz_cfmx Where cflsh = :ldc_cflsh And xh = :ls_zh Using sqlca;
				lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ycjl[ll_cur] = ls_ycsl
				lds_yb_sfmx.Object.sypc[ll_cur] = ls_jl
				lds_yb_sfmx.Object.yyts[ll_cur] = ll_yyts
				lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ypzh[ll_cur] = ls_zh
				IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_Get_spbz( 'CF', ls_brbm, ldc_cflsh, Dec(ls_zh), ll_spbz, as_error) < 0 THEN
					as_error = '获取spbz失败：' + as_error
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			ELSE
				If (ldc_jzlsh <= 0 Or IsNull(ldc_jzlsh)) And ll_cur = 1 THEN
					SELECT KSBM Into :ls_ksbm From MZXT.MZ_yjk1 Where YJLSH = :ldc_cflsh;
				END IF
				IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_Get_spbz( 'YJ', ls_brbm, ldc_cflsh, Dec(ls_zh), ll_spbz, as_error) < 0 THEN
					as_error = '获取spbz失败：' + as_error
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
			IF IsNull(ll_spbz) THEN ll_spbz = 0
			lds_yb_sfmx.Object.spbz[ll_cur] = ll_spbz
			ldc_xmsl = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_cur]
			ll_fyxh = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmlsh[ll_cur]
			ll_ypcd = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.cdlsh[ll_cur]
			ls_ywlx = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur]
			IF ldc_xmsl < 0 THEN
				//数量小于0 的和正的消掉
				ldc_xmsl = ldc_xmsl * -1
				ls_filter = " ywlx = '"+ls_ywlx+"' and xmlsh = "+String(ll_fyxh)+" and cdlsh = "+String(ll_ypcd) + " and xmdj = " +String(lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmdj[ll_cur])  +" and xmsl >= " + String(ldc_xmsl)
				IF ll_spbz = 9 Or ll_spbz = 1 THEN
					ls_filter += " and spbz in (1,9) "
				ELSE
					ls_filter += " and spbz in (0,2,8) "
				END IF
				ll_find = lds_yb_sfmx.Find(ls_filter,1,ll_cur - 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_find] = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_find] - ldc_xmsl
					IF lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_find] = 0 THEN
						lds_yb_sfmx.DeleteRow( ll_find)
						ll_cur --
						ll_count --
					ELSE
						lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ZJJE[ll_find] = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ZJJE[ll_find] + lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ZJJE[ll_cur]
						lds_yb_sfmx.Object.zfje[ll_find] = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.zfje[ll_find] + lds_yb_sfmx.Object.zfje[ll_cur]
						lds_yb_sfmx.Object.yhje[ll_find] = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.yhje[ll_find] + lds_yb_sfmx.Object.yhje[ll_cur]
					END IF
					lds_yb_sfmx.DeleteRow( ll_cur)
					ll_cur --
					ll_count --
				ELSE
					as_error = String(ll_find) + '找不到大于等于的该正数量的明细' +  String(lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmmc[ll_cur])
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
	IF ll_count <= 0 THEN
		as_error = '无明细' + String(ll_count)
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ldc_jzlsh) Or ldc_jzlsh = 0 THEN
		SELECT Min(JZLSH) Into :ldc_jzlsh From MZ_JZXX Where GHLSH = :ldc_ghlsh;
	END IF
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq = lstr_yb_mzsfqq_null
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_grjbxx = gu_ybjk_public.istr_yb_grjbxx
	//lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_zhxx = gu_ybjk_public.istr_yb_zhxx //病人账户信息
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx = Create datastore //费用明细
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.DataObject = lds_yb_sfmx.DataObject
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Reset()
	lds_yb_sfmx.RowsCopy(1, lds_yb_sfmx.RowCount(), Primary!, lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx, 1, Primary!)
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm = ls_ysbm
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'SF' THEN
		lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.SetSort('xmsl D')
		lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Sort( )
	END IF
	// //市民卡诊间结算，医保是否结算
	//SetNull(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs)
	//lstr_yb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf = '1' //0：支付  1：不支付
	//IF ldc_smkzf <> 0 THEN
	//	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf = '0' //0：支付  1：不支付 --市民卡账户是否支付
	//	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs = '1'
	//ELSE
	//	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf = '1'
	//	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs = '2'
	//END IF
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.GHLSH = ldc_ghlsh
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.JZLSH = ldc_jzlsh
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.KSBM = ls_ksbm
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = ''
	//lstr_yb_mzsfqq.jzlsh = 
	IF ls_jylx = 'TSB' Or ls_jylx = 'MXB' THEN
		lstr_yb_mzsfqq.tsbxmdm = String(lstr_brxx.tsbxm ) //特殊病编码
		lstr_yb_mzsfqq.mxbxmdm = String(lstr_brxx.mxbxm ) //慢性病编码
	END IF
	
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'GH' THEN
		IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_gh_jscl( lstr_brxx.BRBM, False,ls_jylx, gstr_jqxx.as_jqm, lstr_yb_mzsfqq, lstr_yb_mzghqq, as_error) < 0 THEN
			//   IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_gh_jscl( lstr_brxx.brbm, false, ls_jylx, gstr_jqxx.as_jqm, lstr_yb_mzsfqq, lstr_yb_mzghqq, as_error) < 0 THEN
			GOTO Error
		ELSEIF lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.ylfyze + lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.bscfyje <> ldc_zjje Or lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jjzfze <> ldc_jzje THEN
			as_error = '医保与发票金额不一致，医保金额：' + String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.ylfyze) + '--' +String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jjzfze) + '发票金额：' + String (ldc_zjje) +'---'  + String(ldc_jzje)
			IF MessageBox('询问',as_error + '~r~n是否继续补记录'  ,question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
//				as_error = '取消操作'
				GOTO Error
			END IF
//			GOTO Error
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_mz_jscl(lstr_brxx.BRBM, 0, ls_jylx,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,lstr_yb_mzsfqq, as_error ) < 0 THEN
			GOTO Error
		ELSE
			IF lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.ylfyze + lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.bscfyje <> ldc_zjje Or lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jjzfze <> ldc_jzje THEN
				as_error = '医保与发票金额不一致，医保金额：' + String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.ylfyze) + '--' +String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jjzfze) + '发票金额：' + String (ldc_zjje) +'---'  + String(ldc_jzje)
				IF MessageBox('询问',as_error + '~r~n是否继续补记录'  ,question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
					GOTO Error
				END IF
			ELSE
				IF MessageBox('询问','是否继续补记录'  ,question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
					as_error = '取消操作'
					GOTO Error
				END IF				
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	//lstr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = 'A' + as_fplsh
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = ls_fplsh	
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Reset()
	lds_yb_sfmx.RowsCopy(1, lds_yb_sfmx.RowCount(), Primary!, lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx, 1, Primary!)
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm = ls_ysbm
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'SF' THEN
		lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.SetSort('xmsl D')
		lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Sort( )
	END IF
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'GH' THEN
		li_ret = gu_ybjk_public.uf_gh_jscl( lstr_brxx.BRBM, True, ls_jylx, gstr_jqxx.as_jqm, lstr_yb_mzsfqq, lstr_yb_mzghqq, as_error)
	ELSE
		IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_mz_jscl(lstr_brxx.BRBM, 1, ls_jylx,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,lstr_yb_mzsfqq, as_error ) < 0 THEN
			GOTO Error
		END IF
		li_ret = gu_ybjk_public.uf_mz_jscl(lstr_brxx.BRBM, 2, ls_jylx,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,lstr_yb_mzsfqq, as_error )
	END IF
	
IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	ELSE
		ls_jsjylsh = lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jsjylsh
		//本次结算所有的不够市民卡支付，但是如果有支付，那么回滚
		IF IsNull(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje) THEN lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje = 0.00
		//	ldc_smkzf = ldc_smkzf + lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje
		as_error = ''
		IF ldc_smkzf = 0 And lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje <> 0 THEN
			lb_isyz = True
			as_error = '原非市民卡账户支付，但现存在市民卡账户支付:' + String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje)
		ELSEIF ldc_smkzf <> 0 And (lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje <> lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.xjzfze Or ldc_smkzf <> lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje) THEN
			lb_isyz = True
			as_error = '市民卡支付不一致，原:'+String(ldc_smkzf)+'自负：'+String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.xjzfze) +"市民卡："+ String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje)
		END IF
		IF lb_isyz THEN
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_tkqr( 'MZ', lstr_brxx.jzkh,ls_jsjylsh,ldc_zjje,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,ldt_now,lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx,as_error)
			//		gu_ybjk_public.uf_tkqr(lstr_brxx.jzkh,ls_jsjylsh,ldc_zjje,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,ldt_now,lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx,as_error)
			GOTO Error
		END IF
		as_error = as_error + '医保金额：' + String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.ylfyze) + '--' +String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jjzfze)
	END IF
NEXT
IF IsValid(luo_brxx) THEN Destroy luo_brxx
IF IsValid(lds_yb_sfmx) THEN Destroy lds_yb_sfmx
IF IsValid(uds_bjy_temp) THEN Destroy uds_bjy_temp
RETURN 1
Error:

IF IsValid(luo_brxx) THEN Destroy luo_brxx
IF IsValid(lds_yb_sfmx) THEN Destroy lds_yb_sfmx
IF IsValid(uds_bjy_temp) THEN Destroy uds_bjy_temp
RETURN -1


end function

event clicked;String ls_yybz
Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_find,ll_fpcount
DEC{0} ll_ywlsh
String ls_ywlsh,ls_ywlx
ls_yybz = gf_getpara(0,'YYBZ'+String(gi_pyyq),'FEY','医院标志')

IF is_ybjk = 'lb'  THEN RETURN
IF ls_yybz = 'TZFBY' And is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
	ll_count = dw_ybjsmx.RowCount( )
	ll_fpcount = dw_mxdz.RowCount( )
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		ls_ywlsh = dw_ybjsmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
		IF dw_ybjsmx.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = 1 THEN
			IF ii_bplx = 4 Or ii_bplx = 7 Or ii_bplx = 41 THEN
				ll_find = dw_mxdz.Find( "fplsh = '"+ls_ywlsh+"'", 1, ll_fpcount)
				IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
					SELECT COUNT(1) Into :ll_find From MZ_FPK Where FPLSH = :ls_ywlsh Using SQLCA;
				END IF
				IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
					SELECT COUNT(1) Into :ll_find From H_MZ_YCFP Where FPLSH = :ls_ywlsh Using SQLCA;
				END IF
			ELSEIF ii_bplx = 5 Or ii_bplx = 8  or ii_bplx = 51  THEN
				ll_find = dw_mxdz.Find( "string(ghlsh) = '"+ls_ywlsh+"'", 1, ll_fpcount)
				IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
					
					ll_ywlsh = Long(ls_ywlsh)
					SELECT COUNT(1) Into :ll_find From mz_ghxx Where ghlsh = :ll_ywlsh Using SQLCA;
				END IF
			END IF
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
				dw_ybjsmx.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = 99
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
	RETURN
END IF
//========================
IF ii_bplx = 4 Or ii_bplx = 7 Or ii_bplx = 41 THEN //Or ii_bplx = 5 Or ii_bplx = 8 
	ll_count = dw_ybjsmx.RowCount( )
	ll_fpcount = dw_mxdz.RowCount( )
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		ls_ywlx = dw_ybjsmx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur]
		IF ls_ywlx = 'SF' THEN
			IF is_ybjk = 'syd' or is_ybjk ='tzsyd' THEN
				ls_ywlsh = dw_ybjsmx.Object.jyid[ll_cur]
			ELSE
				ls_ywlsh = dw_ybjsmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
			END IF
			IF left(ls_ywlsh,1) ='A' THEN CONTINUE
			IF dw_ybjsmx.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = 1 THEN
				ll_find = dw_mxdz.Find( "fplsh = '"+ls_ywlsh+"'", 1, ll_fpcount)
				IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
					SELECT COUNT(1) Into :ll_find From MZ_FPK Where FPLSH = :ls_ywlsh Using SQLCA;
					IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
						SELECT COUNT(1) Into :ll_find From H_MZ_YCFP Where FPLSH = :ls_ywlsh Using SQLCA;
					END IF
					IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
						dw_ybjsmx.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
ELSEIF ii_bplx = 5 Or ii_bplx = 8 Or ii_bplx = 51 THEN
	ll_count = dw_ybjsmx.RowCount( )
	ll_fpcount = dw_mxdz.RowCount( )
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		ls_ywlx = dw_ybjsmx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur]
		IF ls_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
			IF is_ybjk = 'syd' or is_ybjk ='tzsyd' THEN
				ls_ywlsh = dw_ybjsmx.Object.jyid[ll_cur]
			ELSE
				ls_ywlsh = dw_ybjsmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
			END IF
			IF left(ls_ywlsh,1) ='A' THEN CONTINUE
			IF dw_ybjsmx.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = 1 THEN
				ll_find = dw_mxdz.Find( "GHLSH = "+ls_ywlsh, 1, ll_fpcount)
				IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
					ll_ywlsh = dec(ls_ywlsh)
					SELECT COUNT(1) Into :ll_find From mz_ghxx Where ghlsh = :ll_ywlsh Using SQLCA;
					IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
						dw_ybjsmx.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF

event clicked;
Long ll_ybcount
ll_ybcount = dw_ybjsmx.RowCount( )
IF ll_ybcount > 0 THEN
	String ls_cbrlb,ls_error
	Long ll_jslb,ll_jsdw,ll_ret
	IF Not IsValid(gu_ybjk_public) THEN
		gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
		IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_init( ls_error ) = False THEN
			MessageBox('提示','医保初始化失败！')
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
	IF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzybjk.ib_yd = False
		ls_cbrlb = dw_ybjsmx.Object.ylrylb[1]
	ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzybjk.ib_yd = True
	ELSEif is_ybjk ='zhyb' then
		ls_cbrlb = dw_ybjsmx.Object.ylrylb[1]
	else
		ls_cbrlb = dw_ybjsmx.Object.cbrlb[1]
	END IF
	IF Left(is_ybjk,2) = 'wd' or is_ybjk ='zhyb' THEN
		IF dw_ybjsmx.Object.gbbjdx[1] >= '1'   THEN
			ll_ret = gu_ybjk_public.uf_get_brxz( 'GB' + ls_cbrlb, ll_jslb, ll_jsdw)
		ELSE
			ll_ret = gu_ybjk_public.uf_get_brxz( ls_cbrlb, ll_jslb, ll_jsdw)
		END IF
	ELSE
		ll_ret = gu_ybjk_public.uf_get_brxz( ls_cbrlb, ll_jslb, ll_jsdw)
	END IF 
	
	IF ll_ret  <  0 THEN
		MessageBox('提示','获取病人性质失败')
		RETURN
	END IF
	String ls_ywlsh
	Long ll_count,ll_row,ll_find
	Dec{2} ldc_fyze,ldc_zfje,ldc_jzje
	ll_count = dw_mxdz.RowCount( )
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ls_ywlsh = dw_mxdz.Object.fplsh[ll_row]
		IF Left(ls_ywlsh,1) = 'T' THEN ls_ywlsh = Mid(ls_ywlsh,2)
		ll_find = dw_ybjsmx.Find("YWLX = 'SF' AND YWLSH = '"+ls_ywlsh+"'", 1, ll_ybcount)
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			IF left(is_ybjk,2) = 'tz' THEN
				ldc_fyze = dw_ybjsmx.Object.fyze[ll_find]
				ldc_jzje = dw_ybjsmx.Object.hjbxje[ll_find]
				IF ldc_fyze = dw_mxdz.Object.xmzje[ll_row] THEN
					dw_mxdz.Object.xjje[ll_row] = ldc_fyze - ldc_jzje
					dw_mxdz.Object.jzje[ll_row] = ldc_jzje
				END IF
			END IF
			dw_mxdz.Object.jslb[ll_row] = ll_jslb
			dw_mxdz.Object.jsdw[ll_row] = ll_jsdw
		ELSE
			dw_mxdz.Object.jslb[ll_row] = 6034
			dw_mxdz.Object.jsdw[ll_row] = 1001
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF

event open;IF Not IsValid(gu_ybjk_public) THEN
	String ls_error
	gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
	IF Not gu_ybjk_public.uf_init(ls_error) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','医保接口初始化失败' + ls_error)
	END IF
END IF

	dw_main.object.gy_ygdm_kz_sptjs.visible = false

blocks.name: ue_enchange
blocks.text:
event ue_enchange;String ls_filter
Long ll_row,ll_rowcount ,ll_index

ll_rowcount = dw_main.RowCount( )
FOR ll_index = 1 To ll_rowcount
	
	dw_main.SelectRow(ll_index, False)
NEXT
ls_filter = "(gy_ygdm_ygdm like '"+ Trim(This.Text)+"%') or "  +"(gy_ygdm_ygxm like '" +  Trim(This.Text)+"%')"

ll_row = dw_main.Find( ls_filter,il_row +1 ,ll_rowcount)

IF ll_row > 0 THEN
	il_row = ll_row
	dw_main.ScrollToRow( ll_row)
	dw_main.SelectRow(ll_row, True)
ELSE
	il_row = 0
END IF

end event

clicked
blocks.text:
event clicked;String ls_filter

IF Trim(sle_1.Text) <> '' THEN
	IF Left(Trim(sle_1.Text),3) = '.sk' THEN
		ls_filter = "isnull(gy_ygdm_kz_sybdm)  "
	ELSEIF  Left(Trim(sle_1.Text),3) = '.sn' THEN
		ls_filter = "gy_ygdm_kz_sybdm <> ''"
	ELSEIF  Left(Trim(sle_1.Text),3) = '.lk' THEN
		ls_filter = "isnull(gy_ygdm_kz_sptdm )"
	ELSEIF  Left(Trim(sle_1.Text),3) = '.ln' THEN
		ls_filter = "gy_ygdm_kz_sptdm <> ''"
	ELSE
		ls_filter = 'gy_ygdm_ksdm = '+Trim(sle_1.Text)
	END IF
	
ELSE

event clicked;String ls_Brbm,ls_fplsh,ls_fplsh_1,ls_fplsh_yb,ls_cbrlb,ls_temp
//根据病人编码和fplsh查找对应的明细
//判断和zffs的金额是否一致，一致则改不一致则不改
Long ll_count,ll_row,ll_cur,ll_jslb,ll_jsdw
Dec{2} ldc_ybje,ldc_fpzjje,ldc_ybzjje,ldc_fpje
ll_count = tab_1.tabpage_3.dw_6.RowCount()
//ll_count = 3
debugbreak()
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ls_fplsh = tab_1.tabpage_3.dw_6.Object.fplsh[ll_row]
		ls_Brbm = tab_1.tabpage_3.dw_6.Object.grbm[ll_row]
		ldc_fpje = tab_1.tabpage_3.dw_6.Object.fpje[ll_row]
		ldc_fpzjje = tab_1.tabpage_3.dw_6.Object.zzje[ll_row]
		IF Mid(ls_fplsh,8,1) = '0' THEN
			ls_fplsh_1 = '60080991' + Right(ls_fplsh,4)
		ELSE
			ls_fplsh_1 = '60080990' + Right(ls_fplsh,4)
		END IF
		SELECT ywlsh,xjzfze,ylfyze,cbrlb Into :ls_fplsh_yb,:ldc_ybje,:ldc_ybzjje,:ls_cbrlb From jkxt.yb_jsmx Where brbm = :ls_Brbm And (ywlsh = :ls_fplsh Or ywlsh = :ls_fplsh_1) And ztbz = 1;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			SELECT TJLXH Into :ls_temp From XTGL.GY_DMZD_DZ Where TNAME = 'GY_TGDW' And DMSB = :ls_cbrlb Using sqlca ;
			IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
				ll_jslb = Long(Mid(ls_temp,1,4))
				ll_jsdw = Long(Mid(ls_temp,5,4))
			ELSE
				gf_applog(ls_fplsh +"获取结算类别错" +sqlca.SQLErrText)
				CONTINUE
			END IF
			
			IF ldc_fpzjje = ldc_ybzjje THEN
				IF ldc_ybje <> ldc_fpje THEN
					gf_applog(ls_fplsh +"现金不对：fp" + String(ldc_fpje) + "yb:" + String(ldc_ybje))
				ELSE
					IF ls_fplsh_yb = ls_fplsh_1 And ls_fplsh <> ls_fplsh_yb THEN
						UPDATE jkxt.yb_jsmx Set ywlsh = :ls_fplsh Where brbm = :ls_Brbm And (ywlsh = :ls_fplsh Or ywlsh = :ls_fplsh_1) And ztbz = 1;
						IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
							gf_applog(ls_fplsh +"出错" +sqlca.SQLErrText)
							gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
						END IF
					END IF
					UPDATE mz_fpk Set jslb = :ll_jslb,jsdw = :ll_jsdw Where fplsh = :ls_fplsh;
					IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
						gf_applog(ls_fplsh +"完成")
						gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
					ELSE
						gf_applog(ls_fplsh +"出错" +sqlca.SQLErrText)
						gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
					END IF
				END IF
			ELSE
				gf_applog(ls_fplsh +"金额不对：fp" + String(ldc_fpzjje) + "yb:" + String(ldc_ybzjje))
			END IF
		ELSE
			gf_applog(ls_fplsh +"查询出错" + sqlca.SQLErrText)
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF






end event

Long ll_row,ll_find
ll_row = dw_ybjsmx.GetRow( )
IF ll_row > 0 And ll_row <= dw_ybjsmx.RowCount( ) THEN
	IF dw_ybjsmx.Object.jydd[ll_row] = 'YDZF' And dw_ybjsmx.Object.ywlx[ll_row] = 'SF' THEN
		DateTime ldt_jssj,ldt_kpsj
		String ls_ywlsh,ls_cbrlb,ls_error,ls_brbm
		Long ll_jslb,ll_jsdw,ll_ret
		Dec{2} ldc_fyze,ldc_xjzc,ldc_jjzf,ldc_xmzje
		Dec{0} ldc_jylsh = 0
		ldt_jssj = dw_ybjsmx.Object.JSSJ[ll_row]
		ls_ywlsh = dw_ybjsmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_row]
		ls_cbrlb = dw_ybjsmx.Object.ylrylb[ll_row]
		ldc_fyze = dw_ybjsmx.Object.ylfze[ll_row]
		ldc_xjzc = dw_ybjsmx.Object.grxjzc[ll_row]
		ls_brbm = dw_ybjsmx.Object.brbm[ll_row]
		ldc_jjzf =  dw_ybjsmx.Object.jjzfze[ll_row] + dw_ybjsmx.Object.grzhzc[ll_row]
		ll_find = dw_mxdz.Find( "FPLSH = '"+ls_ywlsh+"'", 1, dw_mxdz.RowCount())
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			RETURN
		ELSE
			SELECT kpsj,xmzje Into :ldt_kpsj,:ldc_xmzje From mz_fpk Where fplsh = :ls_ywlsh;
			IF Date(ldt_kpsj) <> Date(ldt_jssj) THEN
				IF ldc_fyze <> ldc_xmzje THEN
					MessageBox('提示','总额不一致：' + String(ldc_fyze) + '--' + String(ldc_xmzje))
					RETURN
				END IF
				IF ldc_xjzc <> 0  THEN
					SELECT jylsh INTO :ldc_jylsh FROM h_mz_zhjymx WHERE brbm  = :ls_brbm AND jysj >= :ldt_kpsj - 0.1 AND jysj < :ldt_kpsj + 0.1
						And jylb = 11 And jyje = :ldc_xjzc *  -1 And jkfs = 12;
					IF IsNull(ldc_jylsh) Or ldc_jylsh = 0 THEN
						MessageBox('提示','h_mz_zhjymx找不到记录')
						RETURN
					END IF
				END IF
				IF Not IsValid(gu_ybjk_public) THEN
					gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
					IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_init( ls_error ) = False THEN
						MessageBox('提示','医保初始化失败！')
						RETURN
					END IF
				END IF
				IF dw_ybjsmx.Object.gbbjdx[1] >= '1'   THEN
					ll_ret = gu_ybjk_public.uf_get_brxz( 'GB' + ls_cbrlb, ll_jslb, ll_jsdw)
				ELSE
					ll_ret = gu_ybjk_public.uf_get_brxz( ls_cbrlb, ll_jslb, ll_jsdw)
				END IF
				
				IF ll_ret  <  0 THEN
					MessageBox('提示','获取病人性质失败')
					RETURN
				END IF
				
				dw_mxdz.Object.jslb[ll_row] = ll_jslb
				dw_mxdz.Object.jsdw[ll_row] = ll_jsdw
				//MZ_FPK
				UPDATE MZ_FPK SET KPSJ = :ldt_jssj,RJSJ = :ldt_jssj,JSLB = :ll_jslb ,JSDW = :ll_jsdw ,
					XJJE = :ldc_xjzc,JZJE = :ldc_jjzf   Where fplsh = :ls_ywlsh;
				IF SQLCA.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
					ls_error = 'MZ_FPK:' + SQLCA.SQLErrText
					ROLLBACK Using SQLCA;
					GOTO Error
				END IF
				//MZ_SFMX
				UPDATE MZ_SFMX Set SFSJ = :ldt_jssj  Where fplsh = :ls_ywlsh;
				IF SQLCA.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
					ls_error = 'MZ_SFMX:' + SQLCA.SQLErrText
					ROLLBACK Using SQLCA;
					GOTO Error
				END IF
				//H_MZ_WDYFP
				UPDATE H_MZ_WDYFP Set kpsj = :ldt_jssj  Where fplsh = :ls_ywlsh;
				IF SQLCA.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
					ls_error = 'H_MZ_WDYFP:' + SQLCA.SQLErrText
					ROLLBACK Using SQLCA;
					GOTO Error
				END IF

This.SelectRow( 0, False )

String ls_jylsh,ls_grbh, ls_jsid, ls_jzid, ls_cbdxzqh, ls_error,ls_ywlx,ls_ylcbd,ls_brbm

Long ll_rowCount,ll_zyh
Boolean lb_ybydzf = False
IF This.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zxmx' THEN
	ls_grbh = This.Object.rybh[row]
	ls_jsid = This.Object.jsid[row]
	ls_jzid = This.Object.jzid[row]
	ls_jylsh = This.Object.fsfid[row]
	IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
		MessageBox("提示", "个人编号不能为空！")
		RETURN
	END IF
	
	IF IsNull(ls_jsid) Or Trim(ls_jsid) = "" THEN
		MessageBox("提示", "结算ID不能为空！")
		RETURN
	END IF
	
	IF IsNull(ls_jzid) Or Trim(ls_jzid) = "" THEN
		MessageBox("提示", "就诊ID不能为空！")
		RETURN
	END IF
	DateTime ldt_jssj
	ldt_jssj = DateTime(Date(em_1.getdate()))
	ls_ylcbd = Left(iu_zhyl_his.is_yljgxzqh,4)
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_rowCount From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :ldt_jssj - 15 And (jslsh = :ls_jsid Or jylsh = :ls_jylsh) And grbh = :ls_grbh And substr(cbdxzqh,1,4) = :ls_ylcbd;
	IF ll_rowCount > 0 THEN
		SELECT ZYH,BRBM,YWLX Into :ll_zyh,:ls_brbm,:ls_ywlx From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And jylsh = :ls_jylsh;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
			SELECT ZYH,BRBM,YWLX Into :ll_zyh,:ls_brbm,:ls_ywlx From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And jslsh = :ls_jsid;
		END IF
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
			SELECT ZYH,BRBM,YWLX Into :ll_zyh,:ls_brbm,:ls_ywlx From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And grbh = :ls_grbh;
		END IF
	ELSE
		SELECT BRBM, cbdxzqh Into :ls_brbm, :ls_cbdxzqh From jkxt.zhyb_ydzfts Where grbh = :ls_grbh And substr(cbdxzqh,1,4) = :ls_ylcbd And scsj >= :ldt_jssj - 7;
		//		SELECT cbdxzqh Into :ls_cbdxzqh From jkxt.yb_brjbxx Where grbh = :ls_grbh And substr(cbdxzqh,1,4) = :ls_ylcbd;
		IF IsNull(ls_cbdxzqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdxzqh) = ""  THEN
			SELECT BRBM, cbdxzqh Into :ls_brbm, :ls_cbdxzqh From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where grbh = :ls_grbh And substr(cbdxzqh,1,4) = :ls_ylcbd And jssj >= :ldt_jssj - 7;
		END IF
		IF IsNull(ls_cbdxzqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdxzqh) = "" THEN
			MessageBox("提示", "参保地行政区划不能为空！")
			RETURN
		END IF
		IF This.Object.tfjsbz[row] = '1' and This.Object.ylfze[row] < 0 THEN //This.Object.jylx[row] = '-1' And
			SELECT jssj,jslsh,cbdxzqh Into :ldt_jssj, :ls_jsid_y,:ls_cbdxzqh From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where BRBM = :ls_brbm And jssj > :ldt_jssj - 30 And  ztbz In (1,2) And jzid = :ls_jzid And substr(cbdxzqh,1,4) = :ls_ylcbd;
			IF IsNull(ls_jsid_y) Or ls_jsid_y = '' THEN
				MessageBox("提示", "获取原交易流水失败！")
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
		lb_ybydzf = True
	END IF
ELSEIF This.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zxmx_yd' THEN
	ls_grbh = This.Object.rybh[row]
	ls_jsid = This.Object.jsid[row]
	ls_jzid = This.Object.jzsxh[row]
	ls_jylsh = This.Object.fsbwid[row]
	ls_cbdxzqh = This.Object.cbdxzqhdm[row]
	ldt_jssj=  idt_begin
	IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
		MessageBox("提示", "个人编号不能为空！")
		RETURN
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_jsid) Or Trim(ls_jsid) = "" THEN
		MessageBox("提示", "结算ID不能为空！")
		RETURN
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_jzid) Or Trim(ls_jzid) = "" THEN
		MessageBox("提示", "发送报文ID不能为空！")
		RETURN
	END IF
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_rowCount From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :ldt_jssj - 15 And (jslsh = :ls_jsid Or jylsh = :ls_jylsh) And grbh = :ls_grbh And cbdxzqh = :ls_cbdxzqh;
	IF ll_rowCount > 0 THEN
		SELECT ZYH,BRBM,YWLX Into :ll_zyh,:ls_brbm,:ls_ywlx From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And jylsh = :ls_jylsh;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
			SELECT ZYH,BRBM,YWLX Into :ll_zyh,:ls_brbm,:ls_ywlx From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And jslsh = :ls_jsid;
		END IF
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
			SELECT ZYH,BRBM,YWLX Into :ll_zyh,:ls_brbm,:ls_ywlx From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And grbh = :ls_grbh;
		END IF
	ELSE
		SELECT BRBM Into :ls_brbm From jkxt.zhyb_ydzfts Where grbh = :ls_grbh And cbdxzqh = :ls_cbdxzqh And scsj >= :ldt_jssj - 7;
		//		SELECT cbdxzqh Into :ls_cbdxzqh From jkxt.yb_brjbxx Where grbh = :ls_grbh And substr(cbdxzqh,1,4) = :ls_ylcbd;
		IF IsNull(ls_brbm) Or Trim(ls_brbm) = ""  THEN
			SELECT BRBM Into :ls_brbm From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where grbh = :ls_grbh And cbdxzqh = :ls_cbdxzqh And jssj >= :ldt_jssj - 7;
		END IF
		IF IsNull(ls_brbm) Or Trim(ls_brbm) = "" THEN
			MessageBox("提示", "对应brbm为空！")
			RETURN
		END IF
		IF This.Object.jylx[row] = '-1' or This.Object.ylfze[row] < 0 THEN //This.Object.jylx[row] = '-1' And
			SELECT jssj,jslsh Into :ldt_jssj, :ls_jsid_y From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where BRBM = :ls_brbm And jssj > :ldt_jssj - 30 And  ztbz In (1,2) And jzid = :ls_jzid And cbdxzqh = :ls_cbdxzqh;
			IF IsNull(ls_jsid_y) Or ls_jsid_y = '' THEN
				MessageBox("提示", "获取原交易流水失败！")
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
		lb_ybydzf = True
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN
END IF
//医保移动支付
IF lb_ybydzf THEN
	
//	IF This.Object.tfjsbz[row] = '1'  and This.Object.ylfze[row] < 0 THEN //This.Object.jylx[row] = '-1' And
//		SELECT jssj,jslsh Into :ldt_jssj, :ls_jsid_y From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where BRBM = :ls_brbm And jssj > :ldt_jssj - 30 And  ztbz In (1,2) And jzid = :ls_jzid And cbdxzqh = :ls_cbdxzqh;
//		IF IsNull(ls_jsid_y) Or ls_jsid_y = '' THEN
//			MessageBox("提示", "获取原交易流水失败！")
//			RETURN
//		END IF
//	END IF
	// 签到
	IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref ls_error) < 0 THEN
		MessageBox('提示', ls_error)
		RETURN
	END IF
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_init('5203')
	iu_zhyl_his.istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdxzqh
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('setl_id', ls_jsid)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('mdtrt_id', ls_jzid)
	IF Not iu_zhyl_his.uf_send(Ref ls_error, '') THEN
		MessageBox('提示', ls_error)
		RETURN
	END IF
	ll_rowCount = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_mxnr( 'setlinfo')
	IF ll_rowCount > 0 THEN
		String ls_yllb,ls_bzbm,ls_return,ls_bzdm
		str_zhyl_jsxx lstr_yb_jsxx
		iu_zhyl_his.of_get_ybjsxx( 99, lstr_yb_jsxx)
		ls_yllb = lstr_yb_jsxx.yllb
		ls_bzdm = lstr_yb_jsxx.bzbm
		if left(lstr_yb_jsxx.fsbwid,1) = 'H' then ls_jylsh = lstr_yb_jsxx.fsbwid
		iu_zhyl_his.is_jylsh = ls_jylsh
		iu_zhyl_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh = ls_grbh
		//判断是否有记录，有则return
		IF This.Object.ylfze[row] > 0 THEN
			IF IsNull(lstr_yb_jsxx.invono ) THEN lstr_yb_jsxx.invono = 'YDZFBJY'
			IF iu_zhyl_his.of_insert_jymx(ls_brbm, 0, 0, lstr_yb_jsxx.invono , 'SF', 'YDZFBJY', ls_yllb, ls_bzdm, 'YDZF', lstr_yb_jsxx, ls_return) < 0 THEN
				MessageBox( '提示','插入结算记录失败！' + ls_return)
				RETURN
			END IF
			IF iu_zhyl_his.of_update_jsmx( ls_jylsh, lstr_yb_jsxx, ls_return) < 0 THEN
				MessageBox( '提示','更新结算记录失败！' + ls_return)
				RETURN
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF iu_zhyl_his.of_update_jymx_tp( 'SF', ls_jsid_y, 'BJY', ldt_jssj, lstr_yb_jsxx,  ls_return) < 0 THEN
				MessageBox( '提示','退结算记录修改失败！' + ls_return)
			END IF
		END IF
		IF This.Object.ylfze[row] > 0 THEN //This.Object.tfjsbz[row] = '0' And
	      if left(ls_cbdxzqh,4) = '3303' then
				if This.Object.tfjsbz[row] = '0' then RETURN
			end if
			IF MessageBox('询问','是否作废该记录？',question!,yesno!,2) = 1 THEN
				IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_jyzf(ldt_jssj,'2207',ls_grbh,ls_jylsh,ls_return) = -1 THEN
					MessageBox('提示','改账失败'+ls_return)
					RETURN
				ELSE
					MessageBox('提示','改帐成功')
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSE
		MessageBox( '查询成功','无结算记录！')
	END IF
	RETURN
END IF
IF ll_zyh > 0 THEN
	ii_bplx = 6
ELSE
	IF ls_ywlx = "" Or ls_ywlx = "SF" THEN
		ii_bplx = 4
	ELSEIF ls_ywlx = "GH" THEN
		ii_bplx = 5
	END IF
END IF
s_exchange ls_exchange
ls_exchange.LongParm[1] = ii_bplx
ls_exchange.LongParm[2] = ll_zyh

ls_exchange.StringParm[2] = ls_jsid

ls_exchange.datetimeparm[2] = idt_end
ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'zhyb'
OpenWithParm(w_sbdz_zhyb_bptz, ls_exchange)

end event

li_ret = 0

	IF MessageBox('提示',ls_jsjylsh + '的交易时间'+String(ldt_jssj)+'可能存在跨天，是否继续申请改帐！',Question!,YesNo!,2) = 2 THEN
		RETURN
	END IF

If (ls_ywlx = 'GH' Or ls_ywlx = 'SF') THEN
	IF ld_ylfyze >= 0 THEN
		ls_ywlx = '2207'
	ELSE
		ls_ywlx = '2208'
	END IF
ELSEIF 	ls_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	IF ld_ylfyze >= 0 THEN
		ls_ywlx = '2304'

		ls_ywlx = '2305'
	END IF

li_ret = iu_zhyl_his.uf_jyzf(ldt_jssj,ls_ywlx,ls_grbh,ls_jsjylsh,ls_return)
IF li_ret = -1 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','改账失败'+ls_return)
	RETURN
ELSE	
	MessageBox('提示','改帐成功')
END IF
end event

	u_datastore luds_sfmx
	IF Not IsValid(luds_sfmx) THEN
		luds_sfmx = Create u_datastore
		luds_sfmx.DataObject = 'd_mzsf_yw_gl'
		luds_sfmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	END IF
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ls_brbm = dw_list.Object.brbm[ll_row]
		lstr_brxx = lstr_brxx_null
		lstr_brxx.brbm = ls_brbm
		lstr_return = luo_brxx.uf_get_brxx( 'BRBM', lstr_brxx)
		IF lstr_return.ai_return < 0 THEN
			MessageBox('提示','获取病人基本信息失败' + lstr_return.as_error )
			CONTINUE
		END IF
		ldc_ysje = dw_list.Object.ysje[ll_row]
		if ldc_ysje <= 0 then continue
		ls_yybz = dw_list.Object.yybz[ll_row]
		ll_yybz = Long(ls_yybz)
		gu_mz_zhjz.uf_setyybz(ll_yybz)
		ls_fplsh = dw_list.Object.fplsh[ll_row]
		ls_fplshs[1] = ls_fplsh
		ldt_kpsj = dw_list.Object.sfsj[ll_row]
		ldc_jylsh = gf_get_max(sqlca,'H_MZ_ZHJYMX',1)
		gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
		UPDATE mz_fpk Set xjje = xjje + :ldc_ysje ,jzje = jzje - :ldc_ysje Where fplsh = :ls_fplsh;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			gf_applog(ls_fplsh + "更新fpk失败：" +sqlca.SQLErrText)
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			CONTINUE
		END IF
		SELECT count(1),Max(xh) Into :ll_zffs5,:li_xh From h_fp_zffs Where fplsh = :ls_fplsh And zffs = 5;
		IF ll_zffs5 > 0 THEN
			UPDATE h_fp_zffs Set ZFJE = ZFJE + :ldc_ysje  Where fplsh = :ls_fplsh And zffs = 5;
		ELSE
			IF IsNull(li_xh) THEN
				li_xh = 1
			ELSE
				li_xh = li_xh + 1
			END IF
			INSERT Into h_fp_zffs(fplsh,xh,zffs,ZFJE) Values (:ls_fplsh,:li_xh,5,:ldc_ysje) Using sqlca;
		END IF
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			gf_applog(ls_fplsh + "更新h_fp_zffs失败：" +sqlca.SQLErrText)
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			CONTINUE
		END IF
		UPDATE h_mz_zhye Set zhye = zhye - :ldc_ysje Where brbm = :ls_brbm And ZHLB = 1;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			gf_applog(ls_fplsh + "更新H_MZ_ZHYE失败：" +sqlca.SQLErrText)
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			CONTINUE
		END IF
		INSERT INTO H_MZ_ZHJYMX(JYLSH,JYLB,BRBM,ZHLB,JYJE,ZFJE,JYSJ,ZHYE,CZYBM,JYDD,JKFS,YYBZ,ZJLY,JYDJH)
			Values (:ldc_jylsh,11,:ls_brbm,1,:ldc_ysje * -1,:ldc_ysje * -1,:ldt_kpsj,0,'9999','BJY',5,:ll_yybz,0,'补收');
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			gf_applog(ls_fplsh  + "插入H_MZ_ZHJYMX失败：" +sqlca.SQLErrText)
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			CONTINUE
		END IF
		ll_mxcount = luds_sfmx.Retrieve(ls_fplshs )
		if ll_mxcount <=0 then
			gf_applog(ls_fplsh  + "获取sfmx失败：" +luds_sfmx.is_error)
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			CONTINUE
		end if
		ll_sqlcode = 0
		FOR ll_mxrow = 1 To ll_mxcount
			ldc_ywlsh = luds_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_mxrow]
			ls_ywlx =  luds_sfmx.Object.ywlx[ll_mxrow]
			INSERT Into H_MZ_ZHJYMX_GL(JYLSH,ywlsh,YWLY) Values (:ldc_jylsh,:ldc_ywlsh,:ls_ywlx);
			IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				ll_sqlcode = sqlca.SQLCode
				gf_applog(ls_fplsh + "插入H_MZ_ZHJYMX_GL失败：" +sqlca.SQLErrText)
				gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
				EXIT
			END IF
		NEXT
		IF ll_sqlcode <> 0 THEN
			gf_applog(ls_fplsh  + "插入H_MZ_ZHJYMX_GL失败：" +sqlca.SQLErrText)
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			CONTINUE
		END IF
		gf_applog(ls_fplsh  + "完成")
		gf_COMMIT_transaction(sqlca)
		ldc_ysje = 0.00		
	NEXT
END IF

blocks.name: doubleclicked
blocks.text:
event doubleclicked;call super::doubleclicked;String ls_brbm, ls_jsjylsh
Dec{0} ll_zyh
DateTime ldt_jysj
String ls_jzkh
s_exchange ls_exchange

IF row > 0 THEN
	il_select = row
	nextrow:
	This.SelectRow( 0, False )
	This.SelectRow( il_select, True )
	
	IF ii_bplx = 6 THEN //住院
		ll_zyh = This.Object.zyh[il_select]
	ELSEIF ii_bplx = 3 THEN //基金支付不平
		IF This.Object.zyh[il_select] > 0 THEN
			ll_zyh = This.Object.zyh[il_select]
			ii_bplx = 32 //基金支付不平（住院）
		ELSE
			ls_brbm = This.Object.brbm[il_select]
			ii_bplx = 31 //基金支付不平（门诊）
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_brbm = This.Object.brbm[il_select]
	END IF
	IF ii_bplx = 4 Or ii_bplx = 41 THEN
		IF cbx_1.Checked  THEN
			ii_bplx = 41
		ELSE
			ii_bplx = 4
		END IF
	END IF
	IF ii_bplx = 5 Or ii_bplx = 51 THEN
		IF cbx_1.Checked  THEN
			ii_bplx = 51
		ELSE
			ii_bplx = 5
		END IF
	END IF
	ls_exchange.LongParm[1] = ii_bplx
	ls_exchange.LongParm[2] = ll_zyh
	ls_exchange.StringParm[1] = ls_brbm
	ls_exchange.StringParm[2] = ls_jsjylsh
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[1] = idt_begin
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[2] = idt_end
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[3] = ldt_jysj
	IF ll_zyh > 0 THEN
		SELECT SBHM Into :ls_jzkh From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ll_zyh Using sqlca;
	ELSE
		SELECT jzkh Into :ls_jzkh From mzxt.mz_brda Where brbm = :ls_brbm Using sqlca;
	END IF
	ls_exchange.StringParm[3]='zhyb'
//	IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
//		IF Left(ls_jzkh,4) = '3303' OR len(ls_jzkh) < 30 THEN
//			ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'wd'
//		ELSE
//			IF Left(ls_jzkh,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
//				Long ll_count
//				SELECT COUNT(1) Into :ll_count From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj <= :idt_end And brbm = :ls_brbm ;
//				IF ll_count > 0  THEN
//					ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'wd'
//				ELSE
//					ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'syd'
//				END IF
//			ELSE
//				ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'syd'
//			END IF
//		END IF
//	END IF
	OpenWithParm(w_sbdz_zhyb_bptz, ls_exchange)
	IF ii_bplx = 41 or ii_bplx = 51 THEN
		IF il_select + 1 <= This.RowCount( ) THEN
			il_select = il_select + 1
			GOTO nextrow
		ELSE
			MessageBox('提示','完成')
			event ue_ref()
		END IF
	END IF
END IF


end event
